tei:titleStmt.tei:title: bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung skor pod phyi ma (ja)pa la/bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/sngon 'gro chos spyod dpag bsam rab rgyas zhes bya ba kun 'dus
bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung skor pod phyi ma (ja)pa la/bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/sngon 'gro chos spyod dpag bsam rab rgyas zhes bya ba kun 'dus

tei:div.tei:p: bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung skor pod phyi ma (ja)pa la/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ sngon 'gro chos spyod dpag bsam rab rgyas zhes bya ba kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs/ bla ma drag po'i byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i dbyangs ring*/ bla ma zhi ba'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma'i las byang gdung ba zhi byed/ khrag 'thung padma drag po'i zhi sgrub rig 'dzin he ru ka yi/ bsnyen pa'i dmigs rkang thugs mchog rdo rje'i zhal lung*/ rigs 'dzin padma'i las mtha' las/ dbang chen tshe yi las byang rdo rje'i snying po/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i nor sgrub bsod nams stobs bskyed kyi las byang*/ gu ru nor lha dbyer med kyi g.yang 'bod dngos grub char 'bebs/ padma khrag 'thung 'dus pa las/ sgrub thabs snying po'i bcud dril/ mngon rtogs nad 'joms par bu chog khrigs/ bla ma'i padma khrag 'thung las/ nad rims srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ khyung sgrub nā ga 'joms byed chog khrigs su bkod pa 'od gdon mthar byed/ rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs bde chen dpal bskyed/ rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i las byang bde chen dpal mo'i rol rtsed/ rtsa rlung dpal bskyed mkha' 'gro'i bsnyen dmigs/ khrag 'thung padma drag po'i las byang rdo rje gad rgyangs/ mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba 'dod rgu yid 'joms gter bum/ khrag 'thung padma drag po'i las byang rdo rje'i gad rgyangs/ mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba 'dod rgu yid 'joms bsnyen dmigs/ khrag 'thung padma drag po'i las byang rdo rje'i gad rgyangs/ mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba 'dod rgu yid 'joms gter 'bum/ a phyi'i ka bstod/ khrag 'thung padma drag po'i gtor zlog phas rgol dpung 'joms/ padma khrag 'thung gi bzlog pa grangasagasog rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi dam sri mnan pa ldang med 'chi bdag nag po'i gre hom du gtad pa/

bla ma zhi ba'i sreg blugs ye shes 'od dpung*/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ bsnyen sgrub kha skong zhi ba'i sreg blugs zla ba'i bdud rtsi/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ bzlas sngags dmigs pa'i zin bris snyan brgyud gdams ngag bcud kyi snying po/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ bsnyen sgrub kyi yi ge grub gnyis 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpal ster/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi/ rdzogs rim snying po'i yang bcud/ tshe sgrub padma gsang thig gi /tshe dpal 'gugs dang dngos grub len chog

'di yi dbu mjug tu brda yig 'dug kyang ma dpe ma rnyed pas ci bya zad slad rnyed par gyur na dbu mjug gi sa stong der 'bri rogs zhu/ spang byang smon tshig /bcas chos sde so gnyis bzhugs pa lags so// zhar byung sa bcad gzhan gyi khongs su bzhag pa ni/ i) khrag 'thung padma drag po'i dbang mchog rdo rjespyi blugs/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ snying po'i gtor dbang bskur ba'i tshul ye shes snying po/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ gtum mo'i don khrid rlung sems rang grol gsal byed kyis brgyan pa/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi /rdzogs chen rtsal dbang don khrid kyi dgongs 'grel 'khor 'das rang grol/ bcas bzhi po ni dbang chog phyogs bsdus dang khrid yig phyogs bsgrigs zur bya'o/ /sku gsum kun 'dus bla ma padma 'byung*/ /yi dam yongs 'dus gtum drag khyung zhon rtsal/ /mkha' 'gro'i spyi dpal phag mo rlung zhags can/ /phrin las lnga rdzogs zab chos bla na med/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongasapa rdzogs pa dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /lhag pa'i lha dang gang de'i chos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e wam̐ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa'ang bla ma drag po'i chos sde yongs rdzogs par du gsar bskrun skabs gter gzhung dang chog khrigs sogs kha skong rigs so sor phyes nas go rim gsar du bsgrigs pa bzhin dpe skrun byed po gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nas dkar chag gsar bkod bgyis skabs yi ge pa ni sgrub brtson au ḍīs bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/

sngon 'gro chos spyod dpag bsam rab rgyas zhes bya ba kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs bzhugs so/ che mchog rtsa gsum kun 'dus lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: dang po tho rangs gti mug gnyid sad dus: rang sems ma bcos lhug par 'bol le bzhag: de nas rlung ro lan gsum bsal ba yis: nyon mongs las sgrib ma lus dag par bsam: ngag tu dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bzlas: ngag sgrib nyams chag dag nas lus stobs 'phel: lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun krong nge bya: skad cig tsam gyis yi dam lha ru bsgom: rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: snang stong ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gyis: 'ja' 'od gur phub snang srid 'od klong 'khyil: rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma de: o rgyan chen po gu ru padma'i tshul: bag gro lhun chags zil phrum gzi brjid 'bar: bdag la thugs nyams dgyes pa'i spyan gyis gzigs: gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems rgyal sras dang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bka' sdod rnams: nyi ma'i 'od dang nyi khyim lta bu 'khod: bdag gis re sa gzhan med blo rtse gtad: 'o dod lhang lhang dkon mchog 'bod pa dang : kha zhe med par skyabs 'gro gsol 'debs bya: mkha' mnyam pha ma 'gro drug thams cad kyis: dbyangs snyan 'ur gyis mthun myur brjod par bsam: na mo buddha ya: na mo dharma ya: na mo saṅga ya: na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍākki sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: kye ma kye ma dkon mchog rin po che: brtse bas gzigs shig mkhyen pa'i ye shes spyan: bdag sogs mun pa'i sdug bsngal 'di nyid las: da lta nyid du grol bar mdzad du gsol: chung ngu'i byis pa gti mug ngang du 'khyams: na so dar dus g.yeng bas nyin mtshan 'das: 'byung ba lus rgud rgas dus rang dbang med: las ngan 'khor ba'i 'dam nas 'don du gsol: legs par bsam na dal 'byor rnyed par dka': mi rtag 'jig sla 'chi rkyen bsam mi khyab: sa steng 'di na 'gul shes sems can kun:

skye ba'i rjes la thams cad 'chi rgyu la: rnam g.yeng le lo can la thugs rjes zungs: srid pa'i rtse nas dmyal khams yan chad du: kun kyang 'gyur ldog 'khor ba'i lus len na: rgyu 'bras bslu ba med par rang la smin: 'chi ba snying nas dran par byin gyis rlobs: lus thog 'di ru dam chos ma byung na: gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal rang bzhin la: phyis nas 'gyod thal dran kyang rang dbang med: da res snying rus nus par thugs rjes zungs: kyai maḥ bslu med dkon mchog gsum po che: bdag sogs skye 'gro sems can la: rgyun du brtse bas skyong ba dang : byang chub bar du gzigs su gsol: sngon chad las ngan dbang gis ni: da bar 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung : da ni mkhyen brtse nus ldan gyis: nam yang 'khor bar ma btang zhig: bdag la re ba gzhan med pas: skyid sdug yar mar gang btang yang : bdag ni mi shes dud 'gro la: skyabs gnas khyed kyi thugs rjes drongs: khyod kyi snying rjes ma drangs na: bdag ni slar yang 'khor bar 'khyams: skyabs dang skyel ma gzhan ma mchis: ji ltar byung yang dkon mchog mkhyen: sngon byon rgyal bas bor nas bskyur: nyan rang sangs rgyas btang snyoms dang : da lta khyed kyis mi gzigs na: dus ngan sems can su la re: de sngon sdig sgrib bsags pa rnams: skyabs mgon khyed kyi mdun du bshags: da ni sdig pa'i las mi byed: ci nus dam pa'i chos la 'bung : 'di dang phyi ma bar do ru: dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og 'jug: sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ni: bdag gi lus ngag yid la stsol: kye ma/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ skyes bu don 'grub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na/ /phyis nas yang dag 'byor pa ga la 'gyur/ ༈ mtshan stong gis 'bar bde gshegs snying po'i sku/ /bsod nams brgya las grub pa'ang mi rtag na/ /chu bur rdol bar yid rton mi rung bas/

/rang gi lus 'di nges par 'chi bar 'gyur/ ༈ lus can skye 'gro dag gi lus rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud ni mi za bas/ /tshogs shing dus la bab par gyur pa na/ /'bras bu smin pa ltung ba nyid du 'gyur/ ༈ 'khor ba'i gnas su me 'obs khab rtse 'dra/ /bde ba'i skabs med zo chun 'khyud mo 'dra/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud thog mtha' med pa la/ /'khor bar 'khor ba'i 'gro rnams snying re rje/ kyai ma kye hud dkon mchog thugs rje can: rgyal ba khyed la brtse ba'i thugs mnga' bas: bdag sogs rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las: da lta nyid du thar bar byin gyis rlobs: de la dang po skyabs su 'gro ba'i rten: kun 'dus gu ru padma sems dpa'i cha byad can: zhi ba'i las byang ltar la: sku dge 'dun: gsung dam chos: thugs sangs rgyas: yon tan yi dam: phrin las chos skyong bcas gsal gdab la: dam bca' ni: na moḥ mdun gyi nam mkha' chos dbyings skye med ngang : ma bcos stong nyid e yi 'phro 'du las: rang byung lhun grub 'od kyi gzhal yas khang : phyi nang gzhal 'das bkod pa rab rgyas pa'i: 'ja' tshon spungs bzhin khyon kun yangs pa'i dbus: dri med gdod ma'i mtsho dkyil pad sdong rtser: chags med skyon bral 'od skur sprul pa'i sku: rje btsun chen po padma thod phreng rtsal: dkar dmar mdangs ldan dri med gzi 'bar ba: mtshan dpe'i sku la rgyal kun rab rdzogs pa'i: phyag mtshan la sogs cha shas ma nyams par: dpa' la rab tu bzhad cing bzhugs pa yi: 'khor yug khyab par bskor ba'i skyabs yul lha: skar tshogs grangs bzhin chu zla'i snang ngor ltar: ma 'dres gsal bzhin gsol ba 'di ltar du: sku gsum bla ma bsgrub par dam bca'o: mi dmigs mdun mkhar: rnam dag mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od klong : bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma rje: rdo rje thod phreng mthing gsal rdor dril bsnams: lha lcam dmar mo rdo rje tshe bum 'dzin:

gnyis med 'khyud sbyor bde chen longs spyod rdzogs: rtsa gsum lha tshogs rab 'byams rgyal kun gtibs: nam mkhas gar khyab thugs rje'i 'od zer 'bar: bdag dang 'gro kun byang chub ma thob bar: rtse gcig mos gus gdung bas skyabs 'gro ni: yid ches nges shes tshad du longs par bya: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na moḥ dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa theg chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed: bdag pas gzhan gces stong nyid snying rje ldan: ma rig 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa: yang dag mchog tu dgod phyir smon 'jug sems: don dam gnyis med blo bral bden par gnas: sngon du yid kyis smon sems bskyed pa ni: g.yas pa pha tshogs: g.yon pa ma tshogs: 'og tu 'gro ba rigs drug bcas gsal gdab: ma sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral gyur cig /bde dang bral bar ma gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang bral gyur cig / 'jug pa sems bskyed ni: sangs rgyas thob pa'i gzhi yin pas: spyod kyi snying rjes gtong len yin: nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems theg rim tshang : ho: gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das don dam sems bskyed do: gsum pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni: hoḥ bdag lus spyi gtsug dung khang pho brang steng : rdo rje sems dpa' dri med shel gyi mdangs: rdo rje dril bu thabs shes phyag rgya can: snyems ma dkar mo rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin: yab yum zung 'jug 'khril thabs skyil krung bzhugs: lha rdzas rin chen rgyan mdzes thugs ka ru: hūm̐ yig mtha' ru yi ge brgya pa ni: g.yas g.yon 'khor bas sdig sgrib bag chags dag: chu zla'i rang bzhin dri med rjen par shar: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya:

sogs gter sgrub las: āḥ bdag lus snang stong rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: dkar gsal 'od phung rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs sku pad zlar skyil krung bzhugs: thugs mchog dwangs ma lnga ldan 'od phung klong : rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rin po che: gcer bu rus rgyan zla zhun 'bum gyi lhun: skyil krung mnyam bzhag thugs kar zla ba'i steng : skye med a yig mtha' mar yig brgyas bskor: de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i zhing kun mchog: thugs rje'i byin bsdus nus stobs tshad med bskyed: nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags bcas par sbyangs: 'od zer mar 'phros khams gsum rigs drug gi: duḥkha kun bsal phan bde'i stobs bskyed de: dran snang rang rig rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rtogs: snod kyi 'jig rten mngon par dga' ba'i zhing : bcud kyi gzugs snang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: sgra grags thams cad rang byung snying po'i gdangs: dran rtog thams cad chos dbyings skye 'gag bral: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su lhun grub gyur: zhes yig brgya dang yang snying 'bru lnga pa sogs ci nus su bzlas: thun mtshams snod bcud gzhal yas lha dang bcas pa bdag gi thugs ka'i āḥlas bsdu zhing : dran rig mi rtog pa'i ngang du bzhag go: brjod nas bzlas 'jug tu: ho: bdag ni bag med rmongs pa yis: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig gi: don dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa: rigs 'dus rdor sems lha la bshags: gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid: thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can: 'gro ba'i don du bdag skyabs mchi: sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so: sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur: bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor chu la nya ldang ba lta bur rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur:

gsum pa: sgrib sbyong bdag nyid rdo rje sems: thugs srog sngags phraing 'od kyis sdig ltung sbyangs: slar yang 'od 'phros snang srid sems dpar gsal: oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba rtags tshad bstun: 'khor 'das 'ub chub ka dag ngang du'o: kṛ ya u pa yo ga'i theg rim tshang : bzhi pa tshogs bsags maṇḍal 'byor tshogs kun: dngos bshams blos sprul sku gsum zhing ma lus: rgyal kun ngo bo bla ma'i 'khor lor 'bul: de nas yig brgya bzlas la/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag: gseg ma la sogs med pa dang : lag mthil ltar mnyam baiḍūrya: rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig: de nas maṇḍal lag tu blangs te rdul phyis nas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi/ sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ dri bzang chu yis brlan byas te/ byang chub sems kyis rgyud brlan par bsam/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐: sogs so bdun gang 'grub 'bul bar bya/ om̐ a hūm̐: sprul sku'i zh-ing khams stong gsum bye ba brgya: longs sku'i bkod pa phung khams dbang por bcas: chos sku khyab bdal rig stong 'dzin med 'di: skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rje la 'bul: tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas yon tan mthar phyin shog: lnga pa byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni: rang lus snang stong yi dam lha yi sku: spyi bor padma stong ldan nyi zla'i steng : sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang : mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar thugs rje'i byin 'od gtibs: mos gus gdung shugs drag po'i rtse gcig tu: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje mngon du gyur: sku gsum dbyer med bla ma rin po cher: gsol ba 'debs so thugs rgyud byin rlabs stsol: sku gsung thugs ldan dkon mchog gsum gyi ngang : rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma rin po cher: gsol ba 'debs so dgongs pa rtogs grol stsol: rtsa gsum dbyer med yid bzhin nor bu'i sku:

mkhyen brtse nus ldan bla ma rin po cher: gsol ba 'debs so rtogs pa mthar phyin stsol/ rje btsun khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs: zhes kha snying sprad la gsol ba btab/ ༈ rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol gyi/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa kun tu bzang : rang dbyings gsal dag rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang : thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul thub chen rdo rje sems: sku gsum ston pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs: don brgyud yongs rdzogs 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon: brda tshig mngon gyur dga' rab rdo rje rtsal: rig rtsal dbang thob 'chi med padma 'byung : 'gro 'dren mchog gi sprul skur gsol ba 'debs: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gsang mdzod mtsho rgyal lcam: theg mchog bstan pa'i srol 'dzin rje 'bangs grogs: sku gsum rgyal tshab gter ston sprul pa'i sku: gang 'dul phrin las mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ bka' gter snyan brgyud zab don gdams pa'i mdzod: rgyal kun dgongs gsang ye shes gdod ma'i srog: mngon sum rjen par ston mdzad bka' drin can: kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs: snang srid rnam dag 'ja' 'od theg le'i klong : phung khams rnam dag zhi khro rab 'byams lha: rang sems rnam dag rig pa rang grol sku: gzhi grol rdzogs pa che la gsol ba 'debs: rje btsun chen po o rgyan rin po che: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa: ye nas sangs rgyas yin kyang ngo ma shes: 'khrul pa'i phu thag chod par byin gyis rlobs: don med srid pa'i bag chags las ldog ste: nyin mtshan bar med chos kyis 'da' ba dang : chos brgyad bag chags kun gzhi bcas pa kun: 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings su dag par shog: yin lugs cig car rtogs pas bdag grol nas: ting 'dzin mngon shes rdzu 'phrul grub rtags ldan: rtsol med mkhyen brtse'i thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol: phyam gcig 'od gsal snying po grol bar shog:

dag snang phyogs med nyin mtshan 'od gsal ngang : bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: byams dang snying rje rgyun chad med pa yis: gang 'dul phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par shog: rtse gcig bsgrubs pas bla ma mnyes pa dang : dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung kun bral zhing : 'khruul gzugs gdos bcas lus ngag sems rnams kun: tshe gcig rang mdangs 'od skur dag par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra ma hā dzñā na dharma buddha yo gi ni siddhi sa ma ya dza dzaḥ

zhes sngags phreng rnams ci nus bzlas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐ badzra sa ma ya dza siddhi pha la hūm̐: a bhi sha ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: drug pa dbang bzhi blangs shing bdag dang dbyer med bsres/ hūm̐: rje btsun chen po o rgyan rin po che: zol med bdag gis re ltos nyid las med: sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dam pas thugs rjes zungs: byin gyis rlobs shig gsol ba snying nas 'debs: sku yi dbang bskur bskyed rim lha yi sku: sprul sku'i 'gro don nus par byin gyis rlobs: gsung gi dbang bskur zung 'jug sngags kyi sgra: longs sku'i rang rtsal rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs: thugs kyi dbang bskur rdzogs rim ka dag ngang : chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen ye shes dbang drag 'dus pa'i lha: 'di nas brtsams te zag med rdo rje'i sku: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor bsgrub par dam bcas nas: mi 'da' mi 'gyur bla med ye grol du: rang dbyings a ti'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig: om̐ gu ru dzñā na padma dhā ra sarba siddhi hrīḥswā hā: skyabs yul 'od du zhu nas rang la thim: rang lus snang stong spros bral nam mkhar thim: nam mkhas gar khyab sems kyis khyab pa yin: ma yengs bya ra byed par rang sems skyongs: gnas na gnas thog steng du bzhag: 'gyu na 'gyu thog steng du bzhag: 'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas rang ngo shes: ma hā a nu a ti'i theg rim tshang : zhes gsungs so/ bdun pa smon lam gyis rgyas gdab pa ni/ de ltar thun mtshams kyi mthar/ phyag chen las/ hoḥ kun gzhi mkha' ltar yangs pa'i klong : ka dag rang byung ye shes de: rang la yod kyang ngo ma shes: 'khor ba'i sems can snying re rje: byams mgon rgyal ba sras dang bcas: 'od gsal chen po'i dgongs pa yis: bdag la sangs rgyas yon tan kun: rdzogs nas thugs rje'i stobs bskyed de: rtsol med 'gro don mthar phyin shog:

ji srid nam mkha' ma zhig bar: mkhyen brtse ye shes rgyas pa yi: gang 'dul thogs med phrin las kyis: 'gro ba sangs rgyas sa thob shog: ces smon lam bya'o/ smon lam ni/ hoḥ skye 'gag bral yang sna tshogs ngo bo nyid: rig dang ma rig cho 'phrul kun rtog rnams: chig chod mthong nas mtha' yas sangs rgyas shog: skad cig dran pa'i rig pa mi nyams zhing : phyi nang 'khrul pas skye ba ma chod par: bsam zhing dran pa'i chos sku thob par shog: de ltar mthong nas 'bras bu ngo bo nyid: nam mkha'i mdzod kyi gter chen dge ba des: 'khor ba stongs nas sems can sangs rgyas shog: dran shes bag yod brten pa'i dge ba bsngo: zhes de ltar smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyor khyad che bas snying rus kyis bya'o/ zhes bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las sngon 'gro'i man ngag zab don rgyun gyi lam khyer kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs dang sngon 'gro zab don rin po che'i sgron me bcas phyogs gcig tu la rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i thugs sprul gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis khyer bde ru bris pa'o/ dge bas 'gro kun bla ma drag po'i sku 'grub par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ bla ma drag po'i byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i dbyangs ring bzhugs/ drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud/ sa ma ya/ dkyil 'khor byin rlabs rim pa ni/ spos bsreg rnga rol mda' dar g.yab/ gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ 'og min chos dbyings rnga yab gling*/ /snang srid dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /sku gsum ston pa pad 'byung la/ /rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin rgya mtshos bskor/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /rlung lnga ye shes rin chen mkha'/ /rgyal ba longs sku'i zhing khams nas/ /gu ru nor lha dbyer med la/ /dbang sdud mgyogs ma bzhi yis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /rnam dag lhun grub mkha' la spyod/ /tshe dbang sprul sku'i zhing khams nas/

/rig 'dzin pad 'byung tshe dpag med/ /tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro bzhi yis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod dang*/ /gang 'dul der ston pho brang nas/ /drag po khrag 'thung yab yum la/ /yi dam rgyud sde'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /sku bzhi lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas/ /nyi zla bam gyi snying dbus steng*/ /sprul pa'i ging chen yab yum la/ /yang sprul khro chung tshogs kyis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /che mchog yab yum he ru kaḥ /gnas lnga gsang ba'i pho brang nas/ /go cha khro bcu yab yum la/ khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dur khrod nas/ /sdig pa chu srin phag dang khyung*/ /pho nya sgo skyong las byed rnams/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /mkha' dbyings chos 'byung pho brang nas/ /dbu rgyan bya khyung rigs lnga la/ /rigs bdag kun bzang tshogs kyis bskor/ /chos sku gsal rdzogs ngang du gnas/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /ti sgro gsang ba'i brag phug tu/ /dkyil 'khor zab rgya gtad pa'i tshe/ /a phyi chos kyi sgrol mar grags/ /gter srung sman mo'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /sngon tshe pad 'byung yab yum gyis/ /las smon brda bzhi mngon phyung mdzad/ /gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje la/ /las can chos bdag 'bum gyis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig hūm̐/ zhi ba dbyings kyi lha tshogs kyis/ /dbang dang dngos grub byin phob cig /drag po khrag 'thung lha tshogs kyis/ /mthu rtsal nus pas byin phob cig /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas rnams/ /phrin las gang bcol bsgrub pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin phob la/ /bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu myur du stsol/

oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba a be sha ya hriṃ hriṃ dza dza sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes bla ma drag po'i bsnyen sgrub skabs su gnam lcags rdo rjes bris pa'o/ bkra shis par shog/ // bla ma zhi ba'i las byang gi gsol 'daibs bsdus pa ni/ e ma ho/ gzhim̐ dbyings gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /gzhim̐ snang longs sku'i rol rtsal mig mi 'dzum/ /gzhim̐ grol rang byung sprul sku padma la/ /gzhim̐ med rtsa bral ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /ka dag gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsam̐ng ba rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'dzin mkhar chen bza'/ /gsam̐ng chen grub pa'i dpa' bo gnubs chen rje/ gsam̐ng mdzod gter la dbang bsgyur rtsa gsum gling*/ /gsam̐ng gsum g.yo med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /lhun grub snang bzhi mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs/ /rim̐g 'dzin rtsal 'chang bla ma he ru kaḥ rim̐gs bzhi phrin las mnga' bsgyur yum chen bzhi/ /rim̐gs 'dus bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /rim̐g rtsal rang grol ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa lam lhong byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun sgrib bzhim̐ ka nas dag /dbang bzhim̐ ye shes rtsol med rgyud la skyes/ /sku bzhi'im̐ go 'phang tshe 'dir thob par shog / ces pa'ang u tshugs au ḍī'i ngor gu hyas rtug pa btsir btsir gyis smras pas yi ge ni bskul ba po nyid kyis byas so// // ༈ bla ma'i las byang gdung ba zhi byed bzhugs so/ dus gsum bde gshegs kun 'dus padma 'byung*/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la/ /gus pas btud nas bskyed rdzogs phrin las gzhung*/ /gcig chog mos gus gdung ba zhi byed bstan/ de yang gzhung las/ dang po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: dben zhing yid 'ong bkra shis gnas: dmar smug dbang gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs: bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings can:

bum rdzas chu yis sum gnyis bkang: bhandha mtshan ldan nang du ni: zhi rgyas dbang gi drag gtor bzhag: phyi nang spyan gzigs gzhung bzhin bsham: rang nyid shar du zhal kha gyu: drag po'i sngon 'gro song nas ni: zhes dkyil 'khor gyi bca' gzhi mthong brgyud ltar bsham: de nyid drag po'i bdag bskyed bya: yang na so saur bsgrub kyang chog: kha skong drag po dag nas blang : zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ zhi sgrub rtsa ba'i dgongs don mdun bskyed kho na dang: so sor bsgrub kyang chog par bshad pa bzhin: 'di ni rkyang sgrub bklag chog tu bkod pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes so/ dang po la lnga'i thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong: ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ gsum pa dkar gtor sngon du 'gro bas bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid khro rgyal khrag 'thung rol: 'byung po bka' las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma khyer la rang gnas dengs: 'tshe na drag sngags me char 'bebs: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad bhyoḥ thum shig gtor myog rbad raṃ dzwa la phaṭḥ bzhi pa srung mtshams ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las srung ba'i gur: rdo rje lcags sdig bya khyung 'phros: gri gug kha ṭwāṃ me yi gur: sra mkhregs pha lam rang bzhin gyur: oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa: tri pā paṃ tsakra rakṣa: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsakra rakṣa: ka ra ti ka tsakra rakṣa: tri shu la tsakra rakṣa: ram̐ dzwa la tsakra rakṣa: oṃ e swa bhā tsakra rakṣa: lnga pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo:

nang mchod sman gtor rakta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha liṃ ta te dzwa bha liṃ ta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ sarba a haṃ dzñā na a mṛ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes lnga'am bdun gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun gyi dang po bskyed rim ni/ ma bcos lhun grub ngang nyid du/ /rang byung dran rdzogs 'di ltar bsgom/ hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing brdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rang rtsal rdzogs: oṃ: kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐: keṃ dang bhrūm̐ gyur rang byung pho brang nas: gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang mtshan nyid ldan: 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i zer 'khrigs ye shes klong: rin chen rgyan tog mdzes pa'i pho brang dbus: nyi zla padma sna tshogs khri steng du: gser gyi rdo rje hūm̐ mtshan tshwa tshwa can: dran rdzogs rang nyid padma 'byung gnas sku: dkar gsal mdangs ldan shel sgong dwangs ma'i dbyibs: he ru ka pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje btegs thabs mkha' la phyar: g.yon pa'i thod pa bdud rtsi lnga yis bkang: dbu skra thor tshugs thod phreng rigs lngas brgyan: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan rlung gis bskyod: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bzhugs: gsang ba dbyings phyug dmar mo rus rgyan can: rdo rje dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: mnyen lcug brda 'byin zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: yab yum zung 'jug thugs kar āḥdang ma: sngags phreng 'khor zhing bde stong ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: phyi rim padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru: rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing 'od gri thod 'dzin:

rin chen mkha' 'gro ser gsal gri thod 'dzin: padma mkha' 'gro dmar gsal gri thod 'dzin: las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang smug gri thod 'dzin: thams cad 'jo sgeg mnyen lcug 'khril ldem ma: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan sna tshogs cod pan 'phur: gcer mo bha ga nu ma rab tu rgyas: dbu skra thor tshugs lcang lo sil bur 'phyang : gar stabs tshul gyis pad zla'i gdan la 'gying : thugs kar ha ri ni sa lam gyis shar: de ltar sngags phreng 'khor zhing gzi 'bar ba: gzhan yang phyi nang mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: thams cad mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas rnams: bar snang sa gzhir til gang kha phye ltar: dri bzang 'ja' gur 'thib cing spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rnga yab gling mchog dpal ri'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin thod phreng yab yum gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi sna tshogs 'od lnga'i pho brang nas: ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: gnas nas gshegs shing byin gyis rlob pa'i tshe: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan pu ru ru: gzi brjid bkrag mdangs mtshan dpe ya la la: snyan dbyangs drug cu'i g.yer kha si li li: nyi zla'i zer 'phro bkrag mdangs ta la la: brda bsgyur gar rtsed rol mo di ri ri: dri zhim spos ngad phyogs bcur chi li li: byin rlabs dpal 'bar thugs rje sha ra ra: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin rlabs myur du phob: skal ldan bdag la nyams rtogs ting 'dzin bskyed: dur khrod dkyil 'khor rdzas la bcud chen phob: phyi yi snang ba snod bcud dbang du sdus: nang gi rtsa rlung thig le bkrag mdangs skyed: gsang ba nyon mongs dug lnga dbyings su spor: phyi nang rten 'brel spel zhing bskyed du gsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru padma ḍākki ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ:

gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral padma nyi zla'i gdan: sna tshogs 'ja' tshon 'khyil ba'i dbus nyid du: rig 'dzin yab yum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnams: byams gdung bdag la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: phod ka sngags chas brgyan cing phyi phyag 'tshal: gnas lugs bskyed rdzogs dran pas nang phyag 'tshal: gar mo ging mo sgeg mos gsang phyag 'tshal: rnal 'byor bdag gi gdung bas phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba la gsum/ dang po phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: yid 'phrog lha mo gsang ba'i gzugs mdzes ma: brda gar bsgyur zhing bde ba'i skad 'byin ma: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin bde ba'i zungs bskul ma: thod phreng gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs āḥhūm̐: rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe gīrti nīrti mā lye lā sye swa ra swa tī sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bhandha'i snod du bdud rtsi chi li li: dung khang zhal bor rakta rba rlabs 'phyo: dam rdzas rmad byung gtor ma ri ltar spungs: thod phreng gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi:

gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes pa'i rdo rje nyid: shes rab dbyings phyug gsang ba'i bha ga ru: srub cing bskul ba'i bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga: dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag klad rus 'bul: oṃ badzra ratna ti ri a haṃ a mṛ ta pū dza ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha lingta kha kha khā hi: drug pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings rnam dag skye med ngang nyid las: sku mdog dkar gsal 'od stong ldan pa ni: bde gshegs sku la 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: dbu skra thor tshugs gyen du bsgrengs pa ni: ye shes zang thal rang dbyings rdzogs pa'i brda: thod skam rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa ni: nyon mongs dug lnga ka nas dag pa'i brda: dar chen sna lnga'i cod pan 'phur ba ni: ye shes lnga ldan lhun grub rdzogs pa'i brda: thugs rje'i spyan gyis phyogs bcur gzigs pa ni: 'od gsal ngang la 'khor 'das bral ba'i brda: zhal 'dzum dkar la dgyes shing snum pa ni: pad 'byung thugs rje phyogs ris bral ba'i brda: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdeng ba ni: sku lnga lhun grub 'gro don mdzad pa'i brda: g.yon pa mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi bsnams pa ni: sgrub la 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol ba'i brda: rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba ni: rtag chad mtha' bral pha rol phyin drug brda: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang phyed skyil bzhugs pa ni: skye 'chi bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'i brda: padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni: 'khor ba ma spangs skyon gyis ma gos brda: gsang ba dbyings phyug sku la 'khril ba ni: bde stong zung 'jug skye med rdzogs pa'i brda: sku mdog dmar mo mdzes chags gzigs pa ni: shes rab gzugs la dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i brda: g.yas g.yon rdo rje bhandha bsnams pa ni: chos rnams thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i brda: rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba ni: rtsa rlung thig les bde drod bskyed pa'i brda:

zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril ba ni: 'khor 'das ro gcig chos skur mtshon pa'i brda: yab yum sku la gzi brjid ldan pa ni: snang srid dbang sdud chos skur grol ba'i brda: brda rtags rgyan rdzogs bla ma rje la bstod: hūm̐: phyi rim ye shes gsang ba ḍākki ma: rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing 'od ldan pa ni: gnas lugs gshis la mtha' dbus bral ba'i brda: rin chen mkha' 'gro ser gsal mdzes pa ni: ma 'gags rtsal ldan zang thal 'gyu ba'i brda: padma mkha' 'gro dmar gsal mdangs ldan ni: shar grol rtogs pa rol rtsal rdzogs pa'i brda: las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang smug g.yo ba ni: ye shes rlung gis 'khor 'das dbye ba'i brda: thams cad rigs lnga cod pan 'phur ba ni: dug lnga ma spangs ye shes spyod pa'i brda: thor tshugs lcang los sku rgyab g.yo ba ni: rang byung rang shar rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i brda: khro 'dzum mdzes la zim bur gzigs pa ni: thugs rje chags pas sems can 'dren pa'i brda: g.yas pa thams cad gri gug phyar ba ni: ma dag 'khrul rgyun rtsad nas gcod pa'i brda: g.yon pa'i dung dmar raktas bkang ba ni: ro gcig rtogs pas sa gsum gnon pa'i brda: rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la mdzes pa ni: tshogs drug ma spangs rang sar grol ba'i brda: gcer bu bha ga nu ma rgyas pa ni: dam tshig can gyi grogs mo bgyis pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar gyis bzhugs pa ni: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong ba'i brda: pad zla'i gdan la 'gying stabs ldan pa ni: skye 'gag gnyis med lhun gyis grub pa'i brda: gsang ba mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i tshogs la bstod: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor tshogs la bstod: phyag 'tshal bstod cing rtse gcig gdung ba'i mod: byin rlabs 'bad med thugs rjes char chen phob: dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par mdzad du gsol: bdun pa 'dzab bzlas pa ni/ hūm̐: yang gsang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs:

skye med dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: 'gags med rang byung snying pos bskul: thugs kar āḥyig tha ma ru: sngags phreng 'od zer lta bur 'khor: lus khengs phyi nang zang thal klong : spros pas rgyal ba mchod pas dgyes: bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis thim: sbyor bas bde stong bla na med: gnas pas ma bsgoms lhun gyis grub: gsal ba'i snod bcud dkyil 'khor lha: lta ba rang rig padma 'byung : sgom pa lhun grub mkhyen brtse'i ngang : spyod pas ma sring dbang du sdus: 'bras bu ma 'grub bar du bsgrub: srog la babs kyang mi btang ngo : zhes zhi sgrub kyi gnad byang thugs rje'i lcags kyu bzhin bdag mdun chig rdzogs kyi 'phro 'du gsal btab la/ bdag nyid pad 'byung he ru ka yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor gyi nang du 'od lnga'i rang mdangs can gyi sa bon mthar sngags phreng 'od lnga 'khrug ge ba rang sgra dang bcas te/ g.yas su 'ur dir gyis 'khor ba las 'od zer dpag med du 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad la mnyes mchod phul/ de dag gi thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad sku dang thig le'i rnam par char ltar babs pas thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par mos/ oṃ gu ru padma kā ra ḍākki ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ zhes bzla'o/ bsnyen pa grub rjes dbyang gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams bzla zhing mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang spyan gzigs tshogs: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dang: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs? shabda āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta khā hi: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral?phyag 'tshal bstod/ skabs 'dir rgyun gsol dang bshags skong sngon du 'gro bas gtor bsngos rig 'dzin srog sgrub tshigs lhug bar bya'o/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa bcu gnyis las/

dang po tshogs mchod la'ang bdun gyi thog mar bsang sbyangs byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: rang byung snying po'i 'od zer gyi: rgyu 'byung yi ge sbyong byed 'phros: gtsang btsog bzang ngan ka nas dag: oṃ dharma ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ shuddhe hoḥ hūm̐: bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: byin rlob yi ge 'bru gsum 'phros: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs spel bsgyur: tshogs rdzas nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza bi shwa mu khe bhya: gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rje btsun thod phreng yab yum la: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig pho brang nas: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho la: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs thibs se thib: khro bo'i lha tshogs ya la la: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang la: gshegs shing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: mos pa'i skal ldan smin par mdzod: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa phud kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: che mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzhes: deng 'dir mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: rig 'dzin srog sgrub mthar dbyung*/ bzhi pa tshogs kyi bskang bshags ni/ hūm̐: phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma thod phreng yab yum gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: ma rig rmongs pa'i 'khrul gzugs bdag: grangs med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib tshogs: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐: lnga pa bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden pa'i mthus:

gnod byed 'byung po log lta'i rigs: myur du tha ma'i liṅgar khug: pho nyas bzung zhing byad du chugs: oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha ya ru tra mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥnan: hūm̐: ka dag chos sku'i thugs ka nas: gzi byin thugs rje'i sa bon 'phros: gnas 'gyu dran rig phur bu ni: rtsol ba gzhom pa'i stobs kyis 'debs: sgrol cig ma rig bdud la ya: bstab bo dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: ye shes chen po'i las mdzod cig: oṃ badzra kī la ha la pañtsa mā ra ya rbad rbad: bhyo: blo 'das khyon ltar yangs pa'i zhal phyes shig: rgyud drug dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: mtha' yas 'khyams pa'i sems can ma lus pa: bla med byang chub 'thob phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa ma ya: i daṃ bha liṃ ta ma hā māṃ sa tsitta rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi: drug pa tshogs la rol pa ni/ hoḥ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: sogs/ lhag gtor byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ bdun pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal gyi ma mo bye ba 'bum: gnas nyul dur khrod tshogs khang 'grim: gsang sngags grogs kyi mel tshe ma: lhag ma bzhes la phrin las mdzod: oṃ bhakṣa li si ta ma hā bha lingta khā hi: gnyis pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: rnam dag ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rig 'dzin kun gyi 'dus gzugs padma 'byung: rtsa gsum lha tshogs bde gshegs dkyil 'khor rnams: thugs rje'i klong nas sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs shig: deng 'dir 'gro la brtse chen gzigs par bskul: bdud bzhi nyon mongs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: bdag 'dzin ru tra gzhom pa'i dus la bab: dug lnga'i dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: ma dag rigs drug 'dren pa'i dus la bab: 'khor ba'i sa bon gzhom pa'i dus la bab: sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem pa'i dus la bab: srid pa'i skye sgo gcod pa'i dus la bab: bskul lo thugs rje lcags kyus rtsal phyungs shig:

du ma ro gcig gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khams gsum stongs shing sdug bsngal byang gyur nas: bla med 'bras bu thob pa'i phrin las mdzod: gtor 'bul mthar dbyung/ gsum pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe me ri 'bar ba ru: bla ma thod phreng drag po dang : mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes gnyis: rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor phyes: steng 'og lha srin khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: de 'og ti sgro'i tshogs khang du: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas dang : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma sring gnas nyul khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa yis: ti sgro'i tshogs khang chen mo nas: gsang rgya zab gter bzhes pa'i tshe: las kyi ma mos khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: yang gsang bsgrub ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di: phyogs bcur spel ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti ḍākki ma mo ru lu bhyoḥ i daṃ bha liṃ ta khā hi: bzhi pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan sil snyan sgra: brda gar glu dbyangs khyugs se khyug: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ma hā bha lingta khā hi: lnga pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: stong gsum chem chem khro bo'i bro: mnan no ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bro: nam yang ma ldang las kyi bro: sgab 'dre dam sri 'dul zhing bshig: oṃ nan: ā nan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan: drug pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: zab dbyings bla med gsang ba'i tshogs: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyis: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: mi 'gyur sku yi dbang bzhi stsol: 'gags med gsung gi dbang bzhi stsol: spros bral thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: phrin las bzhi ldan dbang bzhi stsol:

'chi med tshe dang mi zad nor: snyan grags mnga' thang chos srid dpal: phun tshogs 'dod rgu deng 'dir stsol: oṃ dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirmā kā ya: kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bdun pa gtang rag mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang spyan gzigs tshogs: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dang: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs? shabda āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta khā hi: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral?phyag 'tshal bstod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ brgyad pa bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam las 'gal ba dang: ma 'byor nyams dang chad lhag 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags la mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya bzla'o/ dgu pa mdun bskyed brtan bzhugs bya la bdag bskyed bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: gsang 'dus rang byung ye shes dkyil 'khor lha: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas 'khor bsdu yum la bsdu: yum yab hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yang dmigs med klong : ka dag rang byung shar grol klong du hoḥ a āḥ bcu pa bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: dmigs med rgya yan chos nyid rgyu yi bsngo: rang shar rang rtsal ma 'gags lam gyi bsngo: sna tshogs spros bral ka dag 'bras bu'i bsngo: kun gzhi skye med 'khor 'das gcig tu bsngo: bcu gcig pa smon lam ni: hoḥ bdag blo ye nas dbyings rig sgrib pa bral: gnyis 'dzin ma rig 'khrul pa'i rmongs gzugs rnams: dran rtog chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: tshe rabs pad 'byung yab yum 'bral med shog: bcu gnyis pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: ka dag lhun grub rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis 'chi med tshe yi lha: gnas lugs rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin padma 'byung :

tshe rabs gtan gyi bla mar bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i bkra shis mkha' 'gro las kyi bdag: gsang rgyud gdams rgyud smin pa'i bkra shis shog: ces 'dir brtson pa'i dgos chad ni: bdag 'dra padma 'byung nas kyis: gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i rgyud lung bzhin: skal ldan 'di phyi'i don gnyer ba: nga nyid he ru ka ltar du: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrub brtsams: 'di nyid bsgrub cing nyams len na: phyi nang bar chad thams cad zhi: rnam g.yeng 'khrul pa'i bdud las rgyal: rtsa rlung snang ba dbang du 'dus: rten 'brel phyogs med nyid kyang 'char: dug lnga rtsol med rang sar zhi: 'ja' lus chos sku mngon du 'gyur: zhes gsungs so/ de ltar gu ru zhi ba'i las byang gdung ba zhi byed 'di ni/ zab lam 'dir mos gdung mi phyed pa spang ston karma mthar phyin dang*/ sde pa lha dbang rdo rje dang sras mo dpal 'byor sogs kyis nyams len gsal 'debs su bskul ngor/ skyid grong smyon pas bsgrigs pa kun tu dge bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ khrag 'thung padma drag po'i zhi sgrub rig 'dzin he ru ka yi/ bsnyen pa'i dmigs rkang thugs mchog rdo rje'i zhal lung bzhugs so/

chos kun ma 'dres zag med mkha' 'dra'i klong*/ /lhun grub snang ba bzhi zad rdo rje'i sbubs/ /rten 'brel mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo che'i/ /dbang bskur khyab bdag thugs mchog rdo rjes skyongs/ de yang khrag 'thung padma drag po'i zhi sgrub kyi bsnyen yig nag 'gros 'khyer bder bkod pa la/ rnal 'byor pa spros pa chen pos sgrub chen mdun bskyed lta bu dang*/ rjes su 'brel na rtsa ba'i gter gzhung snying po kun 'dus las gsungs pa bzhin/ bum thod dkyil 'khor bkod pa ci rgyas dang*/ sgrub khog bsnyen chen gyi yi ge rnams las nges pa bzhin sta gon/ dngos gzhir dmigs gnad kyang*/ bdag mdun gsal rdzogs kyi 'od zer 'phro 'duu sogs las sbyor gyis shes par bya ba dang*/ 'dir sman raka gtor gsum tsam la brten nas/ bdag bskyed kho nar nyams su blang ba la/ thog mar sngon bskal ma tshar gcig brgyud 'debs skyabs sems nas bzung bzlas pa yan/ khyab bdag bla mas bstsal ba'i chog bsgrigs gdung ba zhi byed ltar bdag bskyed gsal ngar thon pa'i ngang nas/ bdag nyid pad 'byung he ru ka yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor gyi nang du 'od lnga'i rang mdangs can gyi sa bon mthar/ oṃ gu ru padma kā ra ḍākki ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ sogs kyi sngags kyang 'od lnga 'khrug ge ba rang sgra dang bcas te/ g.yas su 'ur dir gyis 'khor ba las 'od zer dpag med du 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad la mnyes mchod phul/ de dag gi thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad sku dang thig le'i rnam par char ltar babs pas thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas par bstims pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rgyas te/ yab yum bde sbyor mdzad pas/ thugs rje rang 'od kyi rten 'brel thogs med mngon par g.yo nus pas/ dwangs bcud dkar dmar gyi rnam par 'khyil ba rdo rje lus kyi rdzu 'phrul nus stobs thams cad cig car du shugs kyis rdzogs te/

nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus pa 'ub kyis sbyangs/ snang stong 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha sku'i gsal snang 'bar zhing*/ slar 'od zer mar 'phros rigs drug gi sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te/ 'jig rten gyi khams dngos dang dngos med kyi yid dpyod thams cad 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs lhun grub thugs rje'i rol par phyam bdal bas/ oṃ gu ru padma kā ra ḍākki ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ zhes rdo rje gsum gyi ngang nas bdun gnyis bar rtse gcig tu bzlas/ rtsa sngags 'di nyid bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dang bcas pa chig rdzogs kyi dgongs don yin gyi/ slar yang gtso bo'i thugs rjes 'od zer gyis 'khor tshogs ḍākk-i sde bzhi'i thugs rgyud bskul te/ zhal nas ha ri ni sa'i dbyangs dang dgyes pa'i gar stabs dang bcas te/ stong gsum rab 'byams kyi zhing khams thams cad 'gul shig tu khyam khyom/ lhun grub 'od lnga'i zhing khams su mnan na nem zhing btegs na spar ba thod rgal gyi zer phreng 'ja' 'od thig le yom yom/ mchog gsum rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro thams cad nyi zla 'bum gyi gzi byin du 'khrugs te/ dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig shig tu g.yo ba'i ngang nas snang srid thams cad ka nas dag pa'i zang thal 'khor 'das ris med nyag gcig bri gang 'pho 'gyur med par 'od mi 'gyur ba'i thugs klong chen por ye grol mchis par yongs grol du gnas par mos pas/ gong gi rtsa sngags bdun gcig tu sbyar te bzla'o/ de ltar bdun gsum lha zhal mjal ba'i gdeng tshad grub nas slar las sbyor la 'jug pa ni/ sngon 'gro zhi ba'i sngags bsnyen pa'i dus su ltar/ rig 'dzin he ru ka'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' dkar gsal shel sgong lta bu g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa sku smad dar dkar gyi sham thabs sogs rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa thugs srog sngags phreng dkar po las 'od zer 'phros skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du bsags pa'i a 'thas las ngan bag chags thams cad gzhob tu byas pa'i rten 'brel gyis/

nyon mongs kyis 'ching ba'i rtsa mdud phra rags dang bcas pa khrol bas/ las kyi rlung dag 'khrul pa zad/ rten 'brel thams cad phyogs med du 'char/ khams gsum rigs drug gi ngan goms dug lnga'i rang mdangs kyi bag rdul cha tsam med par ka nas dag cing 'khor 'das chos sku thig le nyag gcig tu stong par dmigs la/ oṃ gu ru padma kā ra sogs rtsa sngags mthar oṃ shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes bzla'o/ nyin phyed rgyas pa'i dus/ skad cig gis sku mdog ser po gnod sbyin sgeg pa'i tshul 'chang ba g.yas rin chen dang g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sku smad la dar dmar sham thabs sogs rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa las/ zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs kyi thugs srog sngags phreng rang mdog dang mtshungs pa las 'od zer 'phro ba yin pas 'gres mchan bu'o/ 'od zer tshwa rngam cig car du 'phros pas phyi snod 'byung lnga'i khams kyi dug rnams gzhil/ dwangs ma bcud du 'khyil ba dngos po'i legs tshogs thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus pas/ gtso 'khor thams cad bde chen zag med kyi nyams rgyas te/ zung 'jug tu sbyor bas snang srid 'byung ba'i rang sgra thams cad a haṃ du bsgrags/ khyad par lha klu mi dang mi min drang srong rig 'dzin nyi zla la sogs tshe dpal 'byor mnga' thang snyan grags sogs 'dod rgu zag med kyi phywa g.yang thams cad ye shes 'od lnga'i rnam pa char ltar babs te/ 'chi med rdo rje'i rol pa chen por 'byams klas pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ gu ru padma sogs/ mthar/ oṃ puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes bzla'o/ dgong mo dbang gi dus su/ sku mdog dmar po khro chags kyi tshul 'chang ba/ g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin zhing dar dang rin po che'-i rgyan sna tshogs bklubs shing chos nyid kyi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba tsam gyis/ khams gsum srid gsum mdor na 'khor 'das kyi phyag rgya thams cad dbang du bsdus nus pa'i dpa' zil can du bskyed/

slar 'od zer dmar po sbubs mchu'i rnam pa can tshwa ba'i dbal ngar dang ldan par 'phros pa tsam gyis/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ji snyed dang dbyer med par/ snang ba thams cad bder gshegs zhi khro longs sku'i sgyu 'phrul mngon par rol pa dang*/ rtog med kyi ngang mdangs chen pos ma rig pa thams cad bcom ste pha rol gyi tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor pa sogs/ zag med kyi bcud dang srid zhi 'khor 'das kyi che btsan thams cad kyi srog gis 'od zer sbubs mchus 'ub kyis bsdus nas/ thugs srog gi zhabs su bstims shing*/ nam yang mi shigs pa chos nyid stong pas rgyas thebs pa ste/ snang srid thams cad dmar ltems ltems/ 'ja' 'od kyi li li'i ngang nas/ oṃ gu ru padma sogs? nas/ oṃ wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes bzla'o/ srod drag po'i mthar/ skad cig gis sku mdog ljang 'od g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje gdeng stabs dang g.yon phur pa gzer stabs su 'chang zhing*/ dor stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ sku la ber dang sham thabs sogs dur khrod chas kyis brjid pa/ khro zhing gtum pa'i gar gyis srid gsum 'dar zhing sngangs nus pa zhig las 'od zer ljang zhing rtsub pa/ lci zhing 'thas pa ka gdung tsam 'phros pas srid pa gsum gyi dregs byed bdud tshogs log 'dren drag po rnams dang*/ khyad par dam sri rgyal bsen thams cad 'od zer tsha bar mi bzod pas snying khrag lhud kyis phyung zhing*/ stobs dang nus pa thams cad nyams te/ ci dgos pa'i bka' dang dam la gnas te/ nye bar 'tshe ba'i zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs rnams la thogs rdugs med par mngon spyod drag po'i tshul gyis bsgral zhing*/ ming shul tsam yang lhag med du rol pa'i dam tshig nos par bsams pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ gu ru padma kā ra sogs nas? hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ gong gi zhi rgyas dbang drag so sor yab rnams gsal ngar thon pas yum rnams rang 'dra bde bas 'khyud pa'am rtsal dang 'khor rnams kyang tha dad kyi gsal brtan thub pa dang*/

de bzhin mos sgom brtan po'i nga rgyal g.yo med du bzung bar bya'o/ bsnyen pa'i rtags kyang rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam tshun/ gzhung las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ gang zag sngon gyi las dbang 'phro mtha' can sogs dbang po'i sgo dang mtshams sbyor gyis/ lha yi zhal mthong lung bstan sogs grub pa'i rtags thon pa sha stag byung ba yin zhing*/ ci'i phyir ḍākki zab gnad zhal rlangs drod ma yal ba'i dgongs pa tshad du phyin pa'i rkyen gyis lags na/ da lta'i lus rtsa'i 'ching rgya grol nas lhag med du mkha' la spyod pa'i grong khyer chen por gdod ma'i rgyal sar dbugs dbyung bar 'gyur ro/ de lta bu'i sgrub pa grol nas dga' ston tshogs mchod dngos grub blang ba'i rim pa rnams kyang rjes kyi cho ga spyi ltar ro/ zhes rig 'dzin he ru ka'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge thugs mchog rdo rje'i zhal lung zhes pa 'di ni/ dam pa gang la mi phyed pa'i dad gdung can skal ldan gyi skyes bu mang po'i gsung gis bskul 'debs gnang bar brten/ sgrub pa'i sngon rjes go rim rnams/ rang nyid spros pa dang mtshams sbyor ni/ sgrub khog gzhan du byas te/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs rkang hrag bsdus tsam bkod pa 'di ni/ gtad med du spyod pa kong smyon karma bi dho dhā ras dben gnas mchod rten rnam rgyal gyi dus mchod chen por bgyis pa mchog tu dge bar gyur cig/ // sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge legs 'phel// // rig 'dzin padma'i las mtha' las/ dbang chen tshe yi las byang rdo rje'i snying po bzhugs so/ rab 'byams rgyal kun thugs rjes 'o mtsho las/ /'chi med rdo rje'i skur bzhengs padma 'byung*/ /gang gi gsang gsum rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul du/ /mnyam rol tshe sgrub rdo rje'i snying po bstan/ de yang gzhung gi dgongs don bdag bskyed drag po'i bsnyen sgrub sngon du song nas: mdun bskyed tshe yi sgrub pa dang*/

rgyun khyer dbyings mi shigs drag po rtsal gyi thugs mchog zab mo dpal tshe yi dkyil 'khor du gsal bar byas kyang*/ 'di drag sgrub dang ma 'brel bar tshe sgrub rkyang du byed pa/ las byang gi dgongs don ji bzhin la/ sngon 'gro rjes kyi mtshams sbyar te/ gtan la phab pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro bca' gzhi dang cho ga'i sbyor ba/ dngos la bsgrub gzhi bsgrub don sgrub thabs/ rjes kha skong mtha' bsdu ba'o/ dang po bca' gzhi ni las byang dang*/ zab don gnad kyi sgron me bzhin ma nor bar bkod/ gnyis pa cho ga'i sngon 'gro bzhi las/ dang po gsol 'debs/ ༈ 'chi med yang gsang bcud dril gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'ja' 'od sprin gyi phung po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos dbyings spros bral bde chen dbang gi zhing*/ /'chi med mgon po snang mtha' tshe yi lhar/ /gsol ba 'debs so ā yur siddhi hrī/ /byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badzra ho/ /lnga ldan 'od lnga dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku tshe lha rigs lnga la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ā yur siddhi hrī/ /byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badzra ho/ /sprul sku'i sgrub gnas brag dmar g.ya' ma lung*/ /'chi med sprul sku pad 'byung yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ā yur siddhi hrī/ /byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badzra ho/ /bsam yas chos 'khor gling gi yang dben nas/ /bka' bab ye shes rje 'bangs grogs lnga la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ā yur siddhi hrī/ /byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badzra ho/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor los dbang bsgyur ba/ /gar dbang rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ā yur siddhi hrī/ /byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badzra ho/ /'gro ba gang 'dul sprul pa'i pho brang nas/ /dbang lung man ngag brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ā yur siddhi hrī/

/byin gyis rlobs shig dzñā na badzra ho/ /dam tshig mi shigs gsang ba'i gnyer gtad pa/ /bka' dang gter srung dam can rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi bar chad sol/ /skyabs yul gsol btab byin rlabs rang la bsdus/ /bhrūm̐ yig yab dang yum gyi mkha' klong dkyil/ /tshe brtan mi 'gyur snying po'i gwa'u brtan/ /tshe dpal stobs bskyed 'byung lnga sor chud nas/ /'chi med pad 'byung go 'phang e ma ho/ zhes tshe sgrub 'chi med bcud dril gyi gsol 'debs 'ja' 'od sprin gyi phung po 'di yang*/ bla ma padma rgyal mtshan ming gis bskul ngor/ khrom gzigs gnam lcags rdo rje'i thugs sras 'gro 'dul bde ba'i rdo rje'i ming gis nyung bsdus su spel ba'o/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa ni: hrīḥ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang : tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba sems can kun don du: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin thob par sems bskyed do: mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku: tshe bdag rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten dang ni 'das pa yi: bcud rnams ma lus mchod pa 'bul: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub la sogs: tshogs gnyis rnams la yi rang ngo: bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi: tshe yi bar chad sel bar bskul: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'gro rnams tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shing: thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog: lan gsum/ gnyis pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid khro rgyal dbang gi sku: log 'dren bar gcod tshe bdud rnams: mchod sbyin khyer la gzhan du dengs: dpal chen bka' las 'da' ma byed: oṃ badzra kro ta gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ gsum pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams khro bo'i gur: bskal pa'i me 'bar 'od phung 'khrigs:

ye shes lnga ldan zer thag 'tsher: mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang gyur: oṃ badzra dzwa la dzñā na tsakra bhrūm̐: bzhi pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum snod yangs bhandha'i nang: sha lnga 'bru bcud a mṛ ta: bum nang tshe bcud rdo rje'i srid: kun bzang mchod rdzas bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta a yu ṣe puṇyai hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ? sogs shabda āḥhūm̐: lnga pa byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam ḍākki chos skyong rnams: mi mngon dag pa mkha' spyod klong nas bzhengs: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob: dbang bzhi mchog thun stsol bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru ḍākki dzñā na sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ drug pa brda sgo ni/ hūm̐: ma rig srid pa'i 'khrul mun sgrib pa'i mkhar: nga bdag 'khor bar ltung ba'i sgo bcad nas: rang rig chos sku'i pho brang dag pa'i klong : kun nas ye grol chen po'i brda sgo dbye: bhrūm̐ dzñā na saṃ skṛ ta pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bdun pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i thugs dang rang sems gcig: bar du gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i nyon mongs shar: tha ma a 'thas gol ba'i bag chags tshogs: rang shar ye grol dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ

brgyad pa dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐: deng 'dir 'chi med tshe yi dal bzung nas: sgo gsum yal bar mi dor srog ltar bsgrub: dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i gzhung bsrangs nas: rten 'brel bskyed rdzogs zab mo mig ltar brtse: oṃ dzñā na tsakra he ru ka a yu ṣe sa ma ya nan: de nas dngos gzhi la dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: kun gzhi mi dmigs rig pa'i mkha': rgyu 'byung thugs rje'i zer ma shar: srog rten sprul pa'i yi ge hrī: rang byung 'od lnga'i pho brang shar: oṃ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: oṃ badzra hrīḥbhrūm̐: a spha ra hūm̐: a tsakra maṇḍa la: ma sūrya maṇḍa la: paṃ padma maṇḍa la: yaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭ: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: oṃ badzra a be sha ya phaṭḥ de nas gzhal yas lha bskyed nas bzung bar bya'o/ gnyis pa dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las dbang chen nam mkha'i dbyings: rlung me chu las rdo rje'i sa gzhi brjid: rang byung 'byung lnga e yi pho brang nas: gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang 'ja' tshon gtibs: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs rin chen tog gis spras: de dbus zla gam dmar mo sgo gcig pa: lug rgyud zer thag 'ja' tshon rang bzhin can: padma nyi zla thabs shes rdo rje'i khrir: hūm̐ yig sngon po ind+ra nī la'i mdog: skad cig gnas 'gyur bla ma thod phreng rtsal: 'ja' lus 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin ni: chos dbyings mthing ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mdzes 'dzum zhal ldan ral pa spyi bor bcings: rigs lngas dbu rgyan dar dmar cod pan 'phur: snyan rgyan mgul rgyan phyag gdub se mo do: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas tshe bum bsnams: lha rdzas ga shal rgyan ldan dar dpyangs bskyod: mi shigs rdo rje phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro dmar mo mdangs ldan ma: phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas bhandha bsnams: dbu rgyan ga shal dar dpyangs cod pan 'phur:

phyed skyil mgul 'khyud zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: yab yum zung 'jug bde stong 'ja' lus ngang : phyi rol padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru: rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi bdag: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang gar stabs bsgyur: g.yas pas rang rtags phyag mtshan mda' dar 'dzin: g.yon pas tshe bum padma'i phreng ba thogs: phyi rol tshe 'dzin mgyogs ma sprin ltar gtibs: rang bzhin ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings la shar: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gnas nas spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas: 'chi med dbang po rig 'dzin tshe yi lha: yab yum tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: lhun grub tshe yi dal du gshegs su gsol: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: mi shigs rdo rje 'jigs bral sra brtan khrir: mi g.yo ngang tshul dgyes pa'i gdan steng du: deng 'dir 'ja' lus tshe yi rgyud bskul phyir: bdag la dgongs te dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum lhun grub 'ja' lus rdo rje'i bdag: 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe yi lha tshogs la: mi phyed 'dun blo rtse gcig drag po yis: gsang 'dus 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'dud: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: sna tshogs mdzes pa phyi mchod lha mo'i gar: nang mchod sman raka bha ling ri ltar spungs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas kyi mchog: gsang 'dus 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: bdun pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings rang bzhin ind+ra nī la'i mdog: ye shes lnga ldan cod pan phyogs bcur bskyod:

rigs lngas dbu rgyan sku lnga lhun gyis grub: zhi 'dzum spyan gnyis mkha' dbyings phyogs bcur gzigs: phyag g.yas rdo rjes tshe bdud bar chad srung: g.yon pas tshe bum sgrub la 'chi med stsol: rin chen rgyan ldan 'dod rgu char bzhin 'bebs: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil mi shigs rdo rje'i ngang : gsang ba'i yum mchog bde stong zung 'jug nyid: shes rab rang gsal dmar ser mdangs dang ldan: phyag g.yas mda' dar srid gsum tshe bcud bsdus: phyag g.yon bdud rtsis 'ja' lus srog 'dzin sgrub: dbu rgyan cod pan rtog med don dang ldan: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril bde stong zung 'jug ngang : yab yum sku la mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis spras: 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: hūm̐: phyi rim mgyogs ma tshe yi las byed ma: dkar ser dmar ljang mnyen lcug 'khṛl ldem gar: mda' dar phyag mtshan lha klu'i tshe bcud bsdus: g.yon pa'i tshe bum 'chi med bdud rtsis bkang : dar tshon sna tshogs cod pan dbyings la bskyod: 'jo sgeg mdzes ldan mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi la: bde stong dbyings rig ma bcos ngang la bstod: rtse gcig gdung shugs drag pos bstod pa'i mthus: 'ja' lus 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol: brgyad pa 'dzab bskul ni/ hūm̐: gsang 'dus sgrub cing bsnyen pa'i lha: rang byung rang rig skye 'gag bral: rang snang 'chi med tshe yi lha: kun 'dus sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams: 'dzab kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: rdo rje srin po nam langs nye: dngos grub 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: dgu pa dzap bzlas pa la gsum las dang po bsnyen pa ni/ tshe bdag thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor dang: hrīḥyig sngags phreng mth-ing gsal sgra bcas 'khor: bde stong nyams 'bar 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: mgyogs ma 'bum sde bskul zhing stong gsum khyab: bde gshegs byin rlabs tshe la dbang ba'i mthus: lha klu mi dang 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud bcas:

ye shes lnga ldan 'od mdangs 'tsher ba sdus: baiḍūr sngon po'i ri rab khong seng nas: nyi zla bye ba'i 'od 'bar ltar mi bzod: khyed shes gdung shugs drag po'i gsol btab pas: tshe bcud dwangs ma ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun: lnga ldan bar ma chad pa bdag nyid kyi: thugs srog la thim bla tshe rang bzhin khug: srog tshe nyams pa gsos la bkrags mdangs gsal: lus kyi nang khaings snang srid 'od phung gtibs: ba spu'i bu gar rdo rje me ris gtams: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mchog 'grub par dmigs: oṃ padma hrī dha ā yurdzñā na ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ zhes tshe bsnyen bye ba'am ni bdun 'bum bzlas/ gnyis pa sgrub par 'phro 'du gong ltar la/ tshe lha yab yum sbyor mtshams bdud rtsi'i rgyun: babs pas lhan cig phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams: tshe lha'i ngo bo dbyings kyi gar khyab 'khrigs: kun gyi mkha' nas ye shes bde rgyun babs: nyi zla'i zer 'phro ro bcud phun tshogs pas: 'chi bdag bdud gzhom mi shigs rdo rje'i tshe: skad cig nus ldan rdzas mchog bla med gyur: oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bhrūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ 'bum phrag gsum mam gcig tu bzlas/ thun mtshams gong ltar tshe dbang blang*/ gsum pa las sbyor 'khor 'das mnyam rdzogs ni/ bdag mdun thugs srog 'od kyis snod bcud khyab: 'jig rten thams cad dag pa'i gzhal yas klong: bcud kyi sems can thams cad tshe dbang rgyal: nam mkhas gar khyab 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud 'bar: nyon mongs gnas dag ye shes snying po'i bcud: bdag mdun 'od kyis khab len lcags phye bzhin: 'ub 'ub bsdus te gnyis med gzi byin bskyed: 'chi med 'od sku 'grub pa'i nges shes bskyed: mdun gyis dam rdzas lha dang dbyer med par: ye shes 'od snang gsal 'tsher mi shigs blta: oṃ tshe bhrūm̐ g.yu bhrūm̐ g.yu tshe bhrūm̐ ā yurdzñā na g.yu tshe bhrūm̐:

zhes dang tshe brtan pa'i gzungs ring bzla'o/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying po tshar gsum bzlas mthar/ hūm̐: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta khā hi: drug pa mtha' rten la gsum las/ dang po tshe 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: shar phyogs dkar mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi'i tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la bstim: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: hūm̐: rin chen rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: lho phyogs ser mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi'i tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la bstim: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: hūm̐: padma rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: nub phyogs dmar mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi'i tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la bstim: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: hūm̐: las kyi rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: byang phyogs ljang mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi'i tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la bstim: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: hūm̐: buddha rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: dbus phyogs sngon mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi'i tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la bstim: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: de nas tshe 'gugs ni: hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro tshe yi bdag: mda' dar shar du bskyod pa'i tshe: khrag nyams bsos nas chu bcud sdus: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gug go: hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro tshe yi bdag: mda' dar lho ru bskyod pa'i tshe: sha nyams bsos nas sa bcud sdus: lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gug go: hūm̐: padma mkha' 'gro tshe yi bdag: mda' dar nub tu spyod pa'i tshe:

drod nyams bsos nas me bcud sdus: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gug go: hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro tshe yi bdag: mda' dar byang du bskyod pa'i tshe: rlung nyams bsos nas rlung bcud sdus: byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gug go: hūm̐: steng 'og rigs kyi tshe bdag ni: dmar ljang gsal stong mkha' 'gro ma: nyi zla'i bcud bsdus rtsa rlung bskyed: mkha' dang steng 'og tshe 'gug go: zhes rtsa sngags/ oṃ padma hrī dha ā yurdzñā na ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ gis 'gugs so/ hūm̐: thugs las sprul pa'i mgyogs ma ni: rang 'dra rigs mthun dpag med 'phros: mthu stobs mnga' thang rgyas pa yi: 'dzam gling kun gyi bcud bsdus la: 'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsol: dkar mo tshe bdag sku yi dbang bzhi stsol: dmar mo tshe bdag gsung gi dbang bzhi stsol: sngon mo tshe bdag thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: ser mo tshe bdag yon tan dbang bzhi stsol: ljang mo tshe bdag phrin las dbang bzhi stsol: sku lnga rdo rje'i srog tu rgyas thob cig: oṃ badzra ratna padma karma ḍākki ha ri ni sa a yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gnyis pa tshe sba ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs sku gsung tshe yi lha: yub yum sprul pa 'khor dang bcas: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms: sku gsung thugs kyis rgyas thob cig: tshe dang srog 'di khyod la gtad: khyod kyis rgya 'di thub par srungs: bcol lo gnyer ro ye shes lha: gtad do 'khor dang srung ma'i tshogs: tshe srings srog skyobs dpal skyed la: smin grol dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badzra kā wā tsi rakṣa hūm̐: gsum pa thun mthar mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hrī: ma bcos spros bral rdo rje'i sku: gnyam bzhag tshe bum 'chi med bcud: mi 'gyur g.yung drung longs spyod rdzogs:

'ja' lus rang byung padma 'byung: rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: hūm̐: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs dgongs: dang po bsnyen cing bar du bsgrubs: da lta bdag la gnyis su med: 'dir dus rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: dkyil 'khor gsum du bsnyen cing bsgrubs: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mtha' ru phyin: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: rgyal ba thugs rje'i rang bzhin la: gnad nas bskul ba mi 'tshal yang: deng sang thugs dam gnad nas bskul: gsang ba thugs kyi dpal be'u nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: 'byor pa drug ldan rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: mos pa rnam bzhi dbang gi dngos grub stsol: dgra bgegs tshar gcod drag po'i dngos grub stsol: las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las skyob pa'i nus mthu: ster ba'i dngos grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas/ deng 'dir bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol: oṃ padma hrī dha ya ā yurdzñā na ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ kā ya siddhi oṃ: wākka siddhi āḥtsitta siddhi hūm̐: sarba siddhi hrīḥ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa bco lnga las/ dang po tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: rang nyid pad 'byung thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge 'phros: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis nyes skyon bsregs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: 'dod yon tshogs kyis snang srid gang : rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing: rang byung tshe yi dkyil 'khor du: padma mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

byin phob mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs mchod bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: skye med ngang du thugs dam bskang*/ dam tshig 'gal 'khrul tshogs kyis bshags: gu ru dhai wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: bzhi pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : gzugs ling dgra bo'i rten mkhar la: chauos skyong pho nya'i bden pa'i mthus: gnod byed dgra sri myur du khug: badzra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ hūm̐: dbang chen khrag 'thung thugs kyi sras: rdo rje gzhon nu phur pa'i sku: gnam lcags rngam pa'i dbal ldan 'di: byad ma'i snying la kī la ya: nṛ tri myog thum dgra bo rbad: hūm̐: dbang chen lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: byad ma bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rngam yangs chos nyid lto bar bskyil: ldog med ye shes dbyings su hoḥ lnga pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: lhag sdud ging dang laṅka rnams: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab bzhes: gsang sngags bstan pa'i srung ma mdzod: dam sri dgra bo cham la phob: utstshiṣṭa bha liṃ ta la khā hi: drug pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: chos dbyings ngang nas drag por bzhengs: sngon gyi tha tshig rgyud bskul ba'i: thugs dam ma g.yel phrin las mdzod:

bdun pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe zab gsang rdo rje'i dbyings: bar du mchims phu g.ya' ma lung : da dus sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: laṅka ma mo shugs 'gro yis: rang rtags srog phul ci bzhin du: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'ja' lus tshe yi sgrub grogs mdzod: oṃ baṃ ḍākki mu khā le ma mo rakṣa kro ti bha liṃ ta khā hi: brgyad pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten skyong mdzad brtan ma rnams: rgyan ldan dur khrod gnas nyul ma: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: ci bcol phrin las rogs dan mdzod: ma ma ma mo ting ting shag shag le le bha liṃ ta khā hi: dgu pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro brdung : chem chem dgra bo'i mgo la brdung : mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ bhrūm̐ tsakra ya dgra bo nan nan: bcu pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: tshe la dbang ba rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor srid kyi dngos grub stsol: tshe yi dbang bzhi smin grol mchog thob nas: tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor rgyas thob gyur cig: rtsa sngags/ oṃ padma hrī dha ā yurdzñā na ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi hūm̐: bcu gcig pa mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral rdo rje'i sku: mnyam bzhag tshe bum 'chi med bcud: mi 'gyur g.yung drung longs spyod rdzogs: 'ja' lus rang byung padma 'byung : rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: bcu gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum yongs 'dus dkyil 'khor du: yo byad ma tshang 'bag btsog shor: cho ga lhag chad ting 'dzin g.yel: 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bzod par gsol: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya

sogs: yig brgya bzlas/ bcu gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas mi dmigs dbyings su yal: hūm̐ yig nā da skye med chos dbyings āḥ snang stong sku bzhi'i ngang la gnas gyur cig: hūm̐ hrī a la la: bcu bzhi pa smon lam btab pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'chi med gsang ba'i dal bzung nas: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i mthus: dge ba rgya mtshos sems can smin gyur nas: kun bzang pad 'byung go 'phang thob gyur cig: bco lnga pa bkra shis gsol ba ni/ hoḥ rtsa gsum 'khor lo pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor: zung 'jug tshe la rab gnas dbang ba yi: 'chi med bdud rtsis rtag tu ngoms byas nas: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog: de ltar yang zab padma khrag 'thung gi dbang chen tshe yi las byang chog khrigs 'di/ tshe sgrub padma gsang thig dang*/ lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ sngon rjes rnams kha bkang ste bklag chog tu bkod pa rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang nyid kyi nyams len thun mong ma yin pa'i gsal 'debs dang*/ spang ston theg gling smyon pas kyang bskul ba bcas/ skyid grong smyon pas rang gnas nor skyong klu yi lte gnas shel ri rin chen brtsegs pa'i mgul du bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ // sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈ rig 'dzin bla ma'i nor sgrub bsod nams stobs bskyed kyi las byang bzhugs so/ ma hā gu ru yid bzhin gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir rig 'dzin bla ma'i nor sgrub bsod nams stobs bskyed kyi phrin las rnal 'byor khrigs su bsdebs pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ thog mar sngon du 'gro ba la lnga/ dang po gsol 'debs ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings lhun grub spros pa'i mtha' bral yang*/ /'gro ba'i don du snying po'i rtsal phyung nas/ /ma gyur 'dren pa'i ngo bo snang mtha' yas/ /bdag la dngos grub rnam gnyis deng 'dir stsol/

/byin rlabs dbang dang nus pas bdag la skyongs/ /rang bzhin snying rje 'gags med rmad du byung*/ /'phags mchog phyag na padmo spyan ras gzigs/ /'bad med 'dun pa'i gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur bar bdag skyongs la/ /thugs rje'i rlabs phreng sgyu ma'i gar sgyur bzhin/ /skye dgu rnams la bsod nams char chen g.yo/ /gtan gyi skyabs mgon o rgyan chos kyi rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'di phyi dge legs stsol/ /skad gnyis smra mchog buddha dzñā na dang*/ /sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so chos nyid mngon gyur nas/ /rang rig bla mar 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro kun dge legs 'byin mdzad dzambha la/ /dbul ba'i phongs sel padma rgyal po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so sgrub rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /ke'u ri gsang ba mchog gi gnas mchog nas/ /zab gsang gnyen po gter gyi bya ra ma/ /dbyings phyug chos sgrol sman btsun mched lnga la/ /gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol/ /'di phyi kun tu tshogs gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /gnas skabs tshe bsod dpal 'byor gong du 'phel/ mthar thug don gnyis 'bras bu mngon gyur nas/ /padma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob shog / gnyis pa skyabs sems ni/ na mo hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dal: yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi dkyil 'khor lha: bsod nams spel zhing bsgrub phyir skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun dbul phongs sel bar sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ dkar gtor sngon du 'gro zhing*/ bgegs gtor la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis 'dod yon du spel/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa yi: 'gugs pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed: sgrub la mi dbang log 'dren bgegs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir mchis: oṃ badzra ṭākki rā dza ya: gnod byed 'byung po dza dzaḥ

hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung rol: 'byung po bka' las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma khyer la rang gnas dengs: 'tshe na drag sngags me char 'bebs: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad bhyoḥ thums shig gtor myog rbad raṃ dzwa la phaṭḥ bzhi pa mtshams gcod srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las srung ba'i gur: rdo rje lcags sdig bya khyung 'phros: gri gug kha ṭwāṃ me yi gur: sra mkhregs pha lam rang bzhin gyur: oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa: tri pā paṃ tsakra rakṣa: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsakra rakṣa: ka ra ti ka tsakra rakṣa: tri shu la tsakra rakṣa: raṃ dzwa la tsakra rakṣa: e swa bhā tsakra rakṣa: lnga pa mchod pa byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs? shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha lieṃ ta te dzwa bha liṃ ta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes pas lan gsum gyis brlab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la brgyad kyi dang po bskyed rim ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rang bzhin dbyings kyi dpal chen po: 'bar ba'i gar dgus srid pa'i dpyi nas gnon: log 'dren dgra bgegs dam sri bdud dpung sreg: stong gsum snod kyi 'jig rten srid pa'i khyon: stong pa'i ngang las 'byung lnga bsnol brtsegs pa: rin chen sna tshogs las grub gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang mtshan nyid ldan: bkra shis rdzas rtags nor bu'i tog gis spras: de dbus rin chen sna tshogs khri steng du: longs spyod bdag nyid rig 'dzin dzam bha la: sku mdog ser la snum 'bol mol le ba: khro 'dzum zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgeg cing dgyes: dbu skra thor tshugs rin chen sna tshogs brgyan:

dar tshon cod pan phyag gdub snyan cha 'khrol: phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas nor bu 'dzin: gsus khyim 'khyil zhing ratna'i ga shal brgyan: zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang stabs kyis bzhengs: gsang ba'i yum mchog lha mo nor bdag ma: sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis: g.yas pas lcags kyu g.yon pas nor bu 'dzin: yab kyi mgul 'khyud rin chen sna tshogs brgyan: zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon pas yab la 'khril: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug ldan par bsgom: phyi rol dbang sdud pho nya mkha' 'gro bzhi: g.yas pas rang rtags g.yon pas ne'u le 'dzin: rin chen brgyan cing gar stabs 'gros su bsgom: phyi rol phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: bka' sdod nor lha phyogs skyong sde dpon bcas: de ltar gsal ba'i 'bru lnga'i 'od zer gyis: nor bdag dbang phyug lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: badzra sa mā ya dza: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: gter 'byung yid bzhin gzhal yas nas: nor bdag rig 'dzin 'dod rgu'i rje: yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: gter 'byung yid bzhin gzhal yas nas: yid 'ong dgos 'dod dar 'bol steng: nor bdag rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: bsod nams 'dod rgu'i bdag nyid mchog: longs spyod phywa g.yang sdud mdzad pa: rig 'dzin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas: dngos grub bdag po khyod la 'dud: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod yid 'ong lha yi gter: nang mchod bdud rtsi dkar dmar phud: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bha liṃ ta: nor bdag 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs? oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: drug pa bstod pa ni/

hūm̐: bde chen lhun grub chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong: 'dod rgu'i dpal ldan nor bdag longs spyod rje: rin chen rgyan ldan sgrub la dngos grub ster: khro 'dzum dgyes pas rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong: phyag g.yas lcags kyus mi nor dbang du sdud: g.yon pas rin chen 'dod rgu char bzhin 'bebs: sgeg cing dgyes la sa gsum zil gyis gnon: dor stabs zhabs ldan rdzu 'phrul gar dgu bsgyur: rin chen khrir bzhugs khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog lha mo nor bdag ma: sku mdog dmar ser dbang gi phrin las sgrub: phyag g.yas lcags kyus 'byung lnga'i bcud mdangs sdud: g.yon pa'i nor bus dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs: rin chen rgyan ldan bang mdzod bcud kyis 'gengs: yab la zhabs 'khril bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'bar: 'dod rgu'i mchod sbyin dbyings phyug dpa' mor bstaud: gar gyi nyams ldan myur mgyogs mkha' 'gro bzhi: rin chen rgyan cha sna tshogs spungs se spung: phyag g.yas rang rtags rigs lnga'i phrin las rdzogs: g.yon pa'i ne'u les nor gyi char pa 'bebs: gar sgyur 'greng stabs sgrub po'i grogs mo'i tshul: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: khyed nyid sgrub cing mchod pa'i skal ldan la: 'dod rgu yid bzhin 'bad med dngos grub stsol: bdun pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/ mdun bskyed thugs kar padma nyi zla'i steng*/ /thugs srog hūm̐ yig btso ma gser mdog mthar/ /sngags phreng rang sgra sgrog bzhin 'khor ba las/ /'od kyi zer 'phros phyi snod gzhal yas khang*/ /nang bcud sems can lhar gyur sngags kyi sgra/ /bung ba tshang zhig lta bu di ri ri/ /grags stong brag cha dran stong 'od gsal dbyings/ /snang srid gzhir bzhengs ye shes rtsal rdzogs gyur/ oṃ gu ru puṇye ḍā ka ḍākki ā pa ra mi ta siddhi dza dzaḥ bsnyen sgrub dbyer med ci nus bzlas/
