zhes dang sham bur/ slar yang thugs srog sngags las 'od zer ni/ /gser mdog sna tshogs nor bu'i rnam pa can/ /grangs med rab 'phros phyi nang kun tu khyab/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba dang*/ /legs tshogs yon tan nyams rtogs ye shes kun/ /yar zla bzhin rgyas tshur 'dus snying gar thim/ /'gyur med rig pa'i ye shes rtsal rdzogs nas/ /snang srid mos bzhis dbang du bsdus par bsam/ rtsa sngags mthar/ a tri nṛ yaṃ sarba 'gul 'gul: ma ma hriṃ hriṃ: ma ma kha shi: mi snying bsgul bsgul: mi 'gram chog chog: hring hring bsdus bsdus ma ma kha shi baṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes btags la bzla'o/ brgyad pa thun mtshams gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gling bzhi gling phran bkod pa'i tshom bu la: lha mi'i yo byad nor rdzas rgyan gyis phyug: snang srid 'di ru ci srid 'tshogs pa yi: phyi nang mnyes mchod dgyes pa'i 'dod rgu'i tshogs: pad 'byung nor lha bsgrub phyir mchod pa 'bul: sgrub la tshe chos zas nor mnga' thang srid: yid la mos pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa yaksha nā ga dhe wa lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha liṃ ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes bskul dbyangs gsal yi ge brgya pas kha bkang ngo*/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim par nyer gcig las/ thog mar tshogs kyi mchod pa la brgyad las/ dang po bsang sbyang ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas chos dbyings ngo bo stong: rang byung snying po'i 'od zer gyis: rgyu 'byung yi ge sbyong byed 'phros: gtsang btsog bzang ngan ka nas dag: oṃ sarba dharma ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ shuddhe hoḥ gnyis pa byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: byin rlob yi ge 'bru gsum 'phros: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs spel bsgyur: tshogs rdzas nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ gsum pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas:

rje btsun thod phreng yab yum la: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: longs spyod dbang phyug dzam bha la: sa snying mdog can yum dang sbyor: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig pho brang nas: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho la: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'drain gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs thibs se thib: khro bo'i lha tshogs ya la la: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang la: gshegs shing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: mos pa'i skal ldan smin par mdzod: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dza: bzhi pa phud kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dbang sdud yab yum mgyogs ma bcas: dam can gter bdag chos skyong la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas skal ldan bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: lnga pa bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi yi spyan gzigs 'dod yon rnam lnga'i gter: nang gi rdzas mchog bla med mchod pa'i sprin: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po rnam lnga yis: rig 'dzin nor lha rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : dbang drag padma thod phreng thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bka' srung gter bdag rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskangs la dgyes pa rab bskyed nas: sgrub la dgos 'dod yid bzhin char ltar phob: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

drug pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: phyi nang dam tshig 'gal zhing nyams pa dang: bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags mchod rdzas chad cing lhag: bag med dam 'gal le lo ci mchis pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas skong zhing bshags: nyams sgrib dag nas tshangs par stsal du gsol: oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐: bdun pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: mdun du hom khung lcags khang gru gsum nang: nṛ tri las skyes dgra bgegs 'byung po dang: god bdag dbul sri mngon sum gsal bar gyur: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: khyad par bka' srung chos skyong bden pa'i mthus: gnod byed 'byung po bar chad rtsom pa'i rigs: rang dbang med par tshogs ling 'di la khug: bskrad cing bsdams la bsgral gtubs phye mar thongs: oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ hūm̐: ye shes thugs las sprul pa khro bo'i rgyal: sras mchog las mdzad badzra ku mā ra: phyag gnyis srid pa'i ri rab phur bu bsgril: byad ma gdug pa'i snying la kī la ya: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dam sri mā ra ya trig nan: gzir nan: mā ra ya rbad rbad: brgyad pa zhal du bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang sdud rgyal po dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: dug lnga dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rngam yangs zhal du bzhes shig mgrin par drongs: bde stong chos nyid rang byung lto bar bskyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: g.yang skyabs bya bar 'dod na g.yang 'bod dngos grub char 'bebs 'dir bya/ de nas tshogs la rol/ gnyis pa rjes kyi bya ba la bcu gsum las/ dang po lhag ma gtong ba ni/ hūm̐: bka' nyan ma mo bye ba 'bum: gnas nyul dur khrod tshogs khang 'grims: gsang sngags grogs kyi mel tshe ma: lhag ma bzhes la phrin las mdzod: oṃ bhakṣa li si ta ma bha liṃ ta khā hi:

gnyis pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe me ri 'bar ba ru: bla ma thod phreng drag po dang : mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes gnyis: rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor phye: steng 'og lha srin khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: de 'og ti sgro'i tshogs khang du: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas dang: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma sring gnas nyul khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa yis: ti sgro'i tshogs khang chen mo nas: gsang rgya zab gter bton pa'i tshe: las kyi ma mos khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: yang gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di: phyogs bcur spel ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti ḍā ka ḍākki ma ma ru lu bhyoḥ i daṃ bha liṃ ta khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan sil snyan sgra: brda gar glu dbyangs khyugs se khyug: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ma hā bha liṃ ta khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: stong gsum chem chem khro bo'i bro: mnan no ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bro: nam yang ma ldang las kyi bro: sgab 'dre dam sri 'dul zhing bshig: oṃ nan: a nan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan: lnga pa thugs dam bskul zhing dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rig 'dzin dzam bha la: mkha' 'gro nor lha rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la: lha mi'i dpal yon 'dod rgu'i gter chen po: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin bla med 'bul: gdung sems dam tshig ldan pas tshul bzhin du: khyed rnams bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod phul ba'i mthus: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la zhal bzang ston: thugs rjes brtser dgongs shugs ldan thugs rje bskyed:

sku gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs mthu stobs bsdus: rtse gcig bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: nyi zla drang srong rig 'dzin tshe bcud bsdus: mi 'gyur gnas pa tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bde dga'i dpal ldan lha klu'i mthu stobs bsdus: brgyud 'dzin srid dang dpal 'phel dngos grub stsol: snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus: bla yid dung dung shes pa dbang med sgyur: g.yang can nor gyi phung po ri ltar spungs: brjid ldan gos dang dar zab sprin ltar gtibs: grags can snyan pa'i sgra skad 'brug ltar sgrogs: bcud ldan zas nor longs spyod char ltar phob: bkra shis mi nor tshe dpal mtsho ltar skyil: 'dod rgu 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa dang: kun la dbang bsgyur chab 'bangs chos srid stobs: srid par che btsan 'gran zla bral ba yis: kun kyang theg chen chos la 'god par stsol: gsol btab bden pa'i 'bras bu g.yel gyur na: brtse chen thugs rjes dam bca' gang la mdzad: brgyud 'dzin dbul zhing phongs pas nyam thag na: mthu stobs byin rlabs myur zhes ci zhig bya: de bas thugs dam gnyan pos brtser dgongs la: tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: rtags dang mtshan ma mngon sum ston pa dang: zas nor longs spyod tshe dpal dngos grub kyi: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du: 'dzad med gter la spyod pa'i dngos grub stsol: sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ drug pa mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod yid 'ong lha yi gter: nang mchod bdud rtsi dkar dmar phud: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bha liṃ ta: nor bdag 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs? oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bde chen lhun grub chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong: 'dod rgu'i dpal ldan nor bdag longs spyod rje: gsang ba'i yum mchog dbyings phyug dpa' mo dang*/ dbang sdud mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs la bstod:

bdun pa bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam las 'gal ba dang: ma 'byor nyams dang chad lhag 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags nas mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs? zhes yig brgya bzlas/ brgyad pa rten la bzhugs gsol 'debs pa ni/ e ma hoḥ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing mchog bde ba can: rnam dag padma bkod pa'i mkha' dbyings nas: snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs: dbang bzhi stsol zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: rnga yab dpal ri zangs mdog tsitta'i dbyibs: lhun grub padma 'od kyi pho brang nas: o rgyan yab yum rnams la gsol ba 'debs: dbang bzhi stsol zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: yid bzhin 'khor lo 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i zhing: snang srid dbang du 'du ba'i gnas mchog nas: gtso mchog mkha' 'gro nor lhar gsol ba 'debs: dbang bzhi stsol zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: deng nas bzhugs te byang chub snying po'i bar: bsod nams longs spyod 'bad med 'grub pa dang: mi mthun bdud bzhi'i tshogs las rab rgyal nas: tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par mdzad du gsol: oṃ gu ru padma sarba siddhi dzaḥ dgu pa brtan bzhugs dang g.yang skyabs skabs yin na rgyas gdab bya/ bcu pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: gsang 'dus rang byung dpal chen pho brang lha: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas 'khor bsdu yum la bsdu: yum yab hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yang dmigs med klong: ka dag rang byung rang shar klong du hoḥ a āḥ bcu gcig pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ dmigs med rgya yan chos nyid rgyu yi bsngo: rang shar rang rtsal ma 'gags lam gyi bsngo: sna tshogs spros bral ka dag 'bras bu'i bsngo: kun gzhi skye med 'khor 'das gcig tu bsngo: bcu gnyis pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ srid pas bsdus pa'i mtha' yas sems can rnams: dbul phongs pre ta'i 'ching ba rab grol nas: don gnyis bsod nams 'bras bu tshogs rdzogs te:

mthar thug gu ru'i go 'phang thob gyur cig: bcu gsum bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: ka dag lhun grub rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis 'chi med tshe yi lha: gnas lugs rang rtsal mngon rdzogs bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin padma 'byung: tshe rabs gtan gyi bla mar bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i bkra shis mkha' 'gro las kyi bdag: gsang rgyud gdams pas rgyud smin bkra shis shog: dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla ma yi dam tshogs: zil gnon dbang sdud padma rgyal po rtsal: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag: phyi nang rtsa gsum lha yi bkra shis shog: ces pa 'di yang gzhung nyid la rigs mthun gyi cho ga dag las kha bkang ste/ skyid grong smyon pas khams gsum bde ldan dpal 'khyil du bkod pa dge bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ gu ru nor lha dbyer med kyi g.yang 'bod dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs padma 'byung*/ /gang gi thugs rje'i rnam rol rmad po che/ /mi zad rgyun gyi 'khor los phyug pa'i phyir/ /dngos grub 'gugs pa'i chu rgyun 'di na spro/ de yang g.yang rten rdzas gtor sogs/ padma rgyal po'i spyi gzhung 'gal med legs par grub nas/ ༈ dang po sgab 'dre bse rag bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dbang drag padma he ru kaḥ nyon cig bse rag dbul sri ltogs 'gong tshogs: dbus kyi ri rab lho phyogs 'dzam gling 'dir: spyi mthun chos nor longs spyod spel ba la: rang rang las kyi dbang gis mi 'tshams pa'i: dbul sri mi la bse rag zhes bya ba: gang gi rgyu ni ser sna'i rang gzugs te: rkyen ni rgyu mthun yi dwags yid kyi lus: sna tshogs gzugs su brdzu zhing dpal g.yang rku: snod bcud rten 'brel legs tshogs spel ba la: byur dang mi kha god kha gang stong sogs:

rnam kun bar chad sna tshogs sgab 'dre ldang : ltogs 'gong dbul sri 'byung po'i sde tshogs kun: tshwa ram sgog g.yer la sogs mi kha'i rdzas: rang rang yid mthun yas stags 'di longs la: lan chags bu lon 'brel thag chod par gyis: myur du mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i pha mthar song : bsgo ba'i bka' las 'da' na lus ngag yid: yi dam drag tu khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gdon mi za: de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ye shes lnga yi srung 'khor brtan par bsgom: gnyis pa dag byed bsang khrus bya ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lha shing bsang gis mi bsangs gang yang med: chab gtsang khrus kyis mi 'dag gang yang med: gtsang sme gnyis 'dzin sems kyi 'khrul snang char: btsog mnol dme yugs mi gtsang grib phog pa: phyi nang 'byung 'khrugs rten 'brel nyes tshogs kun: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum lnga'i mkha' dbyings klong : chos nyid rnam dag dbyings su dag gyur cig: oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe swā hāḥ yam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe swā hāḥ bam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe swā? lam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe? ram̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe? e yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ ram̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe swā hāḥ.a a swā hā: zhes gter kha 'og ma sku dgongs las so/ de nas tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang dbang ba'i gces phrug pho mo rigs ldan gyi phyag tu lcags kyu ne'u le mda' dar dang padma'i zhags pa bcas thogs/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i phyag tu rnga shing dang dam tshig rdo rje ratna'i zhags pa bcas thogs la dbyangs snyan po dang bcas nas 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen dbyings kyi mkha'/ /klong lnga zer thag 'tsher ba'i pho brang nas/ /skal ldan smin grol lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs rjes g.yang khug cig /gzung 'dzin bral ba sems nyid rig pa'i mkha'/ /rang gsal rig pa'i cho rol pho brang nas/

/rang rig sangs rgyas chos skur grol mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang sems byin rlabs g.yang khug cig /ma 'gags shar grol rang byung shar ba'i mkha'/ /mdo sde 'dul ba lung rigs pho brang nas/ /yo ga rnam gsum chos kyis smin mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rdzogs gzhi grol chos kyi g.yang khug cig /bstan pa'i brgyud 'dzin 'dzam gling yongs kyi mkha'/ /snyan pa'i ba dan bsgrengs pa'i pho brang nas/ /ma rig sems can 'khor ba stongs mdzad pa'i/ /skyes chen tshogs 'dus dge 'dun g.yang khug cig /thugs rje'i rtsal las gang 'dul sprul pa'i klong*/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug theg rim dgu yi lha/ /srid pa gsum na stobs bcus dbang bsgyur ba/ /yi dam lha tshogs dngos grub g.yang khug cig /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis mkha' la lam lam 'gro/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i dwangs ma'i srog 'dzin ma/ /chos sku yum chen rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum/ /ma sring mkha' 'gros rten 'brel g.yang khug cig /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' btags dam gnas pa/ /mthu rtsal stobs ldan sha khrag srog la rngam/ /dam sri bdud rigs dgra bgegs thal bar brlag /chos skyong srung ma'i mthu rtsal g.yang khug cig /shar phyogs mgyogs ma rdo rje lcags kyu mas/ /yul 'khor srung dang dri za lha mi bcas/ /shar phyogs lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /lho phyogs mgyogs ma rin chen zhags pa mas/ /'phags skyes po dang gshin rje lha mi bcas/ /lho phyogs 'dzam bu gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /nub phyogs mgyogs ma padma lcags sgrog mas/ /spyan mi bzang dang klu dbang lha mi bcas/ /nub phyogs ba lang spyod la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /byang phyogs mgyogs ma rgya gram dril bu mas/ /rnam thos sras dang gnod sbyin lha mi bcas/

/byang phyogs sgra ma'i snyan la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /dngos grub bdag mo klu mo nor skyong mas/ /lha klu mi yi mnga' thang longs spyod srid/ /tshe dpal mnga' thang snyan grags 'dod rgu'i dpyid/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /gzhan yang lo zla tshes la dbang ba dang*/ /lo dang spar sme dus 'dzin sa yi bdag /chu tshod 'byung lnga'i khams dang rgyu skar gyi/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /sde dpon sum cu sngags bdag bco brgyad dang*/ /dregs chen bco brgyad 'jigs dgu sde brgyad kyis/ /'dzam gling srid pa'i yid la gang mos pa'i/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /phywa khu ye g.yang khu ye hu ye g.yang sdud do/ zhes dang*/ de nas brtan bzhugs gsol ba ni/ e ma ho/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing mchog bde ba can/ /rnam dag padma bkod pa'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /snang mtha' 'od ma'i 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi stsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /rnga yab dpal ri lhun grub padma 'od/ /zangs mdog tsitta'i dbyibs kyi pho brang nas/ /o rgyan yab yum rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi stsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /ye shes rtsal lnga spras pa'i pho brang nas/ /thod phreng yab yum rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi stsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /yid bzhin 'khor lor 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /snang srid dbang du 'du ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /brtan g.yo padma rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi stsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bsod nams longs spyod 'bad med 'grub pa dang*/ /mi mthun bdud bzhi'i tshogs las rab rgyal nas/ /tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par mdzad du gsol/
oṃ gu ru padma sarba siddhi dzaḥ

brtan bzhugs gsol nas rgyas gdab pa ni/ hūm̐/ ma chags thogs med 'khor lo rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /yid 'ong mdzes ldan btsun mo rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /kun la dbang bsgyur blon po rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /theg chen stobs ldan glang po rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /cang shes shugs ldan rta mchog rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /log rtog dpung 'joms dmag dpon rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /mi 'gyur dbyings kyi sna tshogs rdo rje yis/ /kun nas kun tu bzung zhing rgyas gtab bo/ kyai/ bkra shis dang po'i rgyal mtshan gcig /gser nya rin chen bkra shis gnyis/ /chos dung g.yas 'khyil bkra shis gsum/ /dri med padma'i bkra shis bzhi/ /lhun grub bum pa'i bkra shis lnga/ /yid 'jo dpal be'u'i bkra shis drug /mkha' yi gdugs mchog bkra shis bdun/ /rtsibs stong 'khor lo'i bkra shis brgyad/ /mi shigs g.yu drung bkra shis dgu /phywa g.yang brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /mi chod mi shigs rgyas gdab bo/ /rtsal chen khyung dang stobs chen sdig /sgo lha stag g.yag mtshams su ni/ /'byung po zhugs pa'i go skabs med/ /de bas srungs shig rgyas gdab bo/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes rgyas 'debs bsngo smon sogs rten 'brel bzhin du bya/ g.yang 'gugs dngos grub char 'bebs zhes pa 'di/ gu ru nor lha dbyer med phrin chog kha skong du rong smyon pas sbyar ba dge/ bkra shis shog/ // ༄༅/ /padma khrag 'thung 'dus pa las: sgrub thabs snying po'i bcud dril bzhugs so:

padma he ru ka la 'dud: padma khrag 'thung 'dus pa yi: sgrub thabs snying po'i bcud dril ba: spros med don gyi rnal 'byor che: gu ru'i gsung bzhin yi ger bkod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod skyabs sems dang : tshogs bsags mchod pa byin brlab sogs: ji ltar rigs pa sngon song nas: zhes pas: thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: lan gsum: gsum pa mchod pa byin brlab ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzwa bha liṃ ta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ oṃ sarba a haṃ dzñā na a mṛ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes lnga'am bdun gyis brlabs: gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed rim ni: ma bcos lhun grub ngang nyid du: rang byung dran rdzogs 'di ltar bsgom: oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: gdod ma'i stong nyid ngang las snying rje'i rtsal: hūm̐ dmar 'od kyi 'phro 'dus snod bcud sbyangs: stong gsal ngang las rdo rje'i srung 'khor dang : dur khrod rab 'jigs drag po'i gzhal yas dbus: pad nyi dregs pa rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i steng : sa bon phra thabs tshul du babs pa las: che mchog padma khrag 'thung drag po rtsal:

dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar khro zhing gtum: spyan gsum sdang mig sma ra smin ma gzengs: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgra sgrogs: phyag g.yas rdo rjes snang srid zil gyis gnon: g.yon pas phur pa ma rungs snying la gzir: lcags sdig tshwa tshwas dam 'gong hub hub za: dbu gtsug rta mgo rdo rje dbyings su 'tsher: 'jigs pa'i gad mos stong gsum 'gul zhing 'khyom: dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du rngam: gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis: drag me dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong na rol: spyi bor rigs bdag tshe dpag med pas mtshan: sku la zhi khro rab 'byams sprin phung 'phro: gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge gsal zhing 'bar: thugs ka'i 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs bsam: hūm̐ hrīḥ raksha srin po khros pa'i pho brang nas: stong gsum dregs pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng rtsal: padma khrag 'thung drag po'i skur bzhengs nas: ma rungs log 'dren 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: hrīḥ padma kro dha he ru ka e hya hi hrīṃ hrīṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: bskyed pa'i dam tshig rten la gnyis med bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pa'i brda yis dad phyag 'tshal: drag po'i nyer spyod sman raka gtor ma'i tshogs: sbyor sgrol brtul zhugs phyag rgya'i gar gyis mchod: shrī he ru ka badzra arghaṃ sogs? pañtsa a mṛ ta ta na ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ gtum chen drag shul dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams kun tu g.yo: bde stong ye shes snying rje khros pa'i tshul: padma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bzlas pa sngags kyi 'phro 'du ni: thugs kar pha lam rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐: sngags phreng dus mtha'i me lce 'bar ba yis: dregs pa tshar bcad rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs nus stobs bdag thim gnyis med gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ padma he ru ka artsig nirtsig sarba duṣṭāṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ

sgra dag ting 'dzin gsal bar 'bum phrag bzhi: bzlas pas khrag 'thung chen po'i nus stobs rdzogs: thun mthar mchod cing bstod la bzod par gsol: lha dang rang sems dbyer med 'od gsal ngang : bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rgyas gdab bo: zhes pas: shrī he ru ka badzra arghaṃ sogs? pañtsa a mṛ ta ta na ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ gtum chen drag shul dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams kun tu g.yo: bde stong ye shes snying rje khros pa'i tshul: padma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod gsol ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam las 'gal ba dang : ma 'byor nyams dang chad lhag 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags la mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya bzla'o: mdun bskyed brtan bzhugs bya la: bdag bskyed bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: gsang 'dus rang byung ye shes dkyil 'khor lha: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas 'khor bsdu gtso la bsdu: gtso bo hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yang dmigs med klong : ka dag rang byung shar grol klong du hoḥ a āḥ bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: dmigs med rgya yan chos nyid rgyu yi bsngo: rang shar rang rtsal ma 'gags lam gyi bsngo: sna tshogs spros bral ka dag 'bras bu'i bsngo: kun gzhi skye med 'khor 'das gcig tu bsngo: smon lam ni: hoḥ bdag blo ye nas dbyings rig sgrib pa bral: gnyis 'dzin ma rig 'khrul pa'i rmongs gzugs rnams: dran rtog chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: tshe rabs pad 'byung yab yum 'bral med shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rdzogs rim thugs ka'i hūm̐ dmar kho na la: rlung yig rig pa dril la mdung tshugs gtad: 'das pa 'gags shing ma 'ongs ma skyes pa'i: da lta'i shes pa rig stong lam du khyer: bdud dang dam sri rgyal 'gong la sogs pa: thams cad sems kyis snang ba kho na te: sems la ngo bo ngos bzung mtshan ma med:

stong gsal don gyi padma khrag 'thung che: gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang rig 'di ka rang : 'khor 'das gnyis med chen por la bzla'o: de ltar goms 'dris brtan pa thob pa na: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i chos kun zil gyis gnon: rdo rje he ru ka dpal mngon sum 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: snod ldan smin byed snying po'i gtor dbang ni: dpal gyi gtor chen brjid ldan mdzes par bsham: lha sngags ting 'dzin nus ldan cho gas bsgrub: slob mas yon phul gsol gdab rgyud sbyangs la: dam ye dbyer med brten byas gnas gsum du: gtor ma bzhag cing sku gsung thugs dbang sbyin: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub padma khrag 'thung sku: rtsa gsum rab 'byams sku dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi lus la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim sku yi dbang mchog thob par shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sngags mthar: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub padma khrag 'thung gsung : rtsa gsum rab 'byams gsung dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi ngag la dbang bskur bas: nus pa sngags kyi dbang mchog thob par shog: sngags mthar: wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub padma khrag 'thung thugs: rtsa gsum rab 'byams thugs dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi yid la dbang bskur bas: rig rtsal don gyi dbang mchog thob par shog: sngags mthar: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: slar yang gtor ma spyi bor bzhag byas la: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'gro ba 'dren mdzad padma khrag 'thung rtsal: rgyal ba sras bcas rnams dang gnyis su med: rtsa gsum lha tshogs sku yi dbyings su rdzogs: skal ldan slob ma'i spyi bor mngon sum byon: sgo gsum nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad sol: smin grol dbang dang byin rlabs char ltar phob: rang byung rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor na: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: sarba siddhi hrī: zhes brjod gtor ma'i lha bstim dngos grub sbyin:

bkra shis brjod cing me tog char chen dbab: bar chad bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rab rgyal nas: padma khrag 'thung nus stobs rdzogs par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: bde gshegs kun 'dus padma khrag 'thung gi: smin grol spros med don gyi gdams zab 'di: ma 'ongs don phyir rin chen gter du sbas: las 'phro can gyi bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter gyi snying po'o// // ༈ drag po padma khrag 'thung gi mngon rtogs: nad 'joms par bu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ khro rgyal stobs 'dus drag por 'dud: ma 'ongs yang mtha' rtsod ldan gyi: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: bod mi mgo nag bsod nams chung : mi dge dug sbyor nag po yi: bar chad ldang zhing dus min 'chi: mtha' yi mi bzhi dbus su bsnyeg: dam sri 'dre rgod tsha ngar che: sngar gyi chos khrims sil bur 'thor: chos rgyal dmangs kyi khol bur 'bebs: gtsug lag bya sprang yul 'dres 'dzin: bcos thabs ma mchis nad rigs dar: srin mos sha khrag dmar 'gyed gtong : grib btsan shan pa rlung ltar 'tshub: dmar nad lhog yams tre tre hoḥ rims yams me dbal sha khol gyis: bar chad sdang zhing mi thog 'bud: smyo 'bog snying gzer steng grib kyi: ltas ngan sna dgu ldang ba'i dus: srung thabs man ngag khyad par can: gu ru bdag gis legs par gdams: jo mo mtsho rgyal khyod nyid kyis: yi ger thobs la gter du sbos: gter bdag dge bsnyen bzhi la bcol: gzho stod ti sgro'i brag la sbas: yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus: gnubs ban dzñā na'i skye ba ni: padma gter bdag gling la sprod: dur khrod tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan: sa gzhi mthing nag 'jam pa'i dal: dkyil 'khor bri zhing mchod pa bsham: las rim gzhung bzhin shes par bya: yang na spros med lugs ltar bya:

rang nyid drag po'i nga rgyal gyis: bskyed rim gsal zhing drag sngags bzlas: rims yams lhog rgod gdon gyi rigs: sbur ma mes khyer ci bzhin du: gzhom zhing bsregs pa'i dmigs pa bya: rang nyid srung ngam nad pa la: rdzas kyi gdams pa 'di ltar bstan: nag po dgu dang khyung lnga sman: gri khrag ke tshe shang tshe dang : dug khrag thod rus phag nag khrag: 'dzin pa thar nu ra nag khrag: de dag sngags shing ril bu bsgril: lus la 'chang ngam lto ru btang : zhag bdun dag la lan re bskyar: yang na yul srung dar lcog 'dzugs: snga zhogs dud pa ma btang gong : sngags bzlas bskyed rim gsal gyur na: 'go nad srung bar the tshom med: srung ba bya na rdzas rnams byugs: lus la rgyun du 'chang bar bya: thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: lan gsum: gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed rim ni: dang po skad cig dran rdzogs su: snang stong ma bcos 'di ltar gsal: hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing brdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rang rtsal rdzogs: oṃ: kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: gzhung chen mo las so/ hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ rgya gram: ram̐ las me ri kham̐ rakta: sum̐ las zhing chen keṃ ri rab: bhrūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal yas rdzogs: ye shes me zer srung ba'i gur: mi shigs pho brang rakṣa bhrūm̐: oṃ badzra e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐ dzñā na hūm̐: de nas lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: dur khrod e yi sa gzhi dbus: lha klu sde brgyad bsnol ba'i khrir: dam sri bsgral ba'i zhing gdan du: bdag nyid che mchog he ru kaḥ

drag rtsal padma khrag 'thung sku: sku mdog dmar nag me zer 'phro: zhal gsum phyag drug zhal gdangs khro: spyan dgu smin ma glog ltar 'khyug: dbu la rigs lnga'i khyung chen rdzogs: g.yas gsum gri gug rdo rje me: g.yon gsum thod khrag lcags sdig sbrul: dur khrod dpal chas yongs su rdzogs: zhabs bzhi khro bo'i 'gying stabs kyis: bya khyung mthing nag me gshog zhon: sa bdag klu yi gnyen por bsgom: hūm̐: shar du sgrol ging srog bdag mthing : g.yas gsum spu gri chu gri me: g.yon gsum thod khrag snying dang sdig: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan: me yi bya khyung dmar nag zhon: hūm̐: lho ru gtum ging sngo nag 'bar: g.yas gsum tsitta me chu gri: g.yon gsum kha ṭwāṃ lcags sdig me: dur khrod dpal chas rab tu rdzogs: 'joms byed bya khyung kham nag zhon: hūm̐: nub tu khro ging dmar nag gtum: g.yas gsum ral gri gri gug thod: g.yon gsum 'khor lo spu gri sdig: khro chas rdzogs shing rngam pa la: srog gzan bya khyung ser nag zhon: hūm̐: byang du las ging ljang nag rngam: g.yas gsum 'khor lo rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum tri shūl lcags sdig khyung : dur khrod chas brgyad 'jigs la rngam: gtor byed bya khyung ljang nag zhon: kun kyang dur khrod chas dang ldan: zhal gsum gdangs shing spyan dgu bgrad: ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba brtsegs: dbu rgyan bya khyung dmag tshogs 'gyed: brkyang bskum khyung zhon gsal bar bskyed: mtshams bzhir khro bo sprul pa'i khyung : dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag rngam: gser mig zangs ra lcags mchu bgrad: me gshog rdeb cing khro sder bsnun: rgyal bsren dam sri'-i gnyen por bsgom: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi ru: shar du ma mo sdig gdong ma: rgyal bsren 'joms pa'i gnyen por bsgom: lho ru ma mo chu srin gdong : klu gnyan sa bdag gnyen por bsgom: nub tu ma mo phag gdong ma:

gson 'dre dam sri'i gnyen por bsgom: byang du ma mo khyung gdong ma: yams nad dus 'khrugs gnyen por bsgom: las kyi ma mo mched bzhi po: gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams: gcer mo mtshan bsgrad stong khams nyul: chibs su lcags sdig mgo dgu bcibs: stobs kyis dpag tshad stong khams g.yo: yams nad 'joms pa'i gnyen por bsgom: hūm̐: phyi rol sprul pa'i bya khyung 'gyed: gzhan yang las byed pho nya rnams: snang srid rol pa'i rtsal shar nas: chu zla rmi lam ji bzhin bsgom:

spros med spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig rgyal ba rig 'dzin tshogs: dgongs shig che mchog drag po rtsal: padma khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha': dus 'khrug yams nad rgyal 'gong dang : dam sri gnod byed kha dar bas: khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: nad bdag choms la nad mkhar shigs: nad dal chod la yams dal sgyur: nad mtshon bsregs gtor rdul du rlog: sgrub pa'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams su: bya khyung sprul pa'i dmag dpung 'khrigs: me gshog rlabs bskyod stong gsum g.yo: drag sngags gzir 'debs srid gsum gzhom: yams nad gdug pa thal bar rlog: hūm̐: bskul lo rig 'dzin mthu ma chung : rbad do bya khyung rtsal ma zhan: brten no ma mo bang ma bul: g.yab bo sgrol ging rgyang ma ring : nad mtshon gdug pa'i dbal zor 'di: myur du gzhom pa'i phrin las mdzod: dzapa ྄bzla ba ni: gzhung dang man ngag gi dgongs pa'i dgos pa gsal btab la: ༈ bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid thugs kar nyi zla'i steng/ /ye shes sems pa gsang bdag mthing*/ /de yi thugs kar ting 'dzin sems/ /snang mtha'i thugs kar thig le'i klong/ /dmar nag hūm̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng*/ /'khor ba'i 'od zer dpag yas 'phros/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal mchod byin dbang bsdus/ /nad gdon dgra bgegs tshar thag bcad/ /'gro ba'i sgrib dag snod bcud sbyangs/ /mdor na snang grags rtog pa'i chos/ /pad ma drag po'i sku gsung thugs/ /lha sngags ye shes rol par gyur/ zhes pa'ang gnam lcags gu hyas rang gi dgos mkho'i ched gter gzhung dgongs pa dang mthun par sbyar ba'o// oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes bsnyen pa dang : oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐: zhes sgrub sngags ji ltar rem par bzla: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: snang srid thams cad drag po e yi klong : snod bcud gzugs snang yi dam lha yi sku: 'byung 'jug rlung rnams rang bzhin snying po'i sngags: khams kyi rang mdangs khro bo rol pa'i rtsal: gnas lugs ma bcos skye med yi ge hūm̐: rang rig ngo bo che mchog drag po rtsal: padma khrag 'thung gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: bla ma rdo rje thod phreng sku mdog mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing drag tu khros: rdo rje gri gug ral gri g.yas su thogs: bhan dmar thong gshol lcags sdig g.yon na bsnams: rdo rje sgro gdengs dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs: rdo rje phag mo zangs mdog gri thod 'dzin: brkyang bskum ye shes gar gyis pang du 'khyud: 'bar ba'i zer ldan me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'jigs byed drag po'i sku yi char: spyi bor snang mtha' rigs kyi bdag: steng du sprul pa'i bya khyung rngam: dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje 'jigs: mgrin par dbang chen rta mgrin gshe: thugs kar phyag na rdo rje gtum: lte bar rdo rje gzhon nu 'bar: gsang bar yaksha khro bo brjid: phyag g.yas badzra kī la ya: phyag g.yon ratna kī la ya: zhabs g.yas padma kī la ya: zhabs g.yon karma kī la ya: gsang ba yum gyi gnas lnga ru: bde chen mkha' 'gro sde bzhis gar: gzhon nu rgyan rdzogs cha lugs 'chang : drag po yab yum phyogs bzhi ru: 'jigs byed ging chen yab yum bzhi: sgrol ging gtum ging khro ging dang : las kyi ging bcas yab yum brgyad: mtshams su sprul pa yang sprul bcas: gzhan yang sgo skyong la sogs pa: dbang drag rdo rje srin po yi: sku gsung thugs kyi gzi brjid rnams: stobs bcu 'gyed phyir sprul pa'i lha: srid gsum mngon spyod las kyis sdud:

stong gsum sde brgyad dam la btags: gling khams kun la 'dren zla bral: sku las khro chung tshwa tshwa 'phro: me ri 'bar mched wa la la: 'byung po mi dang mi min sogs: bgegs dang dam sri ma lus kun: drag po'i stobs kyis tshar bcad gyur: rang bzhin hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes hūm̐ sgra sgrogs shing snang srid thams cad res 'ga' khro bo khro mo res 'ga' hūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan snang srid kyi khyon thams cad khengs par bsgom/ skabs su rang bzhin 'ub kyis bdag la bsdu ba mi dmigs gsal stong ka dag ngang la bsgom: rang nyid che mchog padma khrag 'thung du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas las kyi ging bzhi sprul pa'i khyung lnga sgrol ba'i ma mo bzhi khro bo rang 'dra dang bcas nas skar mda' 'khrugs pa ltar: me dpung gi rang bzhin 'bar zhing stong khams khengs bar 'phros pas: nad nad bdag dang bcas pa hub hub ljib ljib tu zos nas lhag ma med pa rdul du brlags par bsam: yang lcags sdig nag po bye ba dung phyur 'phros shing rgyal nad srog rlung du gyur pa rnams brlags par bsam: ging bzhi'i sngags ni: oṃ badzra tsakra kro ta tsaṇḍa grī wa tsa tur kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bhyoḥ khyung lnga'i sngags ni: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa pañtsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ khro mo sha za bzhi la: oṃ ma mo mu kha le kro ti tsa tur baṃ ru lu ru lu bhyoḥ phag sdig khyung lnga la: oṃ wa ra hi pa paṃ khrom̐ ṭa ya bhyoḥ dang po las sngags nad 'joms ni: oṃ ma hā gu ru khrom̐ ka ra ging ka ra tsa mun tri ta ya: ka la dunti tsitta la bhyo bhyoḥ oṃ she la du ging rā dza shig shig: nā ga du na dunti tri zlog zlog: oṃ a ka tsa tu mā ra ya rbad rbad: raksha du tri snying la bhyo bhyoḥ tsha ba tsha nad mā ra ya nan nan: oṃ du na du na shig shig: hag tshal pa kha la dunti bhyo bhyoḥ

ha ching rba du tri kha la bhyo bhyoḥ spel tshig sbyar: tsitta zung zung yaṃ yaṃ rmug rmug: chum chum baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad rbad: las sngags nad bdag 'joms byed ni: oṃ du ching nag po nad bdag gi srog la rbad rbad: pra ching nag po bdun drug gi sha la zo zo: khro chu khol ma rgya nad kyi snying la bhyo bhyoḥ bya khyung nag po rgyu gzer gyi snying la rbad rbad: lcags sdig nag po rgyal bsren gyi srog la chum chum: phag nag khro gtum rims yams kyi dbugs la sdud sdud: trig khrom̐ nag po sha khol gyi snying la bhyo bhyoḥ bhe tri nag po khrag skyug gi nad la thum thum: artsig nag po dmar bshal gyi srog la rngub rngub: ka ru nag po rgya 'brum gyi nad la shig shig: khe tra nag po rgyug gzer gyi srog la hur hur: yaksha nag po 'go nad kyi srog la rbad rbad: trig khrom̐ ra tsa khrag skyug gi nad la rbad rbad: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa pañtsa 'byung lnga'i nad la shig shig: nad bdag rims bdag pho mo myog myog dril dril: thun thun rbad rbad swā hā: zhes drag sngags rnams yengs med chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bzlas shing dmigs pa bskyed rim ltar la: de nas rim bzhin dmigs pa spro bsdu bya ste rdzas la sngags chu sbyar zhing rang ngam gzhan bsrung na sbyin: yang na nad pa sogs la sbyin na rdzas rnams mang bar bya: yul bsrung na: ras sam shing shun la bris te rgyal mtshan du gzugs pas rlung gi zer phog pa rnams la bsrung bar 'gyur ro: rang nyid nad pa'i sa ru 'gro na: snga zhogs dud pa sna la ma song dus: sngags rnams mang du bzlas shing sna bug tu spur bas srung ba'i mchog: yang na rdzas la sngags shing bu ga dgu dgag par bya: nad lam gcod pa ni shing tsher ma can la sngags te phyogs bzhir 'dzugs: mnan pa ni: liṅga bris shing 'gugs gzhug bya la: shing tsher ma can la sngags pas lan dgu brab ste: lam rgya gram du mnan:

sreg pa ni: thugs dam bskul zhing sngags te tsher ma can gyi me ru bsreg: 'phang ba ni: thugs dam bskul te rdo thun gyi zor steng 'og phyogs bzhir 'phang : skyabs pa ni: sngags chu steng 'og khang khyim du steng 'og tu gtor: spo ba ni: dar lcog bris pas tshang : srung ba ni: lcags sdig pho mo gnyis kyi khog par sngags 'di 'bri zhing las sngags kyis rab tu gnas te la chas dril la 'chang : sdig pa pho yi khog par 'di bris: papaṃbadunadruganadalasrungasashig: sdig pa mo yi khog par: nghararimasayamasalasrungasashig: khang par 'dzugs na bya khyung pho'i khog par: garuḍapakhyingadza'agonadalasrungasashig: bya khyung mo yi khog par: khroṃthaḍagingahara'agoba'inadalasrungasashig: yul bsrung na phag nag po pho yi lto bar: ghakhyingarādzaganyan rgodalasrungasashig: phag nag po mo yi lto bar: trishigaharalhogayamasalasrungasashig: ces bris te: thams cad la rdzas kyis byugs nas dril la thum dmar nag bya'o: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug mchog : yang zab drag po khyung zhon 'di: sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma: ma 'ongs yang mtha' kha ral la: 'go nad sna dgu dar ba'i tshe: bsam gtan nyal chog bsgrub pa 'di: 'gogazand nathayandad: thugs sras buddha dzñā na yi: byin brlabs sprul pa shes rab can: padma gter bdag gling pa la: sprod cig dge bsnyen sde bzhi rgya: gter srung sman mo mched bzhi khyod: dam chos 'di yi mel tshe gyis: dam nyams bdud rigs log lta can: snying med dred po skal chad mkhan: lag tu ma shor sa ma ya: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra smyo spyod can gter bdag gling pas 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang chen po nas gdan drangs shing*/ sbas yul padma rong du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ gter gzhung gzhir bzhag gi chog khrigs 'di bzhin gnam sprul lnga pa bzod pa rab brtan gyi zhal 'don du bzhugs pas rje nyid kyis mdzad pa min nam snyam/

kho bos kyang chung ngu'i dus nad khrod dang ro sngas su yang yang bskyod dgos par 'go nad 'byung gis dogs nas yab rje gnam lcags bkra shis las zhal shes blangs te bsnyen tshad 'brel 'jog dang*/ rgyun khyer nyams len bya srol bzhin gu hyas slar bsdebs pa lags// // bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi /nad 'joms par bu'i nad rims srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris bzhugs so/ sdig pa pho 'khor/ sdig pa mo 'khor/ khyung po 'khor/ khyung mo 'khor/ phag nag pho 'khor/ phag nag mo 'khor/ rang nyid bsrung na sdig pa pho mo'i 'khor lo la rdzas byugs shing kha sbyar nas/ rdzas ni nad 'joms par bu'i gzhung du bshad pa'i rims srung gi rdzas yin/ bgegs bskrad khrus dang*/ sgrub pa byas la rab tu gnas te thum dmar nag bya/ la chas bsgril te lus la 'chang bar bya'o/ /de bzhin khang par bsrung na bya khyung pho mo'i 'khor lo rdzas dang sgrub pa sogs sngar dang 'dra la lteb chings sogs 'khor lo spyi 'gros ltar sgo'i ya them la 'dogs pa dang*/ yul bsrung na phag nag po'i 'khor lo sogs bya lugs gong dang mtshungs so/ /'khor lo'i dpe'u ris gzhung gi dgongs pa dang bstun ri mo zur gsal du bkod pa 'di'ang sgo sprul pas so// bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ khyung sgrub nā ga 'joms byed chog khrigs su bkod pa 'og gdon mthar byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ sangs rgyas thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭaḥ gti mug las gyur klu srin gdug pa 'dul/ /ye shes me yis dug gsum nad rims bsreg /gtum chen 'bar ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang khyung sgrub nyams su len pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ gzhung las/ dben par phyi nang mtshams bcad la: mthing nag gru gsum e dal steng : pho mo'i bhandha kha sbyor nang : sman chen bswe zho a ru nag: gla rtsi gu gul shu dag nag: rtsod mdud mu zi dngul chu sbrang :

gri sha mi khyi phag brun rnams: zhib 'thag nus ldan dri chus sbrus: ril bu sran ma tsam dril blugs: dar mthing gis dril gtor mchod bsham: zhes gsungs pa bzhin gnas dben par phyags dar legs par byas la mdun stegs khar/ rten mchod bkram pa'i mdun sgrub rten sman raka gtor gsum dang*/ khyad par bhandha'i nang rdzas rgod gong ltar ram ma 'dzoms na spyi 'gros bya khyung lnga dang nag po dgu sbyor sogs sgrub rdzas legs par bsham/ mdun du nyer spyod sogs mchod pa ci 'byor dang*/ bdag nyid la nyer mkho las bum ḍā dril 'thor nas nang mchod bcas 'du bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ sngon dngos rjes gsum mo/ dang po gzhung las/ bgegs bskrad srung mtshams byin rlabs sogs: gzhung ltar bya zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar sngon 'gro'i rim pa la'ang drug las/ dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: gsum pa bgegs dgug pa ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa yi: 'gugs pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed: sgrub la mi dbang log 'dren bgegs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir mchis: oṃ badzra ṭakki rā dza ya: gnod byed 'byung po dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung rol: 'byung po bka' las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma khyer la rang gnas dengs: 'tshe na drag sngags me char 'bebs: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad bhyoḥ thums shig gtor myog rbad raṃ dzwa la ya phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las srung ba'i gur:

rdo rje lcags sdig bya khyung 'phros: gri gug kha ṭwāṃ me ri'i gur: sra mkhregs pha lam rang bzhin gyur: oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa: tri pā paṃ tsakra rakṣa: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsakra rakṣa: ka ra ti ka tsakra rakṣa: tri shū la tsakra rakṣa: ram̐ dzwa la tsakra rakṣa: e swa bhā tsakra rakṣa: zhes srung 'khor drag po bsgom/ drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha ling ta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ sarba a haṃ dzñā na pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas dngos gzhi la gsum/ thog mar bskyed pa la bdun las/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing brdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rol rtsal rdzogs: oṃ kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐:

gnyis pa lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: badzra khroṃ dzaḥ stong gsal snying po khroṃ yig mthing nag las: 'od 'phros snang srid gru gsum e yi klong : dug mtsho khro chu khol ma'i klong rum nas: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan: dug gi ri rab bang rim dgu yi steng : khroṃ las bya khyung rgyal po ga ru ṭaḥ mthing nag khro chu lus po me gshog can: gnam lcags mchu sder dug mig rdo rje'i mchu: mchong gi mche gtsigs dug lce dmar 'od 'khyugs: krang kring sgra sgrogs srid pa'i klu rigs sngangs: me yi ral pa ra bar nor bu'i steng : padma khrag 'thung rdo rje lcags sdig 'dzin: khro rgyal stobs ldan gshog rlabs srid pa sdud: gzir ba'i phyag rgyas gdol pa nag po za: dpung mgo g.yas su khyung dkar rgyal rigs gzir: g.yon du khyung ser rje rigs klu sbrul gtun: brla g.yas khyung dmar bram ze klu rnams rol: brla g.yon khyung ljang dmangs rigs klu rnams 'dren: spu gri'i sgro gshog bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: ba spu'i gseb nas mtshon cha'i char pa 'bebs: snang srid sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul bar bskyed: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: gsang chen me ri 'bar ba'i gnas mchog nas: ye shes khyung chen lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: khroṃ badzra ga ru ṭa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: srid pa'i ri rab rtse mo nas: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i mthu stobs bdag: gdug pa 'dul mdzad ga ru ṭaḥ thugs rje rol pa'i bya khyung tshogs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: gdug pa 'dul ba'i dngos grub stsol: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum e yi dbus: dam ye gnyis med brtan par bzhugs: 'byung po kun 'dul drag rtsal can: ye shes drag po khyod la 'dud: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ

lnga pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang spyan gzigs dang : nang mchod sman gtor rakta dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ khroṃ badzra ga ru ṭa sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta khā hi: oṃ ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta king ni ri ti kha kha khā hi: drug pa khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: gdug pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan gdon: gnod byed 'byung po bsgral ba yi: sbal sbrul nya sdig ri ltar spungs: khrag gi rgya mtsho me re re: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can: khro chen khyung gi tshogs la 'bul: mchod bzhes thugs dam bskang gyur cig: khroṃ badzra ga ru ṭa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi/ bdun pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min lcang lo can gyi gnas: ri rab 'bar ba'i yang steng nas: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i phrin las bdag: sprul pa'i khyung chen sku la bstod: khro chu'i lus la me gshog sdeb: gnam lcags ra la rdo rje'i mchu: zangs sder 'jums shing dug mig bgrad: khro rgyal khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: ljags ni glog dmar stong du 'khyug: rno gdug mche ba bgegs la gtsigs: lus dkrugs gnam lcags ser rgod 'bebs: klu dang sa bdag bzung zhing za: klu 'dul gser mig 'khyil la bstod: dbu skra dmar nag me zer 'bar: nyi zla nor bus 'od mdangs 'tsher: bde gshegs stobs 'dus me phreng rtsal: snang srid 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: spu gseb bya khyung dmag tshogs 'gyed: ye shes me dpung klong dkyil nas: krang kring sgra sgrogs klu srin 'dren: khrag 'thung rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: gza' dang rgyu skar gnyan gyi gdon: klu dang sa bdag rgyal bsen bgegs: ma lus 'joms pa'i lha chen por: dam tshig gnyan po'i thugs dam bskul:

da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar: bdud srin 'byung po kha dar bas: bdun drug nad dal yams rims phyur: khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i: nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad sol: mi shigs rdo rje'i sku 'grub nas: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol: ces bstod/ gnyis pa bzlas pa la/ dzap bzlas rim pa ni/ thugs kar nyi steng khroṃ yig mthar: sngags phreng 'brug ltar sgra sgrogs 'khor: bde gshegs rab 'byams mthu stobs 'dus: sngags phreng las mched me zer gyis: rtsa khams gang ba'i nad gdon de: ba spu bu ga nas thon te: lus kun khro tshwa khol ma'i mdangs: snang srid sreg pa'i me dpung 'bar: rdzu 'phrul gshog rlabs srid pa sdud: klu gnyan sa bdag ma lus pa: sngangs 'dar snying rtsa yed yed dang : khyad par gnod byed klu gnyan rnams: bdag dang sprul pa'i khyung tshogs kyis: dbyings nas gzir 'debs thal phung du: rngam rngam hrum hrum tsher tsher za: lhag ma med par rdul du brlag: shul kyang khro chu'i zhun du mkhregs: tshur 'dus bdag dang rdzas la bstims: ril bu rnams kyang khyung du gyur: rngam pa'i 'brug stong di ri ri: dbang drag 'bar ba'i stobs rdzogs gyur: gnyis pa bsnyen sgrub chig sgril sngags ni/ oṃ khroṃ badzra ga ru ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ dmigs gnad dang ldan pas ci nus su bzla/ grangs tshad kyang gzhung las/ zhes pa sgra zur ma nyams par: grangs kyi bsnyen pa khri tsho gsum: dus bsnyen zhag bdun ngag dam bcad: ces gsungs so/ gsum pa las sbyor ni/ rtsa sngags la sham bu 'di sbyar te/ ta na ma sha pa: nā ga sde brgyad srog la gtub ling thum sod ya: zhes phrin las bye brag dang sbyar la grangs ni sgrub sngags kyi bcu las mi nyung bar bya'o/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying sogs kyis bzlas pa'i lhag chad bkang*/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ oṃ khroṃ badzra ga ru ṭa sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi:

bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min lcang lo can gyi gnas: ri rab 'bar ba'i yang steng nas: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i phrin las bdag: sprul pa'i khyung chen sku la bstod: bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam las 'gal ba dang: ma 'byor nyams dang chad lhag 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags la mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma y sogs yig brgya bzla'o/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ gsum pa rdzogs rim bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis lhar snang dbyings su bsdus pas rtag mtha' bral/ a a āḥ sa mnyam par bzhag phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyis lhar ldang gsang ba gsum gyis chad mtha' spang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rakṣa maṃ/ zhes go bgo zhing*/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ dmigs med rgya yan chos nyid rgyu yi bsngo: rang shar rang rtsal ma 'gags lam gyi bsngo: sna tshogs spros bral ka dag 'bras bu'i bsngo: kun gzhi skye med 'khor 'das gcig tu bsngo: smon lam ni/ hoḥ bdag blo ye nas dbyings rig sgrib pa bral: gnyis 'dzin ma rig 'khrul pa'i rmongs gzugs rnams: dran rtog chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: tshe rabs pad 'byung yab yum 'bral med shog: bkra shis spyi ltar bya'o/ de nas dus grangs rtags them zhing dbang bzhi len pa'i skabs gong gi mchod bstod thugs dam bskul/ bgegs bskrad byin dbab pa sngon du song nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs bdag: khro chen mthing nag bya khyung rgyal: dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: gzi byin drag pos mthu stobs bskyed: sku gsung thugs kyis dbang bskur stsol: lus kyi nad gdon zhi ba dang : rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs: ngag gi zhen 'dzin dag pa dang : drag sngags nus rtsal bskyed du gsol: sems kyi by-ing rmugs nad dag nas: gsal stong ye shes dngos grub stsol:

rtsa sngags sham bur kā ya wākka tsitta badzra dhā tu sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes pas dbang blang gtor ma btang : ril bu bya khyung khrom tshogs la: bde gshegs stong gis rab tu gnas: dal bsdu bsngo smon la sogs bya: zhes pa bzhin rjes chog spyi ltar bya'o/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas 'bras rtags ji ltar 'byung tshul yang*/ gzhung las/ sbal lcong sdig sbrul bsad dang za: srog chag brdung dang gtub cing gcod: ri brag bshig dang phru ma bdal: lus la me 'bar nags tshal bsregs: go gyon mtshon thogs rdo rbab 'dril: mtsho skam lus la rnag khrag bshal: srog chags don sogs rtags rnams 'byung : mdze sogs klu nad tshab che na: tho rangs ril bu bdun bdun btang : drag sngags stong tsho re mi bcag: skabs su dri chur gla rtsi sbyar: sngags bzlas yang yang bskul rdeg btung : rgyun du khrus byas grib la 'dzem: phag mkhris thang khrom la sngags la: rdo bsregs dud pa snyug sbubs rngub: de yis stod mdze sel bar 'gyur: mkhal rtsa bol gong me btsa' gdab: rkang khrag phyung bas smad mdze sel: chags pa mi spyod mngar skyur spangs: zla ba gcig nas mdze rgod kyi: tho lum song yang sos par 'gyur: zhes dang*/ dam tshig bya sgong sha mi za: gzhan dag po yang de dang mtshungs: mdze rigs rkyen sogs byung dogs la: lto sman khog srung ril bu re: rtag tu tho rangs dri chus phul: gzhan yang gag lhog gnyen thor dang : shu ba la sogs reg pas 'joms: grib dang chams rims kun la bsngags: 'di ltar rdzas sngags sus 'dzin pa: lha srin sde brgyad gnod pa zhi: klu gnyan sa bdag gdon las grol: 'go nad yams rims nad kyang 'joms: mnan gtad ser ba 'bebs srung dang : sa gnyan 'phru slog gnyan kha gsol: yul gsar 'dzin dang gnas gter 'byed: brag bshig shing gcod nad ngan btul: brtul zhugs drag las gang byed kyang : rang lus gnam lcags mkhar dang 'dra: mdze gdon 'byung dogs srung ba la:

'di las zab pa 'jig rten dkon: zhes gsungs pa bzhin phan yon mchog tu bsngags pa yin no/ tshogs sogs spros pa la mos na rigs mthun gzhan las blang bar bya'o/ zhes pa'ang rang slob au ḍīs bskul ngor dus mtha'i sngags rig 'dzin pa gu hyas rab byung bcu bdun pa shing sprel zla ba dang po'i yar tshes la phur pa gling sgrub khang bdud las rnam rgyal du sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/ // ༈ rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs bde chen dpal bskyed bzhugs so/ na mo/ spros bral chos sku'i klong yangs nas/ /chos sku kun tu bzang mo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /chos sku'i gnas lugs rtogs par shog /lhun grub longs sku'i gzhal yas nas/ /longs sku mkha' 'gro sde lnga la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /lhun grub snang bzhi mthar phyin shog /thugs rje kun khyab pho brang nas/ /sprul sku ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rlung sems rang dbang thob par shog /bde stong e yi pho brang nas/ /yang sprul rlung zhags ḍākki la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar bar shog /'khor lo lnga yi pho brang nas/ /rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dga' bzhi ye shes smin par shog /gnas yul nyer bzhi'i pho brang nas/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /gang 'dul 'gro don mthar phyin shog /rlung sems las su rung ba'i mthus/ /dhū ti'i rtsa mdud rab grol nas/ /sa bcu lam lnga mtha' ru phyin/ /'khor lo tshogs chen sa thob shog / ces pa'ang gnam lcags smyon pas bris// // rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i las byang bde chen dpa' mo'i rol rtsed ces bya ba bzhugs so// // dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha' klong nas: thugs rje thabs kyi ḍākki'i skur: rnam rol khyab bdag rlung zhags kyis:

khams gsum nyon mongs 'ching la 'dud: khrag 'thung padma drag po'i yum bka' rtsa rlung dpal bskyed ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa ni/ las rim khrigs chags su bsdebs pa'i sdom la/ gter gzhung las/ skyabs saims mtshams gcod byin brlab sngon 'gro dang: lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag mchod dang: bstod pa 'dzab bzlas gtor 'bul dngos gzhi'o: tshogs mchod lhag bskul chad brtan rta bro dbang : bzod gsol nyer bsdu bsngo smon bkra shis rjes: zhes dang sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: mchog gsum rtsa brgyud bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: byin rlabs ngo bo pad 'byung thugs rje'i bdag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal ḍākki sku dngos mchog: brtse chen ye nas 'bral med skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ na mo: dbyings rig ngo bo ma bcos lhun grub las: gcig tu 'gags med shar ba snying rje'i yul: 'khor 'das cir snang ma gyur sangs rgyas zhing: gdod nas 'khor gsum yongs dag sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ dkar gtor sngon du 'gro bas/ bgegs gtor bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ swā hā/ gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma gcig yum chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas/ bar med khyab pa'i 'gugs byed pho nya 'phros: gnod byed bgegs tshogs gtor ma len phyir khug: bdag gi bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: mchod sbyin 'di khyer rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru glags blta na: bdag nyid dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i mtshon cha thun du brdeg: me ltar 'bar bas bgegs dpung bsregs gtor gzhom:

de bas bgegs tshogs 'byung po phyir dengs shig: oṃ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa mtshams gcod srung 'khaur ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gros thugs ka nas/ mtshon cha me ri drag po thog ltar 'phros: gnod byed tshar bcad mtshams gcod las grub nas: tshur 'dus mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang gyur: oṃ badzra dzwa la rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: lnga pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ hūm̐: phyi snod gling bzhi nyi zla nor bu'i snod: nang bcud dbang po rnam lnga sman raka dang: gtor mchod bha ling ga ṇa tshogs kyi rdzas: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs la sogs pa: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐: oṃ ru tra ma ra ṇi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta āḥhūm̐:

zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs shing bdud rtsis bran no/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dang po bskyed rim ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las rlung lnga bsnaul ba'i dal: pho brang rgyan rdzogs gru bzhi sgo bzhi mdzes: mtshan nyid kun tshang 'ja' zer klong dgu ldan: sna tshogs tog mdzes de yi dbus nyid du: nyi zla padma g.yung drung ljang gsal steng: ye shes mkha' 'gro ljang 'od mdangs dang ldan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gar stabs 'gying tshul ldan: zhal 'dzum mdzes shing ratnas dbu la brgyan: thor tshugs dar dpyangs zar bus sku rgyab khebs: rus pa'i rgyan 'phyang nu ma bha ga rgyas: phyag g.yas rlung zhags g.yon pas tshe bum 'dzin: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rin chen se mo do: gcer mo 'gying stabs bde stong lhag ge ba: phyogs bzhir rang 'dra las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: sku mdog ljang gsal g.yas pas rlung zhags 'dzin: g.yon pas nor bu padmas mtshan pa bsnams: gar stabs bsgyur zhing dbang sdud mgyogs mar gsal: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'od zer gyis: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bsgrub phyir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ phyogs bcu mi mngon rang byung e yi mkha': chos 'byung ljang nag rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang sdud rlung gi bdag mo 'khor dang bcas: khams gsum dbang du bsdud phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ baṃ ḍākki yaṃ hūm̐ dza hoḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: thabs shes rang bzhin nyi zla g.yung drung steng: dbang sdud zhags pa 'gyed pa'i pho brang dbus: phyi yi tshogs drug nang gi snang 'gugs phyir: rlung gi gdan la dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jo sgeg dpa' mo g.yo ba'i shugs 'chang ma: mdangs ldan sring mo dga' ba'i bde spel ma: srid gsum dbang sdud las kyi ḍākki ma: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:

oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: mu tig mdangs ldan zla rgyas byams pa'i bcud: rgya skag ngad ldan dmar gsal rgyun 'byung rdzas: bde chen ngang tshul dpa' mo dgyes pa'i phud: 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag dbang mo che la 'bul: oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs ?shabda a haṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: hūm̐: bde ba yab la stong pa yum: zung 'jug sbyor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim sogs: ro mngar reg bya 'jam pa yi: phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dug lnga ma spangs ye shes ngang: nyon mongs rang grol chags med rdzas: sku lnga lhun grub nang mchod 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : gsang ba ḍākki rig ma'i tshogs: gar sgyur bde ba'i mkha' lam du: rlung gis bskyod pa'i rdo rjes bsrubs: mnyes phyir yid kyi chu gter 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: lcang lo can gyi bhandha ru: sha lnga pañtsa rdzas kyis gtams: zag med bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: dung zhal bde ba chen po'i nang: mdangs ldan dmar chen 'od du 'bar: sna tshogs rakta'i mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : ru tra bsgral ba'i thod pa ru: dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dbang po spungs: bsgral ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : ye nas rmad byung ngo bo'i rdzas: rang byung ma 'gags ye shes kyi: dmigs med mchog gi mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : phyi nang mnyes pa'i rten rdzas mchog: me long mda' dar bla 'khor sogs: spyan gzigs du ma'i mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : oṃ ma hā sarba pū dza me gha mu tra spha ra na sa ma ye swā hā: drug pa bstod pa ni/

hūm̐: ye shes dbyings kyi ḍākki dpa' mo che: rlung sems mdangs ldan 'ja' 'od ta la la: dgyes chags khro la 'dzum bag shigs se shig: rin chen rgyan ldan 'dod rgu'i gter 'dzin ma: cod pan mdzes pa'i thor tshugs ldems se ldem: phyag g.yas rlung zhags snang srid dbang du sdud: g.yon pas tshe bum rtsa rlung thig le bskyed: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rin chen khro lo lo: rus pa'i rgyan ldan g.yer kha si li li: nu 'bur rgyas shing lte ba rab tu zlum: bha ga rab rgyas bde drod chi li li: gar stabs sgeg mo'i 'khril ldem khyugs se khyug: g.yung drung pad zla'i gdan la 'gying mdzad ma: dbang sdud rlung gi bdag mor phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phyi rim las byed mgyogs ma'i shugs 'chang ma: dus bzhir 'gyu ba'i yid 'ong gar mo bzhi: rin chen rgyan ldan 'dod rgu char bzhin 'bebs: ljang gsal mdangs ldan tshogs drug snang ba 'phrog: g.yas pas rlung zhags lha mi dbang du sdud: g.yon pas thabs shais pho mo'i blo sems 'gugs: rus pa'i rgyan ldan dar dpyangs pu ru ru: gcer mo gar sgyur nu ma bha ga rgyas: 'jo sgeg mdzes ldan lha mo bzhi la bstod: khyod la bstod cing phrin las bcol ba ni: phyi nang snod bcud mi nor dbang du sdud: nang gi rtsa rlung bde drod thig le bskyed: gsang ba dga' bzhi ye shes mngon gyur nas: dbang sdud 'ja' lus mkha' 'gro 'grub gyur cig: bdun pa 'dzab bskul ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba dbyings kyi dbang phyug ḍākki'i tshogs: ye shes thugs dam 'dzab kyis rgyud bskul la: zung 'jug bde chen 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i phyir: ma sring khyed rnams srog ltar bzung lags na: zab lam dpa' mos rtag tu grogs gyis shig: phung khams 'od lus chos sku 'grub pa yi: ma khyod bdag gi dpung gnyen mchis pa'i phyir: bzlas pa sngags kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i skur gsal ba'i/

gtsug tor nam mkha'i 'khor lo ru/ /rigs bdag padma thod phreng rtsal/ /'khor lo lnga ru rim pa bzhin/ /rdo rje padma sangs rgyas dang*/ /rin chen las kyi ḍākki lnga/ /sku mdog dkar dmar mthing ser ljang*/ /rang 'dra'i rigs kyi yab dang sbyor/ /thugs srog ha ni baṃ ri sa'i/ /mtha' mar rang mdog sngags kyis bskor/ /rtsa khams ba spu'i grong khyer du/ /'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍākki'i tshogs/ /til gyi gang bu lta bur gsal/ /spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum la/ /gdung shugs drag po'i gsol btab mod/ /thugs srog oṃ dang sngags phreng las/ /bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /sbyor mtshams nas byung gnas lnga yi/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i spyi bo nas/ /rim zhugs rang srog sngags phreng la/ /phog pas g.yon bskor drag tu 'khor/ /spro bas 'od kyis srid zhi khyab/ /bsdus pas gzi byin lhag par 'bar/ /gtso 'khor ma lus thams cad kun/ /bde chen ye shes nyams 'ur bas/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'u ru ru/ /dga' bzhi'i bro rdung khrigs se khrig /rtsa khams ba spu tshun chad kun/ /bde dang stong par phri li li/ /dug lnga dbyings su sangs se sang*/ /dbang bzhi rgyun 'bab na ra ra/ /'ja' dang 'od du kyi li li/ /zer dang zer phreng ya la la/ /snang ba sku ru lams se lam/ /sgra grags sngags su di ri ri/ /dran rtog chos skur sangs se sang*/ /ma rig nyon mongs ka nas dag /snod bcud mkha' 'gro'i da lar rdzogs/ man ngag gsum ldan gyi dgongs pa las/ oṃ ḍākki ha ri ni sa pa shaṃ te dzwa hrī dha ya su khaṃ sarba siddhi dza dza: zhes sngags dang dmigs gnad sbyar te/ /thog mar yid bzlas dang*/ /de nas skyo tshe rags pa rlung bzlas dang phra ba rdor bzlas sngags kyi skyon drug spangs nas/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad 'khyol bar byas la/ /mtshan ma byung dus dngos grub len zhing gtang rag rgya chen bya'o/ sham bur/ oṃ sarba shwa rī pun+ye lo ka pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun dza dzaḥ

zhes bzlas/ gzhan yang las sbyor spyi dang bye brag gi sngags rnams gang 'dod spros shes par bya'o/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mthar mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: mu tig mdangs ldan zla rgyas byams pa'i bcud: rgya skag ngad ldan dmar gsal rgyun 'byung rdzas: bde chen ngang tshul dpa' mo dgyes pa'i phud: 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag dbang mo che la 'bul: oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ sogs? shabda āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa la khā hi: ma hā bha liṃ ta la khā hi: ma hā rakta la khā hi: ma hā sarba pū dza la khā hi: hūm̐: 'jo sgeg dpa' mo g.yo ba'i shugs 'chang ma: mdangs ldan sring mo dga' ba'i bde spel ma: srid gsum dbang sdud las kyi ḍākki ma: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: 'byor ba drug ldan rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: mos pa rnam bzhi dbang gi dngos grub stsol: dgra bgegs tshar gcod drag po'-i dngos grub stsol: las bzhi lhun gyis 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: ye shes mkha' 'gro lha tshogs khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje: mdzad pa'i phrin las: skyob pa'i nus mthu: ster ba'i dngos grub: bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas: deng 'dir bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams la mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol: oṃ ḍākki ha ri ni sa pa shaṃ te dzwa hrī dha ya su khaṃ sarba siddhi dza dza: kā ya siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wākka siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsitta siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ brgyad pa thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ snod bcud yongs khyab sha lnga bdud rtsi'i tshogs: me rlung sbyor bas sbyangs spel stobs bskyed pa: 'bru gsum nus ldan zag maid bdud rtsir bskyil: kun bzang mchod sprin dpag med 'char bar gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/

hūm̐: ma skyes rdzogs pa chos dbyings las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i sku: ma gcig dbyings phyug mkha' 'gror bzhengs: rdo rje rin chen padma las: kun kyang ljang 'od rlung shugs can: rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo: sna tshogs cod pan pu ru ru: rgyan drug dril g.yer si li li: rol mo glu dbyangs di ri ri: snang srid 'gul ldeg khyams se khyam: 'od dang zer du spungs se spung: dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs lhags se lhag: bde ba'i chu rgyun na ra ra: 'du 'bral med par dungs se dung: ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs: dam rdzas rmad byung a mṛ ta: 'dod yon longs spyod gter chen po: 'khor ba'i rgyu bsgral rakta dang: tshogs kyi 'dod yon dpag med pa: ro bcud mdangs ldan zad mi shes: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: 'byung ba bzhi yi bcud dang zhag: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: snang srid sha khrag drod dbugs mdangs: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du sdus: dbyer med nyams rtogs rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: log rtog bdud rigs snang ba sgyur: snang srid chos la 'god par mdzod: nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad sol: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes mchod 'dod don gsol la/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la bcu gcig /dang po tshogs rdzas bdud rtsis bsang zhing*/ hūm̐: bdag nyid mkha' 'gror gsal ba'i thugs ka nas: dngos 'dzin sbyang phyir ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros: tshogs kyi nyes skyon bsregs gtor sbyangs shing bkrus: byin gyis brlab phyir oṃ'aḥ.āḥhūm̐ gsum 'phros: rdzas la phog pas bskyed cing spel ba yis: zag med bdud rtsi ro mchog dpag med gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/

hūm̐: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas: ma gcig ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: yang 'khor ḍākki bye ba 'bum: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: glu len gar sgyur shigs se shig: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: byin rlabs sprin ltar thibs se thib: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: mchod pa'i lha mo gar sgyur tshogs: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: chos skyong gter bdag dam can la: 'bul lo mchog gis dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa ma ya ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: bzhi pa skong bshags ni/ hūm̐: snang srid khyon ltar rab tu bkang ba yi: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bla med rdzas: spyan gzigs la sogs kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: dbyings phyug bde chen dpa' mo'i thugs dam bskang: dbang sdud mgyogs ma sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang: bka' srung gter bdag pho nya'i thugs dam bskang: snang srid mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : thugs dam gnyen skong nyams chag nyes ltung rnams: 'dod yon tshogs kyis bshags so dag gyur cig: yi ge brgya pa bzla'o: lnga pa bsgral bstab ni/ na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba ting 'dzin phyag rgya sngags: gsang ba ḍākki ma sring bye ba 'bum: bka' gter skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor bcas kyi: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rnal 'byor sgos dgra dang: rkyen ngan bar gcod glo bur bgegs kyi tshogs: dgra gzugs tha ma'i liṅga 'di la khug: oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: sras mchog gyad kyi phur bu kī la ya: gdengs shing 'dril ba'i gzir 'debs dus la bab:

ru tra gdug pa'i snying la mā ra ya: phye mar brlag cing bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya rbad rbad bhyo bhyoḥ hūm̐: gsang ba dbyings phyug dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: ma rungs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: dgyes par bzhes la bdud bzhi'i tshogs bcom nas: sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: drug pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gnas nyul dus bdag phra men ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: 'bar ba pho nya'i tshogs rnams la: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'bul: bstan srung mel tshe 'grub par mdzod: oṃ u tstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ ham̐'u: mi mngon ka dag lhun grub 'og min zhing: gsang ba e yi dbyings nyid klong dkyil nas: rigs kyi bdag po gu ru thod phreng rtsal: dbyings phyug dpa' mo khams gsum dbang sgyur yum: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi shugs 'gro phra men tshogs: thugs dam bskul lo 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhengs: da lta snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus mthar 'dir: ma rungs bdud rigs 'byung po sna tshogs kyis: gsang sngags bstan la gdug rtsub sdang zhing gshe: sgrub par 'tshe rgod g.yo ba'i log 'dren tshogs: myur mgyogs thugs rje'i stobs kyis dbang du sdus: tshad med bzhi yi nus stobs dpung bskyed la: ma dag gzugs kyi phung po gum gum chums: ngag gi sdang dgra smod tshig lkugs su chugs: sems kyi zhe sdang gdod ma'i dbyings su choms: sdig sgrib bag chags 'od du ya la la: rang rig gzhi grol ka dag sangs se sang: snang srid mkha' 'gro'i zhing du me re re: ma rig nyon mongs gzung 'dzin dbyings su sgrol: 'khor 'das mnyam par sbyor ba'i phrin las mdzod:

brgyad pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar bskal tha ma'i dus: snying thig sbas dang bton pa'i tshe: bka' srung gter bdag rgya mtsho yis: khas blangs bzhin du gtor ma bzhes: yang zab bya ra 'grub par mdzod: sarba dharma pā la i daṃ bha liṃ ta khā hi: dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod skyong ma sring bcu gnyis kyis: mthun rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: yul srungs lo legs bkra shis spel: dus 'khrugs nad yams zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le te te ma ma khā hi: bcu pa rta bro brdung ba n-i/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bro ra ru: ma sring 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: phyi nang bar gcod thal bar rlog: las bzhi lhun grub chen por gyur: oṃ nanaḥ a nan: hūm̐ nan: dgra bgegs dam sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu gcig dngos grub blang ba ni/ hrīḥm: mchog gi dbang bskur spyi bor stsol: padma thod phreng gtsug tu thim: sku yi dbang bskur lus la stsol: rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpral bar thim: gsung gi dbang bskur ngag la stsol: padma mkha' 'gro mgrin par thim: thugs kyi dbang bskur yid la stsol: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro snying khar thim: yon tan dbang bskur sgo gsum stsol: rin chen mkha' 'gro lte bar thim: phrin las dbang bskur brtan par stsol: las kyi mkha' 'gro gsang bar thim: hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: gsang ba ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol: snyan grags mnga' thang dngos grub stsol: 'jam phrug gos kyi dngos grub stsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun: deng 'dir bdag gis thob gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kā ya wākka tsitta gu na karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rjes chog la drug las/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: mu tig mdangs ldan zla rgyas byams pa'i bcud: rgya skag ngad ldan dmar gsal rgyun 'byung rdzas:

bde chen ngang tshul dpa' mo dgyes pa'i phud: 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag dbang mo che la 'bul: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda a haṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: hūm̐: 'jo sgeg dpa' mo g.yo ba'i shugs 'chang ma: mdangs ldan sring mo dga' ba'i bde spel ma: srid gsum dbang sdud las kyi ḍākki ma: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam las 'gal ba dang: ma 'byor nyams dang chad lhag 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags la mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: ces yig brgya bzlas: brtan bzhugs bya/ gsum pa rdzogs rim bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: klong yangs nam mkha'i cho 'phrul sgyu ma bzhin: bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor mi dmigs chu zla ltar: ka dag dbyings rig klong du badzra muḥ 'gags med rol rtsal sku gsung thugs su rdzogs: a a āḥ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ ma sring mkha' 'gro gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: bskyed rdzogs phyi nang dge bcu'i nyams len mchog: brtson 'grus zab mos myur blangs bgyis pa'i tshogs: ma gyur srid pa'i mtsho sgrol ched du bsngo: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ ting 'dzin 'dus pa gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: ma sring ḍākki srog ltar sgrub pa yis: dam tshig g.yel ba med pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rgyud thams cad du: zab lam rjes bzung mchog gi dga' ston gyi: 'bras bu smin nas rnga yab dpal ri ru: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: drug pa bkra shis ni/ oṃ: chos sku'i bkra shis yum chen pha rol phyin: gnas lugs rang rtsal mngon rdzogs bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis ḍākki dbyings phyug ma: cir snang sgyu mar rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rlung zhags dbang mo che: 'bras bu kun kyang lhun grub bkra shis shog:

gang 'dul bkra shis mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i tshogs: lam bzhi mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis shog: sna tshogs bkra shis ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma sring 'khor tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: rten 'brel bkra shis bden gnyis mtha' ru phyin: 'gro don nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam bkra shis shog: nyin yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis nas: dus drug rtag tu bde legs rgyas par shog: ces shis pa'i me tog char du dbab bo/ de ltar mkha' 'gro'i chog khrigs 'di yang*/ skal ldan gyi slob bu du mas yang yang bskul ngor/ gter gsar gyi mkha' 'gro gzhung rnams nas mi 'gal bar brgyan te/ nor skyong klu mo gzi ldan gyi pho brang g.yu mtsho rten 'brel la kha'i mgul du skyid grong smyon pas bkod pa dge bar gyur cig /slar yang rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i las byang 'di nyid la go rim cung zad mi 'dra ba 'dug pas gsang ba spyi ltar bcos shing zhu dag phran bu bcas rab rgyan sa stag lor dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyin gu hyas par bskrun zhus pa 'dis skal ldan rnams la bde chen mchog gi dngos grub mngon du byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ sgrub pa'i skabs ni dzap bskul mgor bhrūm̐ bi shwa sogs dzap khang dbye/ de nas bsnyen pa'i dmigs bzlas khyug tsam grub rjes/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i gnas lnga ru/ /rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas/ /thugs srog sngags phreng 'od zer gyis/ /mdun bskyed mkha' 'gro'i thugs rgyud bskul/ /gnyis ka'i thugs srog sngags phreng las/ /rang 'od sgra bcas g.yon bskor du/ /'khor ba'i 'bum phrag sde lnga yi/ /lha tshogs ma lus thugs kar phog /kun gyi thugs srog sngags phreng ni/ /rang sgra dang bcas 'khor ba dang*/ /bzod med bde ba'i nyams 'bar zhing*/ /thams cad gtso bo nyid la ni/ /g.yon du kyil kyil bskor ba dang*/ /zhal nas sngags dbyangs kyu ru ru/

/zhabs kyis bro rdung khrigs se khrig /srid gsum yom zhing dbang du sdus/ /nyams rtogs yon tan gong du spel/ /tshur bsdus rang la thim pa yis/ /mchog thun dngos grub thob par dmigs/ gnad ni bdag bskyed kyi gsal snang 'bar bas mdun bskyed zil gyis gnon pa/ bar du srog gi 'khor lo bskor bas dam tshig mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus/ thun mthar srog gi 'od dmar gyi thig le rang la bsdu ba ni/ mkha' 'gro'i srog 'phrog pa'o// // ༈ khrag 'thung padma drag po'i las byang rdo rje'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i thugs rje khros pa'i dpyid/ /mi zad gar dgu'i nyams brgyas rnam dpa' ba/ /bla ma dpal chen padma khrag 'thung rgyal/ /ro gcig gnyug ma'i ngang der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang gi gsang ba zab mo'i sgor 'jug pa'i/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i lam lhong phrin las gzhung*/ /gsal byed thugs rje'i gad rgyangs 'dir sgrogs la/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dge legs stsol/ khrag 'thung padma drag po'i phrin las chog khrigs bklag chog tu bkod pa'i sdom las/ brgyud 'debs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bgegs bskrad dang*/ /srung brlab brda rim sngon 'gro'o/ /dngos gzhi ting 'dzin spyan 'dren bzhugs/ /phyag mchod bstod 'dzab thun gtor ro/ /rjes ni tshogs brlab spyan 'dren mchod/ /bskang bshags bsgral bstab lhag bskul chad/ /zor brtan bro dbang gtang rag dang*/ /bzod gsol bkra shis bsngo smon no/ thog mar sngon 'gro la brgyad kyi dang po skyabs yul brgyud 'debs ni/ khyed shes kyi 'dun pa mi phyed pas/ na mo: mdun gyi nam mkha' chos dbyings skye med ngang: ma bcos stong nyid e yi 'phro 'du las: rang byung lhun grub 'od kyi gzhal yas khang : phyi nang gzhal 'das bkod pa rab rgyas pa'i: 'ja' tshon dpung bzhin khyon kyang yangs pa'i dbus: dri med gdod ma'i mtsho dkyil pad sdong rtser:

chags med skyon bral 'od skur sprul pa'i lha: rje btsun chen po padma thod phreng rtsal: dkar dmar mdangs ldan dri med gzi 'bar ba: mtshan dpe'i sku la rgyan kun rab rdzogs pa'i: phyag mtshan la sogs cha shas ma nyams par: dpa' la rab tu bzhad cing bzhugs pa yi: 'khor yug rab tu bskor ba'i skyabs yul lha: skar 'tshogs grangs bzhin chu zla'i snang ngor ltar: ma 'dres gsal bzhin gsol ba 'di ltar du: sku gsum bla ma bsgrub par dam bca'o: e ma hoḥ ka dag bde ba chen po'i klong yangs nas: chos sku 'od mi 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma 'gags ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: longs sku spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs: cir snang sgyu mar rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: rnga yab padma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: sprul sku o rgyan rje la gsol ba 'debs: skye 'chi 'khrul 'dzin zhig par byin gyis rlobs: zab lam bde chen gsang ba'i pho brang nas: dbyings phyug manda ra bar gsol ba 'debs: snyan brgyud klong du grol bar byin gyis rlobs: shes rab ye shes mchog gi pho brang nas: mtsho rgyal rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs: brda bzhi mngon du grol bar byin gyis rlobs: sku gsum don ston brgyud pa'i pho brang nas: 'phags mchog rigs gsum mgon por gsol ba 'debs: tshig don rgyud la 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen dbang drag 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: dmar nag me phreng sku la gsol ba 'debs: bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad 'dul bar byin gyis rlobs: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pho brang nas: drag po rigs bzhi'i lha la gsol ba 'debs: las bzhi lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sprul pa rnam bzhi 'gyed pa'i pho brang nas: phrin las der ston lha la gsol ba 'debs: dus min 'chi ba 'joms par byin gyis rlobs: gzhan yang pho brang gnas yul ma lus nas:
