dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la gsol ba 'debs: mchog thun 'bras bu 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: rje btsun chen po o rgyan rin po che: zol med bdag gis re ltos nyid las med: sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dam pas thugs rjes zungs: byin gyis rlobs shig gsol ba snying nas 'debs: sku yi dbang bskur bskyed rim lha yi skus: sprul sku'i 'gro don nus par byin gyis rlobs: gsung gi dbang bskur 'byin 'jug sngags kyi sgras: longs sku'i rang rtsal rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs: thugs kyi dbang bskur rdzogs rim ka nas dag: chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen ye shes dbang drag 'dus pa'i lha: 'di nas brtsams te zag med rdo rje'i sku: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor bsgrub par dam bca' nas: mi 'da' mi 'gyur bla med ye grol ngang : rang dbyings a ti'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dzñā na padma dha ra sarba siddhi hrīḥ zhes dbang blang zhing bdag dang dbyer med du bstims la lhan skyes bde stong gi ye shes mngon du gyur pa rang gsal chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ 'khor 'das dbyer med dam dbyings rig 'od gsal rdo rje snying po blo bral chos nyid chen por 'khor ba rnam par dag cing 'pho med zung 'jug gi sku mchog mngon du gyur par bltas la/ na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: gsum pa sems bskyed ni/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la thugs rjes gdung ba lhag par bskyed pas/ hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: bzhi pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ dkar gtor sngon du 'gro bas/

gnyis rtog las gyur pa'i lan chags 'dre gdon stong gsum gyi ru tra rnams byang chub lam la 'god 'dun gyis snying rje'i lcags kyus bzung la/ zag med ting 'dzin gyi gtor mas rgyud grol te mtha' bral dbyings kyi lam du bskrad pa la/ chos nyid drag po'i rngam sgras/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa yi: 'gugs pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed: sgrub la mi dbang log 'dren bgegs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir mchis: oṃ badzra ṭākki rā dza ya: gnod byed 'byung po dza dzaḥ thugs rje drag po'i nga ros bka' bsgo ni/ hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung rol: 'byung po bka' las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma khyer la rang gnas dengs: 'tshe na drag sngags mai char 'bebs: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ: a hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad bhyo: thum shig gtor myog rbad raṃ dzwa la phaṭ: ces gdon bgegs kyi rang 'tshang gab skung phud de mtshams sbyor smon lam gyis rgyas thebs pas phyir mi ldog par blta'o/ lnga pa srung 'khor ni/ ye shes rang snang gi 'od zer mi shigs pa'i srung mtshams rim pa bdun gyi snod bcud mu med du bcings par bltas la/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las srung ba'i gur: rdo rje lcags sdig bya khyung 'phros: gri gug kha ṭwāṃ me yi gur: sra mkhregs pha lam rang bzhin gyur: oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa: tri pā paṃ tsakra rakṣa: khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsakra rakṣa: ka ra ti ka tsakra rakṣa: tri shū la tsakra rakṣa: ram̐ dzwa la tsakra rakṣa: e swa bhā tsakra rakṣa: zhes 'khor 'das mtha' bral ka dag gnyug ma brdal khyab dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du 'khor bas mtshams bcad do/ drug pa mchod pa byin brlab ni/ phyi nang gsang mchod thams cad ye nas rang bzhin rnam par dag pas thabs shes bde stong ye shes kyi rten 'brel phyogs med du 'char ba'i gzhi dbyings 'du 'bral med pa 'od gsal gyi gter chen por mnga' dbang bsgyur bas/

hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha liṃ ta te dzwa bha liṃ ta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrī ṭhā: oṃ sarba āḥham̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes lnga'am bdun bzlas sman raka dkrug cing gtor ma bran no/ bdun pa sgrub rdzas byin rlob ni/ snod bcud gzhal yas lha yi rol rtsal thugs rje'i dgongs klong zab gsal mngon gyur du rtogs pas/ hūm̐: bum pa gzhal yas bdud rtsi lha: bhandha'i snod du rdzas sman bstim: phyi nang spyan gzigs sna tshogs rnams: bskyed spel mtshan ldan rab tu sbyangs: oṃ bhrūm̐ dhe wa bhai ṣa dzyai ye bi shwa oṃ āḥhūm̐: ༈ drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs rim pa ni/ spos bsregs rnga rol mda' dar g.yab/ gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ 'og min zhing dang rnga yab gling*/ /rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /sku gsum ston pa pad 'byung la/ /rtsa gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtshos bskor/ /dkyir 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /las smon brda bzhi'i klong yangs nas/ /gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje la/ /las can chos bdag 'bum gyis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod dang/ /gang 'dul der ston pho brang nas/ /drag po khrag 'thung yab yum la/ /yi dam rgyud sde'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig /gsal ba gsum ldan dkyil 'khor dang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dur khrod nas/ /pho nya khyung dang lcags sdig phag /mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs dang bcas/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig

/zhi ba dbyings kyi lha tshogs kyis/ /dbang dang dngos grub byin phob cig /drag po khrag 'thung lha tshogs kyis/ /mthu rtsal nus pa'i byin phob cig /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas kyis/ /gang bcol phrin las byin phob cig /sku gsung thugs kyi byin phob cig /sgrub pa'i 'bras bu myur du stsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba a we sha ya hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥsarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/

zhes bla ma drag po'i bsnyen sgrub kyi cha rkyen du bris par nyes 'gal mchis na drag po'i lha la bshags na dge bas grub bzang mchog gi dngos grub thob/ yang srid o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis bris pa dge/ // brgyad pa brda dbye brda phyag dam bzung ni/ ma rig blang dor gyi chos thams cad ye grol gdod ma'i gnas lugs ji bzhin pa'i lha zhal mjal ba'i ngang du ma 'da' bas sgrib tshogs phyag cing thugs rje mngon du 'tshal ba ste 'du 'bral med par mchod bshags brten cing lam du ma lhong bar tha mal mi 'byams par chos nyid las mi 'da' ba'i dam bca' brtan pos/ hūm̐: ma rig blang dor 'thib sgo bcad: rang rig lha zhal 'char sgo phyes: brda phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pas bshags: ma 'grub bar du srog ltar bzung : oṃ bhrūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ badzra tsitta hūm̐: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dgu las/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ye grol ka dag ngang rab 'byams chen po'i rang mdangs khams gsum gyi sems can bsgral 'dod kyi snying rje'i rang bzhin kun tu rdo rje mthing ka hūm̐ gis mtshan mar bltas la/ hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing brdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rang rtsal rdzogs: oṃ: kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: zhes gzhi las rlung lnga g.yos 'byung lnga'i yig 'bru rnams rim par thim pa las/ dbang chen bzhi rim gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las ye shes lnga'i gzhal yas dur khrod kyi rgyan bkod rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad chos 'byung khrag mtsho brag chen gtams par gtso bo dang rtsibs brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir ging bzhi/ mtshams bzhir khyung bzhi/ bar khyams la gnas yul gyi dpa' bo ḍākki/ sgor bzhir dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyi rang bzhin gdong can bzhi/ phyi rol du bka' gter srung ma lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa ye shes rig pa'i ngar dpung dang ldan zhing*/

dur khrod brgyad dang srung 'khor rim bdun sogs snod bcud thams cad dag pa ye shes kyi rol pa chen por 'byams klas pa'i dgongs pa mngon du byas nas/ gnyis pa lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ rgya gram: ram̐ las me ri kham̐ rakta: sum̐ las sa gzhi keṃ ri rab: bhrūm̐ las rang byung bhandha'i mkhar: rmang gzhi rdo rje rgya gram nag: gru bzhi sgo bzhi sna lnga'i rtsig: lha klu sde brgyad gza' rgyu skar: ka gdung gral lcam thog steng phub: dmar nag 'dod snam pha gu ser: drwa ba rus rgyan thod tshal 'phyangs: rlung gis sham bu lda ldi bskyod: mda' yab bhandha skam rlon spel: g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan tsitta'i tog: rta babs bya khyung seng 'brug ngar: chos 'khor hūm̐ sgra tog gis mdzes: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa mtshon: me ri khyung dang lcags sdig gur: srid pa'i rlung yang mi thar bsgom: nang du dmar nag rakta'i mtshor: mi rta bam ro'i lhu dum 'khril: dur khrod rgyan 'phyang du ma bres: dbus su zla gam dmar smug klong: chos 'byung mthing nag baṃ gyi steng: gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ sgra can: me ri tshwa tshwa si li li: dran rdzogs padma he ru kaḥ khro rgyal drag po thod phreng rtsal: dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar 'khrugs: khro gtum spyan rtsa glog ltar 'gyu: dbu rgyan bya khyung rigs lnga rdzogs: g.yas gsum gri gug rdo rje me: g.yon gsum thod khrag lcags sdig sbrul: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog brgyangs: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal chas brgyan: zhabs bzhi khro bo rol pa'i stabs: bya khyung mthing nag me gshog brdzis: gsang ba khro mo gri thod mthing: 'khyud cing yab yum me dpung klong: lha srin sde brgyad 'dul bar bskyed: hūm̐: rang rig bla ma drag po rtsal: 'jigs byed dmar nag dpa' chas can: he ru ka dpal gsal ba yi: thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten dbus:

nyi zla'i gwa'u brtsegs pa'i steng: hūm̐ las gsang bdag rdo rje gtum: mthing nag rdo rje sdigs mdzub can: de yi thugs kar nā da'i dbus: thugs mchog snang ba mtha' yas sku: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: de yi thugs kar dran rig sku: hūm̐ ljang 'od kyi rang bzhin gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: drag po'i spyi gtsug 'khor lo ru: ya mānta ka gshin rje'i gshed: ser nag be con thod khrag 'dzin: mgrin par hya ghṛ wa'i sku: dmar nag me dbyug lcags sgrog 'dzin: lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga ni: mdangs lnga gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: gsang bar yaksha me dbal te: smug nag tho ba lcags kyu 'dzin: kun kyang khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs: hūm̐: rang rig bla ma drag po yi: rtsa gnas yan lag bzhi la ni: shar du badzra kī la ya: lho ru ratna kī la ya: nub tu padma kī la ya: byang du karma kī la ya: rang mdog dur khrod chas ky-is brgyan: sgro gshog dbyings kyi mkha' ru brgyangs: phyag na ri rab phur bu bsgril: thams cad sku smad dbal zur ldan: ma 'dres chu zla'i dbyibs ltar bsgom: oṃ ā mi dhe wa hūm̐ hrī dha badzra pā ṇi ya mānta ka hya ghṛ wa ha ri ni sa yaksha kā la badzra ratna padma karma kī la ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: phyi rol gnam lcags rtsibs brgyad steng: shar tu sgrol ging mthing nag rngam: g.yas gsum spu gri chu gri me: g.yon gsum thod phreng snying dang sdig: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs: me yi bya khyung dmar nag zhon: hūm̐: lho ru gtum ging sngo nag khro: g.yas gsum tsitta me chu gri: g.yon gsum kha ṭwāṃ lcags sdig me: dur khrod dpa' chas rab tu rdzogs: 'joms byed bya khyung kham nag zhon: hūm̐: nub tu khro ging dmar nag gtum: g.yas gsum ral gri gri gug thod: g.yon gsum 'khor lo spu gri sdig: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal dang ldan: srog gzan bya khyung ser nag zhon:

hūm̐: byang du las ging ljang nag rngam: g.yas gsum 'khor lo rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum tri shul lcags sdig khyung : dur khrod chas ldan khro la brjid: gtor byed bya khyung ljang nag zhon: hūm̐: yum chen ging gi khro mo bzhi: rang mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis: gri thod 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud: kun kyang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: 'jigs byed bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: dbu rgyan bya khyung rigs lnga rdzogs: thams cad gtso bo'i chas dang mthun: hūm̐: mtshams bzhir yab yum sprul pa'i khyung : dkar ser dmar ljang mthing la rngam: bswe mig zangs ra lcags kyi mchu: me gshog rlabs kyis dpag tshad g.yo: dam sri 'dre rgod gnyen por bsgom: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi sgo yi las byed ma: shar du ma mo sdig pa'i gdong: lho ru ma mo chu srin gdong: nub tu ma mo phag gdong ma: byang du ma mo khyung gdong ma: bzhi ka gcer bu mi bzad pa: gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: phyag na gri gug bhan dmar dkrugs: thams cad lcags sdig mgo dgu zhon: dus 'khrug lo nyes mu ge dang: nad rims dal yams 'joms par gsal: hūm̐: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: khyung dang lcags sdig phag rgod 'gyed: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: gsal snang chu zla'i klong ltar bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas khrag 'thung khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs: oṃ badzra sa mā dza dzaḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ mkha' klong rnam dag gi zhing khams rab 'byams rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i shugs la gnas pa bden pa'i byin rlabs mos gus kyi 'dun pas bskul bas/ thugs rje'i snang brnyan dbang drag 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul du mkha' lam gang bar byon pa dbyer med du thim pa ye shes lnga'i dbang rdzogs/ sku gsung thugs kyi gzi byin lhag par rgyas par bltas la/ dri gsur rol mo gdung dbyangs kyis/

hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum dang: las kyi ma mo yang sprul khyung : gnas 'dir spyan 'dren myur du byon: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: snang ba mtha' yas gshegs su gsol: he chen sku yi pho brang nas: ya mānta ka gshegs su gsol: dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas: hya ghṛ wa gshegs su gsol: lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: badzra pā ṇi gshegs su gsol: mkha' spyod dag pa'i pho brang nas: mkha' 'gro sde lnga gshegs su gsol: gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: yaksha me dbal gshegs su gsol: zhi ba lhun grub pho brang nas: badzra kī la gshegs su gsol: rgyas pa mthar phyin pho brang nas: ratna kī la gshegs su gsol: khams gsum dbang sdud pho brang nas: padma kī la gshegs su gsol: mngon spyod drag po'i pho brang nas: karma kī la gshegs su gsol: bde chen lhun grub pho brang nas: drag po'i lha tshogs ma lus kun: thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog lho nub yul: rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: che btsan rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: laṅka mgrin bcu'i kha gnon mdzad: gdong dmar srin po dam la btags: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mdzad: rje btsun de yi rjes 'jug phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: drag po'i pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir: byin chen phob la dbang chen bskur: 'gyur med sku yi pho brang nas: bskyed rim stobs bcus byin gyis rlobs: 'gags med gsung gi sgo phyes la: tshangs dbyangs drug cus byin gyis rlobs: 'khrul med thugs kyi sgo phyes la: ye shes chen pos byin gyis rlobs: yon tan brgyad khri'i sgo phyes la: myang 'das chos kyis byin gyis rlobs: phrin las sna tshogs sgo phyes la: mchog thun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de ltar ye shes lha yi tshogs:

mi mngon dbyings nas sku bskyod la: rang bzhin dbyings su rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: thugs rje'i dbyings nas 'gro don du: dbang drag lha tshogs bdag gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud tshogs thams cad zil gnon ye shes kyi dpa' stobs drag po nam yang gsal sgrib bral bar bzhugs par mos la/ hūm̐: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dre rgod dang : 'byung po sa bdag klu yi khrir: gdug pa 'dul ba'i rngam stabs kyis: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rang rig drag po'i sku gsung thugs su gzi byin bskyed pa la rig rtsal mkha' 'gro dam can rnams kyis 'du 'bral med pa'i dam phyag mngon du 'dud pas/ hūm̐: mi bzad skur ston khrag 'thung pa: 'jigs byed bla ma drag po yi: phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: brkyang bskum gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba la bdun las/ dang po phyi mchod ni/ snang srid kyi dwangs ma thams cad 'byung ba'i lha mau sgeg mdzes nam mkha' gang bar rol pas dkyil 'khor mchod par mos la/ hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang spyan gzigs dang: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dang: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda sogs/ oṃ sarba pañtsa sogs? oṃ ma hā māṃ sa tsitta go ro sogs? hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: rang byung phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: puṇṭa'i phreng ba mkha' yi gzhu ltar bkra: skyed mo'i dri bsung g.yu bun lan tshar bsigs: ku mud tsha zer 'bar 'od zhags pa 'khyil: klu yi bdud rtsi gzi 'od rlabs su 'phyur: mkha' yi gru 'dzin ro brgya'i bcud du bskyil:

dbyar rnga'i sgra chen stong gsum khyon du g.yo: yid spyod de las gzhol ba'i bye brag rnams: rdo rje thod phreng lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs/ gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ snang srid kyi rtsi bcud thams cad ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsir bskyil ba dza gad dpa' bo dam rdzas kyis thugs dam dgyes par zhal du bstab par mos/ hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: bla med nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: bhandha lcang lo 'khyil ba'i snod yangs su: 'bru bcud sna tshogs sbyar ba 'bras kyi chang : rtsi bcud sna tshogs sbyar ba bstar ba'i chang : sman phud sna tshogs sbyar ba gso ba'i chang : sha chen sna tshogs sbyar ba rdzas kyi chang : rakta sna tshogs sbyar ba drag po'i chang : de ltar bskyed dang rang bzhin bdud rtsi rnams: rdo rje thod phreng lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang: oṃ sarba a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: ༈ bdud rtsi lag mchod bzhugs so/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ka ni skye ba med pa'i klong: pā ni rang byung lhun gyis grub: la ni 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid: don gsum ldan pa'i bhandha ru: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsis bkang: ye shes lnga'i byin phab nas: phyogs dus rgyal kun ma lus dang: dkyil 'khor phyi nang gsang gsum la: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hriḥṭhā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las ma lus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rtsa bar gyur pa'i mtshungs med rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma pa rin po che'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ slar yang khyab bdag drug pa'i ngo bor dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas chos sku kun tu bzang po'i zhal du sarb

longs sku rdo rje sems pa'i zhal? sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje'i zhal? slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen? gu ru shrī singha'i? rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas? lha lcam manda ra ba'i? mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal? gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes? 'gro mgon rtsa gsum gling pa'i? yi dam bla ma drag po yab yum? go cha khro bcu yab yum? khrag 'thung kī la rigs bzhi yam yum? ye shes ging chen sde bzhi yab yum? sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi yi? yang 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad? gter srung sprul pa yang sprul? las byed mngon spyod sprul pa'i? gzhan yang snang srid thams cad rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi skur gsal ba'i? hūm̐: bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag: bdud rtsi'i ngo bo 'chi med rang byung rdzas: bdud rtsi'i don ni mchog gi dngos grub thob: de phyir rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛ ta: rang byung don ston ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta siddhi hūm̐: zhes pa bdud rtsi lag mchod 'di kun dga' blo gros sogs grwa slob kyis bskul ngor rtsa gsum gling pas thun mtshams su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ gsum pa gsang mchod ni/ lha mi'i dpal du gyur pa'i 'dod yon ji snyed kyi lha mos tshogs drug gi yul du dgyes skong lhag par bskyed cing*/

hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: bde chen gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: brda grogs snang stong gsal ba'i me long thogs: grags stong glu mos snyan pa'i pi waṃ thogs: tshor stong bzhad mos dri bsil phreng ba thogs: myong stong gar mos ro brgya'i bcud ldan thogs: reg stong sgeg mos lha yi yug gos thogs: blos blangs yid la dgyes pa'i mchod sprin rnams: rdo rje thod phreng lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : oṃ badzra rū pa shabd bzhi pa sbyor mchod ni/ phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams bde ba'i nyams dang stong pa'i 'od gsal thabs shes dbyer med gdod ma'i ye sbyor chen po'i don dran pas/ hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: zung 'jug sbyor ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: snang mtha' gos dkar sbyor ba chos sku'i klong : spyan gzigs sgrol ma sbyor ba longs sku'i rtsal: drag po phag mo sbyor ba sprul sku'i mdangs: go cha'i lha tshogs rang bzhin bde stong sbyaur: phyag rgya drug gis bde chen dga' bzhi bskyed: ging chen rigs bzhi rang rang yum dang sbyor: zung 'jug rgyas 'debs 'khor lor khyab par bskul: thabs shes 'du 'bral med pa'i mchod pa 'di: rdo rje thod phreng lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang: om̐ sarba a ham̐ dzñā na pū dza hoḥ lnga pa bsgral mchod ni/ 'khor 'das bde sdug bzang ngan gnyis 'dzin thams cad ye shes thugs rje'i mtshon chas gnyis med du bsgral ba'i mchod pas 'khor rgyun stongs par bltas la/ hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo gdug sems can: mngon spyod rdo rje ral gris bsgral ba'i sha: sgrub la 'tshe ba'i log lta bsam sbyor can: chos skyong rnams kyis bsgral ba'i snying khrag dang :

gsang sngags gnyan la dgra bgegs sdig to can: las mkhan rnams kyis bsgral ba'i don snying dang: bdag la 'tshe zhing sdang ba'i dgra bgegs dang: myur mgyogs shan pas bsgral ba'i klad rus rkang : dgra rgol dmag jag ston pa'i byad ma rnams: sna tshogs pho nyas bsgral zhing gtub pa yi: bsgral mchod phung po khyon ltar bkang ba'i tshogs: rdo rje thod phreng 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang: oṃ ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta king ni ri ti kha kha khā hi: drug pa dam rdzas gtor mchod ni/ ru tra byad ma'i dbang tshogs 'du shes dang bcas pa rngam drag dpal chen rol pa'i zhal du bstab pas byang chub sgrub pa'i bdud tshogs shugs kyis zhi ba'i nges shes bskyed la/ hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: bha ling gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: spu gris bcad pa'i 'dre rgod thod pa ru: gdug pa'i dgra bo byad ma'i snying bshos la: dbang po rnam lnga gtor skyu zor gyis bskor: klad rus khrag dang zhag gis shin tu sbags: byad ma'i mi ro rta ro'i g.yang gzhi yi: gdugs sogs sham bu rnams dang phyar rgyan spras: zhe sdang rus pa'i sgal tshigs rtsang gis brgyan: sbrul ltar 'khyil ba bha su'i zhags pas dkris: ye nas rang byung snod bcud bha liṃ ta: bskyed cing spel ba'i dmar chen gtor ma 'di: rdo rje thod phreng 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang: ma hā bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: bdun pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul thams cad rang mdangs rig pa'i cho 'phrul gdod nas dag pa 'khor 'das dbyer med dus gsum mnyam pa chen po'i ngang nas/ hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: rang byung kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni: snang srid ye grol mtshan ma brjod las bral: snod bcud gang snang ye shes sgyu ma'i rtsal:

sna tshogs ma 'gags rang byung ngo bos stong : phyogs med res bral bde chen 'dus ma byas: ci yang ma yin ci yang 'char ba'i rgyu: rnam pa ma grub rnam grol chen po nyid: dbyibs su mi snang a 'thas brtag gzhig bral: 'gogs pa'i mi 'gags khegs pa'i chos kyang med: kun grol khyab brdal ngang las ma g.yos la: shugs kyis rol rtsal cir yang snang ba'i lhar: bya rtsol 'dzin pa mi dmigs mchod bya dang*/ de bzhin mchod yul 'gro 'ong bral ba 'di: rdo rje thod phreng lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang: mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bdag gi g.yar dam nyams pa sor chud nas: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru badzra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pa la ya: sogs brjod/ bdun pa bstod pa ni/ thugs rje ye shes kyi mtshan nyid mthong ba'i yi dam lha la 'du 'bral mi phyed pa'i spro ba skyes te rang rig rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i nga rgyal gyis che ba'i gzi byin bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma drag po he ru kaḥ stobs 'dus padma khrag 'thung rgyal: sku mdog dmar nag srid gsum 'dul: zhal gsum khro zhing pho rgyud sngangs: spyan dgu sdang mig mo rgyud sdud: snyan nas 'brug sgra stong gsum g.yo: shangs nas rlung dmar 'byung po gtor: khro bcu'i mche gtsigs dgra sha dgyes: ljags dmar 'dre rgod snying khrag rngub: khyung gi dbu rgyan snang srid 'dul: sbrul bcings ral bsigs srid rtse 'gul: phyag drug mtshon cha dgra la 'debs: sgro gshog bar snang me 'od 'khrugs: dur khrod chas brgyad dregs pa 'dul: dpal chas ma tshogs dbang du sdud: zhabs bzhi dor stabs stong gsum gnon: srid pa'i khyung brdzis rgyal 'gong bsgral: yum chen gsang ba khro mo mthing : zhal gdangs khro gtum ma rungs brgyal: gri gug skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: bhan dmar 'byung po'i klad khrag rol:

dur khrod chas ldan phar phyin rdzogs: yab 'khril sprul pa'i khro tshogs bskul: yab yum bskal pa'i me ri'i dbus: bzhugs shing tshwa tshwas stong gsum khyab: dus ngan 'byung po 'dul byed pa: 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku: snang srid 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rdo rje mi bskyod snang mthas spyi bor brgyan: mnyam bzhag bsgoms pas kun snang khyab par 'gems: rdo rje sku yi gar dgu 'jigs su rung : be con 'bar ba ma rungs bdud la 'debs: rdo rje gsung gis drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: dbyug tho 'bar bas bgegs kyi spyi bor 'gems: rdo rje thugs kyis rang bzhin klong la khyab: rtse lnga'i rwa gdeng snang srid yongs la phyar: rdo rje glog 'gyu mkha' la 'gro ba'i gar: gcod byed gri gug nyon mongs 'khrul 'khor bshig: rdo rje gnod sbyin srid pa las su sbyor: gnam lcags tho bas ma rungs spyi bor 'gems: rdo rje'i las bzhi'i phrin las sna tshogs 'grub: ri rab phur bus 'khor 'das dbyings su sgrol: de ltar 'jigs byed 'bar ba dbang drag lha: sku yi cha la rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: go cha thams cad yi dam lha ru snang: mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor gzhan nas btsal du gang: snang mtha'i rang bzhin zhi ba dbyings kyi lha: zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dmar nag me phreng khro bo 'dus pa'i dpal: khro bo'i dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ya mānta ka 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha: sku yi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: ha ya ghṛ wa padma dbang chen lha: gsung gi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: badzra pā ṇi gsang bdag rdo rje'i lha: yang dag thugs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje gzhon nu badzra ku mā ra: phrin las phur pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ḍākki rigs lnga dbyings phyug nam mkha'i lha: ma mo rbod gtong lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: yaksha me dbal mngon spyod ldan pa'i lha:

'jig rten mchod bstod lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rigs bzhi'i sras kyis gdab pa'i phyag mtshan 'gyed: dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: khro chen mi bzad 'jigs pa'i ging : las kyi dpa' bo chen po bzhi: zhal gsum gdangs shing rgyal 'gong 'dul: spyan dgu bgrad pas klu gnyan sngangs: dbu rgyan bya khyung sa bdag 'joms: sgro gshog nad rims dal yams gzhom: g.yas gsum mtshon char dgra la 'bebs: g.yon gsum mtshon gyis dam nyams bkums: dpal chas dus 'khrugs 'dre rgod 'dul: zhabs bzhis khyung brdzis klu srin 'joms: rang mdog khro mo rigs bzhi rngam: gri thod 'dzin cing dug lnga gzhom: yab 'khril rang 'dra'i khro chung 'gyed: sku las me lce ya la la: yab yum ging chen tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭa: bswe mig tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: zangs ra dmar po rngam la rno: me gshog stong khams 'u ru ru: lcags sder klu 'dzin khyugs se khyug: gnam lcags rkan sgra thags se thag: dam sri 'byung po'i snying khrag 'thung: sprul pa'i bya khyung bzhi la bstod: hūm̐: sdig pa chu srin phag dang khyung : gdong can sha za khro mo bzhi: zangs kyi gri gug lhabs se lhab: rakta'i khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: gcer mo skra dmar sa la gzhol: lcags sdig 'dur ldang khyugs se khyug: me char tshwa tshwa spungs se spung : sprul pa'i bya khyung phag dang sdig: 'byung po'i srog len myu ru ru: dkyil 'khor phyi nang gsang ba'i lhar: sgo gsum 'dun pas rab tu bstod: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha': nad mtshon 'byung po 'dre rgod dang : dam sri rgyal 'gong kha dar bas: khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: phyi yi dgra 'dre 'byung po thul: nang gi dug lnga'i bar chad sol: gsang ba'i skag rkyen dgra la phob: nad mtshon dal yams rtsad nas chod: las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

brgyad pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/ gzhung dang man ngag gi dgongs pa'i dgos pa gsal btab la/ 'dzab bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ yang gsang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /skye med dbyings nas skur bzhengs la/ /'gags med rang byung snying pos bskul/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig tha ma ru/ /drag sngags me 'od tshwa tshwa dang*/ /rang sgra sgrogs bzhin g.yas su 'khor/ /spros pas rgyal ba mchod pas dgyes/ /bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis bsdus/ /mar 'phros khams gsum snod bcud sbyangs/ /srid gsum gdug pa tshar thag bcad/ /snang ba thams cad khro bo'i dal/ /srid pa thams cad yi dam lha/ /sgra grags thams cad drag po'i sngags/ /dran rtog rig stong ka dag klong*/ /'bras bu ma 'grub bar du bsgrub/ /srog la bab kyang mi btang ngo/ ༈ bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid che mchog padma drag po gsal ba'i thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten gyi dbus bum pa'i gzhal yas su padma'i steng nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' phyag rdor mthing nag /rdo rje sdigs mdzub can/ de yi thugs kar dmar ser thig le'i steng du ting 'dzin sems dpa' snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs kar hūm̐ gi mthar rtsa ba'i sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor bar dmigs la sngags bzla bar bya'o/ slar yang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ zhing khams rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba sras bcas mchod byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus gzi brjid lhag par rgyas shing ma dag pa'i khams rnams su cig car du khyab/ khams gsum gyi dregs byed ma lus dbang du bsdus shing log rtog rnams zil gyis mnan/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can tshar bcad/ 'gro ba'i las sgrib mtha' dag bcom nas yi dam lha yi go 'phang la bkod/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos nyid kyi rol par sad par bsams la bzlas pa bya'o/ yang lha tshogs thams cad kyis zhal dang sngags las kyang rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba'am gnam lcags kyi thog rgod drag tu lhung ba ltar srid gsum thams cad yom yom shig shig tu 'gul zhing ldeg pa dang*/

'od zer dmar nag 'bar zhing rab tu 'khrugs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig tu gnas par byas la bzla bar bya'o/ zhes pa'ang gnam lcags gu hya'i ming gis 'phral mkho la dmigs te bris pa'o// // oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes bsnyen pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐: zhes sgrub sngags ji ltar rim par bzla/ ging bzhi'i sngags ni: oṃ badzra tsakra kro ta tsaṇḍa grī wa tsa tur kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bhyoḥ khyung lnga'i sngags ni: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa pañtsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ khro mo sha za bzhi la: oṃ ma mo mu khā le kro ti tsa tur baṃ ru lu ru lu bhyoḥ phag sdig khyung lnga la: oṃ wā ra hī pā paṃ khrom̐ ṭa ya bhyoḥ zhes rtsa sngags las sngags dang sham bur sngags rgod ni nyi ma bdun phrag rim bzhin bzlas: rgyal bsen ar gtad sham bu ni: oṃ she la du ging rā dza nan tsitta thum bhyoḥ srin mo la: oṃ raksha kā li ya ma nan: tsitta shag 'gas hu lu bhyoḥ 'dre rgod 'byung po la: oṃ a mu ka bhū ta mā ra ya dzi ni rbad bhyoḥ dam sri la: oṃ ya ma ye ru tra mā ra nan bhyoḥ gdon spyi la: oṃ trag thur shag rbad duntsa mā ra ya a mu ka tri sha rbad bhyo trag thum: gzhan yang 'go nad srung na nad 'joms par bu la btags/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: snang srid thams cad drag po e yi klong: snod bcud gzugs snang yi dam lha yi sku: 'byin 'jug rlung rnams rang bzhin snying po'i sngags: khams kyi rang mdangs khro bo rol pa'i rtsal: gnas lugs ma bcos skye med yi ge hūm̐: rang rig ngo bo che mchog drag po rtsal: padma khrag 'thung gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: bla ma rdo rje thod phreng sku mdog mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad:

g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing drag tu khros: rdo rje gri gug ral gri g.yas su thogs: bhan dmar thong shol lcags sdig g.yon na bsnams: rdo rje'i sgro gdeng dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs: rdo rje phag mo zangs mdog gri thod 'dzin: brkyang bskum ye shes gar gyis pang du 'khyud: 'bar ba'i zer ldan me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'jigs byed drag po'i sku yi char: spyi bor snang mtha' rigs kyi bdag: steng du sprul pa'i bya khyung rngam: dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje 'jigs: mgrin par dbang chen rta mgrin gshe: thugs kar phyag na rdo rje gtum: lte bar rdo rje gzhon nu 'bar: gsang bar yaksha khro bo brjid: phyag g.yas badzra kī la ya: phyag g.yon ratna kī la ya: zhabs g.yas padma kī la ya: zhabs g.yon karma kī la ya: gsang ba yum gyi gnas lnga ru: bde chen mkha' 'gro sde bzhis gar: gzhon nu rgyan rdzogs cha lugs 'chang : drag po yab yum phyogs bzhi ru: 'jigs byed ging chen yab yum bzhi: sgrol ging gtum ging khro ging dang : las ging bcas pa yab yum brgyad: mtshams su sprul pa yang sprul bcas: gzhan yang sgo skyong la sogs pa: dbang drag rdo rje srin po yi: sku gsung thugs kyi gzi brjid rnams: stobs bcu 'gyed phyir sprul pa'i lha: srid gsum mngon spyod las kyis sdud: stong gsum sde brgyad dam la btags: gling khams kun la 'gran zla bral: sku las khro chung tshwa tshwa 'phro: me ri'i 'bar mched wa la la: 'byung po mi dang mi min sogs: bgegs dang dam sri ma lus kun: drag po'i stobs kyis tshar bcad gyur: rang bzhin hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:

zhes sgra sgrogs shing snang srid thams cad res 'ga' khro bo khro mo res 'ga' hūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan snang srid kyi khyon thams cad khengs par bsgom: skabs su rang bzhin 'ub kyis bdag la bsdu ba mi dmigs gsal stong ka dag ngang la bsgom: sa ma ya: bsrung bzlog sogs kyang gang 'dod sbyar: dgu pa thun mtshams su gtor 'bul ni/ sngon las 'phral rkyen gyis sgrub pa'i bar gcod dgra bgegs thams cad snying po'i gzi byin gyis srid pa mtha' nas sdud cing dmod pa'i bden pas bsgral ba'i sha khrag rnams skye med chos dbyings su btab par mos la/ hūm̐: mi mngon dag pa lhun grub dbyings klong nas: thod phreng drag po'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: phyi nang rten 'brel dam tshig nyams chag bshags: dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang: phrin las sna tshogs lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: zhes dbyangs gsal yig brgya bzla'o/ mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang spyan gzigs tshogs: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dang: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs? ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta la khā hi: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la nyer gcig las/ dang po tshogs rdzas byin brlab ni/ bsang chus bran la/ hūm̐: gdod nas chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: rang byung snying po'i 'od zer gyis: rgyu 'byung yi ge sbyong byed 'phros: gtsang btsog bzang ngan ka nas dag: oṃ dharma ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ shuddhe hoḥ bdud rtsis bran zhing*/ hūm̐: bdag nyid khro bo'i thugs ka nas: byin rlob yi ge 'bru gsum 'phros: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs spel bsgyur: tshogs rdzas nam mkha' mdzod du gyur:

oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza bi shwa mu khe bhya: gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rje btsun thod phreng yab yum la: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: drag po khrag 'thung yab yum la: ging dang khro mo sha zas bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig pho brang nas: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho la: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs thibs se thib: khro bo'i lha tshogs ya la la: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang la: gshegs shing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: mos pa'i skal ldan smin par mdzod: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa phud dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: che mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzhes: deng 'dir mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa phud bar pas bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma thod phreng yab yum dang: drag po'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lnga pa phud phyi mas bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: ma rig rmongs pa'i 'khrul gzugs bdag: grangs med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib tshogs: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐: spro na skong bshags rgyas pa gud nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ drug pa phud tha ma bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden pa'i mthus: gnod byed 'byung po log lta'i rigs: myur du tha ma'i ling gar khug: pho nyas bzung zhing byad du chugs: oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha ya ru tra mā ra ya: dza dza nan: phur bu thogs la/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung thugs las sprul pa'i sras:

las mdzad badzra kī la ya: nam mkha'i mthongs nas thog ltar babs: ru tra'i snying la kī la ya: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya: sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ru tra trag raksha mā ra ya rbad rbad: bdun pa bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung lha tshogs zhal phyes nas: dam nyams ru tra bsgral ba yi: dug lnga sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: skye med ngang du dgyes par rol: lhag med ye shes dbyings su hoḥ brgyad pa tshogs la rol pa ni/ hoḥ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: 'di la the tshom bya mi rung : bram ze gdol pa khyi phag rje: rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol: hoḥ rin thang med las legs 'ong chos: 'dod chags dri ma rnam dag par: gzung dang 'dzin pa kun spangs pa'i: de bzhin nyid la bdag kyang 'tshal: a la la hoḥ zhes 'bul len byas la tshim par rol/ dgu pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal gyi ma mo bye ba 'bum: gnas nyul dur khrod tshogs khang 'grim: gsang sngags mchog gi mel tshe ma: lhag ma bzhes la phrin las mdzod: oṃ bhakṣa li si ta ma hā bha liṃ ta khā hi: bcu pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon chos dbyings klong nas bzhengs: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: dam las 'gal ba'i dgra bgegs la: bka' yi chad pa drag po phob: dmag 'khrug zhi ba'i dus la bab: mtshon bskal nyams pa'i dus la bab: nad yams bzlog pa'i dus la bab: rgyal bsen 'dul ba'i dus la bab: klu srin 'joms pa'i dus la bab: 'dre rgod bsgral ba'i dus la bab: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe: thad nas langs pa'i dgra bgegs 'di: myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ bhyo bhyoḥ 'byung po gnod byed thams cad zlog zlog: bcu gcig pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe me ri 'bar ba ru: bla ma thod phreng drag po dang : mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes gnyis: rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor phyes:

steng 'og lha srin khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: de 'og ti sgro'i tshogs khang du: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas dang : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma sring gnas nyul khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa yis: ti sgro'i tshogs khang chen mo nas: gsang rgya zab gter bton pa'i tshe: las kyi ma mos khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: yang gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di: phyogs bcur spel ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti ḍā ka ḍākki ma mo ru lu bhyoḥ oṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: bcu gnyis pa zor 'phang ba ni/ hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring dam nyams dgra la 'phen: lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung skyed: nyams pa'i dgra bo cham la phob: gtor zor dbal kha sha ra ra: drag sngags tshwa tshwa si li li: pho nya srog len khyugs se khyug: nam gyi phar ma tshur phyed la: dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod la shog: zor sna las byed shan pas drongs: dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma du na du bhyoḥ thun tsa thun tsa bhyoḥ rbad du shag du bhyoḥ trig thum gzer thum bhyoḥ mā ra ya bhyoḥ bcu gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan sil snyan sgra: brda gar glu dbyangs khyugs se khyug: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ma hā bha lingta khā hi: bcu bzhi pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: stong gsum chem chem khro bo'i bro: mnan no ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bro: nam yang ma ldang las kyi bro: sgab 'dre dam sri 'dul zhing bshig: oṃ nan: ā nan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan: bco lnga dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: yang gsang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: skye med dbyings nas skur bzhengs la:

'gags med rang byung snying pos bskul: rten 'brel sngags bzlas mtha' ru phyin: lus kun bde bas ltem gyis gang : deng sang skya rengs dang po shar: rdo rje srin po nam langs nye: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: zab dbyings bla med gsang ba'i mchog: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyis: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: mi 'gyur sku yi dbang bzhi stsol: 'gags med gsung gi dbang bzhi stsol: spros bral thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: phrin las bzhi ldan dbang bzhi stsol: 'chi med tshe dang mi zad nor: snyan grags mnga' thang chos srid gos: phun tshogs 'dod rgu deng 'dir stsol: oṃ dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirmā kā ya: swa bha kā ya: kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bcu drug pa gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang spyan gzigs tshogs: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dang: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs? ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta la khā hi: bcu bdun pa bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam las 'gal ba dang: ma 'byor nyams dang chad lhag 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags la mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma y sogs yig brgya bzla'o/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ bco brgyad pa gshegs bsdu ni/ hūm̐: gsang 'dus rang byung dpal chen pho brang lha: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas 'khor bsdu yum la bsdu: yum yab hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yang dmigs med klong : ka dag rang byung rang shar klong du hoḥ a āḥ bcu dgu pa bkra shis gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: ka dag lhun grub rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis 'chi med tshe yi lha: gnas lugs rang rtsal mngon pa'i bkra shis shog:

sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin padma 'byung: tshe rabs gtan gyi bla mar bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i bkra shis mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang: gsang rgyud gdams pas rgyud smin bkra shis shog: nyi shu pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ dmigs med rgya yan chos nyid rgyu yi bsngo: rang shar rang rtsal ma 'gags lam gyi bsngo: sna tshogs spros bral ka dag 'bras bu'i bsngo: kun gzhi skye med 'khor 'das gcig tu bsngo: nyer gcig pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ bdag blo ye nas dbyings rig sgrib pa bral: gnyis 'dzin ma rig 'khrul pa'i rmongs gzugs rnams: dran rtog chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: tshe rabs pad 'byung yab yum 'bral med shog: de ltar che mchog thod phreng drag po'i phrin las chog khrigs rdo rje'i gad rgyangs zhes pa 'di ni/ rang gnas rnams nyams len la 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ skyid grong smyon pas yang rdzong rdo rje'i gter phug tu bris pa dge bar gyur cig /bkra shis par shog/ // ༄༅/ mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba 'dod rgu yid 'joms gter bum bzhugs so/ bla ma drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud/ de yang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bskang bar 'jug pa ni/ mthun rdzas dgyes mchod legs par bshams nas/ rim gnyis gzhung gi sbyor ba la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐/ ka dag skye med ye shes ngang nyid las/ kha ru brjod pa'i mtshan ma mi dmigs kyang*/ /ga ga gsal stong dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /nga bdag gzung 'dzin phra rags zhi ba'i phyir/ /ca sogs dbyangs snyan phyi mchod gar mo 'bul/ /cha lugs yid gar mchis pa'i spyan gzigs dang*/ /ja chang nang mchod sman gtor khor yug khengs/ /nya rgyas 'bum phrag zung 'jug gsang mchod lta/ /rta sngon la sogs dkor cha sna tshogs kyis/ /tha dad mos pa'i snang ba tshim pa'i phyir/ /da la dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i tshul bzung ma/ /na ra las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /pa sangs ltar dkar zhi ba'i cha lugs 'dzin/

/pha rol khams gsum skye 'gro dbang du sdud/ /ba spu'i gseb nas sprul pa nyi khri 'gyed/ /ma rungs bdud rgol zhi ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /tsa ra ka yi srung ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /tsha gzer nyi ma 'bum gyi ngad phyungs la/ /dza lam bdud kyi rgol ba zhi bar mdzod/ /wa le rnal 'byor ma la gsol btab mthus/ /zhwa ltar gtsug rgyan rlangs chen dpal seng gdung*/ /za ma tsam yang dbyer med rtag tu skyongs/ /'a cag rig 'dzin gdung ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /ya yol mi dmigs 'dod rgu'i dngos grub stsol/ /ra ltar gyong ba 'khor ba'i rigs drug tshogs/ /la la tsam las mtho ris dka' lags pas/ /sha stag ye shes mkha' 'gros 'dren par mdzod/ /sa gsum skye dgu'i mgon gyur dpal lha mo/ /ha lo'i dri bsung char ltar 'gyed tshims nas/ /a wa dhū ti'i 'ching ba kun grol shog / ces ti sgro las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba bsdus pa tshigs su bcad du smra ba 'di nyid rlangs chen dpal gyi seṅge'i gdung rigs las bskrun pa'i sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rjes shing sbrul lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes la dge/ bkra shis par shog/ // ༈ khrag 'thung padma drag po'i gtor zlog phas rgol dpung 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i gtum drag shugs/ /rigs sngags 'khor lo'i rnam rol ba/ /dbang drag rdo rje srin po yi/ /gtor zlog phas rgol dpung 'joms bstan/ de la bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags thon zhing lta sgom gyi srog dang ldan pa'i sngags pas: rang gzhan gyi don du zlog pa'i phrin las spro ba la: sbyor ba sngon 'gro bca' gzhi dang*/ srung zlog dngos kyi las gzhung bsrang*/ mtha' sdud gtong 'debs zor las so/ dang po ni/ spyi ltar bca' ba'i gnas khang yid du mchis par go mtshon spyan gzigs sna tshogs sogs brjid par bris pa'i dkyil du drag po'i mchod gtor dang sman raka chos srung spyi dang bye brag gi gtor ma chad brtan nyer spyod sogs bshams pa'i mdun lta bu la/

spyir ni spu gri bdun bskor las/ stegs bu che chung gang rung bar: khrag chen dug gi chag chag gdab: zhing rgyus bha su'i thig gdab la: ma traṃ sngo skya yan lag bgrad: mgo bo lho nub rkang pa ni: byang shar bstan pa'i lto ba ru: gru gsum dmar nag zla gam khrag: phyi rol rtsibs sngon bcu drug go: 'khor yug dur khrod rdau mes bskor: las dkyil rdul mtshon nam chu mtshon gyis bris pa dang: e dbus brub khung sum brtsegs nang: liṅga shi lteb mtshon skud bcings: thod ngan nang gzhug brub khung bcug: dur g.yam dur lo can gyis bcad: steng du lcags sam seng phur gzug: ces las dkyil gyi dbus su dgra bgegs gang la bya ba'i liṅga gzhung bzhin bcas pa brub khung du bcug la bzhag: man khri la brten lcags snod du: gtso 'khor gtor zlog phyag rtsang dang: tshe nyungs sha tshil ling chung dang : dar sna lnga yi rgyal mtshan gzug: steng nas sprin chen srung 'khor phub: bcu drug rtsibs steng dmar gtor re: rtsang gzhi sha tshil tshe nyungs brgyan: zhes dang*/ smad las rlung gi 'khor lo las/ drag po'i lcags snod la sogs su: ma traṃ sa gzhi legs par bcag: de dbus chos 'byung bsnol ma brtsegs: phyi rol gnam lcags rtsibs bcu drug: de steng khyung dang ging yab yum: ma mo bzhi bcas tshang bar bsham: dar nag gdugs dang tsa ka li: srung zlog 'khor lo dag kyang btsugs: phyag rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig la: phyi rtsang drug cu rtsa bzhi'o: dmar chen la sogs gzhung bzhin bsham: mda' dar sna lnga brgyan ldan spras: thun rdzas sogs ni zhib tu bsags: zhes las dkyil dbus su maṇḍal khar lcags gzhong du 'bru nag khrag chang gis sbrus pa chos 'byung bsnol ma'i khar dmar gtor gru gsum thog mdel lta bu la/ chos 'byung gi zur dang mtshams rnams su dmar gtor dgu dang mtha' skor du mtheb skyu bcad kha phyir bstan lnga/ bsad khrag gis byugs la/

phyag rtsang nyer gcig dang*/ phyi rtsang drug cu rtsa bzhi/ tshe nyungs/ sha tshil/ g.yas su snying dang g.yon du snying gcus/ rgyu rlon/ me ri sogs drag brgyan dang*/ dar gdugs sna lnga/ tsakli/ zlog 'khor bcas gzug /las dkyil gyi rtsibs bcu drug gi khar dmar gtor re la phyi rtsang bzhi re dang*/ tshe nyungs/ sha tshil la sogs pas brgyan zhing bha sus sbrel lo/ spu gri bdun bskor las/ gzhan yang phye rdzas: rgya tshil dang: phag tshil: rta bong : khyi spyang brun: gu gul: mdze skra: yugs sa'i zhabs sa: thun rdzas: dug sna: khrag sna dang : ke tshe: shang tshe yungs dkar nag: lcags phye: zangs phye: rdo phye rnams thod ngan nam ni ra nang blugs: 'khor yug stag sham thod phreng gis: sgab dkris khru gang tsam du bya: rang dri kha rlangs rdul ma shor: zhes pa ltar bshams pa'i mdun du/ dug chang sbyar ba'i mchod yon dang*/ mkhris pa'i zhabs bsil dbang po'i me tog /tshil chen byugs pa'i bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ khrag mkhris sbyar ba'i dri chab/ sha khrag gis zhal zas rnams sbreng tshar du bsham/ gzhan yang dmar gtor/ g.yab dar/ yungs thun/ rnga gling rol mo'i bye brag ji ltar dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po spyi gzhung bsrang ba ni/ spu gri bdun bskor las/ las kyi gzhung bsrangs bdag mdun gsal: zhes pas brgyud 'debs nas bzung gzhung bsrangs pas ting 'dzin rnam gsum mjug tu:

oṃ swa bhā wa shuddho badzra ātma ko3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod sa gzhi'i dbus: 'byung ba rim brtsegs dmar chen rgya mtsho 'khyil: keng rus gar bsgyur gcan gzan sna tshogs ngar: de dbus rab 'jigs drag po'i thod mkhar ni: rngam stabs rab 'jigs me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil: rakta khrag gi rgya mtsho kyi li li: ru tra'i snying khar chos 'byung 'khor lo'i dbus: srid pa las kyi drag rdzas 'dus pa yi: dmar nag gtor ma dbal ldan ri rab tsam: drag po'i rtsang dang sha khrag liṅgas brgyan: rno dbal thog dang myur mgyogs rlung gis shugs: phyi ni gtor ma nang ni khro bo'i mkhar: ru tra'i snying las grub pa'i pho brang du: de dbus ti ra baṃ chen bsnol ba yi: tsha grang nyi zla 'khrugs pa'i gdan du gsal: oṃ badzra tsand+ra sūrya ti ra baṃ tiṣṭha sa ma ya lhan: zhes bzlog gtor byin gyis brlab/ de'i mjug se gol gcig gis bdag mdun so sor me ri 'dab 'byar gyi tshul du ma yin pa/ ye shes rtsal 'bar gyi tshul du bskyed pa'i spyan 'dren mchod bstod sogs cho ga gcig gis bgyis pa'am/ yang na gzhung ltar bdag bskyed bsnyen pa'i bar grub nas mdun bskyed gong gi bzlog gtor byin brlabs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha badzra ātma ko3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod sa gzhi'i dbus: 'byung ba rim brtsegs dmar chen rgya mtsho 'khyil: keng rus gar bsgyur gcan gzan sna tshogs ngar: de dbus rab 'jigs drag po'i thod mkhar ni: rngam stabs nag 'jigs me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil: rakta khrag gi rgya mtsho kyi li li: ru tra'i snying khar chos 'byung 'khor lo'i dbus: srid pa las kyi drag rdzas 'dus pa yi: dmar nag gtor ma dbal ldan ri rab tsam: drag po rtsang dang sha khrag liṅgas brgyan: rno dbal thog dang myur mgyogs rlung gi shug: phyi ni gtor ma nang ni khro bo'i mkhar: ru tra'i snying las grub pa'i pho brang gyur:

de dbus ti ra bam chen bsnol ba yi: tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i nyi zla gdan du gsal: oṃ badzra tsand+ra sūrya ti ra baṃ tiṣṭha sa ma ya lhan: hūm̐: de steng ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ spel steng : gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ sgra can: me ri tshwa tshwa si li li: dran rdzogs padma he ru ka: khro rgyal drag po thod phreng rtsal: dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar 'khrugs: sogs lha bskyed dang spyan 'dren mchod bstod rnams byed/ gnyis pa bye brag thun bzhir dbye ba las/ thor thun bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sngags dang hūm̐ sgrub mthar bdag nyid mi shigs pa'i go bgo ba ni/ hoḥ skad cig g-is rang nyid dpal chen khro rgyal zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi gyad kyis dor stabs su bya khyung brdzis pa: yum dbyings phyug gtum mor 'khyud c-ing bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: phyi rol rdo rje dang ral gri me dpung 'bar ba'i gur chen po: bskal pa'i rlung bgrod du med pa bar snang thams cad lcags sdig dang bya khyung sbrul nag dug gi phag rgod rnams kyis gtams pas: nang du khro bo rdo rje drag po dkar gsal rdo rje dang gri thod 'dzin pa dpag tu med pas srung ba'i sngags sgra sgrogs shing che ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur: oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa: bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūm̐ dmar nag 'bar ba'i rang bzhin can: thig le'i nang du bla ma snang ba mtha' yas: zla tshes la thod phreng yab yum: mgo sked la bdag srog nṛ yig ljang ku: ha khog tu bsrung bya pho thams cad g.yas: mo thams cad g.yon: zhabs kyu'i nang du zhing khang nor rdzas rnams chud de srung ba'i rang bzhin phyi rol sngags rnams rang sgra dang bcas te 'khor bar gyur: oṃ ma hā gu ru padma he ru ka dzñā na ghṛ wa kro ti shwa rī ma ma nṛ bhrūm̐ bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig: badzra rakṣa swā hā:

zhes gang mang bzla'o/ mthar thun gtor 'bul/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying stong tshig rnams spyi ltar bya'o/ snga thun la spu gri bdun skor las/ lha sruung mchod cing las la bskul: ma nyes dpang gzug bden pa bdar: dgra bgegs 'gugs bstim lha dang dbye: bdud sprod byad gzhug drag sngags bzlas: thun gyis brab cing mnan gzir bstab: zhes pa ltar/ chos srung spyi dang bye brag gi bskang gsol rnams rgyas par bya zhing tshogs mchod bskang bshags bar btang la gser skyems gzu dpang 'gugs gzhug lha dbye bdud sprad rnams bsgral las ltar dang*/ zhes pas thog mar/ mnga' gsol bya ba ni/ gser skyems gtor chung rakta sogs bsham/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung padma he ru ka: srid gsum dbang sdud dregs pa bran du bskol: snang mtha'i thugs las sprul pa khro bo'i rgyal: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: chos sku'i mnga' gsol skye med thugs dang ldan: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: longs sku'i mnga' gsol rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs 'gyed: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: sprul sku'i mnga' gsol dmar nag khro zhing gtum: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: lha dbang mnga' gsol dbu la rigs lnga'i khyung : de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: khro bo'i mnga' gsol dpal chas bcu yis brgyan: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: khro mo'i mnga' gsol dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: srid gsum mnga' gsol bya khyung mthing nag zhon: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: dpa' bo'i mnga' gsol ye shes ging bzhis bskor: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: mkha' 'gro'i mnga' gsol las kyi ma mo sdud: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: chos skyong mnga' gsol mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs:

de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: pho nya'i mnga' gsol khyung dang phag sdig 'gyed: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: bstan srung mnga' gsol bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod: de bzhin? drag rtsal mnga' gsol klu bdud sa bdag 'dul: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: myur mgyogs mnga' gsol ma mos dal yams 'joms: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: mthu stobs mnga' gsol rgyal bsen snying khrag 'thung : de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: shan pa'i mnga' gsol dam nyams srog dbugs phral: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: yul lha'i mnga' gsol lo nyes sad ser zhi: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: dam tshig mnga' gsol rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyongs: de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo: hūm̐: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rakta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling gtor ma'i mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: sgra snyan rol mo'i dbyangs kyis mnga' gsol lo: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas gnyan pos? phyi nang mchod pa rgya mtshos? rin chen gser skyems phud kyis? sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mnga' gsol lo: dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod par? dge 'dun dgon sde skyong bar? bar chad bdud bzhi bsgral bar mnga' gsol lo: 'go ba'i nad rims 'joms par? lo nyes sad ser zhi bar mnga' gsol lo: dus 'khrug mtshon bskal zhi bar? sgrub la mchog thun stsol bar mnga' gsol lo: tshe yi rig 'dzin 'grub par? lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs? gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gser skyems bdud rtsi sman raka gis gtor ma bran zhing nam mkhar gtor ro: de nas liṅga bsgral ba ni: bsgral chas sna tshogs bsags: lcags snod nang du liṅga bzhag la dang po gser skyems ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam can:

mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs shig: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: rdzu 'phrul dpa' ba'i brtul zhugs rtsal phyungs shig: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bstan srung thugs dam can: yul gnas dben ri gnyan po skyong ba dang: mkha' la rgyu ba'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams: rin chen gser skyems? deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rogs dan sgrubs: dam nyams ru tra'i mgon skyabs ma byed cig: mthu ldan srung ma phrin las dus la bab: brnag pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: rnal 'byor pa drag po'i chas su zhugs te/ rdo rje phur bu thogs la/ hūm̐: bdag ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug mthu stobs dbang : rtsal chen bdud dpung 'joms pa'i ngo bor gsal: thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog kī la ya: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug phur bu bsgril: byad ma 'byung po sgrol ba'i rang bzhin gsal: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas hom̐ bskyed pa ni/ phaṭḥ mdun du las kyi brub khung nag po gnam lcags las grub pa'i zur gsum pa nag la 'thug pa dmar la rngams pa: kha dog la gting zab pa: zin nas thar pa med pa'i nang du: dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs sngo la ham pa skya la rid pa mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can: bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa: mgon skyabs kyi lha srung dang bral ba zhig tu gyur: phaṭḥ na mo drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi? khyad par du yang rig 'dzin thod phreng yab yum mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa'i? khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum ging bzhi sha za khyung gi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : bden pa chen po la brten nas: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra:

rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra: mi min mi ru brdzu ba: lha min lha ru brdzu ba: mi bdag la lha med zer ba: lha khyod la mthu med zer ba: khyad par nad bdag pho mo nad mkhar dang bcas pa: dmag jag 'khrug pa'i sna 'dren pa'i dam nyams dgra bo bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i byad ma: 'dre rgod 'byung po gdug pa'i tshogs thams cad rang dbang med par gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ratna pā sha hūm̐: padma spho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ de nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ hūm̐: shar phyogs ma mo sdig gdong ma: sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bsnams: sprul pa lcags sdig bye ba 'bum: shar phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung: oṃ ma mo duṣṭān dgra bo a karṣa ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: lho phyogs ma mo chu srin gdong: sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na 'ching byed zhags pa thogs: sprul pa dug sbrul bye ba 'bum: lho phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung : oṃ ma mo ra tsa ya dgra bo a karṣa ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: nub phyogs ma mo phag gdong ma: sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na sdom pa'i lcags sgrog thogs: sprul pa dug gi phag rgod 'bum: nub phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung: oṃ ma mo raksha ya dgra bo a karṣa ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: byang phyogs ma mo khyung gdong ma: sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na myos byed dril bu bsnams: sprul pa me yi bya khyung 'bum: byang phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung : oṃ ma mo ma tsa bhyo dgra bo a karṣa ya dza dzaḥ de nas dgra bo lha dang dbye ba ni: bya rog 'ug pa'i sgro thogs la: hūm̐: kha khā mu kha bya rog gdong:

hu lu mu kha 'ug pa'i gdong: las kyi ma mo dmar nag gnyis: dam nyams dgra bo lha dang phyes: pha lha ma lha zhang lha phyes: skyes lha yul lha dgra lha phyes: mgon skyabs ban bon srung ma phyes: lha dang phyes la bdud dang sprod: lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang phyes: mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud dang sprod: 'chi bdag srog gcod bdud dang sprod: las ngan nyon mongs bdud dang sprod: nyams pa'i dgra bo byad ma 'di: lha dbye bdud sprod dus la bab: shan pa ma mo mthu ma chung: rdul phran bzhin du brlag mdzod cig: oṃ kha khā mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: ru tra thun bhyo: dgra bo shag phyes: myog thun baṃ ril dgra bo shag phyes: mā ra ma dun dgra bo shag phyes: zhes dang*/ byad du gzhug pa ni mnan gzhung bzhin bya/ spu gri bdun bskor las/ bsad las la/ mdun du brub khung gi steng du gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rno ngar lci zhing 'thas pa g.yas su 'khor zhing 'og phyogs srid pa'i gzhi 'dzin khro chu zhun ma'i 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor ba: spu gri so 'thab drag tu bskyod pas byad ma rnams sha khrag dmar nyil nyil gtub pa la: las kyi pho nya rnams hab sgra di ri ri 'tshub cing zos par bsam: yang phyi rol zlog byed kyi khro bos zlog sngags dang bsad sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs par gyur: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma nṛ tri trig nan e hur thum badzra rbad bhyoḥ oṃ trig khroṃ bhyoḥ mā ra du byad ma bzlog bzlogaḥ ces las gang bsgrub kyi sngags kyi mthar/ mnan gzhung ltar thun brdeg dang las kyi gnyer gtad do/ de nas phur bu thogs la/ hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: khro rgyal badzra kī la ya: mgo bo rgya mdud 'brug stong ldir: 'chang gzung sgra gcan glog dmar 'khyugs: chu srin kha nas thog ser 'bebs: zur gsum shan pa gri thogs 'bum: byad ma bdud 'dul kī la ya:

bsgral zhing gtub bo mā ra ya: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya: dgra bo tsitta bhandha bhandha mā ra mā ra ha la ha la thun rbad: de nas rnam shes spar ba ni/ 'o khyod kyi rnam shes āḥdakar po zh-ig tu gyur te phur pa'i khong seng nas thon te snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs kar thim par mos shig: phaṭḥ ces sangs rgyas kyi zhing du spar: de nas thun sna tshogs brdeg cing*/ hūm̐: yungs thun khro bo nyi li li: khrag thun nad rlangs phyu ru ru: dug thun rlung dmar chi li li: rdo thun rbab rgod sha ra ra: me thun tshwa tshwa si li li: mtshon thun bu yug tshubs se tshub: zangs thun lcags thun spungs se spung: thun rdzas sna tshogs dgra la phob: dgra bo lnga phung rdul du rlog: oṃ thun da ye rbad da ye: na lo shag: rbad rbad: ces brdeg de nas ral gri thogs la/ hūm̐: ma mo mched bzhi dus la bab: dug lnga bsgral ba'i phung po 'di: gtub cing phye mar dkrugs par gyis: oṃ ma mo ma dun bhyoḥ khaḍga ya dgra bo'i sha khrag daun snying lnga la rbad bhyo bhyoḥ chod chod: gtub gtub: myog myog: baṃ ril rbad: de nas lha la mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes shig: dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: phung po khams dang skye mched tshogs drug bcas: rngam yangs chos nyid 'bar ba'i zhal du bzhes: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi:

tshogs la rol zhing lhag gtor 'bul/ padma drag po'i dkyil 'khor du? tshogs smon grub rjes bzlog mdos gso zhing raktas bran: srod thun la ling ro gtor mar bstab cing*/ 'bul gtor sha tshil dang las gtor tshe yungs kyis brgyan pa bshams la/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: 'jigs byed che btsan padma he ru kaḥ snang srid lha srin 'dus pa'i dbus nas bzhengs: deng 'dir thugs dam bskul lo dmag dpung skyed: khrag 'thung mngon spyod las la bskul ba'i tshe: sku mdog dmar nag me zer ya la la: zhal nas hūm̐ sgra drag po chems se chem: phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha zings se zing: sgro gshog tshwa tshwa skar ltar si li li: dur khrod chas brgyad bgegs dpung sa la bsgyel: dor stabs gyad kyi gling bzhi lto bar bcug: ye shes khro bo sprul pa'i dmag tshogs 'bum: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog khro mo gtum chen zhal: mthing nag skur ston chos nyid rang bzhin can: khro gtum spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing byad ma sngangs: rus pa'i rgyan ldan mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung sdud: zangs gri 'bar bas bstan dgra'i mgo lus phral: sha za khro chen dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: ༈ hūm̐: dmar nag me phreng khro rgyal yab yum gyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rab 'byams dpal: thugs rje rmad byung dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo drag rtsal bskyed: 'og min dbyings rig zang thal 'od lnga'i klong: snang mtha' bde gshegs zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis: rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: dug lnga bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: dung khang gnam lcags 'khor lo'i gzhal yas nas:

'jam dpal gshin rje yab yum sras dang 'khor: lnga bcu rtsa dgu 'jigs byed sku yi lha: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: longs spyod zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas nas: dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum sras dang 'khor: dgu bcu rtsa drug drag sngags gsung gi lha: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: 'gyur med zab gsal rdo rje'i gzhal yas nas: rdo rje gtum po yab yum sras dang 'khor: lnga bcu rtsa brgyad yang dag thugs kyi lha: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: sprul pa chos 'byung ye shes gzhal yas nas: thugs rje khros ma sde lnga rigs dang 'khor: bdun bcu rtsa gnyis rbod gtong ma mo'i lha: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: drag rtsal me rlung 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas nas: yaksha me dbal che btsan dregs pa'i 'khor: sde dpon sum cu 'jig rten mchod bstod lha: thugs dam dbyings? dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: las bzhi lhun grub 'khor lo'i gzhal yas nas: stobs ldan drag rtsal sras mchog rigs bzhi'i dpal: sngags bdag bco brgyad dmod pa drag sngags lha: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: ༈ hūm̐: ye shes las kyi dmag tshogs khrag 'thung pa: ging chen yab yum mtshon char si li li: bya khyung dmag tshogs gshog sgra 'u ru ru: ma mo'i dmag tshogs bhyo sgra ti ri ri:

lcags sdig tshogs ni 'dur ldang chems se chem: dug gi phag rgod mche ba thams se tham: dug sbrul nag po 'khyug 'greng khyugs se khyug: las kyi shan pa gri gug zings se zing: dmag dpung skyed cig srung ma dam tshig can: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam tshig gnyan gyi gzhal yas nas: dbyings kyi bka' srung bswe yi lha mo bzhi: las kyi ma mo dge bsnyen sde bzhi bcas: dam tshig bzhin du ma g.yel sa ma ya: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: bskul lo thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: dmag dpung skyed la ru mtshon phyor: zlog sngags mtshon cha'i 'khor lo skor: drag sngags rdo rje'i ser chen phob: nad dal chod la nad mkhar shigs: 'byung po dam sri rmang nas phyungs: rig 'dzin srung ma thugs dam can: drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul zh-ing ye shes khro bo'i dmag tshogs go mtshon thogs pa grangs med 'phros pas 'byung po nad bdag thams cad 'joms par bsgom: de nas gtor mdos la raktas bran zhing*/ khro bo'i tshogs rnams zhal phyir gzigs shing bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ yang bzlog me yi spu gri dmar po ni/ hūm̐: rang byung dur khrod pho brang e yi klong: gru gsum me ri 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs byed padma khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'phros pa yis: 'byung bzhi tshe yi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: g.yas zhal dkar po dgyes la khro ba yis: yi dam lha yi bka' chad bzlog tu gsol: g.yon zhal mthing nag rab tu rngam pa yis: ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags bzlog? dbus zhal dmar po gtum la 'khrugs pa yis: rtsa rlung dbang thang nyams p

spyan dgu sdang mig phyogs bcur 'khyil ba yis: phyogs skyong bcu yi gnod p mche ba dkar po ri ltar gtsigs pa yis: khro bo bcu yi zil gnon bzlog tu? shangs nas drag po'i rlung dmar g.yo ba yis: ma gshin gdug pa'i bsun m zhal nas hūm̐ sgra drag po sgrogs pa yis: ban bon sngags pa'i byad kha bzlog tu gsol: bya khyung rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa yis: steng phyogs lha yi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: dug sbrul nag pos dbu skra bcings pa yis: 'og phyogs lha srin ma rungs bzlog tu gsol: thod skam 'bar ba'i tshal lngas brgyan pa yis: lha srin gdug pa'i dal kha bzlog tu gsol: sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar ba yis: srid pa las kyi cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: phyag g.yas dang pos gri gug phyar ba yis: pho rgyud dmod pa'i drag sngags bzlog tu gsol: g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag bsnams pa yis: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags bzlog tu gsol: g.yas kyi bar pas rdo rje 'dzin pa yis: ma rungs gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: g.yon gyi bar pas lcags sdig 'dzin pa yis: rgyal 'gong dam sri'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: g.yas kyi mtha' mas me dpung bsnams pa yis: lus ngag bsregs mnan bskrad pa bzlog tu gsol: g.yon gyi mtha' mas sbrul zhags bsnams pa yis: klu yi gtad khram ngan pa bzlog tu gsol: g.yas kyi rdo rje sgro gshog brgyangs pa yis: ye shes khro bo'i bka' chad bzlog tu gsol: g.yon gyi rin chen sgro gshog brgyangs pa yis: 'jig rten mkha' 'gros bar chad bzlog tu gsol: glang ko zhing lpags stag sham brjid pa yis: srid pa las kyi g.yo 'khrug bzlog tu gsol: thod phreng khrag zhag tshom bus brgyan pa yis: 'byung po dam sri'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: stag sham rus rgyan dug sbrul brgyan pa yis: pha rol mi kha dmod tshig bzlog tu gsol: me ri dmar nag klong na bzhugs pa yis:

ngag mnan bskrad gzir gtad pa bzlog tu gsol: gsang ba'i khro mo'i sku la 'khril ba yis: nyon mongs dug lnga'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: bya khyung mthing nag me gshog brdzes pa yis: gnyan rgod lhog yams dmar bshal bzlog tu gsol: ༈ hūm̐: che mchog drag po thod phreng yab yum gyi: zhing khams rgyan rdzogs dbyings kyi ye shes bcu: snang mtha' bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs kyis: nyon mongs dug lnga'i nad gdon bzlog tu gsol: 'jigs byed 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs kyis: rgya nad rgyu gzer dal yams bzlog? dbang chen rngam drag gsung gi lha tshogs kyis: btsan sri rta nad gzer thab bzlog tu gsol: yang dag gtum po thugs kyi lha tshogs kyis: smyo 'bog snying gzer rlung nad bzlog tu gsol: drag byed khro mo rbod gtong ma tshogs kyis: mtshon 'khrug nad dal dmar yams bzlog tu gsol: stobs ldan yaksha dregs 'dul lha tshogs kyis: lha srin spyi g.yos chad pa bzlog tu gsol: phyag g.yas me long badzra kī la yas: zhe sdang lha bu'i bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol: phyag g.yon mnyam nyid ratna kī la yas: nga rgyal phung po'i bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol: zhabs g.yas sor rtog padma kī la yas: 'dod chags nyon mongs bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol: zhabs g.yon bya grub karma kī la yas: phrag dog 'chi bdag bdud tshogs bzlog tu gsol: ye shes las kyi sprul pa bye ba 'bum: sngon las 'phral rkyen ngan pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐ bhyo: sku sprul gshed chen bcu gnyis kyis: lus kyi bar chad dgra bgegs zlog: gsung sprul khams brgyad me 'brug gis: ngag gi bar chad dgra bgegs zlog: thugs sprul dbang mo nyer brgyad kyis: yid kyi bar chad dgra bgegs? yon tan sman mo nga brgyad kyis: rtsa rlung bar chad dgra bgegs zlog: phrin las sde dpon sum cu yis: thugs kyi bar chad dgra bgegs zlog: phur 'debs ma mo bcu gnyis kyis:

sgrub pa'i bar chad dgra bgegs zlog: sngags bdag dmod pa bco brgyad kyis: dngos su bsdo ba'i dgra bgegs zlog: ༈ hūm̐: khram kha nag po gshin rje'i gdon: gzi byin stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'chi bdag zhags thogs bdud kyi gdon: drag shul stobs kyis bzlog? shwa kha thogs pa btsan gyi gdon: gtum pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'chi bdag zhags thogs bdud kyi gdon: drag shul stobs kyis bzlog? nad rkyal thogs pa ma mo'i gdon: rngam pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: bse rag chung sri 'gong po'i gdon: khro bo'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: smyo 'bog snying gzir rgyal bsen gdon: gshe ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: god sri 'thab 'khon yul gyi 'dre: sgeg pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: lo nyes sad ser 'byung 'khrug gdon: dpa' ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: dbang thang bdud dang g.yang kha nyam: rgod pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: dus 'khrug mtshon cha'i dal 'bab rnams: mthu rtsal stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: shar gyi sgrol ging chen po yis: ma mo'i rims nad bzlog tu gsol: lho yi gtum ging chen po yis: sa bdag zha grum bzlog tu gsol: nub kyi khro ging chen po yis: lhog yams dmar bshal bzlog tu gsol: byang gi las ging chen po yis: tre tre khrag skyugs bzlog tu gsol: yum chen ging mo mched bzhi yis: rims nad me lce bzlog tu gsol: sprul pa'i bya khyung sde lnga yis: klu srin 'byung po bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: las kyi ma mo mched bzhi yis: bdun drug rgya nad bzlog tu gsol: phag sdig khyung dang dug sbrul gyis: mdze nad bco brgyad bzlog tu gsol: sprul pa yang sprul dmag tshogs kyis: rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong zlog: ༈ hūm̐ bhyo: phyi khyams mu ran skyong ba yi: dpal gyi bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis:

dbyings kyi ma mo 'khrugs pa zlog: 'jigs byed ging chen bco brgyad kyis: dug gsum 'khrugs pa'i dgra bgegs zlog: 'bar ma gnod sbyin ma brgyad kyis: 'jig rten srid pa'i gdug rtsub zlog: sa bdag ma mo so gnyis kyis: dbang chen sde bzhi'i gnod 'tshe zlog: ma mo bdun dang srin mo bzhis: gza' klu 'khrugs pa'i chad pa zlog: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi yis: las mkhan ru log byed pa zlog: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro mas: mi nad phyugs nad dal yams zlog: bka' skyong bswe yi lha mo bzhis: log lta gshe skur sgrogs pa zlog: gter srung dge bsnyen sde bzhi yis: zab chos spel ba'i sgab 'dre zlog: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis: gdul bya phrin las 'gags pa zlog: srid pa'i lha gnyan che dgu yis: rtswa 'bu sad ser than chen zlog: yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad kyis: mi kha phung sbyor gros ngan zlog: mgon rten srung ma thams cad kyis: chag chen nyam nga ma lus zlog: ༈ hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: gnyan lhog sbos 'gas nag po zlog: me dbal sha 'khol khrag skyugs zlog: tre tre gnyan rgod rgyugs 'gyel zlog: mdze nad tsha gzer rims nad zlog: rgya nad rgyu gzer khong lhog zlog: srin glang tarpa dug mda' zlog: 'go nad snying gzer khrag bshal zlog: 'brum bu dkar nag me dbal zlog: nad bdag choms la nad mkhar shigs: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra trag sha ya rbad bhyoḥ kha thun nag po nad bdag gi snying la rbad rbad: nad bdag a purtsi ma tha ma tha rbad rbad: ga ru ṭa pakṣiṃ nad bdag pho mo'i snying la rbad rbad: bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: shig shig ha la ya rbad thun mā ra ya nan nan: zhes zlog sngags rnams tshar gsum du bzla'o/ ༈ de nas rtsang bzlog ni/ hūm̐: drag po'i dur khrod rab 'jigs gnas mchog tu: las mkhan ging gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: myur mgyogs rngam pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs nas kyang:

khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur zhe sdang rang bzhin can: rtse la me 'bar srid gsum wa la la: rtsa bar mun pa khrag mtsho kyi li li: sked pa nga rgyal thog ser sha ra ra: drwa mig phrag dog rlung dmar 'u ru ru: logs su nga rgyal dug rlangs chi li li: dmar nag drag po'i rtsang phur hrangs se hrang : bha su ska rags zhags pa brengs se breng : zlog sngags rbad bskul dmod pa hrangs se hrang : khrag 'thung drag po'i rno dbal rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i dal kha zlog: klu srin lhog yams 'bebs pa zlog: sa bdag zha grum gtong ba zlog: gnyan mdze rgyugs 'gyel bdun drug zlog: khrag skyugs tre tre nag po zlog: sha khol dmar bshal 'brum bu zlog: rgya nad gzer thum smyo 'bog zlog: rkyen ngan bar chad dgra la zlog: oṃ khroṃ kro ta ya bhyoḥ dza tri rbad tri ya bhyoḥ nad bdag shaṃ long ya bhyoḥ nad mkhar ru tri ya shig: trig khroṃ mā ra ya: nad bdag 'byung po kha thaṃ rbad ch-ing ching bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol/ ༈ padma khrag 'thung gi bzlog pa grangs gsog ni/ hūm̐: rang byung dur khrod pho brang e yi klong: gru gsum me ri 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs byed padma khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: khram kha nag po gshin rje'i gdon: gzi byin stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'chi bdag zhags thogs bdud kyi gdon: drag shul stobs kyis bzlog? shwa kha thogs pa btsan gyi gdon: gtum pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'chi bdag zhags thogs bdud kyi gdon: drag shul stobs kyis bzlog? nad rkyal thogs pa ma mo'i gdon: rngam pa'i stobs kyis? bse rag chung sri 'gong po'i gdon: khro bo'i stobs kyis? smyo 'bog snying gzir rgyal bsen gdon: gshe ba'i stobs kyis? god sri 'thab 'khon yul gyi 'dre: sgeg pa'i stobs kyis? lo nyes sad ser 'byung 'khrug gdon: dpa' ba'i stobs kyis? dbang thang bdud dang g.yang kha nyam: rgod pa'i stobs kyis? dus 'khrug mtshon cha dal 'bab rnams: mthu rtsal stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i dal kha zlog: klu srin lhog yams 'bebs pa zlog: sa bdag zha grum gtong ba zlog: gnyan mdze rgyugs 'gyel bdun drug zlog: khrag skyugs tre tre nag po zlog: sha khol dmar bshal 'brum bu zlog: rgya nad gzer thum smyo 'bog zlog: rkyen ngan bar chad dgra la zlog: oṃ khroṃ kro ta ya bhyoḥ dza tri rbad tri ya bhyoḥ nad bdag shaṃ long la ya bhyoḥ nad mkhar ru tra ya shig: trig khroṃ mā ra ya: nad bdag 'byung po kha tham rbad ch-ing: bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces gter gzhung las gu hyas khol du phyung ba'o// // padma khrag 'thung gi stong bzlog sogs grangs gsog bsdu na/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings ka dag drag po e yi klong*/

/lhun grub rang rtsal padma he ru ka /dbyings rig zung 'jug klong nas skur bzhengs la/ /nyon mongs bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dus 'khrugs phyi yi rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol/ /'byung 'khrugs nang gi nad gdon bzlog tu gsol/ /sems 'khrugs gsang ba'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /bzlog go dug lnga ye shes lnga ru zlog /bsgyur ro rnam rtog bag chags dbyings su sgyur/ /bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ padma khrag 'thung gi bzlog pa'i grangs gsog ched 'di bzhin bris zhes rang slob au ḍī ming gis ched bskul bzhin gu hyas smras rim bzhin bskul ba pos bris pa dge'o// // dgong thun la bzlog dmigs ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen phyag rgya yongs rdzogs pa: stong gsum zil gnon 'jig rten g.yo zhing 'khrugs: sde brgyad gnod byed sgab 'dre rbod gtong rnams: dbang med 'dar chum bla rten srog yid 'phrog: zlog byed khro tshogs drag sngags stobs ldan pas: byad ma rang gshed dbab nas brlag par gyur: zhes mos la oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ: āḥhūm̐: byad ma nṛ tri trig nan: e thum dza rbad bhyoḥ oṃ trig khroṃ bhyoḥ mā ra ya du byad ma zlog: bhyo mā ra ya rbad: hūm̐ bandhe sha ya myog: mya lo sha ya rbad: ti lo sha ya rbad: nu lo sha ya rbad: bandhe brag tshal pa: srog rtsa chod: snying rtsa chod: rtsad nas chod: drungs nas phyungs: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la rbod gtong phur kha gnod pa thams cad dam nyams dgra la a mu ka phyes: phye mar phur ya dzaḥ shing tring mā ra ya rbad: ces zlog sngags tshar gsum bzlas nas man ngag gzhung bzhin mthar/ na mo: bla ma sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang: mkha' 'gro chos skyong byin rlabs dang: gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen:

chag che nyam nga rmi ltas rtsub: rbod gtong rbad 'dre zor thun hom̐: byad phur gtad khram phung sel ngan: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi tshogs: sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi: bdud sde dpung dang bcas pa rnams: bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: dgra bgegs steng du mā ra ya: nṛ tri sha truṃ hur thum dzaḥ bhyo bhyo zlog zlog hūm̐ yaṃ phaṭ: sogs dmod mo dang thal rdeb bcas pa bya zhing dmigs pa'i ngang du bskyang : de nas zor btegs la/ hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring dam nyams dgra la 'phen: lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung skyed: nyams pa'i dgra bo cham la phob: gtor zor dbal kha sha ra ra: drag sngags tshwa tshwa si li li: pho nya srog len khyugs se khyug: nam gyi phar ma tshur phyed la: dgra bo srog rtsa chod la shog: zor sna las byed shan pas drongs: dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma du na du bhyoḥ thun rtsa thun ya bhyoḥ rba du shag du bhyoḥ trig thuṃ gzer thuṃ bhyoḥ mā ra ya bhyoḥ sogs brjod pas hom du tshad cing dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i sogs gsol kha'i mtha' dbyung*/ chad brtan sogs rjes chog rnams bya'o 'di yan rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ltar ro/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa nyin tha ma zor 'phang ba'i skabs yin na gong gi bzlog pa grangs gsog grub ma thag mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i mchod bstod ni/ oṃ shrī he ru ka badzra arghaṃ sogs? pañtsa a mṛ ta ta na ga ṇa gu hya pū dza hoḥ bzlog pa'i mtha' bskor gyi mchod pa rnams bzlog par stob/ hūm̐ hrīḥ gtum chen drag shul dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams kun tu g.yo: bde stong ye shes snying rje khros pa'i tshul: padma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: yul phyogs 'gar bzlog dbang zhu srol yod pa ltar bya na skabs 'dir byas na legs par mngon/
