de'ang rtsa sngags sham dngos grub sngags sbyar bas chog par sems so/ de nas gtor ma'i ye shes pa nam mkhar btegs pa ni/ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kyis dbye ba'i rgyas: skad cig mdun bskyed gtor ma'i ye shes pa: nam mkhar gshegs shing gzu dpang mdzad par gyur: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ gis bsdu rgya bcas/ mdun bskyed dmar chen gtor ma'i dam tshig pa: bdag gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur: sa ma ya dgra bgegs ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ slar yang sngar bzhin gtor chen skad cig gis: khro gtum mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba: 'phang ba tsam gyis stong gsum brlag nus pa'i: ha la ha la'i sdong po chen por gyur: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ sa ma ya ha la ha la zor ya zor ya thun ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad sod phaṭḥ thun dang zor rdzas rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus la gral gsham nas bzung rim gyis slob dpon bar ljags sngags kyi rno ngar btags/ sde brgyad spyi chings kyi 'khor lo gdags/ spro na sde brgyad gser skyems yang 'don/ thog mar sgo dbye bya ba ni/ gser skyems rnams rim par btang zhing*/ dang po phyi yi gser skyems gtong ba ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon dag pa phyogs bcu rab 'byams na: bzhugs pa'i grub thob rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dang: zhi khro'i lha tshogs srung ma thugs dam can: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi la: gnas pa'i rgyal chen phyogs skyong bcu: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir drag po zor lam phyes: gtor zor dgra dang bgegs la 'phen: hūm̐: lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa dang: gzhi bdag dben ri skyong ba yi: mthu ldan srung ma thams cad kyis: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i zor lam phyes: gtor zor dgra dang bgegs la 'phen:

hūm̐: lo zla zhag dus dbang ba yi: gdong la gnas pa'i sa bdag dang : gza' skar 'gyu ba thams cad kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: zor gyi dbal kha 'phog srid kyis: dbu chums zhabs bskum g.yas g.yon byol: bdag ni ma nyes dgra bo nyes: nyes can dam nyams dgra bo la: 'phen pa zor gyi sna drongs shig: de nas nang du phyogs bzhir mchod la sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: shar phyogs sgo ma sdig gdong mas: lcags kyus mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang shar sgo phyes: bzhengs bskul dmag gi dpung skyed cig: hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo ma chu srin gdong: zhags pas mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang lho sgo phyes: bzhengs bskul dmag gi dpung skyed cig: hūm̐: nub phyogs sgo ma phag gdong mas: lcags sgrog gis mtshan lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang nub sgo phyes: bzhengs bskul dmag? hūm̐: byang phyogs sgo ma khyung gdong mas: dril bus mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: drag po'i pho brang byang sgo phyes: bzhengs bskul dmag gi dpung skyed cig: hūm̐: bzhengs shig khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: de ring drag po'i phrin las mdzod: nad dal mtshon gyi bskal pa choms: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces bskul te las dkyil gyi mdun du me hom̐ sbar bar brub khung gi liṅga dmag ston gyi tshul du man ngag bzhin bsregs par gsungs kyang deng sang phyag len du mdzad srol mi snang*/ mnan chas sna sel gyi dkar gtor/ ngar glud/ chad mdo/ rtsibs kyi gtor zor rnams brgyad tshan gcig bzhi tshan gnyis su dbye ba dang*/ gtor chen gyi rim par dpag la gong du bsgrubs pa'i thun lhag gis bran dpal 'bar sbar/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams:

mi mngon chos dbyings klong nas bzhengs: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab brten mdzod: dam las 'gal ba'i dgra bgegs la: bka' yi chad pa drag po phob: dmag 'khrug zhi ba'i dus la bab: mtshon bskal nyams pa'i dus la bab: nad yams bzlog pa'i dus la bab: rgyal bsen 'dul ba'i dus la bab: klu srin 'joms pa'i dus la bab: 'dre rgod bsgral ba'i dus la bab: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe: thad nas langs pa'i dgra bgegs 'di: myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ bhyo bhyoḥ 'byung po gnod byed thams cad zlog zlog: ngar glud bsngo/ za lam 'don/ chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ gtor ma dmag lto'i tshul du bzlog par stob/ hūm̐: sngon tshe me ri 'bar ba ru: bla ma thod phreng drag po dang : mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes gnyis: rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor phyes: steng 'og lha srin khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: de 'og ti sgro'i tshogs khang du: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas dang : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma sring gnas nyul khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa yis: ti sgro'i tshogs khang chen mo nas: gsang rgya zab gter bton pa'i tshe: las kyi ma mos khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: yang gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di: phyogs bcur spel ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti ḍā ka ḍākki ma mo ru lu bhyoḥ oṃ bha liṃ ta khā hi: dkar lam sbreng zhing*/ ru mtshon sogs kyis sna drangs 'phen sar bslebs pa dang*/ gong gi phyi'i gser skyems tshar gcig btang la zhes pas/ hūm̐: mi mngon dag pa phyogs bcu rab 'byams na: bzhugs pa'i grub thob rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dang: zhi khro'i lha tshogs srung ma thugs dam can:

rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi la: gnas pa'i rgyal chen phyogs skyong bcu: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir drag po zor lam phyes: gtor zor dgra dang bgegs la 'phen: hūm̐: lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa dang: gzhi bdag dben ri skyong ba yi: mthu ldan srung ma thams cad kyis: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i zor lam phyes: gtor zor dgra dang bgegs la 'phen: hūm̐: lo zla zhag dus dbang ba yi: gdong la gnas pa'i sa bdag dang : gza' skar 'gyu ba thams cad kyis: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: zor gyi dbal kha 'phog srid kyis: dbu chums zhabs bskum g.yas g.yon byol: bdag ni ma nyes dgra bo nyes: nyes can dam nyams dgra bo la: 'phen pa zor gyi sna drongs shig: dkar gtor 'phang phyogs su 'bul/ brub khung gi liṅga bton nas me hom 'bar tshang du mgo bo mthur bstan brgyang la/ dmigs bya 'gugs bstim bya ba ni/ phaṭḥ na mo drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi? khyad par du yang rig 'dzin thod phreng yab yum mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa'i? khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum ging bzhi sha za khyung gi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: bden pa chen po la brten nas: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra: mi min mi ru brdzu ba: lha min lha ru brdzu ba: mi bdag la lha med zer ba: lha khyod la mthu med zer ba: khyad par nad bdag pho mo nad mkhar dang bcas pa: dmag jag 'khrug pa'i sna 'dren pa'i dam nyams dgra bo: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i byad ma: 'dre rgod 'byung po gdug pa'i tshogs thams cad rang dbang med par gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig:

oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ratna pā sha hūm̐: padma spho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ de nas zor 'phen pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni che mchog khrag 'thung sku: nga ni snang srid kun gyi gtso: nga ni 'jigs byed kun gyi rje: nga ni mkha' 'gro kun gyi yab: nga ni snang srid kun gyi gnyen: steng nas khros shing chas pa'i tshe: stong khams me 'od 'u ru ru: nyi zla gza' skar cha la la: drag sngags 'brug sgra ldi ri ri: gnam lcags thog ser sha ra ra: pho rgyud chos skyong las la 'gyed: mo rgyud ma mo dbang du sdud: sde brgyad dregs pa gum gum chums: zhes bskor zhing thog mar khyung gi zor thogs la: hūm̐: srid pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ me gshog brdeb cing nad dal 'joms: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mchu sder can: khrom̐ khrom̐ nad bdag snying la khroṃ: chum chum klu gnyan snying la chums: myog myog sa bdag srog rtsa myog: 'gas 'gas nad bdag snying rtsa 'gas: thum thum rgyal bsen dam sri thums: rbad rbad lhog yams snying rtsa rbad: phyung phyung nad bdag rmang nas phyungs: chod chod myog thum trig sha bhyoḥ oṃ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa hūm̐ kro ta ya gardza ya trig khrom̐ ya gri khrom̐ ya nad bdag gdug pa'i srog la rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

ces 'phangs nas/ gdong mo bzhi yi zor thogs la/ hūm̐: sha za srin mo zangs mche can: khrag gi ral pa sha ra ra: g.yang gzhi rakta 'du ru ru: me 'bar tshwa tshwa si li li: rbad do ma mo las la chos: srin mo 'bum gyis zor sna drongs: brnag pa'i sangs rgyas bstan dgra sgrol: nad dal choms la nad bdag sgrol: 'byung po the'u rang rmang nas phyungs: dam sri 'dre mo'i snying khrag rol: gdug pa'i sa bdag klu srin chums: sprul pa'i lcags sdig dgra la bhyoḥ dug gi phag rgod dgra la bhyoḥ dug sbrul nag po dgra la bhyoḥ me yi bya khyung dgra la bhyoḥ dgra mkhar dgra yul rmang nas shigs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bhyo bhyoḥ ma rakmo rakṣa kro ti mu kha li bring bring myur myur: ru tra a mu ka mā ra mā ra: ma tha ma tha: bhandha bhandha: myog thum rbad dril zlog zlog: ces 'phang*/ de nas ging chen yab yum bzhi'i zor thogs la/ hūm̐: sgrol ba'i gri thogs yab yum bzhi: rbad cing pho nyar mngag pa'i tshe: shan pa srog la rngam pa bzhin: dgra bo'i mgo snying phrol la shog: mi rta nang tshan dkrugs la shog: nam gyi phar ma tshur phyed la: dgra bo'i bla srog chod la shog: snying khrag dron mo 'thung bar gyis: hūm̐: gtor zor drag po sha ra ra: mtshon cha'i bu yug chi li li: dug mda' nad rlangs thibs se thib: 'phen no drag po'i zor 'phen no: drongs shig zor sna dgra la drongs: zor 'phang tshur la ma ldog cig: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: oṃ badzra kro ta ging ka ra kro ti ni tsa tur rakmo mu kha li bhyoḥ rbad thun trig myog yaṃ gtor raṃ chod: ṭa ṭa dā ha ya: ma tha mā ra ya: ru tra nṛ tri myog thum rbad rbad: ces 'phang*/ de nas me hom̐ sbar la gtor chen btegs/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: gzigs su gsol lo: rig 'dzin o rgyan chen po yab yum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgyal sras drang srong bden tshig grub pa thams cad dgongs su gsol lo:

spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra: rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra: rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi rkyen dgra: snga dgra lag tu brdar ba: phyi dgra yid la sems pa: da dgra thad du langs pa: gdong nas rlung ltar 'tshubs pa: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: dben gnas chos 'khor bcom pa: dmag jag dgra sna ston pa: nad bdag yams bdag 'byung po: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba: ngos bstod lkog nas smad pa: bka' dang dam la 'gal ba: bzhag pa'i bran g.yog khrel med: rus kyi nang tshan rgyab log: dam nyams slob ma ngo log: bstan pa'i ru tra 'byung po: yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bo dam nyams pa 'di: lo dang zla bar ma bzhag: zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang bar: da lta nyid du thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod cig bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: mā ra ya thun bhyoḥ rbad kha la dun tse dgra bo dam nyams mā ra ya rbad: gtor chen me hom du 'phang la/ hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring dam nyams dgra la 'phen: lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung skyed: nyams pa'i dgra bo cham la phob: gtor zor dbal kha sha ra ra: drag sngags tshwa tshwa si li li: pho nya srog len khyugs se khyug: nam gyi phar ma tshur phyed la: dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod la shog: zor sna las byed shan pas drongs: dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma du na du bhyoḥ thun tsa thun ya bhyoḥ rba du shag du bhyoḥ trig thuṃ gzer thuṃ bhyoḥ mā ra ya bhyoḥ zhes 'phang zhing dar nag g.yab mo dang dmod mo bya/ hūm̐: rang byung dur khrod pho brang e yi klong: gru gsum me ri 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs byed padma khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: khram kha nag po gshin rje'i gdon: gzi byin stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol:

'chi bdag zhags thogs bdud kyi gdon: drag shul stobs kyis bzlog? shwa kha thogs pa btsan gyi gdon: gtum pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'chi bdag zhags thogs bdud kyi gdon: drag shul stobs kyis bzlog? nad rkyal thogs pa ma mo'i gdon: rngam pa'i stobs kyis? bse rag chung sri 'gong po'i gdon: khro bo'i stobs kyis? smyo 'bog snying gzir rgyal bsen gdon: gshe ba'i stobs kyis? god sri 'thab 'khon yul gyi 'dre: sgeg pa'i stobs kyis? lo nyes sad ser 'byung 'khrug gdon: dpa' ba'i stobs kyis? dbang thang bdud dang g.yang kha nyam: rgod pa'i stobs kyis? dus 'khrug mtshon cha dal 'bab rnams: mthu rtsal stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i dal kha zlog: klu srin lhog yams 'bebs pa zlog: sa bdag zha grum gtong ba zlog: gnyan mdze rgyugs 'gyel bdun drug zlog: khrag skyugs tre tre nag po zlog: sha khol dmar bshal 'brum bu zlog: rgya nad gzer thum smyo 'bog zlog: rkyen ngan bar chad dgra la zlog: oṃ khroṃ kro ta ya bhyoḥ dza tri rbad tri ya bhyoḥ nad bdag shaṃ long la ya bhyoḥ nad mkhar ru tra ya shig: trig khroṃ mā ra ya: nad bdag 'byung po kha tham rbad ch-ing: bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: khyad par du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dam tshig 'khor lo khros 'khrug rngam pas zor rdzas nad mtshon dug gi char phab pas dgra dpung bsad/ bgegs dpung bcom/ slar mi ldog pa'i rgyas btab par mos la lta ba'i klong du bzhag par bya'o/ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ kha nang du bskor la/ ye shes rang snang gi 'od zer mi shigs pa'i srung mtshams rim pa bdun gyi snod bcud mu med du bcings par bltas la/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las srung ba'i gur: rdo rje lcags sdig bya khyung 'phros: gri gug kha ṭwāṃ me yi gur: sra mkhregs pha lam rang bzhin gyur:

oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa: tri pā paṃ tsakra rakṣa: khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsakra rakṣa: ka ra ti ka tsakra rakṣa: tri shū la tsakra rakṣa: ram̐ dzwa la tsakra rakṣa: e swa bhā tsakra rakṣa: zhes 'khor 'das mtha' bral ka dag gnyug ma brdal khyab dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du 'khor bas mtshams bcad do/ slar kha phyir bskor nas bzlog pa ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen phyag rgya yongs rdzogs pa: stong gsum zil gnon 'jig rten g.yo zhing 'khrugs: sde brgyad gnod byed sgab 'dre rbod gtong rnams: dbang med 'dar chum bla rten srog yid 'phrog: zlog byed khro tshogs drag sngags stobs ldan pas: byad ma rang gshed dbab nas brlag par gyur: zhes mos la oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ: āḥhūm̐: byad ma nṛ tri trig nan: e thum dza rbad bhyoḥ oṃ trig khroṃ bhyoḥ mā ra ya du byad ma zlog: bhyo mā ra ya rbad: hūm̐ bandhe sha ya myog: mya lo sha ya rbad: ti lo sha ya rbad: nu lo sha ya rbad: bandhe brag tshal pa: srog rtsa chod: snying rtsa chod: rtsad nas chod: drungs nas phyungs: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la rbod gtong phur kha gnod pa thams cad dam nyams dgra la a mu ka phyes: phye mar phur ya dzaḥ shing tring mā ra ya rbad: ces zlog sngags tshar gsum bzlas nas/ na mo: bla ma sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang: mkha' 'gro chos skyong byin rlabs dang: gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen: chag che nyam nga rmi ltas rtsub: rbod gtong rbad 'dre zor thun hom̐: byad phur gtad khram phung sel ngan: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi tshogs: sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi: bdud sde dpung dang bcas pa rnams: bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: dgra bgegs steng du mā ra ya: nṛ tri sha truṃ hur thum dzaḥ bhyo bhyo zlog zlog hūm̐ yaṃ phaṭ:

sogs dmod mo dang thal rdeb bcas pa bya zhing dmigs pa'i ngang du bskyang*/ de nas der tho zhig gi ngor khroṃ yig bris pa kha phyir bstan bslangs te/ hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ 'khor yug gnam lcags tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: 'byung po phyir 'brangs khyod la gtad: bskal pa stong du ma shor rgya: oṃ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa bhyo bhyoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ tsakra ya thun thun nan: zhes brjod de nas phyi mig mi lta zhing slob dpon gyi sne khrid de byas te sgo drung du slebs pa dang*/ bzlog gzhong sbub/ bshal chu brtan mar blugs nas/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan sil snyan sgra: brda gar glu dbyangs khyugs se khyug: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ma hā bha lingta khā hi: me dgra chu bsad kyi rta bro brdung zhes pas: rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: stong gsum chem chem khro bo'i bro: mnan no ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bro: nam yang ma ldang las kyi bro: sgab 'dre dam sri 'dul zhing bshig: oṃ nan: ā nan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan: me chus rgyas gdab/ gtor snod kha yar bslangs par 'bru 'thor/ de nas chang phud phye mar thogs la/ hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yi dam lha tshogs la: zad med sprul pa'i mchod pa dpag yas 'bul: rten 'brel chos bzhin smon lam shugs phyung nas: sku bzhi'i dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: phye mar bkye zhing*/ hūm̐: chos sku skye med rol rtsal drag po'i lhas: las sgrib rkyen ngan ma rig 'khrul gzugs rnams: shugs sgrol dmod pa zab mos tshar bcad nas: rgyal khams phyogs med bde ba'i bkra shis shog: ces phye mar lhag ma rnams gtor zhing lha rgyal brjod/ sgo drung du srung 'khor sbyar yod na rab gnas 'thor/ nang du log nas tshe rdzas bsham/ dbang gi las byang bzhin tshe 'dzab bzla zhes pas/ bdag thugs gsang bdag thugs mchog nyi zla'i klong:

dwangs ma lnga ldan 'od kyi rdo rje ni: rtse lnga hrīḥs mtshan hrīḥyi 'od zer dang : gnyis med tha mar snying po g.yas su 'khor: tshe bdag thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor dang : hrīḥyig sngags phreng mthing gsal sgra bcas 'khor: bde stong nyams 'bar 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: mgyogs ma 'bum sde bskul zhing stong gsum khyab: bde gshegs byin rlabs tshe la dbang ba'i mthus: lha klu mi dang 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud bcas: ye shes lnga ldan 'od mdangs 'tsher ba bsdus: baiḍūr sngon po'i ri rab khong seng nas: nyi zla bye ba'i 'od 'bar ltar mi bzod: khyed shes gdung shugs drag po'i gsol btab pas: tshe bcud dwangs ma ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun: lnga ldan bar ma chad pa bdag nyid kyi: thugs srog la thim bla tshe rang bzhin khug: srog tshe nyams pa gsos la bkrags mdangs gsal: lus kyi nang khengs snang srid 'od phung gtib: ba spu'i bu gar rdo rje me ri'i gtams: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mchog 'grub par dmigs: oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bhrūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de nas tshe 'gugs pa ni: mda' dar dkar po thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: shar phyogs dkar mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: de nas mda' dar ser po thogs la: hūm̐: rin chen rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: lho phyogs ser mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: mda' dar dmar po thogs la: hūm̐: padma rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: nub phyogs dmar mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: mda' dar ljang gu thogs la: hūm̐: las kyi rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: byang phyogs ljang mo mgyogs ma 'bum:

gling bzhi ri rab bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: mda' dar sngon po thogs la: hūm̐: buddha rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: dbus phyogs sngon mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: oṃ badzra ratna padma karma ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dbang blang gtang rag gi mchod bstod sogs rjes chog rnams gzhung bzhin bya/ las dkyil mchod gtor sogs rjes mi mngon par dben par bsdu'o/ de ltar khrag 'thung padma drag po'i gtor zlog bklag chog tu bkod pa 'di yang myang ston kong smyon rig 'dzin phrin las sogs skal ldan gyi slob bu smyon pa'i cod pan 'chang ba 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor/ skyid grong smyon pas 'jigs byed drag po'i dben gnas yang rdzong rdo rje'i rdzong du bsgrigs pa 'dis kyang*/ dus kyis chad pa mi bsrun pa rmang med 'joms pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // de ltar o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi gtor zlog 'di nyid gang gi thugs sras rig 'dzin chen po o rgyan rog rje gling pa'am skyid smyon thugs mchog rdo rje'i chog khrigs phas rgol dpung 'joms zhes bya ba 'gran zla dang bral bar bzhugs pa la gsar bzo dgos pa ma mchis kyang sngar gyi chog khrigs su mang po sogs khongs su bsdus la 'ga' zhig gzhan du zhal 'phang mdzad pa rnams rang re blo dman rnams la lag len thebs dka' bar brten dpe 'tshol mi dgos pa chu 'bab kyi tshul du bklags pas grub pa zhig bgyis na phan thogs che bar 'dug pas ci nas kyang thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhes chos brgyud 'dir tshe rabs phreng bar dad mos mi phyed pa'i blo gros can khams 'brong smad lci srib dpon tshang gi rgyud 'dzin mi dbang 'brong dpon dpa' rgod mchog nas lha reg nyin mo bde legs kyis sna drangs rin po che'i bum pa cha ldan gnam lcags dbal phur dbang mdog dar gyi cod pan sogs las bzhi'i grangs ldan gyi 'bul nod gya nom pa dang bcas 'brong bla karma'i mtshan can rgyud bskul ngor rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje'i chos rigs kyi brgyud 'dzin du rlom pa'i phyogs nyul gyi dā ri dra o rgyan gsang sngags bstan 'dzin dpal bzang po'am rab btags sgo chen sprul ming du 'bod pas rtsa ba'i yi ge dbu med las zhu dag dang bcas dbu can du bsgyur zhing sogs khongs su yod pa rnams nar gyis bshangs la/

gzhan du zhal 'phang ba rnams dkyus su btsud cing go rim 'khrugs bsdebs dang bcas bka' gter sri zhu e waṃ dpe skrun khang du ma phyi rnams 'phrul par du bskrun pa'i skabs 'brong pa rdo shul gyi bande au ḍī ming nas yig bris dang ri bla karma longs spyod kyis zhu dag gi mthun 'gyur mdzad pa'i dge bas bstan pa 'di nyid phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈

padma khrag 'thung gi bzlog pa grangs gsog ni/ hūm̐: rang byung dur khrod pho brang e yi klong: gru gsum me ri 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs byed padma khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: khram kha nag po gshin rje'i gdon: gzi byin stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'chi bdag zhags thogs bdud kyi gdon: drag shul stobs kyis bzlog? shwa kha thogs pa btsan gyi gdon: gtum pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: 'chi bdag zhags thogs bdud kyi gdon: drag shul stobs kyis bzlog? nad rkyal thogs pa ma mo'i gdon: rngam pa'i stobs kyis? bse rag chung sri 'gong po'i gdon: khro bo'i stobs kyis? smyo 'bog snying gzir rgyal bsen gdon: gshe ba'i stobs kyis? god sri 'thab 'khon yul gyi 'dre: sgeg pa'i stobs kyis? lo nyes sad ser 'byung 'khrug gdon: dpa' ba'i stobs kyis? dbang thang bdud dang g.yang kha nyam: rgod pa'i stobs kyis? dus 'khrug mtshon cha dal 'bab rnams: mthu rtsal stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i dal kha zlog: klu srin lhog yams 'bebs pa zlog: sa bdag zha grum gtong ba zlog: gnyan mdze rgyugs 'gyel bdun drug zlog: khrag skyugs tre tre nag po zlog: sha khol dmar bshal 'brum bu zlog: rgya nad gzer thum smyo 'bog zlog: rkyen ngan bar chad dgra la zlog: oṃ khroṃ kro ta ya bhyoḥ dza tri rbad tri ya bhyoḥ nad bdag shaṃ long la ya bhyoḥ nad mkhar ru tra ya shig: trig khroṃ mā ra ya: nad bdag 'byung po kha tham rbad ch-ing: bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces gter gzhung las gu hyas khol du phyung ba'o// // padma khrag 'thung gi bzlog pa grangs gsog ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings ka dag drag po e yi klong*/ /lhun grub rang rtsal padma he ru ka

/dbyings rig zung 'jug klong nas skur bzhengs la/ /nyon mongs bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dus 'khrugs phyi yi rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol/ /'byung 'khrugs nang gi nad gdon bzlog tu gsol/ /sems 'khrugs gsang ba'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /bzlog go dug lnga ye shes lnga ru zlog /bsgyur ro rnam rtog bag chags dbyings su sgyur/ /bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ padma khrag 'thung gi bzlog pa'i grangs gsog ched 'di bzhin bris zhes rang slob au ḍī ming gis ched bskul bzhin gu hyas smras rim bzhin bskul ba pos bris pa dge'o// // bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ dam sri mnan pa ldang med 'chi bdag nag po'i gre hom du gtad pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpyid/ /dbang drag khro rgyal padma he ru kaḥ mngon spyod drag po'i lha la gus btud de/ /las mtha' mnan pa'i phrin las 'dir gsal bya/ de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du/ dbang thob cing bskyed rdzogs dam tshig drod thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas shin tu 'dul dka'i mi bsrun skye bo'i tshogs zhi bas 'dul bar dka' ba rnams brtse bas mi dor bar thabs mngon spyod drag po'i sbyor ba la brten nas tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi las la 'jug pa la/ rtsa ba srung bzlog bsad pa'i lag len gzhung gsal ltar las kyi mtha' bsdu ba drag po mnan pa'i las rim la 'jug pa ni/ thog mar gzhung bsrang la bdag mdun dus gcig tu bskyed pa'am spro na smad las phas rgol dpung 'joms gzhung ltar bca' gzhi bkod/ bye brag brub khung du gzhug rgyu'i liṅga ni/ dug shog la ru pa dam sri la bya mgo /phung sri la sprel mgo sogs sri can gang gi mgo bo byas pa la yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa'i lte bar tri dzaḥ gsum bcug pa'i steng du

trig nan/ 'og tu breng shag rbad/ phyogs bzhir e hur thum dza/ mtha' skor du yig mgo phyir bstan gyis/ e thun he thun sogs 'gugs sngags kyi mthar gnod byed chaig mo dam sri/ dgra sri/ phung sri/ dur sri/ sogs sri rigs gang yin bkod la gdug pa can gyi lus ngag yid gsum mthu stobs nus pa thams cad hūm̐ nan ya nan suṃ nan khaṃ nan raṃ nan yaṃ nan mā ra ya nan nan sogs phyi nas nang du sbrul 'khyil ltar bkod/ dpral bar chaig mo kha rur trig nan: tshigs chen bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'doms su bhi dha ya trig nan breng shag rbad/ brla la chaig mo'i bla gang du brdzus kyang khug dzaḥ byin pa dang nywa bzhi la mā ra ya rbad satwaṃ bha ya nan/ kha la kha chings shig / phyi rol du/ om̐ lokt+ri pā la nan/ sa ga pā sha nan/ nā ga du du nan/ ma maṃ ma maṃ/ tsir tsa ra tsir tsa ra/ bam̐ ru lu bam̐ ru lu/ rbad tra ko sha ya rbad tra ko sha ya/ ho ra ho ra/ tsi du sod tsi du sod/ shig lhur gtub/ ha la pa ti nan/ 'khor ba thul/ gnod byed 'byung po kā wa tsi dug brlag /sogs mnan sngags kyi mthar/ gnod byed 'byung po sri can gdug pa can dam sri/ dgra sri/ phung sri/ dur sri/ sogs gang yin/ pha rol gdug cing sdang ba'i byad kha brgya yi mi kha stong gi bram mchu dus tshod kyi chad pa 'byung ba'i g.yo 'khrugs gdug pa can sogs chag sgo rkyen ngan mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad satwaṃ bha nan e ha la khaḍga la sarba duṣṭāṃ nan pra duṣṭā nan laṃ bha ya nan satwaṃ bha ya nan mo ha ya nan ya ma ye nan ma ru tri bā ru ṇa ya tsakra ya nan nan: phyi bskor du dzaḥkhram nyer gcig gis bskor/ gzhan yang dkar cha gang 'dug la dzaḥkhraṃ dang*/ sarba satwaṃ bha ya nan zhes bris/ ling khrus gnad gyi man ngag bsdus pa ni/ lam rgya gram gyi sa gtor la/ lam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: chu lkug pas bkrus la/ bam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: ro sol gyi me bskor la/

ram̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: rlung la phyar zhing*/ yam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: nam mkha' la g.yug cing*/ e ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: zhes dang*/ bskyed bya bzas po de'i tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor ba longs spyod bkrag mdangs gzi brjid mthu stobs nus rtsal sogs rang la thim pas tshe bsod longs spyod bkrag mdangs rgyas te kun gyis 'gran zla bral bar bsam/ āḥ kyang nyer gcig dbugs thengs gcig bsgrags te chus bkrus la rang gis btung bar bya'o/ tshe pha rol gyi srog khrag snying khrag dpal chen pos gsol bar bsam/ dug khrag gis byug /dgra lteb tu lteb la/ re ba dang byad thag sngo dmar gyis bcings rtsang rgya gram du gzir/ brub khung du gzhug 'gugs pa bya zhing thun gyis brab/ mnan sngags kyis gdab cing phur pa brdeg go /de nas kha bkab la mtha' skor du zor rdzas rnams kyis bskor/ mnan chas dur g.yam la steng 'byung ba rim brtsegs 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram bris pa/ sātstsha nag po/ skyer phur zur gsum la thā gsum bris pa/ mnan thod khyi mgo bcas 'du bya/ mnan hom gyi steng du mañdzi'i khar gong gnon gyi bzlog gtor bzhag /mdun du drag po'i nyer spyod g.yon du bskor bsham/ 'dabs su g.yag ru'am thun snod nang du thun rdzas dbye rdzas bsgral chas sogs dang*/ gzhan yang thun gtor dkar bgegs ḍā dril gul yungs g.yab dar rol mo'i bye brag sogs mkho chas mtha' dag 'du bya'o/ gnyis pa ni/ las gzhung bsrangs la bzlas pa dang tshogs skong byas rjes/ las gzhung gi thugs dam bskul gser skyems ni/ hūm̐/ kun bzang rdor sems chos dang las kyi dbang*/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen pad 'byung mtsho rgyal ma/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gter ston 'dus par bcas/ /rig sngags dmod pa'i brgyud gsum bla ma la/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/

/rgyud sde bzhi drug theg rim dgu'i lha tshogs/ khyad par bcom ldan padma he ru kaḥ khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi lha/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul mngon spyod gzi byin bskyed/ /dge bsnyen sde bzhi ti sgro'i sman btsun lnga/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang gtsang ris dpal mgon po/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes mthu dpung stobs rtsal bskyed/ /sa bdag rje blon 'bangs 'khor sde rigs bcas/ /lo zla zhag dus gnas 'gyu legs nyes ston/ /ko long sdom pa'i rigs kun gser skyems bzhes/ /ru nga kun spongs mthun pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ gzu dpang ni/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /zhi khro rab 'byams mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs/ /rig sngags dmod pa las kyi pho nya rnams/ /ma g.yel dbyings nas dus 'dir dgongs su gsol/ /sngon tshe bskal pa yar ldan dpal che yang*/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bdag cag bsod nams dman/ /jo bo dkon mchog gsum la skyabs zhus kyang*/ /lha srin 'byung pos gnod pa skyob ma thub/ /lus ngag dkar po dge la 'bung bsam kyang*/ /grogs ngan dbang gis sdig pa'i las la bsgyur/ /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam ngan sbyor spangs kyang*/ /las ngan dbang gis rang dang 'dus ma tshugs/ /de yi rgyab rten nag phyogs 'byung pos byed/ /thar pa bsgrubs kyang bar chad dbang btsan na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i dus shig nam yong ngam/ /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /'dul khrims bsrungs kyang bslab sdom gnas ma nus/ /dben gnas 'grims kyang dgra jag chom rkun dar/ /lto gos mthu chen dam chos yal bar dor/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad sna tshogs pa/ /lo nad nor nad skye 'gro'i srog dbugs sdud/

/sdig sgrib bsags pa'i rgyu rkyen 'byung pos byas/ /sgo gsum dge la 'bad pa'i dbang mi 'dug /kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol/ /sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen mtshams sbyar ba'i/ /bdud dgra dam sri 'byung pos 'tshe dang rgol/ /lo zla zhag dus skag sri mi mthun rnams/ /padma khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi/ /mngon spyod drag po'i stobs kyis 'dir khug la/ /bsgral zhing mnan pa'i phrin las dus la bab/ /thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo mā ra ya/ de nas rnal 'byor pa drag po'i chas su zhugs te phur bu thogs la/ hūm̐: bdag ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug mthu stobs dbang : rtsal chen bdud dpung 'joms pa'i ngo bor gsal: thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog kī la ya: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug phur bu bsgril: byad ma 'byung po bsgral ba'i rang bzhin gsal: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gsal btab hom bskyed pa ni/ ho/ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed 'jigs byed chen po drag tu khros pa'i mdun du/ kaṃ kaṃ dmar nag las grub pa'i gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po rngam la 'thug pa bskal pa'i mun nag 'tshub ma gtibs pa/ phyi thams cad dus mtha'i 'byung ba bsdus pa'i me ltar dmar nag tshwa tshwa ltar du 'khrugs shing gtibs pa ltar/ bar thams cad 'byung ba chu rlung rba 'tshubs pa'i skad ltar dug gi rlangs pa sngo dmar drag tu 'phyur ba/ de'i nang thams cad spu gri dang chu gri ral gri'i tshogs thams cad gzengs sh-ing skar ltar 'khrugs pa/ shin tu mi bzad pa bdud kyi bsha' ra/ btsan gyi bsad khang*/ gshin rje'i brub khung*/ ma mo'i 'gyu lam/ gza' bdud kyi lto ba/ srin mo'i za lam/ pho nya'i rgyun lam/ sde brgyad kyi 'du sa/ srog bdag gi tshogs khang shin tu ya nga ba de yi nang du nṛ tri dmar nag yongs su gyur pa las/

dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can gyi phung khams skye mched dbang po thams cad mngon sum du gsal ba shin tu nyam thag pa'i gzugs can gcer bu byang thang gi lhag pas bsdams pa lta bu lus sngo zhing ham pa/ yan lag thams cad lcags sgrog gis bcings shing dmyal srung gshin rje'i pho nyas drag tu bsdams pa 'dar phri le ba/ kha 'o dod/ mig shi mig /lus mya ngan gyi bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa/ mgon skyabs dang bral ba srog chad la khad pa/ dbugs bral la khad pa/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi zas skal du gtad pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ nṛ tri dgra bgegs a karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ mā ra ya thun: de nas dmod cing 'gugs pa ni/ phaṭḥ na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden p khyad par du yang rig 'dzin thod phreng yab yum mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum ging bzhi sha za khyung gi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : gter srung ma mo dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas/ deng 'dir 'gugs pa'i yul du mchis pa ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde la dmod pa/ khyad par rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la sdang zhing gdug pa'i bsam sbyor 'chang ba/ snga dgra lag gis brdar ba/ phyi dgra zhe la bzhag pa/ da dgra thad nas ldang ba/ spyi dgra rlung ltar 'tshubs pa/ sgos dgra rbab ltar rgyug pa/ zur dgra khyi ltar zug pa/ mtho gong nas rgol ba/ dma' khyad du 'bebs pa/

gyod phyogs nas ldang ba/ sri phugs su chud pa/ snyad tsher ltar 'dzugs pa/ mdun sgug dang rgyab 'ded byed pa/ khyad par du dam sri/ dgra sri/ phung sri/ dur sri/ sogs sri rigs gang yin/ gdug pa can dmigs pa'i yul du bkod pa bsdongs zla rgyab rten dang bcas pa thams cad stong khams gar gnas kyang rang dbang med par las kyi rlung mun gyi rta la bskyon te myur mgyogs kyi pho nyas nyes can btson du khrid pa bzhin/ gzugs liṅga la bkod cing ming byang bu btab cing rnam shes sa bon la btab pa 'di la khug cig stims shig oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ oṃ badzra ratna pā sha hūm̐: oṃ badzra padma spho ṭa baṃ: oṃ badzra karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes drag rol gyi tsha rngam dang 'gugs 'ching sdom myos kyi sngags rgya yang bya/ spro na pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ hūm̐: shar phyogs ma mo sdig gdong ma: sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bsnams: sprul pa lcags sdig bye ba 'bum: shar phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung : oṃ ma mo ma duṣṭān dgra bo a karṣa ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: lho phyogs ma mo chu srin gdong : sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na 'ching ba'i zhags pa thogs: sprul pa dug sbrul bye ba 'bum: lho phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung : oṃ ma mo ra tsa ya dgra bo a karsha ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: nub phyogs ma mo phag gdong ma: sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na bsdams pa'i lcags sgrog thogs: sprul pa dung gi phag rgod 'bum: nub phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung : oṃ ma mo raksha ya dgra bo a karsha ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: byang phyogs ma mo khyung gdong ma: sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: phyag na myos byed dril bu bsnams: sprul pa me yi bya khyung 'bum:
byang phyogs dgra dang nad bdag rnams: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug: rbad pa'i ma mo mthu ma chung : oṃ ma mo ma tsa bhyo dgra bo a karsha ya dza dzaḥ

zhes pho nya bskul zhing 'gugs bstim rtags rdzogs su bya ba'i mtshams rnams su 'gugs sngags ni/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru kaḥ.e thun he thun he ya ma rā dza thun/ ka la ha la mi kha thun/ ki kang ru tra pra ṇa ya thun/ ha la ti kā li ru tra shag ti thun/ ru tra a pa ka ra rurṇa ya thun/ ki kang he pra ma thun/ sri can chaig mo dam sri/ dgra sri/ phung sri/ dur sri/ sogs sri rigs gang yin tri tri a karṣa ya thun thun/ zhes skabs dang bstun te brgya stong sogs bzlas/ khug rtags rdzogs nas/ sri can gdug pa can gyi khog pa gnam lcags spu gri 'khor lo rno ngar dang ldan pa rtsibs bzhi mu khyud med pa gcig gis brgyangs shing sgo gsum nus stobs thams cad g.yo 'gul med par bskal pa'i bar du mnan par bsams la/ oṃ lokt+ri pā la nan: nā ga du shan nan: a mu ka pur thum nan: bighnān trig nan rbad nan: bzlog nan mā ra ya nan: dam sri/ dgra sri/ phung sri/ dur sri/ sogs sri rigs gang yin kā wa tsi satwaṃ bha ya nan: zhes bzlas mthar thun la sngags shing liṅga la brdeg pa ni/ 'au/ nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcu nas gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dam sri dgra sri/ phung sri/ dur sri/ sogs sri rigs gang yin gdug pa can gyi lus ngag yid gsum bskal pa ma stong gi bar du ma ldang cig mā ra ya chings brub satwaṃ bha ya nan hūm̐ nan ya nan e nan sum̐ nan kham̐ nan ram̐ nan yam̐ nan mā ra ya nan nan: zhes pas thun dbab cing g.yab dar dang thal rdeb bya/ thun mtshams su thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ nṛ tri dzaḥ na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum dang yi dam padma khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pas dgra bgegs gnod byed drag po thun gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig: badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ lan gsum bya/ hūm̐: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes shig: dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus:

phung po khams dang skye mched tshogs drug bcas: rngam yangs chos nyid 'bar ba'i zhal du bzhes: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: zhes thun gtor 'bul zhing las kyis gnyer gtad do/ gsum pa ni mnan rtags rdzogs nas liṅga brub khung dang bcas pa mdun du bkod de/ 'gugs gzhug gong ltar tshar gcig song nas phur bu thogs te/ hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: khro rgyal badzra kī la ya: mgo bo rgya mdud 'brug stong ldir: 'chang gzung sgra gcan glog dmar 'khyugs: chu srin kha nas thog ser 'bebs: zur gsum shan pa gri thogs 'bum: byad ma bdud 'dul kī la ya: bsgral zhing gtub bo mā ra ya: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya: dgra bo tsitta bhandha bhandha mā ra mā ra ha la ha la thun rbad: ces pas bsgral te dbang po thams cad la khyab par phur pas bsnun/ zan ling mtshon gyis gtub cing tshogs tha ma ltar zhal bstab bya/ shog ling thog mar mgo bo phyed nas lteb/ ces sogs gzhung ltar bltabs la chings lpags dang bcas pa bya zhing rang gi snod du gzhug /thun rdzas kyis kha bkang la chas bkag /sa dmigs su dkar gtor phul mnan dong brus par me bshur bya/ satwa re thogs la dong nang du gdeng tsam bya zhing*/ hūm̐: bdag ni padma khrag 'thung rtsal/ deng 'dir drag po'i las byed phyir: phyag g.yas gnam lcags satwa re thogs: g.yon pas me yi zhags pa 'dzin: g.yas kyi gnam lcags satwa re de: srid gsum nam mkha'i mthongs su phyar: thog ltar sa la phab pa'i tshe: ri rab gling bzhi phyed du gas: 'og gi rgya mtsho mer gyis gsal: de nang gshin rje ma lus kun: gnas pas 'gro dbang med par yi: mtha' rnams me yi zhags pas bskor: 'chi bdag pho brang mngon sum gsal: de nas gtad pa ni/ dzaḥ gshin rje'i pho brang srog bdag gnas mchog nas: srid pa srog gi bdag po mthu bo che: srid pa'i 'khor lo 'jigs byed ma he'i gdong :

gshin rje a wa glang mgo da bzhengs shig: za byed 'chi bdag 'bar ba'i kha gdongs la: gnod pa'i dgra bgegs yul mkhar sde rigs dang : sri can gdon bgegs 'byung po ma lus pa: bstab bo a wa glang mgo'i zhal du bstab: brub bo 'chi bdag gshin rje'i lto bar brubs: bstab bo gtad do nam yang ma shor cig: ces mnan pa dong du bskyur zhing sa cung zad blugs/ phur bu btsugs la/ hūm̐ ya bhyoḥ dpal chen khrag 'thung las kyi dmod pa'i mtshon: srid pa'i ri rab las grub dug phur 'di: ma rungs dam sri 'byung po mnan phyir btab: nam yang ru tra ldang bar ma gyur cig: om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka kī li kī la ya he e ha la khaḍga ya sarba duṣṭāṃ nan laṃ bha ya nan satwaṃ bha ya nan mo ha ya nan ya ma ye nan ma ru tri bā ru ṇa ya tsakra nan nan: zhes me chu dang dur rdo ri rab bris pa'i kha bkab cing*/ hūm̐ ya bhyoḥ dmigs bya khang bcud 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khar: srid pa spu gri'i 'khor lo'i rgyas thob la: snod kyi 'jig rten ma stongs bar du rgya: nam mkha'i rlung me chu sa ri rab dang : gnam lcags mchod rten rtsibs stong 'bar bas mnan: rgyas btab mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: hūm̐ nan ya nan e nan sum̐ nan kham̐ nan ram̐ nan yam̐ nan mā ra ya nan nan: zhes tshwa tshwa nag po dang me chu'i rgyas btab pa mi mngon par bya/ gong gnon gyi zor gtor thogs la/ hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring dam nyams dgra la 'phen: lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung skyed: nyams pa'i dgra bo cham la phob: gtor zor dbal kha sha ra ra: drag sngags tshwa tshwa si li li: pho nya srog len khyugs se khyug: nam gyi phar ma tshur phyed la: dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod la shog: zor sna las byed shan pas drongs: dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ ya ma du na du bhyoḥ thun tsa thun ya bhyoḥ rba du shag du bhyoḥ trig thuṃ gzer thuṃ bhyoḥ

mā ra ya bhyoḥ zhes mnan steng ngam dgra phyogs su 'phang bshal chus brtan ma bskyang*/ gtor snod mnan steng du kha sbub la rta bro brdung*/ srung 'khor dang bcas rang gnas su log /bdag gi rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas mchod bstod bzod gsol nyer bsdu bsngo smon sogs las ky-i rjes mi mngon par bsdu bas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ de ltar bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi dam sri mnan pa ldang med 'chi bdag nag po'i gre hom du gtad pa zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed dug ri nag po'i mnan pa'i cho ga sor bzhag gis lha mtshan kha bsgyur zhing*/ ma tshang ba rnams rang gzhung nas kha bkang ste bklag chog tu bkod pa 'di yang*/ snyigs dus kyi sngags nag bdud 'dul phrin las rol pa rtsal gyis gangs can phur thogs yongs kyi rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi 'jam dpal nag po dngos su grub pa'i gnas/ bal yul yang le shod a su ra'i ke'u tshang dang 'dabs 'brel ba'i gnam lcags sgrub sde phur pa gling du dus nag mar ngo nyi shu dgu'i sa srod mun pa nag po ru dbu tshugs te/ srod 'khor phag nag gi dus su grub par bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni mtshams nag ral pa can/ au ḍīs bgyis pa 'dis kyang nag phyogs bdud kyi sde tshogs rmang nas gzhom pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ khrag 'thung padma drag po las/ zhi sreg ye shes 'od dpung bzhugs so/ bde gshegs kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung*/ /gcig bsdoms thugs rje'i rnam rol padma 'byung*/ /gang gi gsang ba zab mo'i phrin las sgo/ /ma rig mun sel ye shes 'od dpung bstan/ de la bla sgrub gdung ba zhi byed la bsten pa'i sbyin sreg rtsom pa la gsum/ sbyor ba yo byad dngos su bsham/ dngos gzhi'i phrin las dang rjes las kyi mtha' bsdu ba'o/ dang po ni gzhung las/ dang po zhi ba'i phrin las ni:

sa gzhi dkar la maṇḍal zlum: padma 'dab bzhi mu khyud bcas: bal dkar glang ma tsan dan dkar: zhi ba'i shing gis zlum por brtsig: mchod rdzas thams cad dkar por bsgyur: rang nyid kha ni shar du bstan: zhes pa yar ngo gza' skar dge ba'i snga dro'i char/ kha shar du phyogs pa'i bkra shis pa'i sa dang*/ zhi byed gang yin sa sna las byas pa'i stegs bu dkar po la/ rdul tshon gyis 'dab bzhi mu khyud dang bcas pa'i khar glang ma bal dkar sogs zhi ba'i yam shing gi thab khung zlum po rgya'i phyed cha dngos su brtsigs pa'i kha khyer la ku sha rtse mo g.yas su bstan pas bkab/ g.yas su zhi ba'i yam shing mdzub mo'i sbom phra la ring thung sor bcu gnyis pa pad kha can/ mar dkar gyi mar khu/ til dkar/ dūrba zho zan/ 'bru thug dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru phye dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog /'bras dkar/ so ba/ nas dkar/ gro dkar/ yungs dkar/ sran dkar/ shing tog /me tog sogs rdzas rnams zhi ba'i snod du so sor bshams pa'am gcig tu bshams kyang rung la/ de yang nad yams sdig sgrib sogs zhi zhing bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong kho na la til dang*/ gdon zhi ba la yungs dkar rtogs sgrib zhi ba la ku sha dang skra sen/ tshe yi bar chad zhi bar dūrba/ rgyal pos chad pa dang pha rol gyi gdug rtsub zhi bar zas mchog sogs/ las rim gang yin gtso bor ston pa'i rdzas rnams ci 'byor du bsags/ gang gi tshe yang 'jig 'das kyi dbye bar tshar gnyis bsham/ g.yon ngos su chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang*/ sngon cha/ chad brtan/ rlung g.yab/ me sgron sogs ci ltar dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya'o/ bdag bskyed kyi las gzhung bsrangs shing bzlas pa'i mjug tshogs mchod bsgral bstab dang bcas pa bya/ las bum bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa:

khro bo'i chas thams cad ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur/ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas sogs? shabda āḥhūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can: khro bo'i rgyal po khyod la bstod: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba de las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes bzlas/ mthar khro bo 'od du zhu ste chur thim pas de'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed pa'i khro bor gyur pas phrin las mdzad par mos: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum gyi dang po lce lag mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/ lce yi rtsa bar hrī ཿlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du hrīḥbadzra dzi haṃ zhes pas rdo rje rtse gsum pa nyal stabs su gnas par gyur: lag g.yas nyi ma la hūm̐ dang : g.yon zla ba la āḥs mtshan pa ste thabs shes zung du 'jug par gyur: rdo dril bsang sbyang ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thabs kyi rdo rje las sems can thams cad smin par byed pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro bar gyur: oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje lan gsum gsor/ āḥlas dbyings phyug yum lnga'i rang bzhin shes rab dril bu'i rnam pas sems can thams cad rig pa sad par byed pa'i chos sgra rgyun mi chad par gyur: oṃ ma hā ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes dril bu dkrol/ rdor dril thabs shes kyi phyag rgyas snying khar bsnol zhing*/ hūm̐: thabs shes zung 'jug chos nyid mtshon: ma lus 'gro rnams sad pa dang: sems can smin par bya ba'i phyir: rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol: oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hūm̐ āḥ dgang blugs dang sreg rdzas rnams bsang sbyang ni/ blugs gzar thogs la/

hūm̐: thabs kyi rol pa las byung ting 'dzin gyi: dpa' bo rdo rje snod mchog g.yas su thogs: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ dgang gzar thogs la/ hūm̐: shes rab bde stong dga' bzhi'i snyoms 'jug gis: dpa' mo zab lam chos 'byung g.yon du thogs: mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: kha sbyor te rdzas rnams la g.yas skor du reg cing*/ hūm̐: chags med bdai stong ye shes rnam rol gyis: skye med sna tshogs rdzas kun byin gyis rlobs: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta a we sha ya a āḥ zhes lan gsum/ mchod pa byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha liṃ ta te dzwa bha liṃ ta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ sarba a haṃ dzñā na a mṛ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes lnga'am bdun gyis brlab/ gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ dge 'dun gyi tshang ngam dkyil 'khor gyi mar me las sbar ba'i lce lde thab tu gzhug cing*/ me thab bsang sbyang ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'phros me thab kyi dbus su 'khod pa las sems can thams cad kyi dug gsum zhi bar byed pa'i 'od zer ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bar gyur: oṃ dzwa la dzwa la oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes me sbar/ hūm̐ gis rlung g.yab/ me thab mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang: bhrūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar: rdo rje me 'od dkar gsal klong: oṃ las zhi ba'i me lha dkar: zhi 'dzum ghaṇḍe bgrang phreng bsnams: sha rgyas gzugs thung lto ba 'khyil: ra skyes khrir bzhugs drang srong skur:

'od 'phros rang 'dra spyan drangs bstim: spyan 'dren ni/ me dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: 'dir gshegs 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs: gus pa'i yid kyis khyod phyag 'tshal: bsreg blugs zhal zas tshogs bzhes la: zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: mchod yon 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di'am gzhan dag na: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med dang: mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal chab sogs: bdud rtsi dag pa lha mo'i tshogs: glu gar rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: bde ba'i nyams dang ldan phyir 'bul: oṃ agne de wa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: oṃ agni dāe wa sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: oṃ agne dāe wa sa pa ri wā ra añdza ma nam pra tītstsha ye swā hā: byon skyems dgang blugs kyis 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: a yig rang byung me hom̐ du: hom̐ yig byung ba bdud rtsi'i chu: rigs lnga yab yum snyoms 'jug gis: bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod: oṃ agna ye swā hā: zhes bdun gyis dgang blugs mar khus bkang ba kha sbyor zhing g.yas bskor gyis/ oṃ agna ye a ti bhyaḥpa ti bhyaḥ a be sha yaḥm hā shrī ya ha bhya ka bhya bha na ye swā hā:

zhes lan gsum 'bul/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'bar ba'i rdo rje drang srong lha tshogs la: ting 'dzin dbang bskur dam rdzas bdud rtsi rnams: dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags na: dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs te bzhes su gsol: oṃ dāe wa dzwa la agna ye swā hā/ oṃ dāe ba dzwa la agne ye nad gdon sdig sgrib shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes yam shing mar khu sogs bsreg rdzas rnams sngags de kho nas rdzogs par phul nas mthar 'dod don gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: srid pa'i rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir: ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas: rang bzhin dag pa'i drang srong mchog: dam pa'i srid pa byed par shog: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo ji snyed kun: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ agne de wa sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe dhū pe sogs pra tītstsha ye swā hā: nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: 'dod yon bla med mchod pa 'di: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ agne de wa sa pa ri wā ra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra tītstsha ye swā hā: gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang*/ rakta dmar mchod arghaṃ dang: bcud ldan mchog gi gtor ma rnams: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ agne de wa sa pa ri wā ra badzra a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes sman raka gtor gsum 'bul/ tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol:

oṃ agne dāe wa sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: 'bar ba'i sku la sreg pa'i zhal: phrin las bzhi yi bdag nyid can: tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: hoḥ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes kyi bdag nyid/ 'byung ba chen po me'i rang bzhin drang srong chen po khyed kyis bdag dang yon bdag gi sdig sgrib sreg pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ me 'bar ba'i klong chen gnyis su med par bzhugs nas/ mchod rdzas rnams lha'i zhal du bstab cing*/ gang 'dod kyi phrin las skad cig tu 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes me lha 'bar ba dbyings kyi rang bzhin su mos/ gsum pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me thab du bud shing cung zad bsnan/ las bum gyi chus bsang sbyangs la/ hūm̐: 'byung ba'i mnga' bdag drang srong me yi lha: rab 'bar chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbus: bhrūm̐ las rang byung lhun grub pho brang ni: gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang mtshan nyid ldan: sogs nas spyan 'dren gyi mthar mchod yon 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di'am gzhan dag na: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med dang: mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal chab sogs: bdud rtsi dag pa lha mo'i tshogs: glu gar rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: bde ba'i nyams dang ldan phyir 'bul: rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: sogs dang*/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: sa pa ri wā ra añdza ma nam pra tītstsha ye swā hā: gong ltar 'bul/ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal rnams gzhung bzhin bya/ byon skyems 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: a yig rang byung me hom du: haṃ yig byung ba bdud rtsi'i chu: rigs lnga yab yum snyoms 'jug gis: bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod: ces rtsa sngags lan gsum gyis 'bul/ bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/

hūm̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg 'di: bde gshegs kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi: thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu: las dang nyams chag sgrib pa'i tshogs dag cing: byang chub bsgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing: tshe dang sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin nas kyang: gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs la sogs: 'jigs pa brgyad po zhi bar mdzad du gsol: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur/ nad gdon sdig sgrib shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes spyi dang bye brag bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong la rtsa sngags kho na dang*/ gdon bgegs nyams sgrib bar chad rgyal pos chad pa gcan gzan me chu dug mtshon sogs gang zhi bya'i 'dod byang spel la bsreg rdzas rnams grangs ldan du 'bul zhing brgya re'i mtshams su spyi la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa phul ba la brten nas: bdag cag dpon slob rgyu 'byor ba yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i dgra: gnod pa'i bgegs: gdug pa'i dbal: rno ba'i mtshon: sbyor ba'i dug: nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi: gdon stong phrag brgyad cu: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu: rmi lam ngan pa: ltas ngan pa: mtshan ma ngan pa: sbyor ba rtsub pa: lo zla zhag skeg: mo ngan rtsis rtsub: mi kha bram mchu la sogs mdor na bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po thams cad myur ba nyid du zhi bar mdzad du gsol: shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes dang bye brag bsnyen sgrub kha skong la/ bdag cag ma rig pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin ma gsal zhing bzlas brjod lhag chad du gyur pa sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi sgrib tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur ba nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs gang zhi ba'i 'dod gsol sbyar/ las gzhung gi phyi nang gsang mchod dang*/

tshogs 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzhes: deng 'dir mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: so so'i gzhung ltar bstod pa bya/ 'bul gtor dgang gzar khar bzhag ste/ hūm̐: rdo rje dbyings kyi pho brang chen po nas: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho rnams: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo thugs rje bskyed: nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi ba'i dus la bab: nad gdon rkyen ngan zhi ba'i dus la bab: mi mthun 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dus la bab: 'byung po'i gdug rtsub zhi ba'i dus la bab: dam sri'i kha rlangs zhi ba'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo rgyal ba thugs rje can: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs bdud dgra zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: de yis zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med: zhi mdzad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces 'bul lo/ smon lam ni/ hūm̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: thugs rje'i me sbar mtshan ma'i rdzas phul bas: nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun phyogs rnams kun: rdo rje'i mes bsregs ye shes cher gyur shog: las kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di phul bas: pho nya'i rigs kyi thugs dam bskangs gyur cig: 'bru thug phul bas yid bzhin 'dod 'byung gter: drang srong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs gyur cig: mar khu mchod pas khams gsum sems can rnams: sku gsung thugs rdzogs byang chub mchog thob shog: me tog bsregs te phul bas yon tan rnams: ljon shing lta bur tshe dpal rgyas par shog: 'o skom zhal zas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'dis: khams gsum sems can ma lus tshim par shog: ku sha mchod pas bka' dang sngags kyi dbang : dam tshig tshul khrims nyams chag skong bar shog: til dkar bsregs pas bdag sogs sems can gyi: nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus zhi bar shog:

gu gul sbyar ba'i yungs dkar bsregs pa yis: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs tshogs zhi bar shog: dkar gsum bsregs pas khams gsum sems can rnams: snying po byang sems rgyud la gnas par shog: 'bras dkar bsregs pas bdag dang 'gro ba kun: rnam dkar dge bcu'i dpal la spyod par shog: bdud rtsi bsregs pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis: sku lnga'i dngos grub deng 'dir thob par shog gtor ma bsregs pas bsod nams tshogs rdzogs nas: sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa mthar phyin shog: rakta bsregs pas khams gsum srid gsum gyi: lha 'dre mi nor dbang du bsdus par shog: rig 'dzin bdag gis bde gshegs bka' lung bzhin: phrin las bzung ba'i sngags kyi byin rlabs dang : chos nyid bden pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi mthus: mi mthun phyogs rnams kun nas bzlog pa dang: gnod pa kun zhi tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cig: ces smon lam btab/ bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus dkyil 'khor du: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa ci mchis pa: de dag khyed kyis bzod par gsol: rtsa sngags dang*/ sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ bde gshegs kun 'dus dkyil 'khor gyis: zhi bar gyur pa'i las kun mdzad: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu stsal lags pas: bde gshegs yul du gshegs slad du: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: ci bde bar ni gshegs su gsol: rtsa sngags dang*/ badzra mu zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas ye shes pa gshegs bdag bskyed thugs kar bsdu'o/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la gnyis las dang po me lha gshegs su gsol ba ni/ bud shing kha gso bsang sbyang*/ oṃ agna ye swā hā: lan bdun 'bul zhing me lha gsal gdab la/ oṃ: agne chen po me yi lha: 'dod pa'i don rnams rab sgrub cing: thugs rjes sems can don byed pa: gtang rag mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ dāe wa dzwa la sogs kyis bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams rdzogs par phul rjes/

so rtsi dang gos zung kyang 'bul bar spro na sngags tsam gyis 'bul/ me lha'i gtor ma dgang gzar khar bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis byin brlabs la/ me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha: drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag: shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas pa: mchod cing bstod do phyag kyang 'tshal: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod: ces pas gtor ma me nang du bzhu/ bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa gang mchis pa: de dag khyed kyis bzod par gsol: oṃ agne dāe wa te pa ma dag pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gshegs gsol ni/ hūm̐: drang srong chen po me yi lha: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: khyed kyis sems can don mdzad nas: pho brang nyid du gshegs su gsol: badzra mu: ye shes pa shar lhor gshegs/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la bsdu'o/ gnyis pa bdag gis rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas thugs dam bskul/ tshogs lhag brtan skyong dngos grub len chog bzod gsol sogs rjes bsdu rnams las byang ltar bya zhing/ me ro dal gyis zhi ba'am chus ngar phab chog la chu rlung chen por dor ba'am btsa' sad ser srung sogs spyod cing*/ yo byad lhag ma rnams kyang mi mngon par bsdu'o/ de ltar zhi sreg ye shes 'od dpung zhes pa 'di yang lam zab mor mi phyed pa'i 'dun pa can kun bzang sbyin pas bskul ngor/ skyid grong smyon pas gter gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar rigs mthun gyi cho ga dag las kha bkang ste bklag chog mar/ yang rdzong snying po'i gter phug tu bkod pa dza yantu/ gu ru drag po dang dbang dang rgyas pa sogs rtsa gsum gzhan la sbyar na so so'i las byang dang mthun par rtsa ba'i lha sngags kha bsgyur bas grub bo/ dper na drag po'i skabs/ hūm̐: 'byung ba'i mnga' bdag me yi lha/ rab 'bar chos dbyings mnyam pa'i dbus/

bhrūm̐ las rang byung bhandha'i mkhar: rmang gzhi rdo rje rgya gram nag: gru bzhi sogs? gzhung ltar dang*/ mchod sngags la/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: sogs? rang gzhung ltar kha bsgyur ba dang*/ bsreg rdzas 'bul skabs/ bde gshegs kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul zhes pa/ padma khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ zhes pa lta bu/ lha mtshan kha bsgyur ba khyad par ro/ dmigs bsal sgrub mchod lta bu'i skabs tshom bu spyan 'dren byed na nyin snga ma'i phyi thun gyi mchod bstod skabs tshom bu bkod la 'jig rten me lhar bsreg 'bul grub nas 'bar ba'i rang bzhin du mos te 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me thab tu bud shing cung zad bsnan/ las bum chus bsang sbyangs byas nas/ las gzhung spyan 'dren sngon du btang la spos rol bcas tshom bu gdan 'dren/ rtsa sngags kyis tshom bu'i rtse mo thab tu 'bul zhing*/ hūm̐ 'byung ba'i mnga' bdag sogs? lha bskyed sbyin sreg gzhung ltar btang*/ spyan 'dren 'dir mi dgos pa khyad par dang mthar bshags pa'i rjes su gshegs gsol skabs/ ye shes pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gshegs/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la thim par gyur zhes tshom bu dkyil 'khor du gdan 'dren bya la gzhan rnams mtshungs so/ zhes pa'ang gu hyas so/ yam shing la/ oṃ bhaksha su swā hā: ku sha la/ oṃ ku swa tsa ra ta swā hā: durba la/ oṃ shri ta pa ku swā hā: bilba la/ oṃ bha tri swa ti swā hā: til dkar nag la/ oṃ ti la ti tha swā hā: mar zan la/ oṃ badzra tambu la ye swā hā: dzā ti li shi gur gum tsan dan la/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzye dhi hu swā hā: gser dngul g.yu byi ru mu tig la/ oṃ mu tig ratna ka swā hā: dar sna lnga la/ oṃ pañtsa shrī ka swā hā: 'bras gro so ba sran ma la/ oṃ ge sa ra u ta ka swā hā: zas sna thams cad la/ oṃ sarba bhi su ra pū dza me gha swā hā:

bdud rtsi la/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā hā: rakta la/ oṃ padma rā ga ti swā hā: gtor ma la/ oṃ bha lingta swā hā: : ༄༅/ /bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ bsnyen sgrub kha skong zhi ba'i sreg blugs zla ba'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 'bar ba'i gar gyis srid pa dpyi nas gnon/ /ye shes me lces logs 'dren bud shing bsregs/ /rdo rje'i mtshon gyis nyon mongs 'khrul 'khor gzhom/ /dpal chen drag po khyung zhon bla na rgyal/ de yang bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi bsnyen sgrub kha skong zhi ba'i sreg blugs zla ba'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni gzhung las/ dang po zhi ba'i phrin las ni: sa gzhi dkar la maṇḍal zlum: padma 'dab bzhi mu khyud bcas: bal dkar glang ma tsan dan dkar: zhi ba'i shing gis zlum por brtsig: mchod rdzas thams cad dkar por bsgyur: rang nyid kha ni shar du bstan: zhes pa ltar/ dus kyi khyad par yar ngo gza' skar dge ba'i snga dro'i char/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su thab stegs dkar po la/ ser bcad dam mdzes mtshon gyis dkyil 'khor legs par bzhengs pas/ lte bar padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa phyi rol du rdor phreng 'od kyi mu khyud/ phyogs bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dang bcas pa/ shar lhor me dar dkar po/ thab brtsigs zhi ba'i shing 'o ma can dang sman shing sogs tshon rtsi dkar po'i kha bsgyur ba zlum bskor dang*/ de nas sgrub pa po zhi ba'i chas kyi spras shing kha shar du phyogs pa'i mdun du/ las bum/ ḍā dril/ 'thor nas/ nang mchod/ dgang gzar blugs sogs dang*/ rang dang zhal sprod du stegs bu che ba'i khar g.yas su bla gtor zlum po me lha'i gtor ma bcas bsham pa'i mdun/ mchod rdzas nyer spyod lnga dang g.yas g.yon sman raka bcas 'jig 'das so sor 'bul rgyu nyis tshar bsham/ g.yon du bsreg rdzas thog mar dpal 'bar/

rlung g.yab/ mar khu/ zhi ba'i yam shing mdzub mo'i sbom phra la ring thung sor bcu gnyis pa pad kha can/ de nas mar khu/ til/ zho zan/ 'bras/ swo ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūrba/ ku sha sogs dang gzhan spungs rdzas/ gos zung*/ tambu la sogs rim bzhin 'jig 'das kyi dbye bar tshar gnyis bsham/ bdag bskyed kyi las gzhung bsrangs shing bzlas pa'i mjug tshogs mchod bsgral bstab dang bcas pa bya/ las bum bsang sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa: khro bo'i chas thams cad ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur/ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas sogs? shabda āḥhūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can: khro bo'i rgyal po khyod la bstod: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba de las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes bzlas/ mthar khro bo 'od du zhu ste chur thim pas de'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed pa'i khro bor gyur pas phrin las mdzad par mos/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum gyi dang po lce lag mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/ lce yi rtsa bar hrīḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du hrīḥbadzra dzi haṃ zhes pas rdo rje rtse gsum pa nyal stabs su gnas par gyur: lag g.yas nyi ma la hūm̐ dang : g.yon zla ba la āḥs mtshan pa ste thabs shes zung du 'jug par gyur: rdor dril bsang sbyang ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thabs kyi rdo rje las sems can thams cad smin par byed pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro bar gyur: oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje lan gsum gsor/ āḥlas dbyings phyug yum lnga'i rang bzhin shes rab dril bu'i rnam pas sems can thams cad rig pa sad par byed pa'i chos sgra rgyun mi chad par gyur: oṃ ma hā ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes dril bu dkrol/ rdor dril thabs shes kyi phyag rgyas snying khar bsnol zhing*/ hūm̐: thabs shes zung 'jug chos nyid mtshon:

ma lus 'gro rnams sad pa dang : sems can smin par bya ba'i phyir: rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol: oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hūm̐ āḥ 'di nas bzung sbyin sreg gi bya ba yongs rdzogs ma grub bar rdor dril sar mi 'jog pa dam tshig yin/ dgang blugs dang sreg rdzas rnams bsang sbyang ni/ blugs gzar thogs la/ hūm̐: thabs kyi rol pa las byung ting 'dzin gyi: dpa' bo rdo rje snod mchog g.yas su thogs: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ dgang gzar thogs la/ hūm̐: shes rab bde stong dga' bzhi'i snyoms 'jug gis: dpa' mo zab lam chos 'byung g.yon du thogs: mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: kha sbyor te rdzas rnams la g.yas skor du reg cing*/ hūm̐: chags med bdai stong ye shes rnam rol gyis: skye med sna tshogs rdzas kun byin gyis rlobs: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta a we sha ya a āḥ zhes lan gsum/ mchod pa byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha liṃ ta te dzwa bha liṃ ta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ sarba a haṃ dzñā na a mṛ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes lnga'am bdun gyis brlab/ gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ dge 'dun gyi tshang ngam dkyil 'khor gyi mar me las sbar ba'i lce lde thab tu gzhug cing*/ me thab bsang sbyang ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'phros me thab kyi dbus su 'khod pa las sems can thams cad kyi dug gsum zhi bar byed pa'i 'od zer ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bar gyur: oṃ dzwa la dzwa la oṃ āḥhūm̐:

zhes me sbar/ hūm̐ gis rlung g.yab/ me thab mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang : bhrūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar: rdo rje me 'od dkar gsal klong : oṃ las zhi ba'i me lha dkar: zhi 'dzum ghaṇḍe bgrang phreng bsnams: sha rgyas gzugs thung lto ba 'khyil: ra skyes khrir bzhugs drang srong skur: 'od 'phros rang 'dra spyan drangs bstim: spyan 'dren ni/ me dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: 'dir gshegs 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs: gus pa'i yid kyis khyod phyag 'tshal: bsreg blugs zhal zas tshogs bzhes la: zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: mchod yon 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di'am gzhan dag na: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med dang : mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal chab sogs: bdud rtsi dag pa lha mo'i tshogs: glu gar rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: bde ba'i nyams dang ldan phyir 'bul: oṃ agne dāe wa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: oṃ agni dāe wa sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: oṃ agne dāe wa sa pa ri wā ra añdza ma naṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: byon skyems dgang blugs kyis 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: a yig rang byung me hom du: haṃ yig byung ba bdud rtsi'i chu: rigs lnga yab yum snyoms 'jug gis: bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod: oṃ agna ye swā hā: zhes bdun gyis dgang blugs mar khus bkang ba kha sbyor zhing g.yas bskor gyis/ oṃ agna ye a ti bhyaḥpa ti bhyaḥ a be sha yaḥm hā shrī ya ha bhya ka bhya bha na ye swā hā: zhes lan gsum 'bul/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo ji snyed kun: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ agne de wa sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe dhū pe

sogs pra tītstsha ye swā hā: nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: 'dod yon bla med mchod pa 'di: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ agne de wa sa pa ri wā ra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra tītstsha ye swā hā: gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang*/ rakta dmar mchod arghaṃ dang : bcud ldan mchog gi gtor ma rnams: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ agne de wa sa pa ri wā ra badzra a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes sman raka gtor gsum 'bul/ tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ agne dāe wa sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: 'bar ba'i sku la sreg pa'i zhal: phrin las bzhi yi bdag nyid can: tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par bsam la/ oṃ agne ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis bkang ba'i dgang gzar gyi zags chu las babs pa'i mar khu bdud rtsi'i dwangs mar drangs te gsol bas dgyes shing tshim par bsams la gzar bu kha sbyar te/ oṃ agne ye dī bya bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bahna ya hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā/ zhes pas g.yas su bskor zhing lan gsum du dbul/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes spel tshig dang bcas lan gsum gyis gsol zhing me pra brtag

/de nas rdzas rnams rim bzhin 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'bar ba'i rdo rje drang srong lha tshogs la: ting 'dzin dbang bskur dam rdzas bdud rtsi rnams: dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags na: dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs te bzhes su gsol: oṃ dāe wa dzwa la agna ye swā hā/ oṃ dāe ba dzwa la agne ye nad gdon sdig sgrib shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: yam shing*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya swā hā/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sogs rdzas rnams thab tu dbul la gtang rag gi ched du 'bul rgyu'i rdzas lhag sngar bzhin du bsgrig /mar khu/ oṃ agne ye swā hā/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ til/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swā hā/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyang ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zho zan/ oṃ sarba samba de swā hā/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badzra puṣṭā ya swā hā/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ swo ba/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ye swā hā/ nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā be gā ye swā hā/ shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badzra ghasma ryai swā hā/ nad med phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ku sha/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swā hā/ srung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes rdzas rnams so sor nyer gcig re sogs 'bul/ gzhan yang bsreg rdzas ci 'byor pa agne ye dī bya bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bahna ya hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ 'dod gsol ni/ hūm̐: srid pa'i rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir: ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas: rang bzhin dag pa'i drang srong mchog: dam pa'i srid pa byed par shog: de nas yungs dkar thab tu gtor te/ hoḥ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes kyi bdag nyid/ 'byung ba chen po me'i rang bzhin drang srong chen po khyed kyis bdag dang yon bdag gi sdig sgrib sreg pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ me 'bar ba'i klong chen gnyis su med par bzhugs nas/ mchod rdzas rnams lha'i zhal du bstab cing*/ gang 'dod kyi phrin las skad cig tu 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes me lha 'bar ba dbyings kyi rang bzhin su mos/ gsum pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me thab tu bud shing cung zad bsnan/ las bum gyi chus bsang sbyangs la/ oṃ padma ta kri ta sogs kyis bsang*/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta sogs brjod pas stong par sbyang*/ hūm̐: 'byung ba'i mnga' bdag drang srong me yi lha: rab 'bar chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbus: bhrūm̐ las rang byung bhandha'i mkhar: rmang gzhi rdo rje rgya gram nag: gru bzhi sgo bzhi sna lnga'i rtsig: lha klu sde brgyad gza' rgyu skar: ka gdung gral lcam thog steng phub: dmar nag 'dod snam pha gu ser: drwa ba rus rgyan thod tshal 'phyangs: rlung gis sham bu lda ldi bskyod: mda' yab bhandha skam rlon spel: g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan tsitta'i tog: rta babs bya khyung seng 'brug ngar: chos 'khor hūm̐ sgra tog gis mdzes: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa mtshon:

me ri khyung dang lcags sdig gur: srid pa'i rlung yang mi thar bsgom: nang du dmar nag rakta'i mtshor: mi rta bam ro'i lhu dum 'khril: dur khrod rgyan 'phyang du ma bres: dbus su zla gam dmar smug klong : chos 'byung mthing nag bam gyi steng : gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ sgra can: me ri tshwa tshwa si li li: dran rdzogs padma he ru kaḥ khro rgyal drag po thod phreng rtsal: dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar 'khrugs: khro gtum spyan rtsa glog ltar 'gyu: dbu rgyan bya khyung rigs lnga rdzogs: g.yas gsum gri gug rdo rje me: g.yon gsum thod khrag lcags sdig sbrul: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog brgyangs: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal chas brgyan: zhabs bzhi khro bo rol pa'i stabs: bya khyung mthing nag me gshog brdzis: gsang ba khro mo gri thod mthing : 'khyud cing yab yum me dpung klong : lha srin sde brgyad 'dul bar bskyed: hūm̐: phyi rol gnam lcags rtsibs brgyad steng : shar du sgrol ging mthing nag rngam: g.yas gsum spu gri chu gri me: g.yon gsum thod phreng snying dang sdig: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs: me yi bya khyung dmar nag zhon: hūm̐: lho ru gtum ging sngo nag khro: g.yas gsum tsitta me chu gri: g.yon gsum kha ṭwāṃ lcags sdig me: dur khrod dpal chas rab tu rdzogs: 'joms byed bya khyung kham nag zhon: hūm̐: nub tu khro ging dmar nag gtum: g.yas gsum ral gri gri gug thod: g.yon gsum 'khor lo spu gri sdig: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal dang ldan: srog gzan bya khyung ser nag zhon: hūm̐: byang du las ging ljang nag rngam: g.yas gsum 'khor lo rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum tri shūl lcags sdig khyung : dur khrod chas ldan khro la brjid: gtor byed bya khyung ljang nag zhon: hūm̐: yum chen ging gi khro mo bzhi: rang mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis: gri thod 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud:

kun kyang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: 'jigs byed bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: dbu rgyan bya khyung rigs lnga rdzogs: thams cad gtso bo'i chas dang mthun: hūm̐: mtshams bzhir yab yum sprul pa'i khyung : dkar ser dmar ljang mthing la rngam: bswe mig zangs rwa lcags kyi mchu: me gshog rlabs kyis dpag tshad g.yo: dam sri 'dre rgod gnyen por bsgom: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi sgo yi las byed ma: shar du ma mo sdig pa'i gdong : lho ru ma mo chu srin gdong : nub tu ma mo phag gdong ma: byang du ma mo khyung gdong ma: bzhi ka gcer bu mi bzad pa: gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: phyag na gri gug bhan dmar dkrugs: thams cad lcags sdig mgo dgu zhon: dus 'khrug lo nyes mu ge dang : nad rims dal yams 'joms par gsal: hūm̐: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: khyung dang lcags sdig phag rgod 'gyed: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: gsal snang chu zla'i klong ltar bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas khrag 'thung khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs par gyur:

spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum dang : las kyi ma mo sprul khyung rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren myur du byon: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas mchod yon 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di'am gzhan dag na: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med dang : mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal chab sogs: bdud rtsi dag pa lha mo'i tshogs: glu gar rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: bde ba'i nyams dang ldan phyir 'bul: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra añdza ma nam pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de nas byon skyems 'bul ba ni/ blugs gzar mar khus bkang la/ hūm̐: a yig rang byung me hom du: haṃ yig byung ba bdud rtsi'i chu: rigs lnga yab yum snyoms 'jug gis: bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces lan gsum gyis 'bul/ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dre rgod dang : 'byung po sa bdag klu yi khrir: gdug pa 'dul ba'i rngam stabs kyis: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: mi bzad skur ston khrag 'thung pa: 'jigs byed bla ma drag po yi: phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: brkyang bskum gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang spyan gzigs dang : nang mchod sman gtor rakta dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'bul/ de bzhin du dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/

shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hā: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka ma hā rakta la khā hi/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka ma hā bha lingta khā hi/ oṃ ma hā ta na ga ṇa dharma dhā tu pū dza khā hi/ tshogs 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzhes: deng 'dir mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma drag po he ru kaḥ stobs 'dus padma khrag 'thung rgyal: sku mdog dmar nag srid gsum 'dul: zhal gsum khro zhing pho rgyud sngangs: spyan dgu sdang mig mo rgyud sdud: snyan nas 'brug sgra stong khams g.yo: shangs nas rlung dmar 'byung po gtor: khro bcu'i mche gtsigs dgra sha za: ljags dmar 'dre rgod snying khrag rngub: khyung gi dbu rgyan snang srid 'dul: sbrul bcings ral bsigs srid rtse 'gul: phyag drug mtshon cha dgra la 'debs: sgro gshog bar snang me 'od 'khrugs: dur khrod chas brgyad dregs pa 'dul: dpal chas ma tshogs dbang du sdud: zhabs bzhi dor thabs stong gsum gnon: srid pa'i khyung brdzis rgyal 'gong bsgral: yum chen gsang ba khro mo mthing : zhal gdangs khro gtum ma rungs brgyal: gri gug skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: bhan dmar 'byung po'i klad khrag rol: dur khrod chas ldan phar phyin rdzogs: yab 'khril sprul pa'i khro tshogs bskul: yab yum bskal pa'i me ri'i dbus: bzhugs shing tshwa tshwas stong khams khyab: dus ngan 'byung po 'dul byed pa: 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku: snang srid 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: khro chen mi bzad 'jigs pa'i ging : las kyi dpa' bo chen po bzhi: zhal gsum gdangs shing rgyal 'gong 'dul: spyan dgu bgrad pas klu gnyan sngangs: dbu rgyan bya khyung sa bdag 'joms: sgro gshog nad rims dal yams gzhom:
