g.yas gsum mtshon char dgra la 'bebs: g.yon gsum mtshon gyis dam sri bkums: dpal chas dus 'khrug 'dre rgod 'dul: zhabs bzhis khyung brdzis klu srin 'joms: rang mdog khro mo rigs bzhi rngam: gri thod 'dzin cing dug lnga gzhom: yab 'khril rang 'dra'i khro chung 'gyed: sku las me lce ya la la: yab yum ging chen tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ bswe mig tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: zangs rwa dmar po rngam la rno: me gshog stong khams 'u ru ru: lcags sder klu 'dzin khyugs se khyug: gnam lcags rkan dgra thags se thag: dam sri 'byung po'i snying khrag 'thung : sprul pa'i bya khyung bzhi la bstod: hūm̐: sdig pa chu srin phag dang khyung : gdong can sha za khro mo bzhi: zangs kyi gri gug lhabs se lhab: rakta'i khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: gcer mo skra dmar sa la gzhol: lcags sdig 'dur ldang khyugs se khyug: me char tshwa tshwa spungs se spung : sprul pa'i bya khyung phag dang sdig: 'byung po'i srog len myu ru ru: dkyil 'khor phyi nang gsang ba'i lhar: sgo gsum 'dun pas rab tu bstod: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar: nad mtshon 'byung po 'dre rgod dang : dam sri rgyal 'gong kha dar bas: khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: phyi yi dgra 'dre 'byung po thul: nang gi dug lnga'i bar chad sol: gsang ba'i skag rkyen dgra la phob: nad mtshon dal yams rtsad nas chod: las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg 'di: padma drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi: thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu: las dang nyams chag sgrib pa'i tshogs dag cing : byang chub bsgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing :

tshe dang sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin nas kyang : gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs la sogs: 'jigs pa brgyad po zhi bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ mar khus blugs gzar bkang ba'i bdud rtsi'i dwangs mar drangs te gsol bas dgyes shing tshims par bsams la gzar bu kha sbyar zhing g.yas su bskor zhing lan gsum du dbul/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ de nas yam shing*/ mar khu/ til/ zho zan/ 'bras/ swo ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūrba/ ku sha sogs dang gzhan spungs rdzas rnams/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rtsa sngags 'di kho nas 'bul la/ nyer gcig gam brgya re'i mtshams 'dod gsol/ bdag cag ma rig pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin ma gsal zhing bzlas brjod lhag chad du gyur pa sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi sgrib tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur ba nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod gsol sbyar/ de nas gtang rag mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang spyan gzigs dang : nang mchod sman gtor rakta dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'bul/ de bzhin du dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hā: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka ma hā rakta la khā hi/ de nas so rtsi phul la/ oṃ badzra tambu la ye swā hā/ gos zung 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra wasatra ye swā hā/ de nas 'bul gtor dgang gzar khar bzhag ste/ hūm̐: rdo rje dbyings kyi pho brang chen po nas: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho rnams:

thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo thugs rje bskyed: nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi ba'i dus la bab: nad gdon rkyen ngan zhi ba'i dus la bab: mi mthun 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dus la bab: 'byung po'i gdug rtsub zhi ba'i dus la bab: dam sri'i kha rlangs zhi ba'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo rgyal ba thugs rje can: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs bdud dgra zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: de yis zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med: zhi mdzad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka ma hā bha lingta khā hi/ zhes 'bul lo/ hūm̐ hrīḥ gtum chen drag shul dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams kun tu g.yo: bde stong ye shes snying rje khros pa'i tshul: padma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: padma drag po'i dkyil 'khor du: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa ci mchis pa: de dag khyed kyis bzod par gsol: yig brgya dang*/ sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ padma drag po'i dkyil 'khor gyis: zhi bar gyur pa'i las kun mdzad: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu stsal lags pas: bde gshegs yul du gshegs slad du: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: ci bde bar ni gshegs su gsol: rtsa sngags dang*/ badzra mu zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag gi lte ba'i a thung la bsdu'o/ sgrub mchod skabs/ bzod gsol rjes/ badzra muḥ thab kyi lha tshogs rnams dkyil 'khor pa'i thugs kar gshegs par gyur/ ces ye shes pa dkyil 'khor du gshegs shing tshom bu slar spyan drangs/ slar dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba khyad par ro/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la gnyis las dang po me lha gshegs su gsol ba ni/ bud shing kha gso bsang sbyang*/ oṃ agna ye swā hā: lan bdun 'bul zhing me lha gsal gdab la/ oṃ: agne chen po me yi lha:

'dod pa'i don rnam rab sgrub cing : thugs rjes sems can don byed pa: gtang rag mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ agne ye dī bya bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā/ zhes pas g.yas su bskor zhing dgang blugs dbul/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ de nas rdzas rnams rim bzhin 'bul ba las/ yam shing*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya swā hā/ mar khu/ oṃ agne ye swā hā/ til/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swā hā/ zho zan/ oṃ sarba samba de swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badzra puṣṭā ya swā hā/ swo ba/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ye swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā be gā ye swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badzra ghasma ryai swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swā hā/ ku sha/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swā hā/ zhes rdzas rnams so sor lan re'i rdzogs par 'bul/ gzhan yang bsreg rdzas ci 'byor pa oṃ dāe wa dzwa la agna ye swā hā/ oṃ dāe ba dzwa la agne ye nad gdon sdig sgrib shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo ji snyed kun: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ agne de wa sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de bzhin dhū pe sogs pra tītstsha ye swā hā: oṃ agne de wa sa pa ri wā ra badzra a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes sman raka 'bul/ de nas so rtsi phul la/ oṃ badzra tambu la ye swā hā/ gos zung 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra wasatra ye swā hā/ me lha'i gtor ma dgang gzar khar bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis byin brlabs la/ me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha: drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag: shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas pa:

mchod cing bstod do phyag kyang 'tshal: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces pas gtor ma me nang du bzhu/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: 'bar ba'i sku la sreg pa'i zhal: phrin las bzhi yi bdag nyid can: tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa gang mchis pa: de dag khyed kyis bzod par gsol: oṃ agne dāe wa te pa ma dag pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gshegs gsol ni/ hūm̐: drang srong chen po me yi lha: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: khyed kyis sems can don mdzad nas: pho brang nyid du gshegs su gsol: badzra mu: ye shes pa shar lhor gshegs/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la bsdu'o/ de nas bsngo smon dang bkra shis mdor bsdus bya/ rjes su bdag gis rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas thugs dam bskul/ tshogs lhag chad brtan dngos grub len chog bzod gsol sogs rjes bsdu rnams las byang ltar bya zhing*/ me ro dal gyis zhi ba'am 'o chus bsad la thal ba yang chu rlung chen por dor/ yo byad lhag ma rnams kyang mi mngon par bsdu'o/ de ltar bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi bsnyen sgrub kha skong zhi ba'i sreg blugs zla ba'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba 'di yang sgrub chen dang bsnyen sgrub sogs la nyer mkho'i ched rang gzhung bla ma zhi ba'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga ye shes 'od dpung la gzhi byas shing*/

rigs mthun gzhan nas kha skong cung zad dang bcas rab byung bcu bdun pa rab gnas shing sprel lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por gang gi chos bdag sngags 'chang ārya dhwa dza'i skyes rabs lnga pa'i ming 'dzin gnam lcags pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nas bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni 'brong pa rdo shul gyi bande gsang sngags 'gro 'dul gyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ sngags bzlas dmigs pa'i zin bris snyan brgyud gyi gdams ngag bcud kyi snying po bzhugs so// mkha' grub buddha'i mtshan gyi zhal lung bzlas pa'i dmigs rim ni/ bskyed rim gtsor ston pa ma hā yo ga'i sgrub pa sku'i snang brnyan dang sngags phreng sa bon gyi spro bsdu sgrub pa sogs dang*/ a nu yo ga'i sgrub pa rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga yi bskyed rim gsal gdab pa/ me thab drug gi dmigs pa ltar bsgom zhing rlung la brten pas nad gdon bar chad sogs zhi ba mchog yin la/ rlung bzung zhing lte 'og gi ā dmar po'i me 'bar zhing lus kheng*/ ma dag pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad bsregs/ dag pa ye shes kyi lus snang stong du dmigs par gsal btab la/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bya sgro me la bsregs pa ltar/ lus kyi nang thams cad lcags sreg ltar dmar lhang lhang*/ me lce ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas dmar zi ri ri 'bar bas dpag tshad rgya phrag gi gnas su gdon bgegs 'byung po gang yang mi tshugs pa'i me dpung du bsgoms la/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su yang de ltar yang yang sgom bzlas byed chog /ratna'i lugs kyi drag po bla ma'i bsnyen sbyor gyi dgongs don nyams su len/ 'di nad gdon la sogs la shin tu zab par snang lags/ de nas rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga ltar nyams su len pa'i rim pa bskyed rdzogs zung du gsal gdab pa/

de yis gshis ci yang mi rtog pa stong pa/ de yi rang mdangs ma 'gags par lha yi sku mdog rgyan cha lugs gsal ba ngo bo ci yang mi rtog pa ye nas rang la rang chas su yod pa las/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa 'jug pa de las de bzang zhig re ba nor la/ de bas a ti blo 'das ltar nyams su blang ba ni gong ltar gu ru drag po dbang gi ngo sprod las/ bu ma yengs bar ltos shig /de yi tshe dngos po mthong ba med pa la/ sa le/ hrig ge /rjen ne/ rjes su myong du yod pa las/ de la ngo shes par gyis la dus dang rnam pa kun tu bsgom rgyu spu tsam med pa yengs su skad cig kyang med pa'i don skal ldan khyed rnams kyis nyams su longs shig /rtogs pa bstan cing bsgoms na rtogs ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ zhes gsung phyir thams cad kyi gtso bo de las gzhan med par thugs 'jags zhu zhu/

༄༅/ /bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung las/ bsnyen sgrub kyi yi ge grub gnyis 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ rang rig bla ma drag po rtsal/ /padma khrag 'thung la 'dud de/ /de yi bsnyen sgrub las kyi khrigs/ /grub gnyis dpal ster yid bzhin gyi/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud len 'di na spro/ de yang rgyud las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la 'dud/ ces gsungs pa bzhin/ sgrub pa thams cad kyi nang nas bla ma sgrub pa mchog tu gsungs shing khyad par du slob dpon chen po ni/ spyir rgyal ba thams cad kyi spyi gzugs yin par/ nyid kyis zhal nas kyang*/ nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong*/ /nga sgrub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub/ /nga nyid sangs rgyas kun 'dus yin/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin bsgrub bya rtsa ba gsum dang*/ zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad bla ma sgrub pa la 'dus shing phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sus kyang ma thul ba'i rmu rgod snyigs ma'i sems can rnams sangs rgyas dngos kyi zhal mthong gsung thos kyi skal ba med pa la/ rgyal ba'i phrin las mi yi gzugs su byon pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal bstan chos gsungs nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la mngon du bkod par mdzad pa'i bka' drin sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pas bla ma la gsol ba btab na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs thugs rje cig car du 'jug cing lhag par gu ru rin po ches thugs bskyed smon lam gyi dbang gis gdul bya'i gtso bo bod yul yin zhing*/ dus kyi tha ma bod 'bangs la lhag par thugs brtse zhing byin gyis rlob par zhal gyis bzhes pa yin te/ gsol 'debs las/ sku ni lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: thugs rjes bod kyi sems can yongs la gzigs: zhes dang*/ nangs re dgong re bod kyi don la byon:

nyi zer 'char sdud mdangs la bcibs te byon: yar ngo tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon: 'gro don stobs chen mdzad pa'i thugs rje can: zhes dus gsum 'du 'bral med par skyob par zhal bzhes tshad mas mi bslu ba yin la/ de ma zad rang gi sgrub thabs rang gis mdzad ces gsungs pa bzhin/ thugs sgrub bye ba phrag brgya sogs mang du mdzad cing*/ de dag kyang gtso bo bla ma sgrub pa yin mod/ sgrub lugs la phyi gsol 'debs ltar sgrub pa dang*/ nang sku gsum ltar sgrub pa/ gsang ba rlung sems dbyer med ltar sgrub pa/ yang gsang bla ma drag por sgrub pa ste tshul bzhi las/ 'di ni yang gsang bla ma drag po ltar sgrub pa yin no/ de yi dgos pa yang*/ gter gzhung las/ ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: chos pa rnams kyang chos gzugs rtags tsam 'dzin: nyams len snying rus smyug ma'i sdong po 'dra: yi dam mi sgrub rgyal 'gong the'u rang bsgrub: de yi rkyen gyis stong khams ru trar skye: yi dam mi dgyes ri rab logs la gzigs: steng 'og 'khrugs shing nad mtshon char pa g.yo: chos rgyal bris pa'i ri mo shul rjes smra: ma 'ongs de dus 'gro mang skyob pa yi: yang zab snying thig zab chos bka' rgya can: bla ma drag po sgrub pa'i las tshogs 'di: gzhan las khyad 'phags yid bzhin nor bu'i chos: tshig nyung don che myur zab snying gi cha: yang gsang 'di 'dra gzhan la sbas pa med: ces gsungs pa ltar dus kyi tha ma chos byed yongs la bar chad mang zhing lhag par du gdon gyi gtso bo pho gdon gza' klu rgyal 'gong dang*/ mo gdon bsen mo sogs kha dar nas sngar ma grags pa'i nad rims du mas skye 'gro'i srog la hur thum gzir zhing snyigs dus gdul bya spyi dang*/ khyad par du dam chos sgrub pa la 'gal rkyen bar chad mang zhing mthun rkyen nyung ba'i skabs zhi bas 'dul bar dka' ba rnams drag po'i lha sngags kyis 'dul dgos par gsungs pa bzhin/

'dul bar dka' zhing rgyud ma rungs pa bdud dang ru tra'i tshogs la dbang dang drag po'i phrin las kyis tshar bcad de 'dul ba'i phyir khro bo'i skur bzhengs pa yin pas rno la myur/ de yang gu drag phal cher dpe har btul ba'i lo rgyus dang 'brel la/ dmar nag me phreng sogs phyag mtshan yang lcags sdig 'dzin pa mang*/ 'ga' zhig gdug pa klu gnyan sa bdag btul ba'i mdzad pa dang 'brel bas gu ru drag khros phag zhon can dang rta zhal khyung gdong sogs du mar snang la/ 'di ni gnyen po kun 'dus drag po khyung zhon zhes steng du bya khyung gi dmag tshogs spros shing phyag mtshan las lcags sdig gi tshwa tshwa 'phro bas rgyal 'gong dam sri hab hab za bar byas shing*/ rol du gdong can bzhi dang dug gi phag rgod 'thibs pas 'og gdon 'joms par byed pa dang*/ khyad par du glo bur lhag pa'i 'dre rgod dang nad rims dal yams kyi gnyen por gcig chog yin te/ gter gzhung las/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: bod mi mgo nag bsod nams chung : mi dge dug sbyor nag po yi: bar chad ldang zhing dus min 'chi: mtha' yi mi bzhi dbus su bsnyeg: dam sri 'dre rgod tsha ngar che: sngar gyi chos khrims sil bur 'thor: chos rgyal dmangs kyi khol du 'bebs: gtsug lag bya sprang yul 'dres 'dzin: bcos thabs ma mchis nad rigs dar: srin mos sha khrag dmar 'gyed gtong : grib btsan shan pa rlung ltar 'tshub: dmar nad lhog yams tre tre hoḥ rims yams me dbal sha khol gyis: bar chad sdang zhing mi thog 'bud: smyo 'bog snying gzer steng grib kyi: ltas ngan sna dgu ldang ba'i dus: srung thabs man ngag khyad par can: gu ru bdag gis legs par gdams: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig mar grags pa'i gzhan zla dang bral ba yin pa ma zad sku'i cha la gnas lngar ya mānta ka hya ghṛ wa mkha' 'gro sde lnga yaksha me dbal te/ gnyen po stobs kyi lha ma lus par rdzogs pas byin rlabs dang dngos grub nus mthu thams cad 'di kho na la brten nas 'grub nus pas bsgrub bya lha yi che ba yin no/

gnyis pa bsnyen sgrubs nyams su len pa la/ sgrub pa'i gnas kyang dben zhing rgyal ba gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa sogs mdor na 'gal rkyen nyung zhing yo byad mthun rkyen sogs dgos pa'i nyer mkho tshang ba gal che la/ de dag gi rgyab rten bsod nams kyi dpung bskyed pa'i thabs dang bar chad sel ba'i sna sel du/ spro na sgrub pa chen po'i khog dbub dngos grub nyi ma 'gugs pa'i skya rengs kho bos byas pa ltar grub na legs/ bsdus pa'i dbang du byas na/ thog mar bla gab med pa'i sar bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rgyal brngan lha bsang sogs mgron bzhi spyi mchod byas te sgrub pa mthar phyin cing bar chad med pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ sgrub gnas gsar pa yin na sa brtag slong dbang du bya ba/ sbyang zhing bsrung ba rnams sgrub khog ltar shes par bya yis sgrub gnas rnying pa la mi dgos so/ de lta bu'i gnas su bsnyen sgrub nyams su len pa'i skabs/ thog mar bsnyen rkyang yin na dam tshig gi rten bris sku sogs bkram pa'i mdun sgrub gtor sman raka gtor gsum srung ma'i rten gtor chad brtan bskul gsum rgyun bzhag rnams bkod la/ mthar nyer spyod sogs bsham pa tsam gyis chog /rang mdun du las bum/ ḍā dril 'thor nas nang mchod sogs 'du bya/ rang gi stan 'og tu sa dkar gyi g.yung drung bris pa'i steng rtswa ku sha rtse mo mdun bstan du bsnyal ba'i khar mal stan legs par bca' ba sogs sbyor ba'i chos rnams legs par grub par bya/ nyams len dngos la 'jug pa ni/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems tshogs bsags kyis rgyud sbyangs/ rgyun khyer ram gsang sgrub sogs sgrub thabs gzhung bsrangs te mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar la btang*/ bzlas pa grub pa dang gsol kha nas tshogs skong chad brtan rta bro mchod bstod bsdu rim lhar ldang byas te bkra shis bar brjod rjes sngar gyi lhar ldang gi nga rgyal de ka'i mur/

rtsa sngags kyi gsal gdab tsam brjod pa dang chabs cig sngon gtor sde brgyad mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas sa lha dkar gtor bsham zhing byin gyis brlabs la dkar po'i phyogs yul ris skyong ba'i gnas gzhi'i bdag po la/ gtor ma sbyin zhing byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs gyis shig ces phrin las bcol/ de nas phyi nang gsang mtshams gcod pa rnams spro na sgrub khog ltar byas la bgegs gtor byin brlab cing sngags kyis bsngo/ las byang ltar bka' bsgo zhing mtshams bcad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ mthar bkra shis dang bcas re zhig grol/ de nas bzung ste phyi nang gi rgyu 'grul bcad la rang gis mi sogs gzhan mthong na mtshams bug pa dang*/ gzhan gyis rang mthong na ral ba yin pas dmigs 'og tu ma chud pa dang mi 'phrad par bya zhing chas ka'i gtong len cing mi byed/ cis kyang dgos na srung 'khor drag tu bsgom dngos chas gtong len sogs kyi skabs nyams grib sbyang phyir rdor sems sme brtsegs lta bu'i khrus bum bsgrubs te 'thor 'thung bya/ dngos gzhi ni phyi thun dbang gi dus su mgo 'dzugs dgos pa yin pas thun mtshams lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje he ru ka khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i skur gyur bar mos la/ gtor ma byin rlabs bsngo ba bgegs bskrad/ gu gul bdug /hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ thun gyis brabs shing bgegs gtor phyir bskyal ba'i bar dkyus ltar bya/ nang du logs pa dang sgrub sgo bsdams te gzhung gi mtshams gcod 'don mthar/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ zhes rang gi thugs srog nas 'od zer me dpung khro chung gi tshwa tshwa grangs med pa 'phros bgegs tshogs rnams bskal pa'i pha mthar bskrad cing 'od zer tshur 'dus pas rdo rje'i srung gur gzhom zhig dang bral ba cis kyang mi shigs pa'i rang bzhin du gsal btab/

'di mtshams mgo tshugs nas mthar ma phyin bar mi bsdu zhing nyin re'i thun mjug tu dmigs pas gsal tsam byas pa'i mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa gnad yin no/ de nas bde ba'i stan la bag phebs par 'khod de thog mar kun slong legs par bcos shing dam bca' bzung*/ de nas tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang skyabs sems tshogs bsags rnams rgyun ltar la skabs 'dir bgegs bskrad srung 'khor rnams sngar song zin pas mi dgos shing mchod rlob nas bzlas pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya/ bstod pa'i mthar dngos gzhi gtso bo gsal snang dang nga rgyal sbrel ma cung zad bya zhing bzlas pa phreng skor gsum tsam grub ma thag dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig gam mchod bstod song nas rjes chog nyer bsdus kyi bar grub nas thun mtshams lha skur ldang la bsngo smon bkra shis brjod/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor rnams rang lugs chos spyod sa brtol ljon bzang ltar shes par bya'o/ skabs 'dir phyag len du sngon 'gro sngar song zin pa rnams kyi kha skong du dang po sngon 'gro'i kun slong bcos pa nas bzung blo ldog rnam bzhi dang*/ nang gi sngon 'gro bsags sbyang gi rim pa rnams skabs thob nyin shas bar ci 'grub bya srol yod pas de ltar byas na rab dang*/ deng sang phal cher nyin re bzhin thor thun la sngon 'gro btang ba tsam gyis 'grigs par bya ba yin pas zhor brjod dang*/ dngos gzhi nyin gnyis pa nas bzung thun bzhi rgyun chags bya ba yin la/ dang po thor thun du tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor nas brtsams/ sngon 'gro rgyun ldan ltar song nas dngos gzhi tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas rang gzhung gsol 'debs dang*/ nad 'joms par bu chog khrigs ltar la bsnyen dmigs dang bzlas pa gad rgyangs ltar rtsa bsnyen badzra tsaṇḍa kho na bsags/ grub ma thag dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig gam mchod bstod song nas rjes chog nyer bsdus kyi bar grub nas thun mtshams lha skur ldang la bsngo smon bkra shis brjod/

thun grol nas bsang mchod mdor bsdus sogs rang lugs thun mtshams chos spyod ltar bya/ snga thun la sngon 'gro mi dgos/ dngos gzhi tshig bdun gsol 'debs gnas ri so dgu ma sogs gsol 'debs rgyas spros dang*/ de nas las byang yang rdo rje'i gad rgyangs ltar skyabs sems kyi rjes bgegs gtor byin rlabs bsngo ba rnams dor nas bka' bsgo ba srung 'khor mtshams gcod nas brtsam bsnyen pa dang*/ mchod bstod song ste rjes chog nyer bsdu'i bar grub nas thun mtshams dkyus ltar bya ba yin no/ de nas phyi thun la gsang sgrub gzhung bsrang bsnyen pa grub nas dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig bcas song ste gsol kha la 'jug mthar gzhung ltar rjes chog snga ma ltar dang*/ bsngo smon sogs 'dir rgyas spros bya srol yod/ srod thun ni gsol 'debs skyabs sems nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum bar gzhung ltar dang de nas nad 'joms par bu bsnyen dmigs sogs thor thun dang mtshungs so/ da ni las kyi byang bu cung zad spros te bshad pa la/ sngon dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la'ang gsum/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba la/ thog mar skyabs yul bla ma dang gnyis su med par gu ru rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs skad cig mig 'phrul ltar gsal btab la/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du ci mdzad khyed shes kyis skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o snyam pa ni kun rdzob dang*/ 'khor 'das dbyer med dbyings rig 'od gsal rdo rje snying po blo bral chos nyid chen por 'khor ba rnam par dag cing 'pho med zung 'jug gi sku mchog mngon du gyur par blta ba don dam ste/ de ltar kun rdzob don dam zung 'jug gi ngang nas skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ chos thams cad ye gdod nas dag kyang yin lugs ma shes pa'i 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud du 'phyan nas sdug bsngal mtha' med par gyur pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje dang*/

de rnams bdag gis byang chub la dgod par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa dang*/ de'i ched du rim gnyis zab mo'i lam la slob par mos pa ni 'jug pa yin la/ de yang re dogs blang dor dang bral ba spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ don dam pa'i sems bskyed de/ de ltar mdo sngags dgongs pa gcig pa'i zab gnad du shes par nyams su len/ de dag ni lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba bde bar gshegs pa'i dang po byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos mtshungs pa yin pas gal che'o/ mthar tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par mos la 'khor gsum spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ skabs 'dir las bum sgrub na chos spyod ltar bya/ gsum pa la'ang 'gal spong dang mthun sgrub gnyis/ dang po rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lha ru ldang ste dkar gtor byin gyis brlab/ gang dag dkar po'i phyogs yul ris skyong ba'i gnas gzhi'i bdag po la/ gtor ma sbyin zhing byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs gyis shig ces phrin las bcol/ de nas nag po'i phyogs su gtogs pa'i lan chags bgegs rigs rnams la gtor ma 'dod yon gyi phung po mi zad pa'i gter du bsgyur te byin gyis brlab/ gnyis rtog las gyur pa'i 'dre gdon stong gsum gyi ru tra rnams byang chub lam la 'god 'dun gyis snying rje'i lcags kyus bzung la/ zag med ting 'dzin gyi gtor ma bsngos te bden gnyis gnas lugs brjod pas rgyud grol te mtha' bral ka dag gi dbyings su phyir mi ldog pa'i rgya yis gdab par bya'o/ de ltar rang rgyud 'khrul pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i rnam rtog bdud kyi tshogs ye shes rang snang gi 'od zer mi shigs pa'i srung mtshams rim pa bdun gyis snod bcud mu med du bcings pas srung 'khor dang*/ 'khor 'das mtha' bral ka dag gnyug ma brdal khyab dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du 'khor bas mtshams gcad pa ni mtshams gcod do/

de dag ni bdud bcom pa'i mdzad pa dang chos mtshungs pa yin no/ gnyis pa mthun rkyen sgrub pa la gsum/ dang po mchod pa byin brlab ni/ phyi nang gsang mchod thams cad ye nas rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa la/ cir snang bde ba chen po 'dod rgu lhun grub thabs shes bde stong ye shes kyi rol pa rten 'brel phyogs med du 'char ba'i mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin/ gzhi dbyings 'du 'bral med pa 'od gsal gyi gter chen por byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ snod bcud sgrub rdzas gzhal yas khang dang lha yi rol rtsal rnam dag ye shes kyi 'khor lor shes pas ting nge 'dzin la rtsal sbyang bar bya'o/ gnyis pa byin dbab pa ni/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa ltar byon nas rten bsgrub kyi rdzas dang rnal 'byor pa'i sgo gsum la sib sib thim pas rnam dag ye shes kyi 'khor lor sad par mos la byin dbab/ gsum pa brda dbye brda phyag dam bzung ni/ ma rig blang dor gyi chos thams cad ye grol gdod ma'i gnas lugs ji bzhin pa'i lha dang lta ba mjal ba'i phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ 'du 'bral gnyis su med pa'i rang rtsal ma spangs rgyan gyis mchod cing gnyis 'dzin gyi dri ma ka dag gi ngang du bshags shing snod bcud bde stong ye shes kyi rol pa lam du lhong ba dang*/ tha mal du mi 'byams par chos nyid don las mi 'da' ba ni dam bca' ba ste/ de dag ni bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing sgrib pa sbyang ba dang chos mtshungs pa yin pas des mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i sngon 'gros chos rnams grub par byas pa yin no/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ dang po sku phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor/ gsung bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ thugs 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor ro/

dang po sku phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor la'ang lnga/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis khog dbub pa dang*/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ ye shes pa spyan drangs shing brtan par bzhugs pa/ phyag 'tshal mchod bstod bya ba'o/ dang po la snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ye grol ka dag gi ngang las nam yang 'da' ba med pas 'dus ma byas pa'i chos nyid ye nas stong par gnas pa ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo ngo bo stong pa nyid dang*/ stong nyid de yi rang bzhin 'di lta bu'o zhes mtshan ma'i blo yi spyod yul las 'das pa ni rgyu mtshan ma med pa dang*/ de lta bu'i chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang la 'bras bu thob bya dang 'thob byed las 'das pa'i gang la'ang yid smon med pa ni 'bras bu smon pa med pa'o/ de lta bu'i chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba la blo yang spros pa dang bral bar bzhag pas bsal bzhag spang blang dang bral ba rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil ltar gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa ni de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin no/ de yang nam mkha'i dbyings dag pa las glo bur du 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa shar yang nam mkha'i cho 'phrul tsam las/ bden par ma grub pa bzhin du stong nyid de bzhin nyid kyi gnas lugs la 'khor 'das gnyis su ma grub pas gnyis med kyi ngang la ma g.yos bzhin du sgyu ma'i mtshang ma shes par bslus pa ltar rtsal snang la bden par bzung bas 'khrul te/ 'khor ba'i gnas su rang dbang med par 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag /gtan du sdug bsngal las bsgral bar bya'o snyam du sgrol 'dod kyi snying rje 'dzin med sgyu ma ltar shar ba ni kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin no/ de ltar stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa mi 'gyur bde ba chen po brtan g.yo srid zhi'i chos thams cad la khyab cing rjes su song ba'i ngo bo rdo rje ltar mi phyed pas/ rang bzhin byang chub sems kyi rten du gyur pa dwangs ma'i srog chen po nyid rnam pa shin tu gsal zhing dwangs la 'gyur ba med cing cir snang 'char du rung ba/

mi shigs pa'i thig le chen po ngo bo nyid du shar bar mtshon pa'i gnam lcags kyi rdo rje hūm̐ dmar nag gis mtshan par bsgom pa ni/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang bde gsal gyi rnam 'phrul stong nyid kyi rang bzhin can du 'char ba'i rgyu byas pas na rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin yin no/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum po 'dis/ sbyang bya 'chi srid bar srid skye srid de/ srid pa gsum gyi bag chags dang*/ rtag lta dang chad lta bdag mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i zhen rtog dang*/ gzugs med gzugs khams 'dod khams te khams gsum gyi bag chags rnams sbyangs shing dag par byed/ yar chos sku longs sku sprul sku ste sku gsum gyi sa bon gsos 'debs pa'i 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ lam dus su rdzogs rim don gyi 'od gsal dang*/ zung 'jug /rlung sems kyi lha skur ldang ba'i smin byed du 'gyur ro/ gnyis pa rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang brten pa lha bskyed pa gnyis/ dang po la'ang gsum/ 'og gzhi 'byung ba rim brtsegs bskyed pa/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa/ gdan bskyed pa'o/ dang po srung 'khor gyi nang du nam mkhar gnas pa'i rgyu yi sa bon las 'byung ba'i yi ge rnams rim par chad pa las gzhi las rlung lnga g.yos/ 'byung lnga'i yig 'bru rnams rim bzhin thim pa las/ dbang chen bzhi rim e las nam mkha' chos 'byung mthing nag gdengs ka gyen du bstan zhing rtsa ba phra la thur du zugs pa/ de'i steng du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang gu rgya gram gyi dbyibs can/ de yi steng du ram̐ las me yi dkyil 'khor dmar nag gru gsum pa/ de yi steng du kham̐ las rakta'i rgya mtsho zlum po dmar chen gyi rba rlabs 'khrugs pa/ sum̐ las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi gru bzhi par bam gsar rnying ri ltar spungs pa'i dbus su/ keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi ldan gyi steng du kha khyer gru bzhi pa lcags ris yongs su bskor ba zhig bsgom pa'o/

'dis sbyang bya 'khrul ngor snang ba'i 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas/ ma dag pa'i las snang rnams yin la de rnams sbyangs shing dag /sbyong byed 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud ye shes lnga yi yon tan bsdus pa yum lnga'i klong du gsal gdab pas sbyangs 'bras gang du sangs rgya ba'i zhing khams yum lnga'i mkha' klong du rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o/ des 'byung lnga dag pa rigs kyi yum lnga zhes gzhi 'bras sbrel ba'i nga rgyal bya/ yang rgyu yi sa bon las yi ge bhrūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan du chad pa ri rab kyi steng du babs pas 'phro 'dus 'od du zhu ba las/ ngo bo ye shes lnga'i gzhal yas khang dur khrod kyi rgyan bkod rdzogs par sgom pa ste/ de yang srung gur yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang ri rab kyi steng du rdo rje'i rdul phra mo 'dus pa'i sa gzhi khod snyoms par byas pa'i mthar rdo rje'i rwa ba lcags ri lta bus bskor ba las kha dog lnga yi me dpung 'phro ba'i dbus su khyung dang lcags sdig sogs tshwa tshwa 'phro zhing srung ba'i gur khang srid pa'i rlung yang mi thar bar bsgom/ de yi nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis 'jigs par bskor ba'i nang du padma 'dab ma stong ldan/ de yi steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ge sar gyi rgya dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba mthing nag gru bzhi pa phyogs mdog can/ de yi steng du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rtsig pa rim pa lnga ldan 'dod snam dmar nag la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams gar rtse ba lha klu sde brgyad gza' dang rgyu skar rnams kyi ka gdung gral lcam thog steng phub pa/ nyi zla'i skar khung*/ pha gu ser po sbrul dang thod pa'i drwa ba dang rus rgyan thod tshal 'phyangs pa/ rlung gis sham bu rgyu ma'i lda ldi bskyod pa/ mda' yab la bhandha skam rlon spel ma/ g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan dang tsitta'i tog gis mdzes pa/ zhing chen gyi bla re/

ro skra'i rnga yab/ glo snying gi 'phyang 'phrul/ rta babs rnams sor mo thod pa don snying nyi zla'i phreng bas dkris pa la bya khyung seng 'brug rnams kyis ngar skad sgrogs pa/ chos 'khor gyi rtser hūm̐ sgra bsgrags shing rdo rje'i tog gis mdzes par gsal ba'o/ sbyang bya ni/ rang re rnams gang du skye ba'i snod 'jig rten dang*/ der skye ba'i las kyi bag chags sems la bgos pa rnams sbyang*/ sbyong byed/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi pho brang nyid lam du byas pa dang*/ sbyangs 'bras/ don gyi 'og min rang snang rnam par dag pa'i gzhal med khang mngon du byed pa yin no/ de nas gdan bskyed pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su khrag mtsho brag chen gtams par gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i steng du dbang gi zla gam dmar smug /de'i steng chos 'byung mthing nag gi steng khams gsum gyi dregs byed ma lus pa zil gyis mnan pa'i brdar/ srid pa'i lha klu che dgu sogs draigs pa sde brgyad bsnol ba/ de'i steng skyon gyis ma gos pa'i padma dang thabs shes zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ rtogs med bam ro'i gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa'o/ de yang sbyang bya la mtshon na padma ma'i mngal/ nyi ma rdul/ zla ba khu ba/ sa bon yi ge dri za nye bar len pa'i rnam shes dkar dmar tshogs pa 'jug ka ma'i gnas skabs dang*/ sa bon phyag mtshan du 'gyur ba ni/ dkar dmar sems gsum gcig tu 'dres pa de sbyong*/ de las 'od zer spro bsdus ni 'byung bzhi'i byed las kyi skye mched rim par grub pa dang*/ phyag mtshan de gnas 'gyur te sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ lus rdzogs nas btsas pa'i bar bag chags rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin la/ sbyangs 'bras gang 'dul sprul pa'i skur bzhengs pa na/ lhums su zhugs nas bltams pa'i tshul bar gyi mdzad pa de'o/ gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la mngal skyes sbyong byed bsdus pa rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed ltar bya ba la/

sngar bskyed pa'i rgyu yi sa bon de nyid gdan gyi khar skad cig gis babs pa ni gsung yig 'bru/ de las 'od zer spro bsdu byas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs/ 'od zer gyi tshul du slar 'dus te 'od du zhu ba las gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ dmar nag gis mtshan par gyur pa ni thugs phyag mtshan/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las dbang drag padma he ru ka bsgom pa ni sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i cho ga zhes bya ste/ lam dus su pad nyi zla ba ni rtsa 'khor bde drod 'bar 'dzag mtshon zhing*/ sa bon phyag mtshan rlung sems dhū tir thim pa/ spro bsdu ni zhu bde las byung ba'i bde stong*/ sku rdzogs pa ni lhan skyes ye shes sku 'grub rung du mtshon pas na rdzogs rim smin byed du 'gro'o/ de'ang rnam pa gsal ba ni/ khro gtum bzod par dka' ba sku mdog dmar nag dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar nag tu 'khrugs pa/ spyan dgu glog ltar 'gyu ba/ spyi bor dbu rgyan gyi tshul bya khyung rigs lnga lding ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum gri gug dang rdo rje me dpung*/ g.yon gsum thod khrag dang lcags sdig sbrul zhags bsnams pa/ zhabs bzhi khro bo rol pa'i dor stabs kyi bya khyung mthing nag bswe mig zangs ra lcags kyi mchu can phyag gnyis kyi dug sbrul gnyis kyi mgo bo khar bcugs nas za ba/ me yi gshog pa'i rlabs kyis dpag tshad g.yo ba'i steng du brdzis pa/ gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje phag mo mthing nag gri thod 'dzin zhing yab la 'khyud cing yab yum gnyis ka /bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du sku la dur khrod rol pa'i chas brgyad dang*/ dpal gyi chas bcus brgyan zhing lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru gsal gdab bo/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad las/ bgo ba'i gos gsum ni mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi/ glang chen gyi stod g.yogs/

stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsum mo/ 'dogs pa'i rgyan gnyis ni thod pa skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ sbrul rgyan la/ rgyal rigs dkar po'i skra chings/ rje rigs ser po'i snyan rgyan/ bram ze rigs dmar po'i mgul rgyan/ dmangs rigs ljang gu'i phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ gdol pa nag po'i do shal rnams so/ byug pa'i rtsi gsum ni/ dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu/ mkhur tshos la rakta'i thig le/ mgrin par zhag gi zo ris bcas gsum mo/ de brgyad kyi steng me dpung dang rdo rje dang rin po che'i gshog pa bsnan pas dpal gyi chas bcu zhes bshad la tshul gzhan yang bshad pa yod do/ bdag nyid padma drag po gsal ba'i thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten gyi bum pa'i gzhal yas su padma dang nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor ba'i nang hūm̐ las ye shes sems dpa' gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje mthing nag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ de yi thugs kar dmar ser thig le'i steng du ting 'dzin sems dpa' snang mtha' dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung can gyi thugs kar hūm̐ dmar nag dang bcas pa gsal ba dang*/ spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas dbu rgyan bya khyung rigs lnga dang bcas pa gsal ba'o/ 'di dag ni skye srid dag pa sprul sku lam du khyer ba yin la/ gtso bo'i sku bsgom pa/ de las yum bsgom pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa rnams ma las rim par gzhi dus su byis pa btsas pa dang*/ nar son nas 'dod pa'i tshor bas gdung ste chung ma len pa/ sgo gsum gyi nus pa rim gyis 'phel ba/ rang rig gi bya ba la dbang bsgyur ba rnams sbyong ba dang*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i dus sku bltams pa/ rab tu byung nas dka' thub mdzad pa/ de las byang chub snying por gshegs pa/ bdud btul te bsam gtan bskyed pa/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes pa rnams yin la/

lam gong ma'i tshe bde rlung stong sems las lha skur ldang ba/ lhan skyes kyi ye shes goms par byed pa dang*/ des mchog gi dngos grub la sbyor ba'i gzhi 'ding ba'i smin byed du 'gro'o/ de nas go cha'i lha dang sbyar bar spro na/ bdag nyid gu ru drag po'i spyi bo ru gshin rje'i gshed ser nag be con dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mgrin par hya ghṛ wa sku mdog dmar nag me dbyug dang lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga rang mdog can thams cad kyis gri thod 'dzin pa/ gsang bar yaksha me dbal sku mdog smug nag tho ba dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ kun kyang khro bo'i cha lugs dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rnams yongs su rdzogs par bsam/ yang rang gi yan lag bzhir kī la rigs bzhi rang mdog dur khrod chas ky-is brgyan zhing thams cad kyi phyag na ri rab phur bu bsgril zhing sku smad kyang phur pa'i dbal zur dang ldan pa/ gzhan yang rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer rtsa khams thams cad dpa' bo dpa' mo'i rang bzhin du gsal bar bya'o/ des phung khams skye mched thams cad gdan gsum lha yi dkyil 'khor du dag cing sbyong bar byed pa yin no/ de nas phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi steng du gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir ging chen bzhi cha lugs gtso bo dang mthun zhing*/ mtshams bzhir bya khyung bzhi phyogs mdog /de rnams gzhung las ches gsal bas ma spros so/ bar khyams la gnas yul gyi dpa' bo ḍākki/ sgor bzhir dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyi rang bzhin gdong can bzhi sdig pa chu srin phag dang khyung gdong bzhi ka gcer bu mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon zhing phyag na gri gug bhan dmar thogs pa srin mo'i gzugs can thams cad lcags sdig mgo dgu la zhon pa/ phyi rol du bka' gter srung ma lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa ye shes rig pa'i ngar dpung dang ldan zhing*/ de yi phyi rol du nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad yongs su kheng ba'i/

steng du bya khyung gi dmag tshogs sprin ltar 'thibs shing*/ bar du lcags sdig gi tshwa tshwa ser ltar 'dril ba/ 'og tu dug gi phag rgod bun ltar 'tshubs pa/ bskal pa'i me dpung dang rlung dmar 'tshubs shing steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon tshogs rgyal 'gong dam sri sogs dang*/ nad rims dal yams rnams 'dul ba'i gnyen po stobs kyi lha ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid du gsal zhing dur khrod brgyad dang srung 'khor rim bdun sogs snod bcud thams cad dag pa ye shes kyi rol pa chen por 'byams klas pa'i bdag nyid du gsal gdab bo/ de ltar sbyong byed 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed pa ni/ sbyang bya byis pa bu dang bu mo skyes pa sbyang bar byed/ sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sprul pa mtha' yas pa spro ba dang*/ 'khor rnams byang chub kyi go 'phang la bkod pa'i rang rigs su bskyed par mtshon pa yin no/ gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan 'dren zhing dbang bskur ba/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dbyer med du bsre ba la/ sbyong byed dam tshig gi 'khor lo gtso 'khor kun gyi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' thugs srog sa bon rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bcas bsgom pa yin la/ rang gi sgo gsum rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gyi rang bzhin du mos pa brtan pos gzhi 'bras sbrel ba'i nga rgyal bya/ sbyang bya byis pa'i lus ngag yid gsum nus pa'i rtsal nar son pa sbyang par byed/ sbyangs 'bras sku gsung thugs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par mnga' brnyes pa'i dgos pa dang*/ lam dus su khu rdul rlung gsum sku gsung thugs te/ de rnams kyi snyigs ma zad nas dwangs ma 'phel ba'i ye shes rgyud la skye ba'i gzhi 'ding ba'o/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum dang*/

sa bon dang bcas pa de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang rnga yab padma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad dbang drag rdo rje me 'bar lha tshogs kyi rnam par nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang bar spyan drangs/ de yang sku che ba rnams ri rab tsam/ chung ba rnams yungs 'bru tsam/ bar pa rnams rang gi lus kyi bong tshad tsam/ snang srid thams cad drag po'i rlung 'jigs pa'i 'brug sgra gnam lcags kyi thog dang tshwa tshwa khol ba'i shugs drag dang bcas byon par mos la/ khyad par gyi rdzas bdug spos btul rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra dang bcas te snyan pa'i dbyangs dang mos gus gdung ba drag pos spyan drangs pas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa'i steng gi nam mkhar srung 'khor me ri 'dab sbyar gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam pa ni sbyong byed dang*/ sbyang bya rang dang rigs mthun pa'i 'gro ba snga ma rnams dang blo gros kyi nus pa mnyam pa ste sbyong bar byed/ sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ye shes gcig tu gyur pa'i dgos pa yod do/ gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rigs lnga yab yum mnyam sbyor byang sems bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag dug lnga ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pas rigs kyi bdag po gtso bor byas te rigs lngas dbu brgyan pas thob bya rang gnas kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i nga rgyal bya/ 'dis sbyang bya byis pa de rtsa khams 'phel ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rnam rtog rags pa sbyong bar byed/ sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas pas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang thob pa'i dgos pa yod do/

nyon mongs pa'i bdud tshogs thams cad zil gnon ye shes kyi dpa' stobs bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa dang*/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gnyis chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin du dbye ba med par bzhag pa ni bzhugs gsol gyi don yin no/ des dam ye la mchog dman tha dad du 'dzin pa'i zhen rtog spong ba dang*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo nyid rang sems dbyer med du shes pa/ byin rlabs 'jug pa sogs kyi dgos pa yod do/ lam dus su dpe yi 'od gsal gyis don gyi ye shes mtshon par byed pa dang*/ 'khor 'das gnyis med kyi ye shes rgyud la skye ba'i gzhi 'ding ba'o/ bzhi pa gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod bstod bya ba ni/ lha dang rang sems dbyer med du rtogs pa lta ba mjal ba'i phyag dang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i rig rtsal mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis 'phrul dga'i longs spyod bzhin rang gis rang la spyod pa'am mos pa'i 'khor gyi gtso bo la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ gtso bos brda lan mdzad par bsam pa'o/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'dod yon gyi lha mo'i mchod pa'i sprin spros te nam mkha' gang ba'i dkyil 'khor la mchod cing gnas so sor thim par mos pa dang*/ khyad par drag po'i nyer mchod 'bul ba rnams phyi mchod dang*/ snang srid kyi rtsi bcud thams cad ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsir bskyil ba dza gad dpa' bo'i dam rdzas kyis thugs dam dgyes par stob pa sman mchod dang*/ 'khor 'das bde sdug bzang ngan gnyis 'dzin thams cad ye shes thugs rje'i mtshon chas gnyis med du ru tra byad ma bsgral ba'i mchod pa/ phung khams skye mched dang sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma bcas pa rngam drag dpal chen rol pa'i zhal du bstab par mos pa ni nang mchod/ yab yum rnams thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde stong dga' bzhi bskyed pa sbyor ba'i mchod pa/

ye nas mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul thams cad rang mdangs rig pa'i cho 'phrul gdod nas dag pa 'khor 'das dbyer med dus gsum mnyam pa chen po rtogs pa ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang*/ che ba'i yon tan gyi sgo nas 'khor gyi gtso bo la bstod pa dang*/ thugs rje ye shes kyi mtshan nyid mthong ba'i yi dam lha la 'du 'bral mi phyed pa'i spro ba skyes te rang rig rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i nga rgyal gyis che ba'i gzi byin bskyed pa ni bstod pa'o/ de ltar mchod bstod sogs sbyong byed yin la/ sbyang bya ni/ byis pa de bza' btung gos rgyan gnas khang sogs la ci dgar spyod cing*/ yul nor gyi bcad ris dang khe grags sgrub pa rnams te 'di dag dag par byed/ sbyangs 'bras ni sangs rgyas pa'i tshe na de nyid du mchod pa'i bkod pa mtha' yas pa'i sprin rtag tu 'byung ba dang phyag gi gnas mchod pa'i zhing bla na med pa nyid yin pas de nyid rdzogs par byed/ lam dus su rig pa brtul zhugs kyi rol rtsed la ci dgar spyod pa'i gzhi 'ding bas smin byed du 'gro'o/ gnyis pa gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor la lnga/ thog mar sku phyag rgya la dmigs pa'i dzap dgongs ni/ dmigs pa'i gtso bo lha'i snang zhen la bslab pa la/ rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa gsum/ dang po ni/ snga ma bskyed rim gyi khrid dngos yin la/ smin slob kyi dbang du byas na/ bris sku tshad ldan lta bu mdun du bshams la sems rtse gcig tu 'dzin/ sku hril por blta ba'am cha shas re re nas rim par bslab ste mthar sku yongs rdzogs bar dang*/ de las goms na yid kyi bsgoms shing snga ma ltar sems 'dzin/ mthar 'khor gzhal yas khang dang srung gur tshun chad la gsal snang bton zhing bsgom/ thams cad gsal bar ma nus na gtso bo kho na bsgoms pas kyang 'thus la nyi ma yod na 'od zer rang shugs kyis 'byung ba bzhin gtso bo gcig gis ye shes kyi sgyu 'phrul nyid du snang ba'i phyir ro/

gnyis pa rnam dag dran pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i gsal brtan gyi nyams skyes pa na/ gzhi 'bras sbrel ba'i dag pa'i bskyed rim mchog gi dngos grub kyi nye rgyur smin par bya ste/ de ltar gsal ba de yang dngos po rang mtshan can du bden par mi zhen par don rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la mdog dbyibs zhal phyag sogs kyi spros pa mi mnga' yang*/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi yon tan rnams gdul bya'i blo ngor mtshon byed kyi brda rtags su rten dang brten pa'i rnam par shar ba yin la/ de yang rten gzhal yas khang yang*/ rnam par byang ba'i yon tan byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun nyid rnam pa rten gzhal yas su shar ba yin no/ de bzhin du gnyug ma chos nyid kyi ngo bo gdod nas dag kyang rang bzhin gyi yon tan ma btsal lhun grub tu ye nas bzhugs pa nyid rnam pa rtags kyi phyag rgyar shar ba yin te/ mdor na rtog tshogs lha ru dag lha ye shes su dag /ye shes ni gzung 'dzin med pa'i chos sku la zhal phyag gi mtshan ma rdul tsam med kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan gzhan ngor 'bad med lhun grub tu shar ba'i rang bzhin phrin las 'dod rgur bsgyur ba yin no/ bye brag tu bshad na/ gsal ba yab la stong pa yum mam/ snang ba yab la stong pa yum dang*/ snang stong dbyer med kyi rol pa sras 'khor sprul pa'i rnam par shar ba yin/ de yang bla ma gu ru drag po padma he ru ka sku mdog dmar smug ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dbang dang drag po'i phrin las mthar phyin pa'i brda dang*/ dug gsum 'joms pa'i zhal gsum/ sku lnga ye nas rdzogs pa'i dbang rtags thod skam rigs lngas dbu la brgyan zhing stobs bcu rdzogs pa'i brdar dur khrod dpal gyi chas bcu dang ldan pa/ phyin drug rdzogs pa'i phyag drug gis dug lnga dang shes sgrib rtsad nas gcod pa'i brdar mtshon cha drug bsnams pa/ tshad med bzhi rdzogs pa'i zhabs bzhis sa lam myur du bgrod pa'i brdar bya khyung mthing nag me gshog can gyi steng du dor stabs kyis brdzis pa/

thabs shes zung 'jug mtshon pa'i brdar yum dang 'khril ba/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus shing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i brdar lha klu che dgu sogs draigs pa sde brgyad bsnol ba'i gdan dang*/ skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar padma/ thabs shes zung 'jug mtshon pa'i brdar zla ba dang nyi ma/ gzung 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pa'i brdar rgyal bsen dam sri pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan dang bcas pa gsal ba'o/ gong gsal lha klu rgyal bsen gyi gdan gsang sgrub du ma gsal yang mngon rtogs nad 'joms par bur gsungs pa bzhin spros pa yin no/ spro zhing nus na phyi rol rtsibs brgyad steng phyogs bzhir sku gsung thugs yon gyi ging bzhi/ mtshams bzhir phrin las bzhi mtshon pa'i khyung bzhi/ bar khyams la gnas yul gyi dpa' bo ḍākki/ sgor bzhir dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyi rang bzhin gdong can bzhi/ phyi rol du rol rtsal srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa gsal nus na rab dang*/ min yang thams cad nyi ma dang 'od zer bzhin gtso bo gcig gi ye shes kyi rol pa yin pas nyi ma yod na 'od zer rang shugs la rdzogs pa bzhin gtso bo gcig bsgoms pas 'thus so/ de yang las dang po pas de tsam mi nus pas/ lha'i gsal snang thebs tsam gyis mthar de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi thugs ye shes chen po'i rnam rol byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams mtshon byed kyi brda rtags su shar ba yin no snyam pa'i mos gus la gnas pas dag dran rjes mthun pa 'byung zhing*/ lha rang rgyud du 'dzin pa'i gol sa las ldog pa yin no/ mdor na gzugs kyi skur snang yang*/ chos sku'i rang bzhin las ma 'das par snang stong sgyu ma'i rol par rtsal sbyong ba la rnam dag dran pa zhes bya'o/ gsum pa nga rgyal brtan pa ni/ rang nyid gu ru drag po dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyi 'dzin stangs dang ma bral bar bslabs pas bar chad kyis mi tshugs shing bdag 'dzin 'jig pa'i dgos pa yod do/

de dag srog sdom gzer bzhi dang sbyar na/ bskyed pa lha yi gzer ro/ gnyis pa gsung yig 'bru la dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid padma drag po gsal ba de'i thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten gyi dbus bum pa'i gzhal yas su padma'i steng nyi zla gwa'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su ye shes sems dpa' phyag rdor mthing nag /rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub can bsgom pa ni sku/ de yi thugs kar dmar ser thig le'i steng du ting 'dzin sems dpa' snang ba mtha' yas dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung can bsgom pa ni gsung*/ de yi thugs kar gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar nag gis mtshan pa ni thugs/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od yon tan zer phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i bdag nyid du nges par byas nas/ ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ yig gi mthar rtsa ba'i sngags phreng 'khod pa la sems 'dzin pa zla ba skar phreng lta bu'i dgongs pa yin la/ skabs 'dir thog mar yid bzlas dang*/ 'byin 'jug rlung gi bzla ba'am rdor bzlas sogs la bslab cing gsal snang brtan par bya'o/ skyo tshe ngag bzlas la bslab pa ni/ bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ zhing khams rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba sras bcas mchod byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang dang dngos grub thams cad thob/ gzi brjid lhag par rgyas shing ma dag pa'i khams rnams su cig car du khyab/ khams gsum gyi dregs byed ma lus pa dbang du bsdus shing log rtog rnams zil gyis mnan/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can tshar bcad/ 'gro ba'i las sgrib mtha' dag bcom nas yi dam lha yi go 'phang la bkod/ snod gzhal yas khang bcud lha yi dkyil 'khor sgra grags sngags kyi rang bzhin/ dran rtog ye shes kyi rol par bsgyur la/ rdo rje srin po'i ngur sgras bzla bar bya ste 'di ni gtso bo bzlas pa sngags kyi gzer ro/

gsum pa thugs chos nyid la dmigs pa'i dzap dgongs ni/ thugs dmigs med nam mkha'i dkyil ltar dag pa rang bzhin gyi stong pa'i ngang las rig rtsal 'gag med dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum du gsal la rtog pa med par shar/ shar ba'i dus nyid nas rang bzhin med par dag pa/ skye med kyi ngang las rig pa 'dzin med tshogs drug lhug par bzhag ste bsam med mtha' bral dwangs sang nge ba'i ngang nas grags stong 'dzin med du bzla ba ni chos nyid rang grol gyi dgongs pa ste/ 'di ni dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gzer yin no/ 'di gsum ni gtso bor bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa yin la/ de yang thun gyi cha gsum du bcad pa'i dang po la sku phyag rgya/ gnyis par gsung yig 'bru/ gsum par thugs chos nyid la dmigs pa'i dzap dgongs la gtso bo bya bar gsungs so/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces grangs bsnyen las rung la 'bum phrag bcu gsum dang*/ dus kyi bsnyen pa bzhi cha bzla bar gsungs so/ de nas thun grub ma thag sku gsung thugs kyi nyams chag bshags phyir dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying po gsum gsum dang*/ mchod bstod nongs bshags sogs rjes kyi bya ba la 'jug par bya'o/ gsum pa thugs 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ bdag bskyed bsdu ba la/ bdag gi ye shes pa nam yang gshegs pa ma yin pas/ nyer bsdu'i tshig gis gsal gdab ste snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ de yang mtha' nas rim gyis tshur 'dus te 'khor gyi lha tshogs la thim/ 'khor rnams gtso bo yab yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ de thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de thugs srog hūm̐ la thim par bsams te/ de la sems bzung*/ de je phrar gyen rdzogs na dā'i bar yal bas dmigs pa med pa'i stong nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang la ji gnas su mnyam par bzhag pas rtag mtha' bsal lo/

yang na skad cig gis 'ja' tshon nam mkhar yal ba ltar bsdus kyang 'dra ste/ snga ma la rim gyis bsdu ba dang*/ phyi ma la cig car du bsdu ba yin na yang*/ las dang po pa'i tshe snga ma ltar gal che bar gsungs so/ de ltar yang chos dbyings las bskyed/ chos dbyings la gnas/ chos dbyings la longs spyod/ chos dbyings su thim pas na snang stong 'gal med kyi don la nges shes 'drongs dgos pa yin no/ de dag gi snod bcud rang mtshan du 'dzin pa tha mal gyi zhen rtog gi gnyen po lhar snang sgyu ma'i snang zhen de 'od gsal gyi dbyings su bsdu ba la rdzogs rim zhes bya ste/ 'chi srid chos skur sbyong ba'i nyams len gnad yin pas 'dor du mi rung ngo*/ de nas de las ldang ba ni rtsa sngags tshar gcig brjod pa'i rkyen gyis rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha sku phyag rgya gcig pa'i rnam par ldang bas chad mtha' bsal nas gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pas sku gsung thugs rdo rjer byin gyis brlab/ spyi bor haṃ bkod la de zhu ba'i rgya gram gyis go bgo /mdzub rtse la khro bo gnyis bskyed de lus srung*/ dbu rgyan dang cod pan bcing ste shin tu brtan par bya ba'ang gsungs/ gang ltar yang srung ba'i 'khor lo gsal gdab pa nas/ bsngo smon bkra shis kyi bar bya'o/ thun rjes ma rnams su srung 'khor sogs 'don min ci rigs snang yang dmigs pas gsal 'debs tsam byas pa gal che la/ mchod rlob nas bsnyen pa'i bar sngar ltar byas pas chog /cho ga yang 'bring po gsang sgrub dang bsdu na nad 'joms par bu chog khrigs ltar byas pas chog la/ bsnyen dmigs man chod ni sngon ma ltar bya dgos so/ dmigs bsal phyi thun gyi skabs dbyings phyug zhi drag mtshon pa'i rang lugs gsol kha rgyas bsdus long khom dang bstun/ bsngo smon sogs rgyas par bya/ tshogs mchod ni thog mtha' gnyis dang bar skabs kyi yar mar tshes bcu tsam las rgyun du mi dgos/

bsnyen mtshams dbu tshugs nas ma grol bar lhag ma phyir mi gtong*/ bsnyen pa'i grangs rtags thems nas dngos grub blang ba'am min kyang sgrub pa la 'jug pas kyang rung ngo*/ gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ dang po yo byad bsham bkod la/ thog mar dkyil 'khor ras bris bkram pa'i steng tshom bu lha grangs ltar bkod pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar dbang bzhi rim par brtsegs pa'i rgyab bam gang rung du/ sku rten/ sgrub gtor/ chos skyong gi rten gtor/ chad brtan rgyun bzhag sogs legs par bkod/ dngos gzhi sgrub thabs gsol 'debs nas bstod pa mjug rdzogs pa'i bar bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar la/ dmigs bsal dzap khang dbye ba ni/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ

sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/ zhes se gol gtogs pas gsal gdab la bdag mdun dbyer med du dmigs nas dzap bskul dang*/ bsnyen dmigs mthar bsnyen pa khyug tsam bzlas nas sgrub dmigs la bdag nyid dam tshig sems dpa' sum brtsegs dang bcas pa gsal ba'i thugs srog hūm̐ dmar nag las sngags phreng yig 'bru rnams langs stabs kyis gcig gi zhabs su gcig gi dbu tshud pa/ gcig rjes gcig gnon lu gu rgyud kyi tshul du reg la ma 'byar zhing bar ma chad pa'i phreng ba 'phros te/ sngags kyi rang sgra dang bcas/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig sems dpa'i zhal nas rim par thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs sku'i nang brgyud/ mkha' gsang dang nor bu'i lam nas brgyud de bde chen byang sems kyi ngo bor thugs srog la thim pas/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam zhing*/ slar yang snga ma ltar bar ma chad par 'khor bar bsams la bzla'o/ yang yum gyi zhal nas sngags phreng rnams yab kyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar zhugs/ dhū tir brgyud de zhal nas thon rang gi zhal du zhugs pa snying ga'i sa bon la thim/ yang de las sngar ltar du lha mo'i padmar zhugs shing 'khor ba sogs ni do li ste khyogs kyi bzlas pa'o/ thun rer de gnyis spel na legs pas/ snga dro dang srod la tshur 'khor ba dang*/ nyin gung phyi dro phar 'khor bar bsgom na 'khor lo'i bzlas pa zhes gegs sel dang bogs 'don pa la zab pa'i man ngag go /de bzhin du mdun bskyed yab yum gyi bar dang bdag mdun gnyis kyi bar bcas la 'di bzhin sbyar te sngags phreng spro bsdu bya la 'gal me klad skor lta bu'i dgongs pa la bslab ste sgrub sngags artsig bzla'o/

hūm̐ sgrub bya zhing hūm̐ ci nus bzlas/ sgrub pa'i bsnyen pa grangs ni bsnyen pa'i bcu cha lon par bya'o/ 'khor sngags ging bzhi khyung lnga khro mo sha za bzhi phag sdig khyung sngags rnams sgrub pa grub nye'i skabs sgrub sngags kyi rjes su bzla ba yin la nyin bdun mam yang na grangs khri re tsam bzla'o/ de nas thun grub ma thag sku gsung thugs kyis nyams chag bshags phyir dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying po gsum gsum dang*/ mchod bstod nongs bshags sogs rjes kyi bya ba bsnyen pa dang mtshungs so/ sgrub pa'i skabs nyin re bzhin tshogs mchod kyang grub na legs pas de ltar bya/ gsum pa las sbyor gyi dmigs pa ni/ sgrub pa thems nas las sbyor la 'jug pa yin yang deng sang de ltar bya mkhan dkon la spyir btang ltar sgrub pa phal cher grub la nye ba'i skabs/ sgrub sngags rnams sngar ltar cung zad song ba'i mthar las sbyor gyi dmigs gnad dang 'brel sham bu'i tshul du sbyar ba yin la/ sbyar tshul ni/ las bzhi spyi 'gros ltar sbyar ba dang khyad par gyi las sbyor srung bzlog bsad gsum dang yan lag ci rigs spros pa'o/ dang po rang nyid padma drag po gsal ba'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' dkar gsal shel sgong lta bu g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa sku smad dar dkar gyi sham thabs sogs rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa thugs srog rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar po'i mthar sngags phreng dkar po las 'od zer 'phros skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du bsags pa'i a 'thas las ngan bag chags thams cad gzhob tu byas pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ nyon mongs kyis 'ching ba'i rtsa mdud phra rags dang bcas pa khrol bas/ las kyi rlung dag 'khrul pa zad/ rten 'brel thams cad phyogs med du 'char/ khams gsum rigs drug gi ngan goms dug lnga'i rang mdangs kyi bag rdul cha tsam med par ka nas dag cing 'khor 'das chos sku thig le nyag gcig tu stong par dmigs la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐: oṃ shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o/ nyin phyed rgyas pa'i dus/ rang nyid padma drag po gsal ba'i thugs kar skad cig gis ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog ser po gnod sbyin sgeg pa'i tshul 'chang ba g.yas rin chen dang g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sku smad la dar dmar sham thabs sogs rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa thugs srog rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ ser po'i mthar sngags phreng gser btso ma'i mdog can las/ 'od zer tshwa rngam cig car du 'phros pas phyi snod 'byung lnga'i khams kyi dug rnams gzhil/ dwangs ma bcud du 'khyil ba dngos po'i legs tshogs thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus pas/ gtso 'khor thams cad bde chen zag med kyi nyams rgyas te/ zung 'jug tu sbyor bas snang srid 'byung ba'i rang sgra thams cad a haṃ du bsgrags/ khyad par lha klu mi dang mi min drang srong rig 'dzin nyi zla la sogs tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang snyan grags sogs 'dod rgu zag med kyi phywa g.yang thams cad ye shes 'od lnga'i rnam pa char ltar babs te/ 'chi med rdo rje'i rol pa chen por 'byams klas pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐: bhrūm̐ puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o/ dgong mo dbang gi dus su/ rang nyid padma drag po gsal ba'i thugs kar skad cig gis ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dmar po khro chags kyi tshul 'chang ba/ g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin zhing dar dang rin po che'-i rgyan sna tshogs bklubs shing khams gsum srid gsum mdor na 'khor 'das kyi phyag rgya thams cad dbang du bsdus nus pa'i dpa' zil can du bskyed pa'i thugs srog rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar po'i mthar sngags phreng padma rā ga'i mdog can las/ 'od zer dmar po sbubs mchu'i rnam pa can tshwa ba'i dbal ngar dang ldan par 'phros pa tsam gyis/

phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ji snyed dang dbyer med par/ snang ba thams cad bder gshegs zhi khro longs sku'i sgyu 'phrul mngon par rol pa dang*/ rtog med kyi ngang mdangs chen pos ma rig pa thams cad bcom ste pha rol gyi tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor pa sogs/ zag med kyi bcud dang srid zhi 'khor 'das kyi che btsan thams cad kyi srog gis 'od zer sbubs mchus 'ub kyis bsdus nas/ thugs srog gi zhabs su bstims shing*/ nam yang mi shigs pa chos nyid stong pas rgyas thebs pa ste/ snang srid thams cad dmar ltems ltems/ 'ja' 'od kyi li li'i ngang nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐: hrīḥwā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o/ srod drag po'i mthar/ rang nyid padma drag po gsal ba'i thugs kar skad cig gis ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog ljang 'od g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje gdeng stabs dang g.yon phur pa gzir stabs su 'chang zhing*/ dor stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ sku la ber dang sham thabs sogs dur khrod chas kyis brjid pa/ khro zhing gtum pa'i gar gyis srid gsum 'dar zhing sngangs nus pa zhig gsal ba'i thugs srog rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ ljang nag gi mthar sngags phreng ljang nag las/ 'od zer ljang zhing rtsub pa/ lci zhing 'thas pa ka gdung tsam 'phros pas srid pa gsum gyi dregs byed bdud tshogs log 'dren drag po rnams dang*/ khyad par dam sri rgyal bsen thams cad 'od zer tsha bar mi bzod pas snying khrag lhud kyis phyung zhing*/ stobs dang nus pa thams cad nyams te/ ci dgos pa'i bka' dang dam la gnas te/ nye bar 'tshe ba'i zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs rnams la thogs rdugs med par mngon spyod drag po'i tshul gyis bsgral zhing*/ ming shul tsam yang lhag med du rol pa'i dam tshig nos par bsams pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐:

hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ de ltar zhi rgyas dbang drag so so'i dmigs gnad dang 'od zer spro bsdu'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i tshul ni 'phro 'du phrin las kyi gzer yang yin no/ de ltar las sbyor rnams dus bzhi'am yang na nyin re bzhin sbyar bas 'thus la gong gsal de rnams las bzhi spyi 'gros ltar yin gyi gzhan du dbang drag sogs dmigs bya khyad par can dang sbyar ba'i rim pa yang yod pas zhal las shes par bya'o/ khyad par gyi las sbyor srung bzlog bsad gsum las/ dang po snga thun la srung dmigs bya ba ni/ skad cig gis rang nyid dpal chen khro rgyal zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi gyad kyis dor stabs su bya khyung brdzis pa: yum dbyings phyug gtum mor 'khyud c-ing bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: phyi rol rdo rje dang ral gri me dpung 'bar ba'i gur chen po: bskal pa'i rlung bgrod du med pa bar snang thams cad lcags sdig dang bya khyung sbrul nag dug gi phag rgod rnams kyis gtams pas: nang du khro bo rdo rje drag po dkar gsal rdo rje dang gri thod 'dzin pa dpag tu med pas srung ba'i sngags sgra sgrogs shing che ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur: oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa: bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūm̐ dmar nag 'bar ba'i rang bzhin can: thig le'i nang du bla ma snang ba mtha' yas: zla tshes la thod phreng yab yum: mgo sked la bdag srog nṛ yig ljang ku: ha khog tu bsrung bya pho thams cad g.yas: mo thams cad g.yon: zhabs kyu'i nang du zhing khang nor rdzas rnams chud de srung ba'i rang bzhin phyi rol sngags rnams rang sgra dang bcas te 'khor bar mos la/ srung sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā gu ru padma he ru ka dzñā na ghṛ wa kro ti shwa rī ma ma nṛ bhrūm̐ bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig: badzra rakṣa swā hā: zhes ci nus bzlas/ de nas phyi thun la bsad dmigs ni/

mdun du brub khung gi steng du gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rno ngar lci zhing 'thas pa g.yas su 'khor zhing 'og phyogs srid pa'i gzhi 'dzin khro chu zhun ma'i 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor ba: spu gri'i so 'thab drag tu bskyod pas byad ma rnams sha khrag dmar nyil nyil gtub pa la: las kyi pho nya rnams hab sgra di ri ri 'tshub cing zos par bsam: yang phyi rol zlog byed kyi khro bos zlog sngags dang bsad sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs par mos la/ bsad sngags ni/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma nṛ tri trig nan e hur thum badzra rbad bhyoḥ oṃ trig khroṃ bhyoḥ mā ra du byad ma zlog zlog: ces bzlas/ srod thun la bzlog dmigs ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen phyag rgya yongs rdzogs pa: stong gsum zil gnon 'jig rten g.yo zhing 'khrugs: sde brgyad gnod byed sgab 'dre rbod gtong rnams: dbang med 'dar chum bla rten srog yid 'phrog: zlog byed khro tshogs drag sngags stobs ldan pas: byad ma rang gshed dbab nas brlag par gyur: zhes gsungs pa bzhin dmigs pa phog la zlog sngags ni/ oṃ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ: āḥhūm̐: byad ma nṛ tri trig nan: e thum dza rbad bhyoḥ oṃ trig khroṃ bhyoḥ mā ra ya du byad ma zlog: bhyo mā ra ya rbad: hūm̐ bandhe sha ya myog: mya lo sha ya rbad: ti lo sha ya rbad: nu lo sha ya rbad: bandhe brag tshal pa: srog rtsa chod: snying rtsa chod: rtsad nas chod: drungs nas phyungs: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la rbod gtong phur kha gnod pa thams cad dam nyams dgra la a mu ka phyes: phye mar phur ya dzaḥ shing tring mā ra ya rbad: ces zlog sngags ci mang bzlas mthar thal rdeb ni/ na mo: bla ma sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong byin rlabs dang : gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la:

sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen: chag che nyam nga rmi ltas rtsub: rbod gtong rbad 'dre zor thun hom̐: byad phur gtad khram phung sel ngan: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang : stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi tshogs: sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi: bdud sde dpung dang bcas pa rnams: bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: dgra bgegs steng du mā ra ya: nṛ tri sha truṃ hur thum dzaḥ bhyo bhyo zlog zlog hūm̐ yaṃ phaṭḥ yang dmigs bsal nad rims dang gdon bgegs 'joms pa'i las sbyor la rtsal 'don na/ rang nyid che mchog padma khrag 'thung du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas las kyi ging bzhi sprul pa'i khyung lnga sgrol ba'i ma mo bzhi khro bo rang 'dra dang bcas nas skar mda' 'khrugs pa ltar: me dpung gi rang bzhin 'bar zhing stong khams khengs par 'phros pas: nad nad bdag dang bcas pa hub hub ljib ljib tu zos nas lhag ma med pa rdul du brlags par bsam: yang lcags sdig nag po bye ba dung phyur 'phros shing rgyal nad srog rlung du gyur pa rnams brlags par bsams la nad 'joms par bu'i las sngags gnyis kyang sbyar la/ dang po las sngags nad 'joms ni/ oṃ ma hā gu ru khroṃ ka ra ging ka ra tsa mun tri ta ya: ka la dunti tsitta la bhyo bhyoḥ oṃ she la du ging rā dza shig shig: nā ga du na dunti tri zlog zlog: oṃ a ka tsa tu mā ra ya rbad rbad: raksha du tri snying la bhyo bhyoḥ tsha ba tsha nad mā ra ya nan nan: oṃ du na du na shig shig: hag tshal pa kha la dunti bhyo bhyoḥ ha ching rba du tri kha la bhyo bhyoḥ spel tshig sbyar: tsitta zung zung yaṃ yaṃ rmug rmug: chum chum baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad rbad: gnyis pa las sngags nad bdag 'joms byed ni/ oṃ du ching nag po nad bdag gi srog la rbad rbad: pra ching nag po bdun drug gi sha la zo zo: khro chu khol ma rgya nad kyi snying la bhyo bhyoḥ bya khyung nag po rgyu gzer gyi snying la rbad rbad:

lcags sdig nag po rgyal bsen gyi srog la chum chum: phag nag khro gtum rims yams kyi dbugs la sdud sdud: trig khroṃ nag po sha khol gyi snying la bhyo bhyoḥ bhe tri nag po khrag skyug gi nad la thum thum: artsig nag po dmar bshal gyi srog la rngub rngub: ka ru nag po rgya 'brum gyi nad la shig shig: khe tra nag po rgyug gzer gyi srog la hur hur: yaksha nag po 'go nad kyi srog la rbad rbad: trig khroṃ ra tsa khrag skyug gi nad la rbad rbad: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa pañtsa 'byung lnga'i nad la shig shig: nad bdag rims bdag pho mo myog myog dril dril: thun thun rbad rbad swā hā: zhes gang mang dang bzlas la dmigs bsal rdzas dang srung ba sogs yod na de la sngags gdab/ gzhan yang rgyal bsen dam sri srin mo 'byung po sogs ar la gtad pa dang*/ mnan bsreg 'phang ba sogs mngon spyod kyi las sbyor 'dod na spyi ltar bya la skabs 'dir bsnyen sgrub dkyus ma'i dmigs rnam gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ gzhan thun dang sngon rjes rnams bsnyen pa dang phyogs mtshungs so/ rjes kyi bya ba la/ dang po/ sgrub pa sang grol rgyu'i de ring gi dgong thun mjug tu dngos grub kyi rdzas gsar pa bshams la srod thun bzlas pa'i gsham du/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs te/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i rnam par bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim pas ye shes mchog gi gzi byin 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ kā ya wākka tsitta gu na karma sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes btags pa brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ phyir nangs thor thun la phrin las gzhung bsrangs te/ bzlas pa kha skong mchod bstod bcas grub nas gsol kha khyug tsam btang nas skong bshags tshogs mchod bsgral bstab bar gzhung ltar la skabs 'dir dngos grub la mi dbang zhing blta nyan gyi bgegs tshar bcad pa'i phyir bgegs bskrad srung 'khor byin 'bebs bcas bya/

de nas ye shes lha la 'khon gcugs bshags phyir gnong 'gyod drag pos ye shes sku mchog ma/ yig brgya bcas song nas dngos grub blang ba dngos la 'jug pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs dam rjes su dgongs te sku'i gnas dang sbyor mtshams nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub rnams kyang byang sems bdud rtsi 'od zer 'bar ba'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bdag la thim pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsams la/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes btags pa brgya stong bzlas mthar gzhung gi dngos grub blang ba'i tshig brjod la/ sgrub rten lhar gsal ba'i gnas rnams nas 'od zer sna lnga rang gi gnas lngar thim pas mi zad rgyan 'khor lnga dang thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsams la/ sgrub rten rnams gnas lngar gtugs shing bdud rtsi myang*/ dngos grub kyi rdzas cha gsum du bgos pa'i phud dang po dkyil 'khor gyi lhar phul/ cha gcig sbyin sreg gi rdzas la bsre/ cha gcig rang gis longs spyod par bya'o/ de nas chad lhag kha skong rtsa sngags kyi bcu cha me mchod bya bar gsungs pa bzhin nyin 'di rang du dbu 'dzugs par mos na skabs 'dir bsnyen sgrub kha skong zhi ba'i sreg blugs zla ba'i bdud rtsi ltar bya'o/ de nas dngos grub kyi rdzas dang tshogs la rol nas lhag gtor skabs sngar btson 'dzin byas pa'i lhag ma rnams kyang lhan cig tu spungs la phyir gtong*/ chos skyong gtor 'bul dus gtor ma rnams yang thog lta bur phul/ chad brtan la rgyun bzhag gtor ma phyir bskyang zhing rta bro brdung*/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas par byas la nongs pa bshags/ mdun rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/

dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bdag gi rnal 'byor yang 'od gsal du bsdu zhing rgyun spyod go bgo la nang mtshams bkrol/ phyi mtshams rgyal tho sogs yod na bsdu zhing nang du logs la bsngo smon dang shis brjod gang rgyas byas te thog mar dam tshig gcig pa rnams dang 'phrad la de nas rim gyis gzhan la 'phrad par bya ba yin la/ rjes su yang gtang rag tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang chos skyong gi skong gsol sogs mtha' rgyas par bya la bkra shis dge legs kyi ngang du grol bar bya'o/

zhes bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi bsnyen sgrub kyi yi ge grub gnyis 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di yang ring lugs 'di nyid kyi bstan zhabs su skyes shing bstan pa'i sri zhu sgrub pa'i mos pa mi phyed pa ldan yang chos nor gyi 'khos pa zhan pas ci bya ltos med du gyur te long bas long ba khrid pa'i dpe ltar lam 'dir zhugs par 'dod pa'i gang zag bdag 'dra'i blun rmongs kyi rigs can rnams la phan par bya ba'i ched du dmigs te/ rang gzhung gi dgongs pa gtso bor bzung zhing rigs mthun gzhan dang yang gong bstun rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub spyi 'gros ltar bkod pa'i tshul yin yang spyir bskyed rdzogs yon tan gyi nar ma son zhing lag len myong ba phra bas tshig don gnyis la nor 'khrul chu gnyer bzhin mu med pa yod nges pas bstan 'dir lhag pa'i bsam pa ldan pa'i mkhyen dpyod can dag gis ci nas kyang dag bcos yong bar snying thag pa nas gsol ba lan brgyar 'debs pa yin pas de lugs bzhin thugs brtse'i spyan ras yangs pos btsa' ba mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes pa'ang ma hā gu ru padma saṃ bha wa nyid mchog gi rig 'dzin mngon du brnyes pa'i sgrub gnas bal yul yang le shod kyi char bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs srid pa'i lha klu gnyan gsum bka' dam gyi rtsis su phab pa'i gnas mchog a su ra mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ke'u tshang dang 'dabs 'brel ba'i gnam lcags sgrub sde gsang sngags phur pa gling zhes rtse mor rdo rje'i brag ri ba gam brling zhing brjid chags pa/ bar du ljon shing sna tshogs phang phung du g.yo zhing tshar du dngar bar 'khri shing dang lcug phran gyi drwa ba bres par me tog sna tshogs gyi chun po'i mgo bo ldam ldem du gar rtsed bsgyur zhing bya rigs sna tshogs kyi skad snyan gyi 'gyur khug lhang lhang du sgrogs pa/ g.yas g.yon du rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyi gsung dbyangs dang ḍā dril gyi sgra skad sing sing du sgrogs pa'i gnas mchog ga la ba der gnas pa'i sgrub brtson au ḍīs thun khang du gang gis gsung bskul bzhin sgo chen rgyal ba'i sprul rabs lnga pa'i ming 'dzin o rgyan gsang sngags bstan pa 'dzin pa'i ming du btags kyang don gyi rkang 'dren pa des smras rim bzhin glog klad 'phrul gyi do ra ru lcug phran sor mo'i gar pa bskul ba po nyid kyis bgyis shing rab byung bcu bdun shing pho sprel gyi cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba dang po'i dus tshes la grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang dman pa rnams la phan thogs shing mkhas pa rnams thugs bskul ba'i g.yab mo ru gyur cig/

// ༄༅/ /bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi /rdzogs rim snying po'i yang bcud bzhugs so/ rang rig bla ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ bla ma drag po'i spros med rdzogs rim nyams su len pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po/ gnas dben par nges 'byung dang byang chub sems kyi kun nas bslangs te rnam g.yeng dang 'du 'dzi spangs la rtse gcig tu bsgom par bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi rdzogs rim la gnyis/ thun mong dang thun min no/ dang po la'ang gnyis te mtshan bcas dang mtshan med do/ dang po mtshan bcas ni/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ rdzogs rim thugs ka'i hūm̐ dmar kho na la: rlung yig rig pa dril la mdung tshugs gtad: ces pa bzhin/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ thog mar byang chub sems bskyed la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rtsal du bton zhing bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems bsre/ de nas lus rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrangs/ sems kyi gang yang mi dmigs par/ rang gi mdun du bla ma drag pos bris sku'am/ thugs srog hūm̐ yig dmar po bris pa la rab gnas bya/ de nas nye ring mig gi blta bde ba'i sar bzhag /de kho na la sems gtad de lus mi 'gul/ mig mi 'dzum/ bar rlung cung zad bzung*/ mdor na rlung yig rig pa gnad gcig tu dril te shes pa mdung tshugs su gtad cing blo yi spros rtog dang bral ba'i ngang ye re seng nger bzhag par bya'o/ gnyis pa mtshan med ni/ de la goms na sku dang hūm̐ sogs yid ngor lhag ger 'char bar sems 'dzin gyi rten tsam byas nas bsgom pas chog go /de ltar legs par goms na zhi gnas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams mu med par 'char zhing sems 'khrul rtog rba rlabs rang sar zhi nas sems kyi rang bzhin chu bo'i ngang dwangs pa bzhin gsal stong brjod pa dang bral ba'i nyams skye bar 'gyur ro/ skabs su rtsal sbyong ba ni/ hūm̐ sgra sgrogs shing snang srid thams cad hūm̐ gis gang bar bsam/

yang res 'ga' hūm̐ rnams gnas 'gyur te khro bo khro mo'i gang bar bsam/ yang skabs 'gar khro bo khro mo rnams gnas 'gyur te hūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan gyis snang srid kyi khyon thams cad khengs par bsgom/ skabs su rang bzhin 'ub kyis bdag la bsdu ba dang mi dmigs gsal stong ka dag ngang la yun ring du gnas par bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi spros med nyams len ni/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ 'das pa 'gags shing ma 'ongs ma skyes pa'i: da lta'i shes pa rig stong lam du khyer: zhes gsungs pa bzhin lus gnad sogs sngar ltar 'dra la dmigs pa'i gnad bla ma'i rnal 'byor rtsal du bton te dbang bzhi blangs shing thugs yid bsres la mnyam par bzhag /de yi tshe ci yang dran med thom me ye re kun gzhi lung ma bstan du song ba'ang ma yin la/ mi rtog pa'i nyams had de ba de sgom du 'dod pa'ang ma yin/ rnam rtog mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu 'di yang sgom du 'dod pa ma yin zhing*/ rnam rtog ched du bkag pa'ang ma yin par gang shar gyi rnam rtog la gcer gyis bltas pas yul snang ma 'gags kyang der 'dzin rtog pa med par sa le hrig ge 'di ka'i thog bzo mi 'chos par lhod kyis klod la 'jog pa ste/ mdor na 'das pa'i rnam rtog gi rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i rnam rtog gi mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i shes pa skad cig ma de la blo yi bsgyur bcos spu tsam yang ma byas pa gnyug ma'i gshis kyi gnas lugs rig stong rjen pa de kho na nyid du la bzla bar bya'o/ rjes thob tu tshogs drug gi snang ba gang shar sgyu ma lta bu'i lam 'khyer la slob dgos te/ de'ang gter gzhung las/ bdud dang dam sri rgyal 'gong la sogs pa: thams cad sems kyis snang ba kho na ste: zhes gsungs pas bdud thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa yin zhing de las gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba mched de/ de la nang du chags sdang a 'thas su shar bas phyi ru zhe sdang pho gdon dam sri dang rgyal 'gong*/

'dod chags mo gdon dang bsen mo/ gti mug klu gdon la sogs pa rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i dbang gis ji ltar shar yang don la thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'phrul 'khrul pa'i snang ba kho na tsam ste/ rnam rtog las gzhan pa'i sems zhes grub pa rdul tsam yang med do/ yang gter gzhung las/ sems la ngo bo ngos bzung mtshan ma med: gsungs pa bzhin/ sems kyi ngo bo la tshur bltas na 'di yin 'di min zhes smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das shing ngos bzung dang mtshan ma med de rgyud las/ rtsa ba med pa'i sems nyid la/ /bstsal bas mi rnyed ngos bzung med/ /ji bzhin ye yin stong pa'i ngang*/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin bzod nas stong nyid las 'da' ba med do/ yang gter gzhung las/ stong gsal don gyi padma khrag 'thung che: gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang rig 'di ka rang : 'khor 'das gnyis med chen por la bzla'o: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rang byung gi ye shes gdod nas ngo bo stong pa/ stong bzhin du rang bzhin gyi gsal cha ma 'gags par stong gsal rig pa'i snying po can thugs rje'i rang rtsal rang shar rang grol gyi ngang la rang babs su 'jog pa las/ don dam gyi padma khrag 'thung zhes che che gnyan gnyan zhig gzhan nas mi 'tshol bar dus gsum gyi rtog pas ma bslad da lta'i shes pa bzo bcos thams cad dang bral ba'i rang byung gi rig pa 'di ka rang du shes na 'khor 'das la bzang ngan dang spang blang gyi bya ba rdul tsam med pas gnyis med ye grol chen por la bzla bar bya'o/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ de ltar goms 'dris brtan pa thob pa na: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i chos kun zil gyis gnon: rdo rje he ru ka dpal mngon sum 'gyur: de ltar dpyad 'jog spel ma'i tshul gyis goms shing 'dris par byas pas rim gyis brtan pa thob par 'gyur la/ des na gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i chos kun nyi mas mun pa bcom pa ltar bdag med ye shes rdo rjes zil gyis gnon zhing log rtog bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje he ru ka dpal mngon sum du 'gyur bar gdon mi za ba nyid do/

de ltar bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gi rdzogs rim snying po'i yang bcud gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang zab gnad rgya mtsho las/ bdag blo ku sha'i rtse mo'i cha shas kyi cung zad blangs te/ ma hā gu rus srid pa'i lha 'dre che dgu rdo rje'i bka' gtsigs su phab pa'i gnas/ a su ra brag phug gi nye 'dab e wam̐ sgrub sder gsang sngags 'dzin pa 'jam dpal rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sgrub brtson rdo bla o rgyan ming gis bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ / tshe sgrub padma gsang thig gi: tshe dpal 'gugs dang dngos grub len chog bzhugs so: de nas tshe gtor dang tshe rdzas thogs la: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings rdo rje mi 'gyur klong yangs nas: padma dbang chen tshe bdag he ru kaḥ ḍākki tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mkha' spyod dag pa 'chi med gnas nas bzhengs: sngon tshe rig 'dzin gsang ba'i tshe sgrub ltar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la stsal du gsol: ngo mtshar rmad byung yid 'ong lha yi gter: 'dod pa'i re skong 'chi med bdud rtsi'i srid: kun 'byung dngos grub rtsa ba mchog stsol la: 'dzad med rgyud 'dzin smin pa'i dbang mchog bskur: zhes rtsa sngags bzlas shing dbang bskur: dngos grub kyang zhu/ de nas tshe ril thogs la: hūm̐: byin rlabs rtsa ba rgyud kun gcig bsgril ba: 'jigs bral rdo rje tshe srid 'byung ba'i rdzas: padma 'byung gnas yab yum ngo bo mchog: kun 'byung gdod nas zas mchog ril bu'i rdzas: dam rdzas bcud len snying po don thob shog: oṃ gu ru ḍākki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dzñā na ma ma wā shaṃ siddhi dza dzaḥ tshe chang thogs la/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dbyings nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun: kun 'byung byang sems thugs dam rgyud bskul ba: mkha' las rang byung rig pa'i bdud rtsi mchog: skal ldan rtsa rlung snang ba gong 'phel rdzas: bde drod 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dbang thob shog:

oṃ gu ru ḍākki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dzñā na ma ma wā shaṃ siddhi dza dzaḥ mda' dar thogs nas/ hūm̐ dzaḥ shar phyogs rdo rje rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: chu la dbang bsgyur ḍākki mas: rdo rje tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog rdo rjes rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru? mda' dar/ hūm̐ hūm̐: lho phyogs rin chen rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: sa la dbang bsgyur ḍākki mas: rin chen tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog ratnas rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru? mda' dar: hūm̐ baṃ: nub phyogs padma rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: me la dbang bsgyur ḍākki mas: padma tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog padmas rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru? mda' dar: hūm̐ hoḥ byang phyogs las kyi rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: rlung la dbang bsgyur ḍākki mas: karma tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog rgya gram rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru ḍākki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dzñā na ma ma wā shaṃ siddhi dza dzaḥ mda' dar: hūm̐ hrīḥ dbus phyogs dbyings kyi rig ma'i gtso: nam mkha' dbang bsgyur ḍākki ma: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: buddha tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog g.yung drung rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru? de nas rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rgya: longs sku mi 'gyur padma'i rgya: sprul sku mi 'gyur g.yung drung rgya: ḍākki mi 'gyur 'khor lo'i rgya: gter srung mi 'gyur phyag mtshan rgya: tshe srog mi 'gyur go khrab rgya: ye shes mi shigs stong nyid rgya: rim bdun sra brtan 'jigs med kyis: skal ldan tshe srog brtan gyur cig: oṃ gu ru ḍākki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dzñā na ma ma wā shaṃ siddhi dza dzaḥ rtsa sngags rgyas gdab ste rab gnas 'thor: zab gsang padma thugs bcud kyi: 'chi med rdo rje'i go khrab 'di:

thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya srung rol pa skya bdun rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ gis rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa'i mgul 'od gsal rdo rje'i phug nas gdan drangs pa shog ser kyus mtho gang zheng sor bzhi nas bkra shis nyin par phab pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// //
